    cy: Float,
    baseRadius: Float,
    style: Int,
    tSec: Float,
    alphaScale: Float,
  ) {
    val aScale = alphaScale.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    if (aScale <= 0.02f) return
    val spinDeg = (tSec * 44f) % 360f

    when (style.coerceIn(0, 3)) {
      1 -> {
        val rOuter = baseRadius * 1.12f
        val rInner = baseRadius * 0.94f
        cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 2.6f
        cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((235f * aScale).roundToInt(), 250, 204, 21)
        canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, rOuter, cosmeticStrokePaint)
        cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 1.6f
        cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((200f * aScale).roundToInt(), 254, 240, 138)
        canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, rInner, cosmeticStrokePaint)
        for (i in 0 until 6) {
          val a = (spinDeg + i * 60f) * PI.toFloat() / 180f
          val ca = cos(a)
          val sa = sin(a)
          val px = -sa
          val py = ca
          val tipX = cx + ca * (rOuter + 12f)
          val tipY = cy + sa * (rOuter + 12f)
          val baseX = cx + ca * (rOuter + 2f)
          val baseY = cy + sa * (rOuter + 2f)
          cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 2.5f
          cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((245f * aScale).roundToInt(), 254, 240, 138)
          canvas.drawLine(baseX + px * 6f, baseY + py * 6f, tipX, tipY, cosmeticStrokePaint)
          canvas.drawLine(baseX - px * 6f, baseY - py * 6f, tipX, tipY, cosmeticStrokePaint)
        }
      }
      2 -> {
        val rOrbit = baseRadius * 1.10f
        cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 2.2f
        cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((205f * aScale).roundToInt(), 168, 85, 247)
        canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, rOrbit, cosmeticStrokePaint)
        for (i in 0 until 4) {
          val a = (spinDeg * 1.15f + i * 90f) * PI.toFloat() / 180f
          val nx = cx + cos(a) * rOrbit
          val ny = cy + sin(a) * rOrbit
          val d = 7.5f
          cosmeticPath.reset()
          cosmeticPath.moveTo(nx, ny - d)
          cosmeticPath.lineTo(nx + d * 0.72f, ny)
          cosmeticPath.lineTo(nx, ny + d)
          cosmeticPath.lineTo(nx - d * 0.72f, ny)
          cosmeticPath.close()
          cosmeticFillPaint.color = Color.argb((235f * aScale).roundToInt(), 192, 132, 252)
          canvas.drawPath(cosmeticPath, cosmeticFillPaint)
          cosmeticFillPaint.color = Color.argb((245f * aScale).roundToInt(), 245, 208, 254)
          canvas.drawCircle(nx, ny, 2.6f, cosmeticFillPaint)
        }
      }
      3 -> {
        val rCyan = baseRadius * 1.16f
        val rCrimson = baseRadius * 0.98f
        cosmeticRect.set(cx - rCyan, cy - rCyan, cx + rCyan, cy + rCyan)
        cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 2.8f
        cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((240f * aScale).roundToInt(), 0, 245, 212)
        for (i in 0 until 3) {
          canvas.drawArc(cosmeticRect, spinDeg + i * 120f, 68f, false, cosmeticStrokePaint)
        }
        cosmeticRect.set(cx - rCrimson, cy - rCrimson, cx + rCrimson, cy + rCrimson)
        cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 2.6f
        cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((235f * aScale).roundToInt(), 251, 113, 133)
        for (i in 0 until 3) {
          canvas.drawArc(cosmeticRect, -spinDeg * 1.35f + i * 120f + 24f, 62f, false, cosmeticStrokePaint)
        }
        cosmeticFillPaint.color = Color.argb((245f * aScale).roundToInt(), 248, 250, 252)
        for (i in 0 until 3) {
          val a = (spinDeg + i * 120f + 34f) * PI.toFloat() / 180f
          canvas.drawCircle(cx + cos(a) * rCyan, cy + sin(a) * rCyan, 3.2f, cosmeticFillPaint)
        }
      }
      else -> {
        val rRet = baseRadius * 1.06f
        cosmeticRect.set(cx - rRet, cy - rRet, cx + rRet, cy + rRet)
        cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 2.5f
        cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((230f * aScale).roundToInt(), 245, 158, 11)
        for (i in 0 until 4) {
          canvas.drawArc(cosmeticRect, spinDeg + i * 90f, 44f, false, cosmeticStrokePaint)
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private fun drawKillFinisherBurst(canvas: Canvas, fb: FinisherBurstEntity) {
    val prog = (fb.ageSec / fb.maxLifeSec.coerceAtLeast(0.01f)).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    val inv = (1f - prog).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    if (inv <= 0.01f) return
    val cx = fb.x
    val cy = fb.y
    val scale = RiftCalibrationState.projectileScale

    when (fb.style.coerceIn(0, 4)) {
      1 -> {
        if (prog < 0.48f) {
          val pIn = prog / 0.48f
          val pullR = (165f * (1f - pIn * 0.82f)) * scale
          cosmeticFillPaint.color = Color.argb((125f * (0.4f + 0.6f * pIn)).roundToInt(), 79, 70, 229)
          canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, pullR * 0.42f, cosmeticFillPaint)
          cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 4.2f
          cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb(225, 129, 140, 248)
          canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, pullR, cosmeticStrokePaint)
          cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 2.2f
          cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb(230, 192, 132, 252)
          for (i in 0 until 8) {
            val a = i * (PI.toFloat() * 0.25f) + pIn * 1.6f
            canvas.drawLine(
              cx + cos(a) * pullR,
              cy + sin(a) * pullR,
              cx + cos(a) * (pullR * 0.34f),
              cy + sin(a) * (pullR * 0.34f),
              cosmeticStrokePaint,
            )
          }
        } else {
          val pOut = ((prog - 0.48f) / 0.52f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
          val fadeOut = 1f - pOut
          val snapR = (28f + 225f * pOut) * scale
          cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 6.5f * fadeOut + 1.5f
          cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((235f * fadeOut).roundToInt(), 0, 245, 212)
          canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, snapR, cosmeticStrokePaint)
          cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 3.2f * fadeOut + 1f
          cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((220f * fadeOut).roundToInt(), 168, 85, 247)
          canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, snapR * 0.78f, cosmeticStrokePaint)
        }
      }
      2 -> {
        val coronaR = (28f + 195f * prog) * scale
        cosmeticFillPaint.color = Color.argb((110f * inv).roundToInt(), 250, 204, 21)
        canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, coronaR * 0.44f, cosmeticFillPaint)
        cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 5.4f * inv + 1.4f
        cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((240f * inv).roundToInt(), 250, 204, 21)
        canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, coronaR, cosmeticStrokePaint)
        cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 2.6f * inv + 0.9f
        cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((245f * inv).roundToInt(), 254, 240, 138)
        for (i in 0 until 12) {
          val a = i * (PI.toFloat() / 6f) + prog * 0.85f
          val r0 = coronaR * 0.32f
          val r1 = coronaR * (if (i % 2 == 0) 1.32f else 1.05f)
          canvas.drawLine(cx + cos(a) * r0, cy + sin(a) * r0, cx + cos(a) * r1, cy + sin(a) * r1, cosmeticStrokePaint)
        }
      }
      3 -> {
        val shatterR = (24f + 205f * prog) * scale
        cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 4.2f * inv + 1.2f
        cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((220f * inv).roundToInt(), 168, 85, 247)
        canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, shatterR * 0.78f, cosmeticStrokePaint)
        for (i in 0 until 8) {
          val a = i * (PI.toFloat() * 0.25f) + prog * 1.15f
          val sx = cx + cos(a) * shatterR
          val sy = cy + sin(a) * shatterR
          val len = (24f * inv + 7f) * scale
          val wid = (8.5f * inv + 2.5f) * scale
          val ca = cos(a)
          val sa = sin(a)
          cosmeticPath.reset()
          cosmeticPath.moveTo(sx + ca * len, sy + sa * len)
          cosmeticPath.lineTo(sx - sa * wid, sy + ca * wid)
          cosmeticPath.lineTo(sx - ca * len * 0.65f, sy - sa * len * 0.65f)
          cosmeticPath.lineTo(sx + sa * wid, sy - ca * wid)
          cosmeticPath.close()
          cosmeticFillPaint.color = Color.argb((230f * inv).roundToInt(), 192, 132, 252)
          canvas.drawPath(cosmeticPath, cosmeticFillPaint)
          cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 1.6f
          cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((245f * inv).roundToInt(), 245, 208, 254)
          canvas.drawPath(cosmeticPath, cosmeticStrokePaint)
        }
      }
      4 -> {
        val apexR = (26f + 220f * prog) * scale
        val rotDeg = prog * 260f
        cosmeticFillPaint.color = Color.argb((145f * inv).roundToInt(), 255, 255, 255)
        canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, apexR * 0.26f, cosmeticFillPaint)

        cosmeticRect.set(cx - apexR, cy - apexR, cx + apexR, cy + apexR)
        cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 5.2f * inv + 1.4f
        cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((240f * inv).roundToInt(), 251, 113, 133)
        canvas.drawArc(cosmeticRect, rotDeg, 130f, false, cosmeticStrokePaint)
        canvas.drawArc(cosmeticRect, rotDeg + 180f, 130f, false, cosmeticStrokePaint)

        val innerR = apexR * 0.76f
        cosmeticRect.set(cx - innerR, cy - innerR, cx + innerR, cy + innerR)
        cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 4.4f * inv + 1.2f
        cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((245f * inv).roundToInt(), 0, 245, 212)
        canvas.drawArc(cosmeticRect, -rotDeg * 1.25f + 40f, 120f, false, cosmeticStrokePaint)
        canvas.drawArc(cosmeticRect, -rotDeg * 1.25f + 220f, 120f, false, cosmeticStrokePaint)

        cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 2.4f * inv + 0.8f
        for (i in 0 until 8) {
          val a = i * (PI.toFloat() * 0.25f) + prog * 1.4f
          cosmeticStrokePaint.color =
            if (i % 2 == 0) Color.argb((235f * inv).roundToInt(), 0, 245, 212)
            else Color.argb((235f * inv).roundToInt(), 251, 113, 133)
          canvas.drawLine(
            cx + cos(a) * (apexR * 0.25f),
            cy + sin(a) * (apexR * 0.25f),
            cx + cos(a) * (apexR * 1.18f),
            cy + sin(a) * (apexR * 1.18f),
            cosmeticStrokePaint,
          )
        }
      }
      else -> {
        val novaR = (24f + 185f * prog) * scale
        cosmeticFillPaint.color = Color.argb((120f * inv).roundToInt(), 245, 158, 11)
        canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, novaR * 0.36f, cosmeticFillPaint)
        cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 5.0f * inv + 1.2f
        cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((235f * inv).roundToInt(), 0, 245, 212)
        canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, novaR, cosmeticStrokePaint)
        cosmeticStrokePaint.strokeWidth = 3.0f * inv + 1.0f
        cosmeticStrokePaint.color = Color.argb((230f * inv).roundToInt(), 250, 204, 21)
        canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, novaR * 0.68f, cosmeticStrokePaint)
      }
    }
  }
}

private const val SAFE_NEXUS_RIFT_AGSL =

  uniform float2 uCenter;

    return fract(p.x * p.y);

    float c = hash21(i + float2(0.0, 1.0));
    float d = hash21(i + float2(1.0, 1.0));
    return mix(mix(a, b, u.x), mix(c, d, u.x), u.y);
  }

  float fbm3(float2 p) {

      v += amp * noise2d(p);
      p = float2(p.x * 1.62 - p.y * 1.21, p.x * 1.21 + p.y * 1.62) + float2(1.7, -1.3);
      amp *= 0.5;

    }

    float turb = clamp(uTurbulence, 0.15, 2.2);
    float glow = clamp(uGlow, 0.25, 2.4);

    float twist = (1.18 - clamp(r, 0.0, 1.28)) * 0.65 * turb - uTime * 0.14;
    float ct = cos(twist);
    float st = sin(twist);
    float2 rotRel = float2(rel.x * ct - rel.y * st, rel.x * st + rel.y * ct);
    float2 stormUv = rotRel * (2.6 + 0.7 * turb) + float2(uTime * 0.18, -uTime * 0.15);
    float n1 = fbm3(stormUv);
    float n2 = fbm3(rotRel * (4.1 + 0.9 * turb) + float2(-uTime * 0.22 + n1 * 1.25, uTime * 0.19 - n1 * 1.10));
    float billow = clamp(n1 * 0.56 + n2 * 0.56, 0.0, 1.0);

    float calmMask = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.86, 1.03, r + (n1 - 0.5) * 0.06);
    float stormInner = smoothstep(0.82, 1.01, r + (n2 - 0.5) * 0.08);
    float stormOuter = 1.0 - smoothstep(1.06, 1.30, r + (n1 - 0.5) * 0.07);
    float stormBand = stormInner * stormOuter;

    float paletteShift = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(uTime * 1.35 + n1 * 4.2);
    float ridge = clamp(1.0 - abs(n1 - n2) * 2.9, 0.0, 1.0);
    float lightningVein = pow(ridge, 3.4) * stormBand * (0.55 + 0.45 * sin(uTime * 4.6 + n2 * 5.0));

    float3 calmBase = mix(float3(0.012, 0.039, 0.086), float3(0.11, 0.015, 0.025), locked);
    float3 shieldGlow = mix(float3(0.00, 0.96, 0.83), float3(0.96, 0.24, 0.28), locked);
    float3 calmCol = calmBase + shieldGlow * (smoothstep(0.76, 1.0, r) * 0.24 * glow);

    float3 riftCyan = float3(0.00, 0.96, 0.83);
    float3 riftViolet = float3(0.49, 0.23, 0.93);
    float3 riftMagenta = float3(0.93, 0.28, 0.60);
    float3 openStorm = mix(riftViolet, mix(riftMagenta, riftCyan, paletteShift), billow) + float3(0.88, 0.98, 1.0) * (lightningVein * 0.95 * glow);
    float3 lockedStorm = mix(float3(0.60, 0.11, 0.11), float3(0.98, 0.58, 0.18), billow) + float3(1.0, 0.92, 0.86) * (lightningVein * 0.90 * glow);
    float3 stormCol = mix(openStorm, lockedStorm, locked);

    float stormAlpha = stormBand * (0.34 + 0.62 * billow) + lightningVein * 0.34;
    float calmAlpha = calmMask * 0.48;
    float3 col = mix(calmCol, stormCol, clamp(stormBand * 1.15, 0.0, 1.0));
    float alpha = clamp(max(calmAlpha, stormAlpha) * uOpacity, 0.0, 0.94);
    return half4(half3(col * alpha), half(alpha));
  }
  """

    float c = hash21c(i + float2(0.0, 1.0));

    return v;

  half4 main(float2 fragCoord) {

    float cA = fbmc3(rotRel * (2.5 + 0.75 * turb) + float2(-uTime * 0.20, uTime * 0.17));
    float cB = fbmc3(rotRel * (3.9 + 0.95 * turb) + float2(uTime * 0.24 + cA * 1.25, -uTime * 0.21 - cA * 1.10));
    float billow = clamp(cA * 0.56 + cB * 0.56, 0.0, 1.0);

    float outerFade = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.92, 1.18, pertR);

    float paletteShift = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(uTime * 1.5 + cA * 4.0);

    float3 rimStorm = mix(uOuterRGB * 0.78, uMidRGB, clamp(billow * 0.75 + paletteShift * 0.30, 0.0, 1.0));
    float3 col = mix(interiorMist, rimStorm, clamp(rimShelf * 1.18, 0.0, 1.0));

private const val STORM_BOUNDARY_AGSL =
  """
  uniform float2 uCenter;
  uniform float uRadius;
  uniform float uTime;
  uniform float uTurbulence;
  uniform float uGlow;
  uniform float uOpacity;
  uniform float3 uGlowRGB;
  uniform float3 uTrimRGB;

  float hash21s(float2 p) {
    p = fract(p * float2(127.1, 311.7));
    p += dot(p, p + 41.23);
    return fract(p.x * p.y);
  }

  float noise2ds(float2 p) {
    float2 i = floor(p);
    float2 f = fract(p);
    float2 u = f * f * f * (f * (f * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0);
    float a = hash21s(i);
    float b = hash21s(i + float2(1.0, 0.0));
    float c = hash21s(i + float2(0.0, 1.0));
    float d = hash21s(i + float2(1.0, 1.0));
    return mix(mix(a, b, u.x), mix(c, d, u.x), u.y);
  }

  float fbms3(float2 p) {
    float v = 0.0;
    float amp = 0.54;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      v += amp * noise2ds(p);
      p = float2(p.x * 1.62 - p.y * 1.21, p.x * 1.21 + p.y * 1.62) + float2(-1.4, 1.9);
      amp *= 0.5;
    }
    return v;
  }

  half4 main(float2 fragCoord) {
    float2 delta = fragCoord - uCenter;
    float dist = length(delta);
    float signedOff = dist - uRadius;
    if (signedOff < -255.0 || signedOff > 250.0) {
      return half4(0.0);
    }

    // Continuous 2D Cartesian world-space coordinates (zero East seam, zero polar stretching, zero clip ring)
    float turb = clamp(uTurbulence, 0.15, 2.2);
    float glow = clamp(uGlow, 0.25, 2.4);
    float worldScale = 0.0046 * (0.76 + 0.32 * turb);
    float2 worldUv = delta * worldScale;

    float cloudA = fbms3(worldUv + float2(uTime * 0.14, -uTime * 0.18));
    float cloudB = fbms3(worldUv * 1.92 + float2(-uTime * 0.21 + cloudA * 1.35, uTime * 0.16 - cloudA * 1.15));
    float billow = clamp(cloudA * 0.56 + cloudB * 0.56, 0.0, 1.0);

    // Smooth radial smoothstep feathering with quadratic outer tail dissolving seamlessly into #010308 deep space
    float pertIn = signedOff + (cloudA - 0.5) * 72.0 * clamp(turb, 0.5, 1.5);
    float pertOut = signedOff + (cloudB - 0.5) * 42.0;
    float inwardMask = smoothstep(-235.0, -14.0, pertIn);
    float outwardMask = 1.0 - smoothstep(10.0, 235.0, pertOut);
    float stormEnvelope = inwardMask * (outwardMask * outwardMask);

    float paletteShift = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(uTime * 1.25 + cloudA * 4.4);
    float ridge = clamp(1.0 - abs(cloudA - cloudB) * 3.1, 0.0, 1.0);
    float flash = 0.55 + 0.45 * sin(uTime * 4.8 + cloudB * 5.6 + cloudA * 3.2);
    float lightningVein = pow(ridge, 3.6) * flash * stormEnvelope;

    float3 deepViolet = float3(0.18, 0.08, 0.38);
    float3 midStorm = mix(deepViolet, uTrimRGB * 0.78, clamp(billow * 0.85 + paletteShift * 0.25, 0.0, 1.0));
    float3 highStorm = mix(midStorm, uGlowRGB * clamp(0.76 + 0.26 * glow, 0.4, 1.7), smoothstep(0.26, 0.82, billow));
    float3 col = highStorm + float3(0.88, 0.98, 1.0) * (lightningVein * 1.05 * glow);

    float alpha = clamp((stormEnvelope * (0.28 + 0.66 * billow) + lightningVein * 0.38) * clamp(uOpacity, 0.2, 1.0), 0.0, 0.95);
    return half4(half3(col * alpha), half(alpha));
  }
  """

package com.example.engine

import android.content.Context

import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableIntStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.roundToInt
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject

enum class LabelPlacement(val label: String) {
  TOP("TOP"),
  BOTTOM("BOTTOM"),
  LEFT("LEFT"),
  RIGHT("RIGHT"),
  CONSOLIDATED_TOP("CONSOLIDATED TOP"),
  CONSOLIDATED_BOTTOM("CONSOLIDATED BOTTOM"),
}

data class CalibrationParamDescriptor(
  val key: String,
  val tabIndex: Int, // 0..7 (Tab 8 = AI Buff & Mechanic Forge)
  val shipIdFilter: Int = 0, // 0 = global, 1..9 = per-ship
  val title: String,
  val unit: String,
  val description: String,
  val min: Float,
  val max: Float,
  val step: Float,
  val decimals: Int = 2,
  val getter: () -> Float,
  val setter: (Float) -> Unit,
) {
  fun formatValue(v: Float = getter()): String {
    return when {
      unit == "%" && max <= 2.5f -> String.format(Locale.US, "%d%%", (v * 100f).roundToInt())
      decimals <= 0 -> String.format(Locale.US, "%d%s", v.roundToInt(), if (unit.isNotEmpty()) " $unit" else "")
      decimals == 1 -> String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f%s", v, if (unit.isNotEmpty()) " $unit" else "")
      else -> String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f%s", v, if (unit.isNotEmpty()) " $unit" else "")
    }
  }
}

  const val BIND_LT = 1001 // Left Trigger (AXIS_LTRIGGER / AXIS_BRAKE / KEYCODE_BUTTON_L2)
  const val BIND_RT = 1002 // Right Trigger (AXIS_RTRIGGER / AXIS_GAS / AXIS_THROTTLE / KEYCODE_BUTTON_R2)

  var bindPrimaryFire by mutableIntStateOf(BIND_RT)

  fun getBindingLabel(code: Int): String {
    return when (code) {
      BIND_LT, android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L2 -> "LT / L2"
      BIND_RT, android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R2 -> "RT / R2"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R1 -> "R1 / RB"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L1 -> "L1 / LB"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_A -> "A BTN"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_B -> "B BTN"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_X -> "X BTN"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_Y -> "Y BTN"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_THUMBL -> "L3"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_THUMBR -> "R3"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP -> "D-UP"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN -> "D-DOWN"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_LEFT -> "D-LEFT"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_RIGHT -> "D-RIGHT"
      else -> "KEY $code"
    }
  }

  fun getActionForBinding(code: Int): String? {
    val norm =
      when (code) {
        android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L2 -> BIND_LT
        android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R2 -> BIND_RT
        else -> code
      }
    return when (norm) {
      bindPrimaryFire -> "MAIN ATK"
      bindSpecialBuff -> "BUFF ATK"
      bindRetroBrake -> "BRAKE"
      bindSecondaryAbility -> "SECONDARY"
      bindRepel -> "REPEL"
      bindMultiToggle -> "MULTI"
      else -> null
    }
  }

  fun getBindingForActionSlot(actionSlot: String): Int {
    return when (actionSlot) {
      "PRIMARY_FIRE" -> bindPrimaryFire
      "SPECIAL_BUFF" -> bindSpecialBuff
      "RETRO_BRAKE" -> bindRetroBrake
      "SECONDARY_ABILITY" -> bindSecondaryAbility
      "REPEL" -> bindRepel
      "MULTI_TOGGLE" -> bindMultiToggle
      else -> BIND_RT
    }
  }

  fun assignControllerBinding(actionSlot: String, newCode: Int, context: Context? = null) {
    val normalizedNew =
      when (newCode) {
        android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L2 -> BIND_LT
        android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R2 -> BIND_RT
        else -> newCode
      }
    val oldCode = getBindingForActionSlot(actionSlot)
    if (oldCode == normalizedNew) return

    // Swap if another slot already uses normalizedNew so bindings never duplicate
    when {
      actionSlot != "PRIMARY_FIRE" && bindPrimaryFire == normalizedNew -> bindPrimaryFire = oldCode
      actionSlot != "SPECIAL_BUFF" && bindSpecialBuff == normalizedNew -> bindSpecialBuff = oldCode
      actionSlot != "RETRO_BRAKE" && bindRetroBrake == normalizedNew -> bindRetroBrake = oldCode
      actionSlot != "SECONDARY_ABILITY" && bindSecondaryAbility == normalizedNew -> bindSecondaryAbility = oldCode
      actionSlot != "REPEL" && bindRepel == normalizedNew -> bindRepel = oldCode
      actionSlot != "MULTI_TOGGLE" && bindMultiToggle == normalizedNew -> bindMultiToggle = oldCode
    }

    when (actionSlot) {
      "PRIMARY_FIRE" -> bindPrimaryFire = normalizedNew
      "SPECIAL_BUFF" -> bindSpecialBuff = normalizedNew
      "RETRO_BRAKE" -> bindRetroBrake = normalizedNew
      "SECONDARY_ABILITY" -> bindSecondaryAbility = normalizedNew
      "REPEL" -> bindRepel = normalizedNew
      "MULTI_TOGGLE" -> bindMultiToggle = normalizedNew
    }

    calibrationRevision++
    if (context != null) {
      savePersistedLayout(context)
    }
  }

  fun resetControllerBindingsToDefault(context: Context? = null) {
    bindPrimaryFire = BIND_RT
    bindSpecialBuff = android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R1
    bindRetroBrake = BIND_LT
    bindSecondaryAbility = android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_X
    bindRepel = android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_A
    bindMultiToggle = android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_Y
    calibrationRevision++
    if (context != null) {
      savePersistedLayout(context)
    }
  }

  /**
   * Converts any camelCase or snake_case variable name into a clean Plain-English Title.
   */
  fun camelCaseToPlainEnglish(rawKey: String): String {
    return rawKey
      .replace("_", " ")
      .replace(Regex("([a-z])([A-Z0-9])"), "$1 $2")
      .split(" ")
      .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
      .joinToString(" ") { word ->
        when (word.uppercase(Locale.US)) {
          "FFA" -> "FFA"
          "HVT" -> "High Resonance"
          "BOUNTY" -> "Resonance"
          "FCT" -> "Floating Text"
          "EMP" -> "EMP"
          "HUD" -> "HUD"
          "AI" -> "AI"
          "PCT" -> "Percent"
          "SEC" -> "Duration"
          "PX" -> "Size"
          "MULT" -> "Multiplier"
          else -> word.replaceFirstChar { if (it.isLowerCase()) it.titlecase(Locale.US) else it.toString() }
        }
      }
  }

  val descriptors: List<CalibrationParamDescriptor>
    get() = buildAllParameterDescriptors()

  /**
   * Deep-frozen baseline snapshot of all factory default numeric calibration parameters.
   */
  val DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG: Map<String, Float> by lazy {
    val snapshot = LinkedHashMap<String, Float>()
    buildAllParameterDescriptors()
      .filter { !it.key.startsWith("forged_") }
      .forEach { snapshot[it.key] = it.getter() }
    snapshot
  }

  fun ensureBaselineCaptured() {
    DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG.size
  }

  fun isCustomGameSandboxActive(engine: RiftGameEngine?): Boolean =
    engine?.currentCustomGame != null

  /**
   * Guarantees that all 6 Main Ranked Modes ALWAYS run 100% factory default rules,
   * without overwriting the user's saved custom slider preset in SharedPreferences or HUD layout offsets.
   */
  fun enforceRankedFactoryDefaultsIfNeeded(engine: RiftGameEngine?) {
    if (engine != null && engine.currentCustomGame == null) {
      ensureBaselineCaptured()
      RiftCodex.resetShipsToDefaults()
      RiftCodex.resetBuffRegistryToDefaults(preserveCustomForged = true)

      for (desc in buildAllParameterDescriptors()) {
        if (desc.tabIndex in 1..7 && !desc.key.startsWith("forged_")) {
          DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]?.let { desc.setter(it) }
        }
      }
      shipScale = 1.0f
      projectileScale = 1.0f
      anomalyScale = 1.0f
      botsEnabled = true

      cloakDrainPerSec = 36f
      empFluxDrainPct = 0.25f
      empFreezeSec = 2.0f
      interdictorBubbleRadius = 275f
      interdictorBubbleDuration = 6.0f
      interdictorBubbleCooldown = 8.5f
      stasisBarrierDuration = 45.0f
      stasisBrigReactorMaxHp = 8000f
      RiftCodex.getShipById(6).bombCost = 0f
      RiftCodex.getShipById(6).bombCooldown = 4.5f
      RiftCodex.getShipById(9).bombCost = 320f
      RiftCodex.getShipById(9).bombCooldown = 8.5f

      engine.publicMatchCycleLimitSec = publicMatchCycleLimitSec
      for (ship in engine.ships) {
        val updatedSpec = RiftCodex.getShipById(ship.spec.id)
        ship.spec = updatedSpec
        val targetMax = updatedSpec.maxFlux
        if (abs(ship.maxFlux - targetMax) > 0.5f) {
          val ratio = if (ship.maxFlux > 1f) (ship.flux / ship.maxFlux).coerceIn(0.05f, 1f) else 1f
          ship.maxFlux = targetMax
          ship.flux = (targetMax * ratio).coerceIn(1f, targetMax)
        }
      }
      for (anom in engine.anomalies) {
        if (!anom.isUnstableMergedRift &&
          !(anom.type == AnomalyType.GRAVITY_RIFT && anom.absorbedWeaponCount > 0) &&
          anom.absorbedWeaponCount == 0
        ) {
          anom.physicalRadius = riftPhysicalRadius
        }
      }
      for (b in engine.interdictorBubbles) {
        b.radius = interdictorBubbleRadius
      }
      engine.enforceBotsEnabledState()
      calibrationRevision++
    }
  }

  /**
   * Immediately propagates any modified Calibration value into active live ships, match timers,
   * and registry entries when in a Custom Game, or enforces factory defaults in a Main Ranked Game.
   */
  fun applyCalibrationChangesLive(engine: RiftGameEngine?, context: Context? = null) {
    ensureBaselineCaptured()
    if (context != null) {
      savePersistedLayout(context)
    }

    if (engine != null && engine.currentCustomGame == null) {
      enforceRankedFactoryDefaultsIfNeeded(engine)
      return
    }

    RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["SEEKER_TORPEDO"]?.let {
      it.flightDuration = seekerFlightTime
      it.projectileSpeed = seekerSpeed
      it.damage = seekerDamage
    }
    RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["NOVA_RING"]?.let {
      it.projectileSpeed = novaBoltSpeed
      it.damage = novaBoltDamage
    }
    RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["SHATTER_CONE"]?.let {
      it.damage = shatterPelletDamage
    }
    RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["STASIS_BARRIER"]?.let {
      it.flightDuration = stasisBarrierDuration
      it.blastRadius = stasisBarrierLength
    }
    RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["HYPER_SURGE"]?.let {
      it.flightDuration = hyperSurgeDuration
    }
    RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["HOLO_PHANTOM"]?.let {
      it.flightDuration = holoPhantomDuration
    }
    RiftCodex.getShipById(9).bombCooldown = interdictorBubbleCooldown

    if (engine != null && engine.currentCustomGame != null) {
      engine.publicMatchCycleLimitSec = publicMatchCycleLimitSec
      for (ship in engine.ships) {
        val updatedSpec = RiftCodex.getShipById(ship.spec.id)
        ship.spec = updatedSpec
        val targetMax = updatedSpec.maxFlux
        if (abs(ship.maxFlux - targetMax) > 0.5f) {
          val ratio = if (ship.maxFlux > 1f) (ship.flux / ship.maxFlux).coerceIn(0.05f, 1f) else 1f
          ship.maxFlux = targetMax
          ship.flux = (targetMax * ratio).coerceIn(1f, targetMax)
        }
      }
      for (anom in engine.anomalies) {
        if (!anom.isUnstableMergedRift &&
          !(anom.type == AnomalyType.GRAVITY_RIFT && anom.absorbedWeaponCount > 0) &&
          anom.absorbedWeaponCount == 0
        ) {
          anom.physicalRadius = riftPhysicalRadius
        }
      }
      for (b in engine.interdictorBubbles) {
        b.radius = interdictorBubbleRadius
      }
      engine.enforceBotsEnabledState()
    }
    calibrationRevision++
  }

  fun exportForgedBuffsJson(): String {
    val forgedArr = JSONArray()
    RiftCodex.getCustomForgedBuffs().forEach { forgedArr.put(it.toJsonObject()) }
    return forgedArr.toString()
  }

  fun exportGameplaySyncPayloadJson(engine: RiftGameEngine? = null): String {
    ensureBaselineCaptured()
    val slidersObj = JSONObject()
    val allowedTab0Keys = setOf("shipScale", "projectileScale", "anomalyScale")
    for (desc in buildAllParameterDescriptors()) {
      if (desc.tabIndex in 1..7 || desc.key in allowedTab0Keys) {
        slidersObj.put(desc.key, desc.getter().toDouble())
      }
    }
    val customCfg = engine?.currentCustomGame
    return JSONObject().apply {
      put("botsEnabled", botsEnabled)
      put("forgedBuffsJson", exportForgedBuffsJson())
      put("sliders", slidersObj)
      if (customCfg != null) {
        put("damageTakenScalePct", com.example.data.snapCustomFivePercentScale(customCfg.damageTakenScalePct))
        put("weaponFluxCostScalePct", com.example.data.snapCustomFivePercentScale(customCfg.weaponFluxCostScalePct))
      }
    }.toString()
  }

  fun applyRemoteCustomGameSyncPayload(
    payloadJson: String,
    engine: RiftGameEngine?,
    context: Context? = null,
  ): Boolean {
    val activeCustom = engine?.currentCustomGame ?: return false
    ensureBaselineCaptured()
    return try {
      val root = JSONObject(payloadJson)
      if (root.has("botsEnabled")) {
        botsEnabled = root.optBoolean("botsEnabled", true)
      }
      if (root.has("damageTakenScalePct")) {
        val snappedDt = com.example.data.snapCustomFivePercentScale(root.optInt("damageTakenScalePct", activeCustom.damageTakenScalePct))
        activeCustom.damageTakenScalePct = snappedDt
        engine.activeCustomGames
          .filter { it.instanceId.equals(activeCustom.instanceId, ignoreCase = true) }
          .forEach { it.damageTakenScalePct = snappedDt }
      }
      if (root.has("weaponFluxCostScalePct")) {
        val snappedFc = com.example.data.snapCustomFivePercentScale(root.optInt("weaponFluxCostScalePct", activeCustom.weaponFluxCostScalePct))
        activeCustom.weaponFluxCostScalePct = snappedFc
        engine.activeCustomGames
          .filter { it.instanceId.equals(activeCustom.instanceId, ignoreCase = true) }
          .forEach { it.weaponFluxCostScalePct = snappedFc }
      }
      val forgedRaw = root.optString("forgedBuffsJson", "")
      if (forgedRaw.isNotBlank()) {
        try {
          val arr = JSONArray(forgedRaw)
          for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
            val entry = SpecialBuffRegistryEntry.fromJsonObject(arr.getJSONObject(i))
            RiftCodex.registerCustomBuff(entry)
          }
        } catch (_: Exception) {}
      }
      val slidersObj = root.optJSONObject("sliders")
      if (slidersObj != null) {
        val descriptorsByKey = buildAllParameterDescriptors().associateBy { it.key }
        val keys = slidersObj.keys()
        while (keys.hasNext()) {
          val k = keys.next()
          val desc = descriptorsByKey[k]
          if (desc != null) {
            val v = slidersObj.optDouble(k, desc.getter().toDouble()).toFloat()
            desc.setter(v)
          }
        }
      }
      calibrationRevision++
      applyCalibrationChangesLive(engine, context)
      true
    } catch (_: Exception) {
      false
    }
  }

  fun generateLocalHullRecipe(prompt: String, variationSalt: Int = 0): CustomHullVisualRecipe =
    CustomHullVisualRecipe.synthesizeFromPrompt(prompt, variationSalt)

  fun forgeBuffFromPrompt(prompt: String): SpecialBuffRegistryEntry =
    SpecialBuffRegistryEntry.synthesizeFromPrompt(prompt, RiftCodex.nextCustomBuffTypeIndex())

  fun toggleParameterHidden(key: String, hidden: Boolean, context: Context? = null) {
    hiddenCalibrationKeys =
      if (hidden) {
        hiddenCalibrationKeys + key
      } else {
        hiddenCalibrationKeys - key
      }
    calibrationRevision++
    if (context != null) {
      savePersistedLayout(context)
    }
  }

  fun unhideAllParameters(context: Context? = null) {
    hiddenCalibrationKeys = emptySet()
    calibrationRevision++
    if (context != null) {
      savePersistedLayout(context)
    }
  }

  @JvmOverloads
  fun loadPersistedLayout(context: Context, engine: RiftGameEngine? = null) {
    ensureBaselineCaptured()
    val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    fun readOffset(key: String): Offset {
      val x = prefs.getFloat("${key}_x", 0f)
      val y = prefs.getFloat("${key}_y", 0f)
      return Offset(x, y)
    }
    topBarOffset = readOffset("topBar")
    buffBarOffset = readOffset("buffBar")
    killLogOffset = readOffset("killLog")
    bottomConsoleOffset = readOffset("bottomConsole")
    combatArcOffset = readOffset("combatArc")
    leftStickOffset = readOffset("leftStick")
    fireStickOffset = readOffset("fireStick")
    bombBtnOffset = readOffset("bombBtn")
    repelBtnOffset = readOffset("repelBtn")
    burstBtnOffset = readOffset("burstBtn")
    brakeBtnOffset = readOffset("brakeBtn")
    multiBtnOffset = readOffset("multiBtn")
    calibrationBtnOffset = readOffset("calibrationBtn")
    nexusBtnOffset = readOffset("nexusBtn")
    toastContainerOffset = readOffset("toastContainer")
    spectatorBoxOffset = readOffset("spectatorBox")
    idleWarningBannerOffset = readOffset("idleWarningBanner")
    unlockFullNinthShipOverride = prefs.getBoolean("unlockFullNinthShipOverride", false)
    botsEnabled = prefs.getBoolean("bots_enabled", true)

    bindPrimaryFire = prefs.getInt("bindPrimaryFire", BIND_RT)
    bindSpecialBuff = prefs.getInt("bindSpecialBuff", android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R1)
    bindRetroBrake = prefs.getInt("bindRetroBrake", BIND_LT)
    bindSecondaryAbility = prefs.getInt("bindSecondaryAbility", android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_X)
    bindRepel = prefs.getInt("bindRepel", android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_A)
    bindMultiToggle = prefs.getInt("bindMultiToggle", android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_Y)

    touchFloatingJoystick = prefs.getBoolean("touchFloatingJoystick", true)
    touchJoystickDeadzone = prefs.getFloat("touchJoystickDeadzone", 0.08f).coerceIn(0.02f, 0.30f)
    touchJoystickSensitivity = prefs.getFloat("touchJoystickSensitivity", 1.0f).coerceIn(0.50f, 2.00f)
    swapLeftRightControls = prefs.getBoolean("swapLeftRightControls", false)
    graphicsQualityTier = prefs.getInt("graphicsQualityTier", 2).coerceIn(0, 2)
    preferMaxRefreshRate = prefs.getBoolean("preferMaxRefreshRate", true)
    squadronVoiceEnabled = prefs.getBoolean("squadronVoiceEnabled", true)
    teamVoiceMuted = prefs.getBoolean("teamVoiceMuted", false)
    teamVoicePushToTalk = prefs.getBoolean("teamVoicePushToTalk", false)

    val hiddenCsv = prefs.getString(KEY_HIDDEN_SET, "") ?: ""
    hiddenCalibrationKeys =
      hiddenCsv.split(",").map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.toSet()

    // Restore persisted Forged Custom Buffs into BUFF_REGISTRY
    val forgedRaw = prefs.getString(KEY_FORGED_BUFFS_JSON, "[]") ?: "[]"
    try {
      val arr = JSONArray(forgedRaw)
      for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
        val entry = SpecialBuffRegistryEntry.fromJsonObject(arr.getJSONObject(i))
        RiftCodex.registerCustomBuff(entry)
      }
    } catch (_: Exception) {}

    // Restore persisted NEXUS FORGE Visual Recipes & Dynamic Lighting
    val visualForgeRaw = prefs.getString(KEY_FORGED_VISUAL_RECIPES_JSON, null)
    if (!visualForgeRaw.isNullOrBlank()) {
      try {
        RiftVisualForgeState.loadFromJsonObject(JSONObject(visualForgeRaw))
      } catch (_: Exception) {}
    }

    // Restore persisted NEXUS FORGE Soundtrack Track A-C & SFX Recipes
    val audioForgeRaw = prefs.getString(KEY_FORGED_AUDIO_JSON, null)
    if (!audioForgeRaw.isNullOrBlank()) {
      try {
        RiftSoundSynthesizer.importAudioForgeJson(JSONObject(audioForgeRaw))
      } catch (_: Exception) {}
    }

    // Restore persisted Syndicate Crest Recipe
    val crestRaw = prefs.getString(KEY_FORGED_SYNDICATE_CREST_JSON, null)
    if (!crestRaw.isNullOrBlank()) {
      try {
        RiftVisualForgeState.updateSyndicateCrest(SyndicateCrestRecipe.fromJson(JSONObject(crestRaw)))
      } catch (_: Exception) {}
    }

    // Restore persisted slider overrides
    val savedConfigRaw = prefs.getString(KEY_SAVED_CONFIG_JSON, null)
    if (!savedConfigRaw.isNullOrBlank()) {
      try {
        val obj = JSONObject(savedConfigRaw)
        val excludedUserSettingKeys =
          setOf(
            "cameraZoomScale",
            "nametagFontSizePx",
            "bountyFontSizePx",
            "fctFontSizePx",
            "labelTextScale",
            "fctScale",
            "ship_6_bombCost",
          )
        val descriptorsByKey = buildAllParameterDescriptors().associateBy { it.key }
        val keys = obj.keys()
        while (keys.hasNext()) {
          val k = keys.next()
          if (k in excludedUserSettingKeys) continue
          val desc = descriptorsByKey[k]
          if (desc != null) {
            val loadedVal = obj.optDouble(k, desc.getter().toDouble()).toFloat()
            when {
              k == "phaseDashImpulse" && loadedVal <= 650f -> desc.setter(1120f)
              k == "stasisBrigReactorMaxHp" && abs(loadedVal - 40000f) < 50f -> desc.setter(8000f)
              k == "cloakDrainPerSec" && loadedVal >= 150f -> desc.setter(36f)
              k == "empFluxDrainPct" && loadedVal >= 0.34f -> desc.setter(0.25f)
              k == "empFreezeSec" && loadedVal >= 2.4f -> desc.setter(2.0f)
              k == "interdictorBubbleDuration" && (loadedVal >= 7.5f || abs(loadedVal - 5.0f) < 0.05f) -> desc.setter(6.0f)
              k == "interdictorBubbleCooldown" && loadedVal >= 9.0f -> desc.setter(8.5f)
              k == "stasisBarrierDuration" && loadedVal <= 15.0f -> desc.setter(45.0f)
              k == "ship_9_bombCost" && loadedVal >= 350f -> desc.setter(320f)
              k == "ship_9_bombCooldown" && loadedVal >= 9.0f -> desc.setter(8.5f)
              k == "ship_6_bombCooldown" && loadedVal <= 1.2f -> desc.setter(4.5f)
              else -> desc.setter(loadedVal)
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (_: Exception) {}
    }
    RiftCodex.getShipById(6).bombCost = 0f
    // Keep base constants neutral so user Settings (rift_user_settings) exclusively controls Zoom & Text Size
    cameraZoomScale = 1.0f
    nametagFontSizePx = 15.0f
    bountyFontSizePx = 16.0f
    fctFontSizePx = 14.0f
    labelTextScale = 1.0f
    fctScale = 1.0f
    applyCalibrationChangesLive(engine, null)
  }

  fun loadFromPrefs(context: Context) = loadPersistedLayout(context)

  fun savePersistedLayout(context: Context) {
    ensureBaselineCaptured()
    val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    val editor = prefs.edit()
    fun writeOffset(key: String, offset: Offset) {
      editor.putFloat("${key}_x", offset.x)
      editor.putFloat("${key}_y", offset.y)
    }
    writeOffset("topBar", topBarOffset)
    writeOffset("buffBar", buffBarOffset)
    writeOffset("killLog", killLogOffset)
    writeOffset("bottomConsole", bottomConsoleOffset)
    writeOffset("combatArc", combatArcOffset)
    writeOffset("leftStick", leftStickOffset)
    writeOffset("fireStick", fireStickOffset)
    writeOffset("bombBtn", bombBtnOffset)
    writeOffset("repelBtn", repelBtnOffset)
    writeOffset("burstBtn", burstBtnOffset)
    writeOffset("brakeBtn", brakeBtnOffset)
    writeOffset("multiBtn", multiBtnOffset)
    writeOffset("calibrationBtn", calibrationBtnOffset)
    writeOffset("nexusBtn", nexusBtnOffset)
    writeOffset("toastContainer", toastContainerOffset)
    writeOffset("spectatorBox", spectatorBoxOffset)
    writeOffset("idleWarningBanner", idleWarningBannerOffset)
    editor.putBoolean("unlockFullNinthShipOverride", unlockFullNinthShipOverride)
    editor.putBoolean("bots_enabled", botsEnabled)
    editor.putInt("bindPrimaryFire", bindPrimaryFire)
    editor.putInt("bindSpecialBuff", bindSpecialBuff)
    editor.putInt("bindRetroBrake", bindRetroBrake)
    editor.putInt("bindSecondaryAbility", bindSecondaryAbility)
    editor.putInt("bindRepel", bindRepel)
    editor.putInt("bindMultiToggle", bindMultiToggle)
    editor.putBoolean("touchFloatingJoystick", touchFloatingJoystick)
    editor.putFloat("touchJoystickDeadzone", touchJoystickDeadzone.coerceIn(0.02f, 0.30f))
    editor.putFloat("touchJoystickSensitivity", touchJoystickSensitivity.coerceIn(0.50f, 2.00f))
    editor.putBoolean("swapLeftRightControls", swapLeftRightControls)
    editor.putInt("graphicsQualityTier", graphicsQualityTier.coerceIn(0, 2))
    editor.putBoolean("preferMaxRefreshRate", preferMaxRefreshRate)
    editor.putBoolean("squadronVoiceEnabled", squadronVoiceEnabled)
    editor.putBoolean("teamVoiceMuted", teamVoiceMuted)
    editor.putBoolean("teamVoicePushToTalk", teamVoicePushToTalk)
    editor.putString(KEY_HIDDEN_SET, hiddenCalibrationKeys.joinToString(","))

    val forgedArr = JSONArray()
    RiftCodex.getCustomForgedBuffs().forEach { forgedArr.put(it.toJsonObject()) }
    editor.putString(KEY_FORGED_BUFFS_JSON, forgedArr.toString())

    editor.putString(KEY_FORGED_VISUAL_RECIPES_JSON, RiftVisualForgeState.toJsonObject().toString())
    editor.putString(KEY_FORGED_AUDIO_JSON, RiftSoundSynthesizer.exportAudioForgeJson().toString())
    editor.putString(
      KEY_FORGED_SYNDICATE_CREST_JSON,
      RiftVisualForgeState.activeSyndicateCrestRecipe.toJson().toString(),
    )

    val configObj = JSONObject()
    buildAllParameterDescriptors().forEach { desc ->
      val currentVal = desc.getter()
      val defaultVal = DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]
      if (defaultVal == null || abs(currentVal - defaultVal) > 0.0005f) {
        configObj.put(desc.key, currentVal.toDouble())
      }
    }
    editor.putString(KEY_SAVED_CONFIG_JSON, configObj.toString())
    editor.apply()
  }

  fun resetTab(tabIndex: Int, context: Context? = null, engine: RiftGameEngine? = null) {
    ensureBaselineCaptured()
    if (tabIndex == 2 || tabIndex == 3) {
      if (tabIndex == 2) {
        buildAllParameterDescriptors()
          .filter { it.tabIndex == 2 }
          .forEach { desc -> DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]?.let { desc.setter(it) } }
      } else {
        buildAllParameterDescriptors()
          .filter { it.tabIndex == 3 }
          .forEach { desc -> DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]?.let { desc.setter(it) } }
      }
    } else {
      buildAllParameterDescriptors()
        .filter { it.tabIndex == tabIndex && !it.key.startsWith("forged_") }
        .forEach { desc -> DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]?.let { desc.setter(it) } }
      if (tabIndex == 0) {
        bountyPlacement = LabelPlacement.TOP
        tagPlacement = LabelPlacement.BOTTOM
        namePlacement = LabelPlacement.BOTTOM
      }
    }
    applyCalibrationChangesLive(engine, context)
  }

  /**
   * Exports a complete JSON bundle of all NEXUS FORGE visual recipes, dynamic lighting,
   * Syndicate crest, Track A-C + SFX audio recipes, HUD offsets, forged buffs, and calibration sliders.
   */
  fun exportDevForgeBundleJson(): String {
    ensureBaselineCaptured()
    val calibrationObj = JSONObject()
    for (desc in buildAllParameterDescriptors()) {
      val cur = desc.getter()
      calibrationObj.put(desc.key, ((cur * 1000f).roundToInt() / 1000.0))
    }

    fun offsetJson(o: Offset): JSONObject =
      JSONObject().apply {
        put("x", ((o.x * 10f).roundToInt() / 10.0))
        put("y", ((o.y * 10f).roundToInt() / 10.0))
      }

    val hudOffsetsObj =
      JSONObject().apply {
        put("topBar", offsetJson(topBarOffset))
        put("buffBar", offsetJson(buffBarOffset))
        put("killLog", offsetJson(killLogOffset))
        put("bottomConsole", offsetJson(bottomConsoleOffset))
        put("combatArc", offsetJson(combatArcOffset))
        put("leftStick", offsetJson(leftStickOffset))
        put("fireStick", offsetJson(fireStickOffset))
        put("bombBtn", offsetJson(bombBtnOffset))
        put("repelBtn", offsetJson(repelBtnOffset))
        put("burstBtn", offsetJson(burstBtnOffset))
        put("brakeBtn", offsetJson(brakeBtnOffset))
        put("multiBtn", offsetJson(multiBtnOffset))
        put("calibrationBtn", offsetJson(calibrationBtnOffset))
        put("nexusBtn", offsetJson(nexusBtnOffset))
        put("toastContainer", offsetJson(toastContainerOffset))
        put("spectatorBox", offsetJson(spectatorBoxOffset))
        put("idleWarningBanner", offsetJson(idleWarningBannerOffset))
      }

    val forgedBuffsArr = JSONArray()
    RiftCodex.getCustomForgedBuffs().forEach { forgedBuffsArr.put(it.toJsonObject()) }

    return JSONObject().apply {
      put("bundleVersion", 1)
      put("visualForge", RiftVisualForgeState.toJsonObject())
      put("syndicateCrest", RiftVisualForgeState.activeSyndicateCrestRecipe.toJson())
      put("audioForge", RiftSoundSynthesizer.exportAudioForgeJson())
      put("hudOffsets", hudOffsetsObj)
      put(
        "labelPlacements",
        JSONObject().apply {
          put("bountyPlacement", bountyPlacement.name)
          put("tagPlacement", tagPlacement.name)
          put("namePlacement", namePlacement.name)
        },
      )
      put("forgedBuffs", forgedBuffsArr)
      put("calibrationValues", calibrationObj)
    }.toString(2)
  }

  /**
   * Imports a Developer Forge JSON bundle (raw JSON or markdown code block) and applies all
   * visual recipes, audio tracks, HUD offsets, forged buffs, and calibration sliders live.
   */
  fun importDevForgeBundleJson(
    rawJson: String,
    engine: RiftGameEngine? = null,
    context: Context? = null,
  ): Boolean {
    ensureBaselineCaptured()
    val trimmed = rawJson.trim()
    if (trimmed.isEmpty()) return false
    val extracted =
      if (trimmed.contains("```")) {
        val afterOpen = trimmed.substringAfter("```").let {
          if (it.startsWith("json", ignoreCase = true)) it.substring(4) else it
        }
        afterOpen.substringBefore("```").trim()
      } else {
        trimmed
      }
    return try {
      val root = JSONObject(extracted)

      root.optJSONObject("visualForge")?.let { RiftVisualForgeState.loadFromJsonObject(it) }
      root.optJSONObject("syndicateCrest")?.let {
        RiftVisualForgeState.updateSyndicateCrest(SyndicateCrestRecipe.fromJson(it))
      }
      root.optJSONObject("audioForge")?.let { RiftSoundSynthesizer.importAudioForgeJson(it) }

      root.optJSONObject("hudOffsets")?.let { hObj ->
        fun parseOff(key: String, fallback: Offset): Offset {
          val o = hObj.optJSONObject(key) ?: return fallback
          return Offset(
            o.optDouble("x", fallback.x.toDouble()).toFloat(),
            o.optDouble("y", fallback.y.toDouble()).toFloat(),
          )
        }
        topBarOffset = parseOff("topBar", topBarOffset)
        buffBarOffset = parseOff("buffBar", buffBarOffset)
        killLogOffset = parseOff("killLog", killLogOffset)
        bottomConsoleOffset = parseOff("bottomConsole", bottomConsoleOffset)
        combatArcOffset = parseOff("combatArc", combatArcOffset)
        leftStickOffset = parseOff("leftStick", leftStickOffset)
        fireStickOffset = parseOff("fireStick", fireStickOffset)
        bombBtnOffset = parseOff("bombBtn", bombBtnOffset)
        repelBtnOffset = parseOff("repelBtn", repelBtnOffset)
        burstBtnOffset = parseOff("burstBtn", burstBtnOffset)
        brakeBtnOffset = parseOff("brakeBtn", brakeBtnOffset)
        multiBtnOffset = parseOff("multiBtn", multiBtnOffset)
        calibrationBtnOffset = parseOff("calibrationBtn", calibrationBtnOffset)
        nexusBtnOffset = parseOff("nexusBtn", nexusBtnOffset)
        toastContainerOffset = parseOff("toastContainer", toastContainerOffset)
        spectatorBoxOffset = parseOff("spectatorBox", spectatorBoxOffset)
        idleWarningBannerOffset = parseOff("idleWarningBanner", idleWarningBannerOffset)
      }

      root.optJSONObject("labelPlacements")?.let { lp ->
        runCatching { LabelPlacement.valueOf(lp.optString("bountyPlacement", "TOP")) }
          .getOrNull()?.let { bountyPlacement = it }
        runCatching { LabelPlacement.valueOf(lp.optString("tagPlacement", "BOTTOM")) }
          .getOrNull()?.let { tagPlacement = it }
        runCatching { LabelPlacement.valueOf(lp.optString("namePlacement", "BOTTOM")) }
          .getOrNull()?.let { namePlacement = it }
      }

      root.optJSONArray("forgedBuffs")?.let { arr ->
        for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
          val bObj = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
          RiftCodex.registerCustomBuff(SpecialBuffRegistryEntry.fromJsonObject(bObj))
        }
      }

      val calObj = root.optJSONObject("calibrationValues") ?: root.optJSONObject("DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG")
      if (calObj != null) {
        val byKey = buildAllParameterDescriptors().associateBy { it.key }
        val keys = calObj.keys()
        while (keys.hasNext()) {
          val k = keys.next()
          val desc = byKey[k] ?: continue
          val v = calObj.optDouble(k, desc.getter().toDouble()).toFloat()
          desc.setter(v)
        }
      }

      RiftSpriteBaker.invalidateAllVisualTargets()
      calibrationRevision++
      applyCalibrationChangesLive(engine, context)
      true
    } catch (_: Exception) {
      false
    }
  }

  /**
   * Generates a complete 1-click AI Studio prompt containing:
   * - Section A: Modified Settings & Visual Forge Diff (`key: oldDefault -> newValue`)
   * - Section B: Complete Replacement Default Objects (`DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG`, `visualForge`, `audioForge`, `BUFF_REGISTRY`, `hiddenCalibrationKeys`)
   * Returns (promptString, modifiedCount).
   */
  fun generateAiStudioDefaultsPrompt(): Pair<String, Int> {
    ensureBaselineCaptured()
    val descriptors = buildAllParameterDescriptors()
    val diffs = mutableListOf<String>()
    val fullConfigJson = JSONObject()

    for (desc in descriptors) {
      val cur = desc.getter()
      fullConfigJson.put(desc.key, ((cur * 1000f).roundToInt() / 1000.0))
      val def = DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]
      if (def != null && abs(cur - def) > 0.0005f) {
        diffs += "  - ${desc.key} (${desc.title}): ${desc.formatValue(def)} -> ${desc.formatValue(cur)}"
      }
    }

    for (target in ForgeElementTarget.entries) {
      val rec = RiftVisualForgeState.getRecipe(target)
      if (!rec.isFactoryDefault) {
        diffs +=
          "  - [VISUAL FORGE] ${target.key} (${target.title}): primary=${rec.primaryHex}, trim=${rec.trimHex}, glow=${rec.glowHex}, style=${rec.geometryStyle}, scale=${rec.pixelScale}x, glowInt=${rec.glowIntensity}x, turb=${rec.shaderTurbulence}x (\"${rec.promptUsed}\")"
      }
    }

    if (bountyPlacement != LabelPlacement.TOP) {
      diffs += "  - bountyPlacement: TOP -> ${bountyPlacement.name}"
    }
    if (tagPlacement != LabelPlacement.BOTTOM) {
      diffs += "  - tagPlacement: BOTTOM -> ${tagPlacement.name}"
    }
    if (namePlacement != LabelPlacement.BOTTOM) {
      diffs += "  - namePlacement: BOTTOM -> ${namePlacement.name}"
    }

    val customBuffs = RiftCodex.getCustomForgedBuffs()
    for (cb in customBuffs) {
      diffs += "  - [NEW FORGED BUFF] ${cb.id} (${cb.officialName} / ${cb.shortLabel}): ${cb.summary}"
    }

    val registryJson = JSONObject()
    for ((k, v) in RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY) {
      registryJson.put(k, v.toJsonObject())
    }

    val hiddenArr = JSONArray()
    hiddenCalibrationKeys.sorted().forEach { hiddenArr.put(it) }

    val totalModified = diffs.size + (if (hiddenCalibrationKeys.isNotEmpty()) 1 else 0)

    val sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.appendLine("Update RIFT's permanent factory defaults in RiftCalibrationState.kt, RiftVisualForgeState.kt, and ShipSpecs.kt to match my forged configuration below:")
    sb.appendLine()
    sb.appendLine("### SECTION A: MODIFIED SETTINGS & VISUAL FORGE DIFF (${diffs.size} Changes)")
    if (diffs.isEmpty()) {
      sb.appendLine("  - (All numeric sliders and visual elements currently match factory defaults)")
    } else {
      diffs.forEach { sb.appendLine(it) }
    }
    if (hiddenCalibrationKeys.isNotEmpty()) {
      sb.appendLine("  - hiddenCalibrationKeys (${hiddenCalibrationKeys.size} hidden): ${hiddenCalibrationKeys.sorted().joinToString(", ")}")
    }
    sb.appendLine()
    sb.appendLine("### SECTION B: COMPLETE REPLACEMENT DEFAULT OBJECTS")
    sb.appendLine("```json")
    val bundle = JSONObject().apply {
      put("DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG", fullConfigJson)
      put("visualForge", RiftVisualForgeState.toJsonObject())
      put("syndicateCrest", RiftVisualForgeState.activeSyndicateCrestRecipe.toJson())
      put("audioForge", RiftSoundSynthesizer.exportAudioForgeJson())
      put("labelPlacements", JSONObject().apply {
        put("bountyPlacement", bountyPlacement.name)
        put("tagPlacement", tagPlacement.name)
        put("namePlacement", namePlacement.name)
      })
      put("BUFF_REGISTRY", registryJson)
      put("hiddenCalibrationKeys", hiddenArr)
    }
    sb.appendLine(bundle.toString(2))
    sb.appendLine("```")

    return Pair(sb.toString(), totalModified)
  }
}

enum class RankedGameMode(

  val subtitle: String,
  val teamFormatBadge: String,
) {
  SECTOR_CONVERGENCE(
    "SECTOR_CONVERGENCE",
    "Sector Convergence",
    "Free-For-All • 1-5 Pilot Squadron",
    "20 PILOTS • 60M",
  ),
  RIFT_SKIRMISH(
    "RIFT_SKIRMISH",
    "Rift Skirmish",
    "Team Deathmatch • 3m Rounds • No Respawn",
    "2v2 - 5v5 • BO3",
  ),
  FLUX_CORE(
    "FLUX_CORE",
    "Flux Core",
    "Hold the Core for +15 Resonance/s & Overcharge",
    "20 PILOTS • BALL",
  ),
  STASIS_BREACH(
    "STASIS_BREACH",
    "Stasis Breach",
    "10v10 • 3m Stasis Captures or Lockdown",
    "10v10 • 3M",
  ),
  RIFT_CONTROL(
    "RIFT_CONTROL",
    "Rift Control",
    "2-Rift Tug-of-War • Hold 15s to Lock",
    "3v3 - 10v10 • 3M",
  ),
  SYNDICATE_WARS(
    "SYNDICATE_WARS",
    "Syndicate Wars",
    "Ranked Syndicate-vs-Syndicate Battles",
    "3v3 / 5v5 / 10v10",
  );

  companion object {
    fun fromId(raw: String): RankedGameMode {
      val clean = raw.trim().uppercase()
      return entries.firstOrNull { it.id == clean }
        ?: when (clean) {
          "FFA", "CONVERGENCE" -> SECTOR_CONVERGENCE
          "SKIRMISH", "TDM", "3V3", "5V5" -> RIFT_SKIRMISH
          "CORE", "JUGGERNAUT" -> FLUX_CORE
          "BREACH", "JAILBREAK", "10V10" -> STASIS_BREACH
          "CONTROL", "RIFT_CONTROL", "TUG", "KOTH" -> RIFT_CONTROL
          "WARS", "CLAN_WARS" -> SYNDICATE_WARS
          else -> SECTOR_CONVERGENCE
        }
    }
  }

enum class AnomalyType {
  PLASMA_RIFT,
  REPULSOR_RIFT,
  GRAVITY_RIFT,
  PHASE_RIFT_A,
  PHASE_RIFT_B,
}

data class SpatialAnomalyEntity(
  val id: String,
  val type: AnomalyType,
  var x: Float,
  var y: Float,
  var physicalRadius: Float = 180f, // Exactly 5x standard ship radius (36f * 5 = 180f)
  var life: Float = 45.0f,
  var maxLife: Float = 45.0f,
  var spinAngle: Float = 0f,
  var partnerId: String = "",
  var absorbedWeaponCount: Int = 0,
  var isUnstableMergedRift: Boolean = false,
  var lastIngressAngle: Float = 0f,
  var lastIngressTimer: Float = 0f,
  var secondaryIngressAngle: Float = 0f,
  var secondaryIngressTimer: Float = 0f,
) {
  fun recordBoundaryIngress(angleRad: Float, durationSec: Float = 0.56f) {
    if (lastIngressTimer > 0.08f && kotlin.math.abs(atan2(sin(angleRad - lastIngressAngle), cos(angleRad - lastIngressAngle))) > 0.28f) {
      secondaryIngressAngle = lastIngressAngle
      secondaryIngressTimer = lastIngressTimer
    }
    lastIngressAngle = angleRad
    lastIngressTimer = max(lastIngressTimer, durationSec)
  }
}

class RiftGameEngine(
  val sfx: RiftSoundSynthesizer,
  var onStatsUpdated: () -> Unit = {},
  var onPrizeToast: (String) -> Unit = {},
  var onArmadaTierKill: (tierSize: Int, bounty: Long) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  var onLifeRunEnded: (snapshot: com.example.data.PeakBountyRunSnapshot, hadPvp: Boolean) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  var onSyndicateContribution: (killsDelta: Long, bounty: Long, winsDelta: Long) -> Unit = { _, _, _ -> },
) {
  companion object {
    const val WORLD_SIZE = 8000f
    const val CAMERA_SCALE = 0.65f
    const val BASE_CAMERA_SCALE = 0.65f
    const val WALL_ELASTICITY = 0.65f
    const val SAFE_ZONE_BOT_BAN_MARGIN = 400f
    const val HVT_BOUNTY_THRESHOLD = 250

    private val BOT_CALLSIGNS =
      listOf(
        "NOVA ACE",
        "SOLARIS IX",
        "IRON WOLF",
        "RIFT 7",
        "VIPER 09",
        "CHRONO X",
        "VALKYRIE Z",
        "MANTA RAY",
        "SOLARIS PRIME",
        "DARK STAR",
        "ZERO DRIFT",
        "HYPERION",
        "VOID REAPER",
        "PULSE 88",
        "TITAN 04",
        "ECHO V",
        "STAR VIPER",
        "OMEGA WING",
        "RAVEN SIX",
        "CRYO BLADE",
        "PHANTOM RAY",
        "STORM RIDER",
        "COBALT FANG",
        "SOLAR FLARE",
      )
    val LEGACY_FOUNDRY_TAGS =
      setOf("KSTL", "AURL", "VRTX", "RUST", "GUE", "GUES", "NOV", "NOVA")

    fun cleanTag(rawTag: String): String {
      val t = rawTag.trim().removeSurrounding("[", "]").trim().uppercase()
      return when {
        t.isEmpty() ||
          t in LEGACY_FOUNDRY_TAGS ||
          t in com.example.data.LocalPilotPrefs.NON_PLAYER_SYNDICATE_TAGS -> "GUEST"
        else -> t.take(3)
      }
    }
  }

  val walls = mutableListOf<WallRect>()
  val brickWalls = mutableListOf<BrickWallEntity>()
  val decoys = mutableListOf<DecoyEntity>()
  val swarmDrones = mutableListOf<SwarmDroneEntity>()
  val pendingAsteroidRespawns = mutableListOf<PendingAsteroidRespawn>()
  private var nextDecoyBrickId: Long = 1L
  private var nextSwarmDroneId: Long = 1L
  private var gravityRadarBakeTimer: Float = 0f
  val safeZone = RectF(3620f, 3620f, 4380f, 4380f)
  val greens = mutableListOf<GreenCrate>()
  val recentBuffSpawnLocations = ArrayDeque<Pair<Float, Float>>()
  val pendingBuffSpawns = mutableListOf<Float>()
  var radarBgBitmap: Bitmap? = null

  fun getSafeZoneRadius(): Float {
    val r = 380f * RiftCalibrationState.safeZoneScale.coerceIn(0.5f, 2.0f)
    safeZone.set(arenaCenterX - r, arenaCenterY - r, arenaCenterX + r, arenaCenterY + r)
    return r
  }

  fun getEffectiveBuffCap(): Int {
    val mult = (currentCustomGame?.crateSpawnMult ?: 1.0f).coerceIn(0f, 3f)
    RiftCalibrationState.buffTargetCountOverride?.let { return (it * mult).toInt().coerceAtLeast(0) }
    val modeCap =
      when (RiftCalibrationState.buffModeOverride.uppercase()) {
        "3V3" -> 12
        "5V5" -> 10
        "10V10" -> 20
        else -> RiftCalibrationState.buffCapFfa
      }
    return (modeCap * mult).toInt().coerceAtLeast(0)
  }

  var mode: String = "SECTOR_CONVERGENCE"
  var activeRankedMode: RankedGameMode = RankedGameMode.SECTOR_CONVERGENCE
  var activeTeamSizeBracket: Int = 3 // 2..5 for RIFT_SKIRMISH, 3/5/10 for RIFT_CONTROL & SYNDICATE_WARS, 10 for STASIS_BREACH
  var teamSize: Int = 20
  var buffVersion: Int = 0
  var isShipLockedForMatch: Boolean = false

  // Cloneable Non-Ranked Custom Game Instances
  val activeCustomGames = mutableListOf<CustomGameConfig>()
  var currentCustomGame: CustomGameConfig? = null

  // Mode 2 (RIFT_SKIRMISH) & Syndicate Wars TDM Best-of-3 State (3m rounds, no respawn until round end, ally spectate, 1v1 escalation & 10s ready-up)
  var skirmishRound: Int = 1
  val skirmishCurrentRound: Int
    get() = skirmishRound
  var skirmishWestRoundWins: Int = 0
  var skirmishEastRoundWins: Int = 0
  var skirmishWestKills: Int = 0
  var skirmishEastKills: Int = 0
  var skirmishRoundTimerSec: Float = 180f
  var skirmishIs1v1Escalated: Boolean = false
  var skirmishAbyssalBlend: Float = 0f
  var skirmish1v1AlertBanner: String = ""
  var skirmish1v1AlertTimer: Float = 0f
  var skirmishReadyCountdownSec: Float = 0f
  val skirmishReadyDurationSec: Float = 10.0f
  var spectatingTargetShipId: String = ""
  var rivalSyndicateWarTag: String = "BOT"
  var onSyndicateWarFinished: (won: Boolean, trophyDelta: Int) -> Unit = { _, _ -> }

  private fun clearShipToggleBuffs(ship: ShipEntity, clearSlotIfActive: Boolean = false) {
    val hadCrateToggleActive =
      (ship.tractorBeamActive && !ship.tractorFromSecondary) ||
        (ship.lanceBeamActive && !ship.lanceFromSecondary)
    ship.tractorBeamActive = false
    ship.tractorFromSecondary = false
    ship.tractorTargetShipId = ""
    ship.lanceBeamActive = false
    ship.lanceFromSecondary = false
    ship.lanceHitSparkActive = false
    ship.lanceTickTimer = 0f
    ship.novaWavesRemaining = 0
    ship.novaWaveTimer = 0f
    if (clearSlotIfActive && hadCrateToggleActive) {
      ship.specialWeaponType = "NONE"
      ship.specialWeaponCharges = 0
      ship.specialWeaponStacks = 0
      if (ship.isLocalPlayer) buffVersion++
    }
  }

  private fun resetDeathmatchEscalationAndReadyState() {
    skirmishIs1v1Escalated = false
    skirmishAbyssalBlend = 0f
    skirmish1v1AlertBanner = ""
    skirmish1v1AlertTimer = 0f
    skirmishReadyCountdownSec = 0f
    sfx.setDynamicEscalationTargetBpm(null)
  }

  // Mode 3 (FLUX_CORE) Volatile Singularity State
  val fluxCoreOrb = FluxCoreOrbState()
  var fluxCoreCarrierEntityId: String = ""
  private var fluxCoreBountyTickAccum: Float = 0f

  // Circular Dynamic-Radius Playfield (centered at 4000, 4000; scales 2100f..3800f with ship count)
  val arenaCenterX: Float = 4000f
  val arenaCenterY: Float = 4000f
  var arenaRadius: Float = 3800f
  private var currentArenaSeed: Int = (System.currentTimeMillis() / 3600_000L).toInt()

  private fun spawnDropletReactionBurst(
    originX: Float,
    originY: Float,
    targetOrWakeX: Float,
    targetOrWakeY: Float,
    pullInward: Boolean,
    crystalCount: Int,
    filamentCount: Int,
    outerColor: Int,
    midColor: Int,
    coreColor: Int,
    baseCrystalRadius: Float = 5.6f,
    durationSec: Float = 0.56f,
  ) {
    val dx = targetOrWakeX - originX
    val dy = targetOrWakeY - originY
    val span = hypot(dx, dy).coerceAtLeast(1f)
    val ux = dx / span
    val uy = dy / span
    val px = -uy
    val py = ux

    val maxPrecipitates = 96
    if (reactivePrecipitates.size + crystalCount > maxPrecipitates) {
      val drop = (reactivePrecipitates.size + crystalCount - maxPrecipitates).coerceAtLeast(0)
      repeat(min(drop, reactivePrecipitates.size)) { reactivePrecipitates.removeAt(0) }
    }
    for (c in 0 until crystalCount) {
      val spread = (Random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 1.15f
      val baseSpeed = if (pullInward) (115f + Random.nextFloat() * 145f) else (78f + Random.nextFloat() * 135f)
      val dirAng = atan2(uy, ux) + spread * 0.55f
      val seed = nextPrecipitateSeed++
      val life = (durationSec * (0.78f + Random.nextFloat() * 0.36f)).coerceIn(0.24f, 1.15f)
      reactivePrecipitates.add(
        ReactivePrecipitateCluster(
          x = originX + px * spread * 14f,
          y = originY + py * spread * 14f,
          vx = cos(dirAng) * baseSpeed + px * spread * 48f,
          vy = sin(dirAng) * baseSpeed + py * spread * 48f,
          anchorX = targetOrWakeX,
          anchorY = targetOrWakeY,
          pullToAnchor = pullInward,
          angle = Random.nextFloat() * (PI.toFloat() * 2f),
          angVel = (if (seed % 2 == 0) 1f else -1f) * (3.2f + Random.nextFloat() * 4.2f),
          radius = (baseCrystalRadius * (0.76f + Random.nextFloat() * 0.52f)).coerceIn(2.6f, 12.5f),
          life = life,
          maxLife = life,
          primaryColor = if (c % 2 == 0) midColor else outerColor,
          coreColor = coreColor,
          facetSeed = seed,
        )
      )
    }

    val maxFilaments = 84
    if (reactiveFilaments.size + filamentCount > maxFilaments) {
      val drop = (reactiveFilaments.size + filamentCount - maxFilaments).coerceAtLeast(0)
      repeat(min(drop, reactiveFilaments.size)) { reactiveFilaments.removeAt(0) }
    }
    for (f in 0 until filamentCount) {
      val archSign = if (f % 2 == 0) 1f else -1f
      val archOffset = (16f + Random.nextFloat() * 26f) * archSign
      val reach = if (pullInward) min(span * 0.88f, 138f) else (38f + Random.nextFloat() * 58f)
      val endX = originX + ux * reach + px * (archSign * 10f)
      val endY = originY + uy * reach + py * (archSign * 10f)
      val ctrlX = originX + ux * (reach * 0.52f) + px * archOffset
      val ctrlY = originY + uy * (reach * 0.52f) + py * archOffset
      val fLife = (durationSec * (0.72f + Random.nextFloat() * 0.30f)).coerceIn(0.22f, 0.95f)
      reactiveFilaments.add(
        ReactiveFilamentTrail(
          x0 = originX,
          y0 = originY,
          ctrlX = ctrlX,
          ctrlY = ctrlY,
          x1 = endX,
          y1 = endY,
          vx1 = ux * (if (pullInward) 85f else 64f) + px * archSign * 34f,
          vy1 = uy * (if (pullInward) 85f else 64f) + py * archSign * 34f,
          life = fLife,
          maxLife = fLife,
          outerColor = outerColor,
          midColor = midColor,
          coreColor = coreColor,
          thickness = (2.8f + Random.nextFloat() * 1.8f),
        )
      )
    }
  }
