                      coreColor = Color.rgb(250, 204, 21),
                      baseCrystalRadius = 5.4f,
                      durationSec = 0.42f,
                    )
                  }
                }

                if (w.hp <= 0f || dist <= anom.physicalRadius * 0.42f) {
                  anom.recordBoundaryIngress(atan2(wCy - anom.y, wCx - anom.x), 0.72f)
                  spawnDropletReactionBurst(
                    originX = wCx,
                    originY = wCy,
                    targetOrWakeX = anom.x,
                    targetOrWakeY = anom.y,
                    pullInward = true,
                    crystalCount = 8,
                    filamentCount = 5,
                    outerColor = Color.rgb(168, 85, 247),
                    midColor = Color.rgb(0, 245, 212),
                    coreColor = Color.rgb(250, 204, 21),
                    baseCrystalRadius = 8.2f,
                    durationSec = 0.78f,
                  )
                  val isStation =
                    w.style == SpaceObstacleStyle.ORBITAL_STATION ||
                      w.style == SpaceObstacleStyle.ASTEROID_STATION
                  pendingAsteroidRespawns.add(
                    PendingAsteroidRespawn(
                      x = w.x,
                      y = w.y,
                      w = w.w,
                      h = w.h,
                      variantSeed = w.variantSeed,
                      timerSec = 20.0f,
                      style = w.style,
                    )
                  )
                  walls.removeAt(wIdx)
                  val clearDrop = resolveClearCrateDropPosition(wCx, wCy)
                  greens.add(
                    GreenCrate(
                      x = clearDrop.first,
                      y = clearDrop.second,
                      spinPhase = Random.nextFloat() * (PI.toFloat() * 2f),
                      buffType = rollRandomCrateBuffType(),
                    )
                  )
                  if (isStation) {
                    val customSpdMult = currentCustomGame?.speedMult ?: 1.0f
                    val customDmgMult = currentCustomGame?.damageMult ?: 1.0f
                    val novaSpeed = 820f * customSpdMult
                    val novaDamage = 165f * customDmgMult
                    val exitR = halfDiag + 12f
                    val overloadTriggerId = w.lastAttackerShipId
                    for (k in 0 until 16) {
                      val a = (PI.toFloat() * 2f * k) / 16f
                      val sx = wCx + cos(a) * exitR
                      val sy = wCy + sin(a) * exitR
                      if (isInsideSafeZone(sx, sy)) continue
                      bullets.add(
                        BulletEntity(
                          ownerId = "station_defense",
                          ownerShipId = 0,
                          ownerCallsign = "STATION DEFENSE",
                          ownerSyndicateTag = "SECTOR",
                          ownerArmadaName = "",
                          ownerIsHuman = false,
                          freq = -999,
                          x = sx,
                          y = sy,
                          vx = cos(a) * novaSpeed,
                          vy = sin(a) * novaSpeed,
                          damage = novaDamage,
                          bouncesLeft = 1,
                          life = 1.85f,
                          color = Color.parseColor("#FACC15"),
                          isHeavyBurst = true,
                          ownerShipLabel = "Orbital Station",
                          weaponLabel = "Station Overload Nova",
                          triggeredByShipId = overloadTriggerId,
                        )
                      )
                    }
                    shockwaves.add(ShockwaveEntity(wCx, wCy, 28f, 290f, Color.parseColor("#FACC15")))
                  }
                  shockwaves.add(ShockwaveEntity(anom.x, anom.y, 22f, anom.physicalRadius * 1.22f, Color.parseColor("#A855F7")))
                  shockwaves.add(ShockwaveEntity(wCx, wCy, 14f, 185f, Color.parseColor("#00F5D4")))
                  spawnExplosion(wCx, wCy, Color.parseColor("#C084FC"))
                  if (hypot(wCx - localPlayer.x, wCy - localPlayer.y) < 1400f) {
                    sfx.playExplosion()
                    addTrauma(if (isStation) 0.36f else 0.28f)
                  }
                  spawnPooledFct(
                    text =
                      if (isStation) "STATION IMPLODED • OVERLOAD NOVA!"
                      else "RIFT IMPLOSION • SUPPLY DROP",
                    x = wCx,
                    y = wCy - 32f,
                    color = if (isStation) Color.parseColor("#FACC15") else Color.parseColor("#C084FC"),
                    maxLife = 1.35f,
                  )
                  implodedAnyObstacle = true
                }
              }
            }

            for (bwIdx in brickWalls.indices.reversed()) {
              val bw = brickWalls[bwIdx]
              var bCx = bw.x + bw.w * 0.5f
              var bCy = bw.y + bw.h * 0.5f
              val dx = anom.x - bCx
              val dy = anom.y - bCy
              var dist = hypot(dx, dy)
              if (dist <= obstaclePullRange) {
                if (dist > 0.5f) {
                  val step = min(dist, 215f * dt)
                  val nextX = bw.x + (dx / dist) * step
                  val nextY = bw.y + (dy / dist) * step
                  if (!rectOverlapsProtectedZone(nextX, nextY, bw.w, bw.h)) {
                    bw.x = nextX
                    bw.y = nextY
                    bCx = bw.x + bw.w * 0.5f
                    bCy = bw.y + bw.h * 0.5f
                    dist = hypot(anom.x - bCx, anom.y - bCy)
                    movedAnyObstacle = true
                  }
                }
                if (dist <= anom.physicalRadius * 0.95f) {
                  bw.life -= 8.5f * dt
                }
                if (bw.life <= 0f || dist <= anom.physicalRadius * 0.42f) {
                  brickWalls.removeAt(bwIdx)
                  shockwaves.add(ShockwaveEntity(bCx, bCy, 14f, 165f, Color.parseColor("#A855F7")))
                  spawnExplosion(bCx, bCy, Color.parseColor("#C084FC"))
                }
              }
            }

            if (implodedAnyObstacle || (movedAnyObstacle && gravityRadarBakeTimer <= 0f)) {
              gravityRadarBakeTimer = 0.45f
              bakeStaticRadarBitmap()
            }
          }

          // Supermassive Gravity Rift gravitational attraction toward nearby non-partnered Rifts (enables live convergence)
          if (anom.physicalRadius >= 360f) {
            val nearbyOther =
              anomalies.firstOrNull {
                it.id != anom.id &&
                  !it.isUnstableMergedRift &&
                  hypot(it.x - anom.x, it.y - anom.y) <= 980f
              }
            if (nearbyOther != null) {
              val dx = nearbyOther.x - anom.x
              val dy = nearbyOther.y - anom.y
              val d = hypot(dx, dy).coerceAtLeast(1f)
              anom.x += (dx / d) * 22f * dt
              anom.y += (dy / d) * 22f * dt
            }
          }
        }

        AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_A, AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_B -> {
          val nodeRadius = anom.physicalRadius * 0.52f
          val phaseCd = RiftCalibrationState.phaseRiftCooldownSec
          val partner = anomalies.firstOrNull { it.id == anom.partnerId }
          if (partner != null) {
            for (s in ships) {
              if (s.respawnTimer > 0f) continue
              if (s.phaseRiftCooldownTimer <= 0f && hypot(s.x - anom.x, s.y - anom.y) < nodeRadius + s.radius * 0.5f) {
                val entryAng = atan2(s.y - anom.y, s.x - anom.x)
                val exitAng = atan2(s.vy, s.vx)
                anom.recordBoundaryIngress(entryAng, 0.60f)
                partner.recordBoundaryIngress(exitAng, 0.60f)
                s.x = partner.x
                s.y = partner.y
                s.phaseRiftCooldownTimer = phaseCd
                spawnDropletReactionBurst(
                  originX = partner.x + cos(exitAng) * (partner.physicalRadius * 0.55f),
                  originY = partner.y + sin(exitAng) * (partner.physicalRadius * 0.55f),
                  targetOrWakeX = s.x + s.vx * 0.18f,
                  targetOrWakeY = s.y + s.vy * 0.18f,
                  pullInward = false,
                  crystalCount = 5,
                  filamentCount = 4,
                  outerColor = Color.rgb(45, 212, 191),
                  midColor = Color.rgb(56, 189, 248),
                  coreColor = Color.rgb(250, 204, 21),
                  baseCrystalRadius = 6.0f,
                )
                spawnExplosion(anom.x, anom.y, Color.parseColor("#2DD4BF"))
                spawnExplosion(partner.x, partner.y, Color.parseColor("#2DD4BF"))
                if (s.isLocalPlayer) {
                  sfx.playWarp()
                  spawnPooledFct("PHASE RIFT TRANSIT", s.x, s.y - 36f, Color.parseColor("#2DD4BF"))
                }
              }
            }

            for (d in decoys) {
              if (d.phaseRiftCooldownTimer <= 0f && hypot(d.x - anom.x, d.y - anom.y) < nodeRadius + 18f) {
                anom.recordBoundaryIngress(atan2(d.y - anom.y, d.x - anom.x), 0.50f)
                partner.recordBoundaryIngress(atan2(d.vy, d.vx), 0.50f)
                d.x = partner.x
                d.y = partner.y
                d.phaseRiftCooldownTimer = phaseCd
                spawnExplosion(anom.x, anom.y, Color.parseColor("#2DD4BF"))
                spawnExplosion(partner.x, partner.y, Color.parseColor("#2DD4BF"))
              }
            }

            for (dr in swarmDrones) {
              if (dr.phaseRiftCooldownTimer <= 0f && hypot(dr.x - anom.x, dr.y - anom.y) < nodeRadius + 14f) {
                anom.recordBoundaryIngress(atan2(dr.y - anom.y, dr.x - anom.x), 0.50f)
                partner.recordBoundaryIngress(atan2(dr.vy, dr.vx), 0.50f)
                dr.x = partner.x
                dr.y = partner.y
                dr.phaseRiftCooldownTimer = phaseCd
                spawnExplosion(anom.x, anom.y, Color.parseColor("#00F5D4"))
                spawnExplosion(partner.x, partner.y, Color.parseColor("#00F5D4"))
              }
            }

            for (b in bullets) {
              if (b.phaseRiftCooldownTimer <= 0f && hypot(b.x - anom.x, b.y - anom.y) < nodeRadius) {
                anom.recordBoundaryIngress(atan2(b.y - anom.y, b.x - anom.x), 0.42f)
                partner.recordBoundaryIngress(atan2(b.vy, b.vx), 0.42f)
                b.x = partner.x
                b.y = partner.y
                b.phaseRiftCooldownTimer = phaseCd
              }
            }

            for (bm in bombs) {
              if (bm.phaseRiftCooldownTimer <= 0f && hypot(bm.x - anom.x, bm.y - anom.y) < nodeRadius) {
                anom.recordBoundaryIngress(atan2(bm.y - anom.y, bm.x - anom.x), 0.52f)
                partner.recordBoundaryIngress(atan2(bm.vy, bm.vx), 0.52f)
                bm.x = partner.x
                bm.y = partner.y
                bm.phaseRiftCooldownTimer = phaseCd
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Cleanly respawn expired Rifts on 45s cycles & replenish sector Rifts after Unstable Rift Collapse
    for (singleType in expiredSinglesToRespawn) {
      spawnSingleAnomaly(singleType)
    }
    if (expiredPairsToRespawn.isNotEmpty()) {
      anomalies.removeAll { !it.isUnstableMergedRift && (it.type == AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_A || it.type == AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_B) }
      spawnPhaseRiftPair()
    }
    if (unstableDetonatedThisStep) {
      for (reqType in listOf(AnomalyType.PLASMA_RIFT, AnomalyType.REPULSOR_RIFT, AnomalyType.GRAVITY_RIFT)) {
        if (anomalies.none { !it.isUnstableMergedRift && it.type == reqType }) {
          spawnSingleAnomaly(reqType)
        }
      }
      val activePhaseNodes = anomalies.count { !it.isUnstableMergedRift && (it.type == AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_A || it.type == AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_B) && it.partnerId.isNotEmpty() }
      if (activePhaseNodes < 2) {
        anomalies.removeAll { !it.isUnstableMergedRift && (it.type == AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_A || it.type == AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_B) }
        spawnPhaseRiftPair()
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Collects relative team & objective waypoints (living allies + active Flux Core, Stasis Breach,
   * and Rift Control objectives) for off-screen edge directional chevrons.
   */
  fun collectTacticalWaypointsForLocal(): List<OffScreenTacticalTarget> {
    val p = localPlayer
    val out = ArrayList<OffScreenTacticalTarget>(10)
    val localFreq = if (p.freq == 1) 1 else 0

    // 1. Active Mode Objectives (highest tactical priority)
    if (isFluxCoreRulesActive()) {
      if (fluxCoreCarrierEntityId.isEmpty()) {
        val distM = (hypot(fluxCoreOrb.x - p.x, fluxCoreOrb.y - p.y) / 10f).roundToInt()
        out.add(
          OffScreenTacticalTarget(
            id = "obj_flux_orb",
            kind = OffScreenTargetKind.FLUX_CORE_ORB,
            label = "FLUX CORE",
            worldX = fluxCoreOrb.x,
            worldY = fluxCoreOrb.y,
            distanceMeters = distM,
            colorHex = 0xFFFACC15L,
            isUrgent = true,
          )
        )
      } else if (fluxCoreCarrierEntityId != p.id) {
        val carrier = ships.firstOrNull { it.id == fluxCoreCarrierEntityId && it.respawnTimer <= 0f }
        if (carrier != null && (!carrier.isCloaked || areAllied(p, carrier))) {
          val distM = (hypot(carrier.x - p.x, carrier.y - p.y) / 10f).roundToInt()
          val alliedCarrier = areAllied(p, carrier)
          out.add(
            OffScreenTacticalTarget(
              id = "obj_flux_carrier_${carrier.id}",
              kind =
                if (alliedCarrier) OffScreenTargetKind.FLUX_CORE_ALLY_CARRIER
                else OffScreenTargetKind.FLUX_CORE_ENEMY_CARRIER,
              label =
                if (alliedCarrier) "ESCORT ${carrier.callsign.take(8)}"
                else "CORE ${carrier.callsign.take(8)}",
              worldX = carrier.x,
              worldY = carrier.y,
              distanceMeters = distM,
              colorHex = if (alliedCarrier) 0xFF38BDF8L else 0xFFFB7185L,
              isUrgent = true,
            )
          )
        }
      }
    }

    if (isStasisBreachRulesActive()) {
      val yourBrigX = if (localFreq == 1) eastBrigReactorX else westBrigReactorX
      val yourBrigY = if (localFreq == 1) eastBrigReactorY else westBrigReactorY
      val enemyBrigX = if (localFreq == 1) westBrigReactorX else eastBrigReactorX
      val enemyBrigY = if (localFreq == 1) westBrigReactorY else eastBrigReactorY
      val yourBrigHp = if (localFreq == 1) eastBrigGeneratorHp else westBrigGeneratorHp
      val capturedAllies =
        ships.count { it.id != p.id && areAllied(p, it) && it.isInStasisBrig }
      val capturedEnemies =
        ships.count { !areAllied(p, it) && it.isInStasisBrig }

      val enemyBrigDistM = (hypot(enemyBrigX - p.x, enemyBrigY - p.y) / 10f).roundToInt()
      out.add(
        OffScreenTacticalTarget(
          id = "obj_stasis_enemy_brig",
          kind = OffScreenTargetKind.STASIS_ENEMY_BRIG,
          label =
            if (capturedAllies > 0) "FREE $capturedAllies ALLY"
            else "BREACH CORE",
          worldX = enemyBrigX,
          worldY = enemyBrigY,
          distanceMeters = enemyBrigDistM,
          colorHex = if (capturedAllies > 0) 0xFFFACC15L else 0xFFFB7185L,
          isUrgent = capturedAllies > 0,
        )
      )

      if (capturedEnemies > 0 || yourBrigHp < getEffectiveBrigReactorMaxHp() * 0.92f) {
        val yourBrigDistM = (hypot(yourBrigX - p.x, yourBrigY - p.y) / 10f).roundToInt()
        out.add(
          OffScreenTacticalTarget(
            id = "obj_stasis_ally_brig",
            kind = OffScreenTargetKind.STASIS_ALLY_BRIG,
            label = "DEFEND CORE",
            worldX = yourBrigX,
            worldY = yourBrigY,
            distanceMeters = yourBrigDistM,
            colorHex = 0xFF38BDF8L,
            isUrgent = yourBrigHp < getEffectiveBrigReactorMaxHp() * 0.50f,
          )
        )
      }
    }

    if (isRiftControlRulesActive()) {
      fun addControlPoint(
        pointId: String,
        shortName: String,
        tx: Float,
        ty: Float,
        controlSec: Float,
        lockedBy: Int,
        westCnt: Int,
        eastCnt: Int,
      ) {
        val isContested = westCnt > 0 && eastCnt > 0 && westCnt == eastCnt
        val friendlyHeld =
          lockedBy == localFreq ||
            (localFreq == 0 && controlSec < -0.25f) ||
            (localFreq == 1 && controlSec > 0.25f)
        val enemyHeld =
          lockedBy == (1 - localFreq) ||
            (localFreq == 0 && controlSec > 0.25f) ||
            (localFreq == 1 && controlSec < -0.25f)
        val colorHex =
          when {
            isContested -> 0xFFFACC15L
            friendlyHeld -> 0xFF38BDF8L
            enemyHeld -> 0xFFFB7185L
            else -> 0xFF00F5D4L
          }
        val stateSuffix =
          when {
            isContested -> " CONTEST"
            lockedBy == localFreq -> " YOURS"
            lockedBy == (1 - localFreq) -> " ENEMY"
            else -> ""
          }
        out.add(
          OffScreenTacticalTarget(
            id = pointId,
            kind = OffScreenTargetKind.RIFT_CONTROL_POINT,
            label = "$shortName$stateSuffix",
            worldX = tx,
            worldY = ty,
            distanceMeters = (hypot(tx - p.x, ty - p.y) / 10f).roundToInt(),
            colorHex = colorHex,
            isUrgent = isContested || enemyHeld,
          )
        )
      }

      addControlPoint(
        pointId = "obj_rift_alpha",
        shortName = "ALPHA",
        tx = riftAlphaX,
        ty = riftAlphaY,
        controlSec = riftAlphaControlSec,
        lockedBy = riftAlphaLockedBy,
        westCnt = riftAlphaWestCount,
        eastCnt = riftAlphaEastCount,
      )
      addControlPoint(
        pointId = "obj_rift_omega",
        shortName = "OMEGA",
        tx = riftOmegaX,
        ty = riftOmegaY,
        controlSec = riftOmegaControlSec,
        lockedBy = riftOmegaLockedBy,
        westCnt = riftOmegaWestCount,
        eastCnt = riftOmegaEastCount,
      )
    }

    // 2. Living Allied Ships (skip if already represented as Flux Core carrier)
    for (s in ships) {
      if (s.id == p.id || s.respawnTimer > 0f) continue
      if (!areAllied(p, s)) continue
      if (isFluxCoreRulesActive() && fluxCoreCarrierEntityId == s.id) continue
      val distM = (hypot(s.x - p.x, s.y - p.y) / 10f).roundToInt()
      val lowFlux = (s.flux / s.maxFlux.coerceAtLeast(1f)) < 0.30f
      out.add(
        OffScreenTacticalTarget(
          id = "ally_${s.id}",
          kind = OffScreenTargetKind.ALLY_SHIP,
          label = s.callsign.take(9),
          worldX = s.x,
          worldY = s.y,
          distanceMeters = distM,
          colorHex = if (s.isInStasisBrig) 0xFFFACC15L else 0xFF38BDF8L,
          isUrgent = s.isInStasisBrig || lowFlux,
        )
      )
    }

    return out
  }
}

enum class OffScreenTargetKind {
  ALLY_SHIP,
  FLUX_CORE_ORB,
  FLUX_CORE_ALLY_CARRIER,
  FLUX_CORE_ENEMY_CARRIER,
  STASIS_ALLY_BRIG,
  STASIS_ENEMY_BRIG,
  RIFT_CONTROL_POINT,
}

data class OffScreenTacticalTarget(
  val id: String,
  val kind: OffScreenTargetKind,
  val label: String,
  val worldX: Float,
  val worldY: Float,
  val distanceMeters: Int,
  val colorHex: Long,
  val isUrgent: Boolean = false,
)

  fun buildLiveSystemPrompt(
    engine: RiftGameEngine,
    localPrefs: LocalPilotPrefs,
    currentUserId: String,
    callsign: String,
    syndicateTag: String,
    syndicateName: String,
    cloudLeaderboard: List<LeaderboardEntry>,
    allTimePeakSnapshot: PeakBountyRunSnapshot?,
    pvpPeakSnapshot: PeakBountyRunSnapshot?,
    syndicateHistory: List<SyndicateServiceEntry>,
  ): String =
    compileLiveSnapshot(
      engine = engine,
      localPrefs = localPrefs,
      currentUserId = currentUserId,
      callsign = callsign,
      syndicateTag = syndicateTag,
      syndicateName = syndicateName,
      cloudLeaderboard = cloudLeaderboard,
      allTimePeakSnapshot = allTimePeakSnapshot,
      pvpPeakSnapshot = pvpPeakSnapshot,
      syndicateHistory = syndicateHistory,
    )

Active ONLY in SECTOR CONVERGENCE and FLUX CORE (live hasActiveSafeZone() = ${engine.hasActiveSafeZone()}, 15s max stay / weapon-lockout); completely disabled in RIFT CONTROL, STASIS BREACH, RIFT SKIRMISH, and SYNDICATE WARS. Open-Space Anti-AFK Flux drain is likewise restricted strictly to SECTOR CONVERGENCE and FLUX CORE."

    sb.appendLine(

Multiplayer syncs cosmetics via Firestore-safe __C<skin><fin><warp><halo> tags validated against remote Live Resonance.",

    sb.appendLine(

        RiftCalibrationState.empFluxDrainPct * 100f,
        RiftCalibrationState.empFreezeSec,

        RiftCalibrationState.maxMinesPerShip,
        19f * projScale,

        RiftCalibrationState.seekerFlightTime,
        RiftCalibrationState.stasisBarrierLength,
        RiftCalibrationState.stasisBarrierDuration,

        "- Destructible Crystal Asteroids & 10-Hit Station Defense Novas: Crystal Asteroids have 2,400 Flux integrity with an on-rock circular integrity ring; shattering one drops a guaranteed Supply Crate and schedules a 20.0s respawn (%d pending respawns). Orbital & Asteroid Stations track weapon impacts with a 10-segment charge ring and unleash a 16-bolt 360-degree Station Defense Nova every 10 hits (+10%% Resonance credit to the triggering pilot on enemy eliminations, -15%% Resonance self-backfire penalty if killed by your own triggered Nova; also detonates as a 16-bolt Station Overload Nova when imploded by a >= 260px Gravity Rift). Supply Crate world size = %.2f world px; 3D AGSL Plasma Flux Ring wraps the 1:1 arenaRadius Circular Minimap.",

Local pilot spawns at %d Starting Resonance; High-Resonance Target halo above match average (Rift Leader threshold >= %d Resonance); eliminating a target awards +%.0f%% victim Resonance; Supply Crates +%d Resonance. Winning with >50%% presence awards +100 Rift Shards.",

    sb.appendLine("[3. COMPLETE 10-SHIP ROSTER -- ALL 10 OPEN AT 0 RESONANCE (100-POINT PARITY)]")
    for (spec in RiftCodex.getAllTenShips()) {
      val shaftWorldPx = spec.primarySpeed * 0.036f

    sb.appendLine(

        unstableCount,

        RiftCalibrationState.repulsorFieldRadius,
        RiftCalibrationState.gravityPullRadius,
        RiftCalibrationState.phaseRiftCooldownSec,
      )
    )

    sb.appendLine("[6. REAL-PLAYER-ONLY SWORN PILOT LEADERBOARD & DOSSIER RECORDS]")
    val realCloudLeaderboard =
      cloudLeaderboard.filter {
        val rawT = it.syndicateTag.trim().uppercase(Locale.US)
        rawT != "BOT" &&
          rawT != "RFT" &&
          !it.callsign.contains("[BOT]") &&
          !it.userId.startsWith("dev_")
      }
    val topCloudAllTime = realCloudLeaderboard.maxByOrNull { it.allTimeBounty }
    if (topCloudAllTime != null) {
      val synClean = localPrefs.sanitizeSyndicateTag(topCloudAllTime.syndicateTag)
      val synBadge = if (synClean.isNotEmpty()) "[$synClean] " else ""
      sb.appendLine(

      )
    } else {
      sb.appendLine(
        "- Cloud Leaderboard Status: 0 Sworn Pilot records synced yet (AI Bots and [RFT] Drifters are strictly excluded)."
      )
    }

    val p = engine.localPlayer
    val pSpeed = hypot(p.vx, p.vy).roundToInt()
    val secX = ((p.x / 1000f).toInt()).coerceIn(0, 7)
    val secY = ((p.y / 1000f).toInt()).coerceIn(0, 7)
    val sectorStr = "${('A' + secX)}${secY + 1}"
    val perShipResSummary =
      (1..10).joinToString(", ") { id ->
        val cleanName =
          if (id == 10) "Rift Frame"
          else RiftCodex.getShipById(id).name.replace(Regex("^[0-9]+-"), "").trim()
        "$cleanName:${engine.getShipResonance(id)}"
      }
    val activeSynClean = localPrefs.sanitizeSyndicateTag(syndicateTag)
    val activeSynLabel = if (activeSynClean.isNotEmpty()) "[$activeSynClean] " else "[SOLO] "
    val skinName =
      RiftProgressionCatalog.hullTrims.firstOrNull { it.id == p.equippedHullSkin }?.name
        ?: "Standard Faction Trim"
    val finName =
      RiftProgressionCatalog.killFinishers.firstOrNull { it.id == p.equippedKillFinisher }?.name
        ?: "Plasma Supernova"
    val warpName =
      RiftProgressionCatalog.warpSignatures.firstOrNull { it.id == p.equippedWarpStyle }?.name
        ?: "Cyan Phase Aperture"
    val haloName =
      RiftProgressionCatalog.hvtHalos.firstOrNull { it.id == p.equippedHvtHaloStyle }?.name
        ?: "Tactical Amber Reticle"
    sb.appendLine(
      "- Active Pilot: $activeSynLabel$callsign (Syndicate: '$syndicateName') | Conduit Rank Tier: ${conduitTier.title} (Next Tier: $nextTierText) | Starting Match Resonance: $startRes | Live Resonance: $liveRes | Peak Resonance: $peakRes | Per-Ship Resonance (10 Hulls): [$perShipResSummary] | Rift Shards: ${engine.riftShards} | Cosmetics: Skin='$skinName' (#${p.equippedHullSkin}), Finisher='$finName' (#${p.equippedKillFinisher}), Warp='$warpName' (#${p.equippedWarpStyle}), Leader Halo='$haloName' (#${p.equippedHvtHaloStyle}) | Live Hull: ${engine.formatShipLabel(p)} (${engine.getShipResonance(p.shipId)} Resonance) in Sector $sectorStr, Speed=$pSpeed px/s, Flux=${p.flux.toInt()}/${p.maxFlux.toInt()} Flux."
    )

    fun formatSnapshot(label: String, snap: PeakBountyRunSnapshot?) {
      if (snap == null) return
      sb.appendLine(
        "- $label: Peak Resonance=${snap.bountyReached} Resonance in ${snap.shipFlown}, Survived=${snap.formattedDuration()}, Kills=${snap.pvpKills} PVP / ${snap.botKills} Bot, Damage=${snap.damageDealt.toInt()} Flux dealt / ${snap.damageTaken.toInt()} Flux taken."
      )
    }
    formatSnapshot("All-Time Peak Resonance Run", allTimePeakSnapshot)
    formatSnapshot("PVP Peak Resonance Run", pvpPeakSnapshot)

    if (syndicateHistory.isNotEmpty()) {
      sb.appendLine(
        "- Syndicate Service History: " +
          syndicateHistory.joinToString(" ; ") {
            "[${it.syndicateTag}] ${it.syndicateName} (${it.totalKills}K, ${it.publicGameWins}W)"
          }
      )
    }

    val modifiedCalibrations =
      RiftCalibrationState.buildAllParameterDescriptors().mapNotNull { desc ->
        val cur = desc.getter()
        val def = RiftCalibrationState.DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]
        if (def != null && abs(cur - def) > 0.0005f) {
          "${desc.title}: ${desc.formatValue(def)} -> ${desc.formatValue(cur)}"
        } else {
          null
        }
      }
    if (modifiedCalibrations.isNotEmpty()) {
      sb.appendLine(
        "- Live Calibration Overrides (${modifiedCalibrations.size}): ${modifiedCalibrations.joinToString(" | ")}"
      )
    }

    return sb.toString()
  }
}
