  val BUFF_REGISTRY: MutableMap<String, SpecialBuffRegistryEntry> = createCoreBuffRegistry()

  fun normalizeSpecialBuffId(raw: String): String {
    val clean = raw.trim().uppercase(Locale.US)
    return when (clean) {
      "BURST", "NOVA", "NOVA_RING" -> "NOVA_RING"
      "SHOTGUN", "SHATTER", "SHATTER_CONE" -> "SHATTER_CONE"
      "MISSILE", "SEEKER", "SEEKER_TORPEDO", "THOR" -> "SEEKER_TORPEDO"
      "DECOY", "PHANTOM", "HOLO_PHANTOM" -> "HOLO_PHANTOM"
      "BRICK", "BARRIER", "STASIS_BARRIER" -> "STASIS_BARRIER"
      "ROCKET", "SURGE", "HYPER_SURGE", "PHASE_BLINK" -> "HYPER_SURGE"
      "SWARM", "DRONES", "SWARM_DRONES" -> "SWARM_DRONES"
      "TRACTOR", "TRACTOR_BEAM", "WEB" -> "TRACTOR_BEAM"
      "PROX_MISSILE", "PROX_SEEKER", "PROX_LOCK", "INFINITE_MISSILE" -> "PROX_SEEKER"
      "LANCE", "LANCE_BEAM", "CONTINUOUS_LANCE" -> "LANCE_BEAM"
      "CHAKRAM", "DISC", "SAW_DISC", "PIZZA_DISC" -> "CHAKRAM"
      else -> clean
    }
  }

  fun getBuffRegistryEntry(idOrAlias: String): SpecialBuffRegistryEntry? {
    val norm = normalizeSpecialBuffId(idOrAlias)
    return BUFF_REGISTRY[norm] ?: BUFF_REGISTRY[idOrAlias]
  }

  fun getBuffRegistryByIndex(index: Int): SpecialBuffRegistryEntry? {
    return BUFF_REGISTRY.values.firstOrNull { it.buffTypeIndex == index }
  }

  fun getCustomForgedBuffs(): List<SpecialBuffRegistryEntry> {
    return BUFF_REGISTRY.values.filter { it.isCustomForged }.sortedBy { it.buffTypeIndex }
  }

  fun nextCustomBuffTypeIndex(): Int {
    val maxExisting = BUFF_REGISTRY.values.maxOfOrNull { it.buffTypeIndex } ?: 15
    return max(16, maxExisting + 1)
  }

  fun registerCustomBuff(entry: SpecialBuffRegistryEntry) {
    val safeEntry =
      if (entry.isCustomForged && entry.buffTypeIndex <= 15) {
        entry.copy(buffTypeIndex = nextCustomBuffTypeIndex())
      } else {
        entry
      }
    BUFF_REGISTRY[safeEntry.id] = safeEntry
    RiftSpriteBaker.invalidateCustomBuffIcon(safeEntry.buffTypeIndex)
  }

  fun removeCustomBuff(id: String) {
    val removed = BUFF_REGISTRY.remove(id)
    if (removed != null) {
      RiftSpriteBaker.invalidateCustomBuffIcon(removed.buffTypeIndex)
    }
  }

  fun resetBuffRegistryToDefaults(preserveCustomForged: Boolean = true) {
    val preserved = if (preserveCustomForged) getCustomForgedBuffs() else emptyList()
    BUFF_REGISTRY.clear()
    BUFF_REGISTRY.putAll(createCoreBuffRegistry())
    for (custom in preserved) {
      BUFF_REGISTRY[custom.id] = custom
    }
  }

  fun buildShipSpecFromCustomSlot(slot: CustomShipLoadoutSlot): ShipSpec {
    val spPts = slot.speedPts.coerceIn(0, 30)
    val thPts = slot.thrustPts.coerceIn(0, 30)
    val tuPts = slot.turnPts.coerceIn(0, 30)
    val mfPts = slot.maxFluxPts.coerceIn(0, 30)
    val rcPts = slot.rechargePts.coerceIn(0, 30)

    val topSpd = computeTopSpeed(spPts)
    val thrustVal = computeThrust(thPts)
    val turnVal = computeTurnRate(tuPts)
    val maxFlx = computeMaxFlux(mfPts)
    val rechVal = computeRecharge(rcPts)

    val priPts = slot.primaryPointCost()
    val secPts = slot.secondaryPointCost()

    val (pTitle, pShort, pCost, pCd, pDmg, pSpeed, pStreams, pSpread, pBounce, isParallel) =
      when (slot.primaryArchetype) {
        "ION_NEEDLER" ->
          PrimaryTuple("Needler", "NEEDLER", 18f, 0.13f, 82f, 950f, 2, 0.04f, 0, false)
        "TWIN_SCATTER" ->
          PrimaryTuple("Twin Scatter Cannons", "SCATTER", 20f, 0.14f, 88f, 900f, 2, 0.065f, 0, false)
        "ANGLED_PULSE" ->
          PrimaryTuple("Ricochet Twin-Pulse", "RICOCHET", 20f, 0.15f, 92f, 960f, 2, 0.055f, 1, false)
        "QUAD_PULSE" ->
          PrimaryTuple("Quad-Converging Flak", "QUAD", 24f, 0.15f, 68f, 940f, 4, 0.045f, 0, false)
        "HEAVY_PLASMA" ->
          PrimaryTuple("Heavy Twin Plasma", "PLASMA", 38f, 0.21f, 150f, 880f, 2, 0.05f, 0, false)
        "TRI_PRISM" ->
          PrimaryTuple("Tri-Prism Splitter", "PRISM", 24f, 0.15f, 80f, 960f, 3, 0.05f, 0, false)
        "SNIPER_RAIL" ->
          PrimaryTuple("1-Bounce Rail-Laser", "RAILGUN", 26f, 0.18f, 225f, 1280f, 1, 0f, 1, false)
        "PARALLEL_AUTOCANNON" ->
          PrimaryTuple("Parallel Autocannon", "AUTOCANNON", 22f, 0.13f, 128f, 1000f, 2, 0.025f, 0, true)
        else ->
          PrimaryTuple("Light Pulse Repeater", "PULSE", 16f, 0.12f, 115f, 980f, 1, 0f, 0, false)
      }

    val supportsNativeMulti = slot.secondaryType == "NATIVE_MULTI"
    val extraPrimaryBounces = if (slot.secondaryType == "NATIVE_RICOCHET") 1 else 0
    val extraRepel = if (slot.secondaryType == "MINE") 1 else 0
    val hasSecBomb = slot.secondaryType !in setOf("NONE", "NATIVE_MULTI", "NATIVE_RICOCHET")

    val (sTitle, sShort, bCost, bCd, bDmg, bBounces, bRecoil) =
      when (slot.secondaryType) {
        "NATIVE_MULTI" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Native 4-Bolt Multi-Toggle", "TWIN MULTI", 0f, 0f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "NATIVE_RICOCHET" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Ricochet Rounds (+1 Bounce)", "RICOCHET", 0f, 0f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "PHASE_DASH" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Phase Dash + +35% Overcharge", "PHASE DASH", 320f, 0.65f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "MINE" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Magnetic Proximity Mines (300 Flux • Max 6)", "PROX MINE", 300f, 0.80f, 1040f, 0, 0f)
        "BOUNCE" ->
          SecondaryTuple("3-Bounce Bank Torpedo", "TORPEDO", 420f, 0.90f, 980f, 3, 220f)
        "PROX" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Proximity Flak Warhead", "PROX FLAK", 450f, 0.95f, 820f, 1, 210f)
        "CLUSTER" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Cluster Shrapnel Bomb", "CLUSTER", 520f, 1.05f, 920f, 0, 250f)
        "NOVA_RING" ->
          SecondaryTuple("360° 16-Bolt Nova Ring", "NOVA RING", 480f, 1.15f, 145f, 1, 0f)
        "SHATTER_CONE" ->
          SecondaryTuple("7-Pellet Shatter Cone", "SHATTER", 380f, 0.85f, 195f, 0, 260f)
        "SEEKER_TORPEDO" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Homing Seeker Torpedo", "SEEKER", 460f, 1.05f, 880f, 0, 190f)
        "CHAKRAM" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Chakram Ricochet Saw-Disc (4 Bounces)", "CHAKRAM", 400f, 0.90f, 560f, 4, 140f)
        "HOLO_PHANTOM" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Holo Phantom Clone + Cloak", "PHANTOM", 400f, 3.5f, 420f, 0, 0f)
        "STASIS_BARRIER" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Stasis Hard-Light Barrier", "BARRIER", 360f, 4.0f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "HYPER_SURGE" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Hyper Surge Thruster Boost", "SURGE", 320f, 3.8f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "SWARM_DRONES" ->
          SecondaryTuple("5-Drone Hunter Swarm", "SWARM", 440f, 1.8f, 210f, 0, 0f)
        "TRACTOR_BEAM" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Toggleable Tractor Beam (112/s)", "TRACTOR", 0f, 0.35f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "PROX_SEEKER" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Proximity Patrol Missile (Max 2)", "PROX LOCK", 500f, 2.4f, 840f, 99, 170f)
        "LANCE_BEAM" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Toggleable Plasma Lance (145/s)", "LANCE", 0f, 0.35f, 280f, 0, 0f)
        "REPEL_PULSE" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Repel Shockwave Generator", "REPEL", 340f, 2.2f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "CLOAK_EMP" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Stealth Cloak + 0-Flux Decloak EMP", "CLOAK", 0f, 4.5f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        "SIEGE" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Heavy Siege Bomb (Air-Burst)", "SIEGE BOMB", 650f, 1.20f, 1350f, 1, 360f)
        "INTERDICTOR_DOME" ->
          SecondaryTuple("Stasis (320 Flux • 6.0s)", "STASIS", 320f, 8.5f, 0f, 0, 0f)
        else -> {
          val customForged = getBuffRegistryEntry(slot.secondaryType)?.takeIf { it.isCustomForged }
          if (customForged != null) {
            SecondaryTuple(
              "${customForged.officialName} (Forged)",
              customForged.shortLabel,
              420f,
              1.40f,
              customForged.damage,
              customForged.wallBounces,
              140f,
            )
          } else {
            SecondaryTuple("Pure Hull Focus (No Secondary)", "NONE", 0f, 0f, 0f, 0, 0f)
          }
        }
      }

    val cleanHullTitle = slot.customName.trim().ifEmpty { "Rift Frame" }
    return ShipSpec(
      id = 10,
      name = cleanHullTitle,
      role = "Modular Custom Hull (${slot.totalAllocatedPoints()}/100 Pts)",
      tacticalLore = "Pilot-engineered modular Rift Frame combining custom 100-Point stat allocation, curated weapon hardpoints, and procedural 3D chassis geometry.",
      silhouetteDesc = "${slot.visualRecipe.silhouette.replace('_', ' ')} • Prompt: \"${slot.visualRecipe.promptUsed.take(64)}\"",
      weaponSummary = "PRI: $pShort (${pCost.toInt()} Flux) • SEC: $sShort" + (if (bCost > 0f) " (${bCost.toInt()} Flux)" else ""),
      primaryTitle = pTitle,
      secondaryTitle = sTitle,
      primaryShortLabel = pShort,
      secondaryShortLabel = sShort,
      maxFlux = maxFlx,
      rechargeRate = rechVal,
      topSpeed = topSpd,
      afterburnerSpeed = topSpd * 1.32f,
      thrust = thrustVal,
      turnRate = turnVal,
      primaryCost = pCost,
      primaryCooldown = pCd,
      primaryDamage = pDmg,
      primarySpeed = pSpeed,
      primaryStreams = pStreams,
      primarySpreadRad = pSpread,
      primaryBounces = pBounce + extraPrimaryBounces,
      isParallelTwin = isParallel,
      hasBomb = hasSecBomb,
      bombType = if (hasSecBomb) slot.secondaryType else "NONE",
      bombCost = bCost,
      bombCooldown = bCd,
      bombDamage = bDmg,
      bombBounces = bBounces,
      bombRecoil = bRecoil,
      supportsNativeMultifire = supportsNativeMulti,
      initialRepels = 2 + extraRepel,
      accentColorHex = 0xFF38BDF8.toInt(),
      speedPts = spPts,
      thrustPts = thPts,
      turnPts = tuPts,
      maxFluxPts = mfPts,
      rechargePts = rcPts,
      primaryPts = priPts,
      secondaryPts = secPts,
      isCustomModularFrame = true,
      activeCustomSlotId = slot.slotId,
    )
  }

private tailrec fun Context.findActivity(): Activity? =
  when (this) {
    is Activity -> this
    is ContextWrapper -> baseContext.findActivity()
    else -> null
  }

fun attemptAutoSignIn(
  context: Context,
  credentialManager: CredentialManager,
  onAuthSuccess: () -> Unit,
  onUnauthenticated: () -> Unit,
  scope: CoroutineScope,
) {
  if (runCatching { Firebase.auth.currentUser }.getOrNull() != null) {
    onAuthSuccess()
    return
  }
  val activityContext = context.findActivity() ?: context
  val clientId =
    try {
      context.getString(R.string.default_web_client_id).trim()
    } catch (e: Exception) {
      onUnauthenticated()
      return
    }
  if (clientId.isBlank() || clientId.startsWith("000000000000-placeholder")) {
    onUnauthenticated()
    return
  }

  val request =
    try {
      val googleIdOption =
        GetGoogleIdOption.Builder()
          .setFilterByAuthorizedAccounts(true)
          .setServerClientId(clientId)
          .setAutoSelectEnabled(true)
          .build()
      GetCredentialRequest.Builder().addCredentialOption(googleIdOption).build()
    } catch (t: Throwable) {
      onUnauthenticated()
      return
    }

  scope.launch {
    try {
      val result = credentialManager.getCredential(activityContext, request)
      val credential = result.credential
      if (credential is CustomCredential && credential.type == TYPE_GOOGLE_ID_TOKEN_CREDENTIAL) {
        val googleIdToken = GoogleIdTokenCredential.createFrom(credential.data).idToken
        val authCredential = GoogleAuthProvider.getCredential(googleIdToken, null)
        Firebase.auth.signInWithCredential(authCredential).await()
        onAuthSuccess()
      } else {
        onUnauthenticated()
      }
    } catch (t: CancellationException) {
      onUnauthenticated()
      throw t
    } catch (t: Throwable) {
      onUnauthenticated()
    }
  }
}

fun onGoogleSignInClicked(
  context: Context,
  credentialManager: CredentialManager,
  onAuthSuccess: () -> Unit,
  onAuthError: (String) -> Unit,
  scope: CoroutineScope,
  onAuthCancelled: () -> Unit = {},
) {
  if (
    !NetworkConnectivityMonitor.isCurrentlyOnline(context) &&
      runCatching { Firebase.auth.currentUser }.getOrNull() != null
  ) {
    onAuthSuccess()
    return
  }
  val activityContext = context.findActivity() ?: context
  val clientId =
    try {
      context.getString(R.string.default_web_client_id).trim()
    } catch (e: Exception) {
      onAuthError(
        "Google Sign-In configuration missing: default_web_client_id was not found in this build. Tap Play as Drifter below to play right away."
      )
      return
    }

  if (clientId.isBlank() || clientId.startsWith("000000000000-placeholder")) {
    onAuthError(
      "Google Sign-In is not configured on this build yet (missing Web Client ID). Set RIFT_WEB_CLIENT_ID in build secrets, or tap Play as Drifter below to play right away."
    )
    return
  }

  val request =
    try {
      val signInOption = GetSignInWithGoogleOption.Builder(serverClientId = clientId).build()
      GetCredentialRequest.Builder().addCredentialOption(signInOption).build()
    } catch (t: Throwable) {
      Log.e("Auth", "Failed to build Google Sign-In request", t)
      onAuthError(
        "Could not start Google Sign-In (${t.localizedMessage ?: "invalid client configuration"}). Tap Play as Drifter below to play right away."
      )
      return
    }

  scope.launch {
    try {
      val result = credentialManager.getCredential(activityContext, request)
      val credential = result.credential
      if (credential is CustomCredential && credential.type == TYPE_GOOGLE_ID_TOKEN_CREDENTIAL) {
        val googleIdToken = GoogleIdTokenCredential.createFrom(credential.data).idToken
        val authCredential = GoogleAuthProvider.getCredential(googleIdToken, null)
        Firebase.auth.signInWithCredential(authCredential).await()
        onAuthSuccess()
      } else {
        onAuthError(
          "Google Sign-In returned an unrecognized credential type (${credential.type}). Tap Sign In with Google to retry, or tap Play as Drifter below."
        )
      }
    } catch (e: GetCredentialCancellationException) {
      val detail = e.localizedMessage?.trim().orEmpty()
      Log.w("Auth", "Google Sign-In cancelled or dismissed: $detail", e)
      val cancelFeedback =
        if (
          detail.isNotBlank() &&
            !detail.contains("cancelled by the user", ignoreCase = true) &&
            !detail.contains("canceled", ignoreCase = true)
        ) {
          "Google Sign-In was cancelled ($detail). Tap Sign In with Google to retry, or tap Play as Drifter below."
        } else {
          "Google Sign-In was cancelled or could not verify this build's Google OAuth setup. Tap Sign In with Google to retry, or tap Play as Drifter below."
        }
      onAuthCancelled()
      onAuthError(cancelFeedback)
    } catch (e: NoCredentialException) {
      Log.w("Auth", "No Google credentials available: ${e.message}", e)
      onAuthError(
        "No authorized Google account was available on this device (or OAuth SHA-1 / Web Client ID is not linked yet). Add a Google account in Android Settings, or tap Play as Drifter below."
      )
    } catch (e: GetCredentialException) {
      val detail = e.localizedMessage?.trim().orEmpty()
      Log.e("Auth", "Google Credential Manager error (${e.type}): $detail", e)
      val offlineHint =
        if (!NetworkConnectivityMonitor.isCurrentlyOnline(context)) {
          "Device appears offline. Connect to the internet to sign in with Google, or tap Play as Drifter below."
        } else {
          "Google Sign-In could not complete (${detail.ifBlank { e.type }}). Tap Sign In with Google to retry, or tap Play as Drifter below."
        }
      onAuthError(offlineHint)
    } catch (e: CancellationException) {
      onAuthCancelled()
      throw e
    } catch (t: Throwable) {
      val detail = t.localizedMessage?.trim().orEmpty()
      Log.e("Auth", "Google Sign-In failed", t)
      val friendlyMsg =
        when {
          com.example.RiftApplication.isUsingFallbackFirebase ||
            detail.contains("API key not valid", ignoreCase = true) ||
            detail.contains("rift-offline-fallback", ignoreCase = true) ->
            "Google account selected, but cloud Firebase credentials (google-services.json) are not bundled in this build. Set GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON in GitHub Secrets, or tap Play as Drifter below to play."
          !NetworkConnectivityMonitor.isCurrentlyOnline(context) ->
            "Device is currently offline. Connect to the internet to complete Google Sign-In, or tap Play as Drifter below."
          else ->
            "Google Sign-In failed: ${detail.ifBlank { t::class.java.simpleName }}. Tap Sign In with Google to retry, or tap Play as Drifter below."
        }
      onAuthError(friendlyMsg)
    }
  }
}

fun signOut(
  credentialManager: CredentialManager,
  scope: CoroutineScope,
  onSignOutComplete: () -> Unit = {},
) {
  scope.launch {
    withContext(NonCancellable) {
      try {
        credentialManager.clearCredentialState(ClearCredentialStateRequest())
      } catch (e: Exception) {
        Log.w("Auth", "Failed to clear credential state: ${e.message}")
      } finally {
        Firebase.auth.signOut()
        onSignOutComplete()
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
fun AuthScreen(
  onAuthSuccess: () -> Unit,
  onPlayAsGuest: () -> Unit = {},
  onOpenChangelog: () -> Unit = {},
) {
  val context = LocalContext.current
  val coroutineScope = rememberCoroutineScope()
  val credentialManager =
    remember(context) { runCatching { CredentialManager.create(context) }.getOrNull() }
  var isLoading by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
  var errorMessage by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
  val scrollState = rememberScrollState()
  val isOnline by
    remember(context) { NetworkConnectivityMonitor.observeOnlineState(context) }
      .collectAsState(initial = NetworkConnectivityMonitor.isCurrentlyOnline(context))

  val startGoogleSignIn: () -> Unit = {
    val cm = credentialManager
    if (cm == null) {
      isLoading = false
      errorMessage =
        "Google Credential Manager is unavailable on this device. Tap Play as Drifter below to play right away."
    } else {
      errorMessage = null
      isLoading = true
      onGoogleSignInClicked(
        context = context,
        credentialManager = cm,
        onAuthSuccess = {
          isLoading = false
          errorMessage = null
          onAuthSuccess()
        },
        onAuthError = { msg ->
          isLoading = false
          errorMessage = msg
        },
        scope = coroutineScope,
        onAuthCancelled = {
          isLoading = false
          if (errorMessage.isNullOrBlank()) {
            errorMessage =
              "Google Sign-In was cancelled or dismissed. Tap Sign In with Google to retry, or tap Play as Drifter below."
          }
        },
      )
    }
  }

  LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
    if (runCatching { Firebase.auth.currentUser }.getOrNull() != null) {
      onAuthSuccess()
    }
  }

  Box(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(Color(0xFF02050B)),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
    // RIFT Title Artwork atmospheric backdrop + translucent #02050B vignette
    Image(
      painter = painterResource(id = R.drawable.rift_title_loading),
      contentDescription = "RIFT Title Artwork",
      contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
      alpha = 0.36f,
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
    )
    Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
      val w = size.width
      val h = size.height
      drawRect(
        brush =
          Brush.radialGradient(
            colors = listOf(Color(0x9E08162E), Color(0xC9040A16), Color(0xE802050B)),
            center = Offset(w * 0.34f, h * 0.50f),
            radius = maxOf(w, h) * 0.80f,
          )
      )
      val starCount = 46
      for (i in 0 until starCount) {
        val hx = ((i * 73856093) xor 0x5A17) and 0xFFFF
        val hy = ((i * 19349663) xor 0x2F91) and 0xFFFF
        val sx = (hx / 65535f) * w
        val sy = (hy / 65535f) * h
        val starCol =
          when {
            i % 7 == 0 -> Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.42f)
            i % 5 == 0 -> Color(0xFFFACC15).copy(alpha = 0.36f)
            else -> Color(0xFFCBD5E1).copy(alpha = 0.28f)
          }
        val r = if (i % 6 == 0) 1.6.dp.toPx() else 1.0.dp.toPx()
        drawCircle(color = starCol, radius = r, center = Offset(sx, sy))
      }
    }

    BoxWithConstraints(
      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxSize()
          .windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.safeDrawing)
          .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
      contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
      val viewportMaxHeight = maxHeight
      val aspect = if (viewportMaxHeight.value > 0f) maxWidth.value / viewportMaxHeight.value else 1.6f
      val isWideLandscape = maxWidth >= 560.dp && aspect >= 1.15f
      val isUltraCompactHeight = viewportMaxHeight < 410.dp
      val cardMaxWidth = if (maxWidth >= 1000.dp) 980.dp else 940.dp

      Surface(
        modifier =
          Modifier.widthIn(max = cardMaxWidth)
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .then(
              if (isWideLandscape && !isUltraCompactHeight) {
                Modifier.heightIn(max = (maxHeight * 0.94f).coerceAtMost(540.dp))
              } else {
                Modifier.heightIn(max = maxHeight * 0.96f)
              }
            )
            .border(
              1.2.dp,
              Brush.linearGradient(
                listOf(Color(0xFF00F5D4), Color(0xFF38BDF8), Color(0xFFFACC15))
              ),
              RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
            ),
        color = Color(0xEE060D1A),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
        tonalElevation = 10.dp,
      ) {
        Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
          // Sci-Fi Command Tablet chamfer/corner registration brackets
          Canvas(modifier = Modifier.matchParentSize()) {
            val stroke = 1.8.dp.toPx()
            val inset = 5.dp.toPx()
            val arm = 20.dp.toPx()
            val cyan = Color(0xFF00F5D4)
            val gold = Color(0xFFFACC15)
            drawLine(cyan, Offset(inset, inset), Offset(inset + arm, inset), stroke)
            drawLine(cyan, Offset(inset, inset), Offset(inset, inset + arm), stroke)
            drawLine(gold, Offset(size.width - inset - arm, inset), Offset(size.width - inset, inset), stroke)
            drawLine(gold, Offset(size.width - inset, inset), Offset(size.width - inset, inset + arm), stroke)
            drawLine(gold, Offset(inset, size.height - inset - arm), Offset(inset, size.height - inset), stroke)
            drawLine(gold, Offset(inset, size.height - inset), Offset(inset + arm, size.height - inset), stroke)
            drawLine(
              cyan,
              Offset(size.width - inset - arm, size.height - inset),
              Offset(size.width - inset, size.height - inset),
              stroke,
            )
            drawLine(
              cyan,
              Offset(size.width - inset, size.height - inset - arm),
              Offset(size.width - inset, size.height - inset),
              stroke,
            )
          }

          val bodyModifier =
            if (!isWideLandscape || isUltraCompactHeight) {
              Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .verticalScroll(scrollState)
                .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 12.dp)
            } else {
              Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = 18.dp, vertical = 12.dp)
            }

          Column(
            modifier = bodyModifier,
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
          ) {
            // TOP TABLET HEADER STRIP
            Row(
              modifier =
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                  .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                  .background(Color(0xFF081326))
                  .border(1.dp, Color(0x3D38BDF8), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                  .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            ) {
              Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
              ) {
                NexusMergedBrandEmblem(modifier = Modifier.size(28.dp))
                Row(
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                ) {
                  Text(
                    text = stringResource(R.string.auth_title),
                    color = Color.White,
                    fontSize = 16.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    letterSpacing = 2.0.sp,
                    maxLines = 1,
                  )
                  Text(
                    text = "// THRESHOLD DYNAMICS STUDIO, LLC",
                    color = Color(0xFFFACC15),
                    fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                  )
                }
              }

              Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))

              Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
              ) {
                val netColor = if (isOnline) Color(0xFF10B981) else Color(0xFFF59E0B)
                val netBg = if (isOnline) Color(0x2610B981) else Color(0x2EF59E0B)
                Row(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .background(netBg)
                      .border(1.dp, netColor, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 5.dp)
                      .testTag("auth_network_status_badge"),
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
                ) {
                  Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size(7.dp)) {
                    drawCircle(color = netColor)
                  }
                  Text(
                    text = if (isOnline) "ONLINE" else "OFFLINE",
                    color = netColor,
                    fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    maxLines = 1,
                  )
                }

                Button(
                  onClick = onOpenChangelog,
                  colors =
                    ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                      containerColor = Color(0xFF0B1C32),
                      contentColor = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
                    ),
                  border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color(0xFF38BDF8)),
                  shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                  contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 11.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
                      .heightIn(min = 36.dp)
                      .testTag("auth_changelog_button"),
                ) {
                  Icon(
                    imageVector = RiftAuthIcons.Terminal,
                    contentDescription = "Patch Log",
                    tint = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
                    modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp),
                  )
                  Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                  Text(
                    text = "[ BUILD #$CURRENT_RIFT_BUILD_VERSION PATCH LOG ]",
                    fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    maxLines = 1,
                  )
                }
              }
            }

            // 2-COLUMN SCI-FI COMMAND TABLET DECK (Left: Live Safe-Harbor Showcase | Right: Briefing & Auth)
            if (isWideLandscape) {
              val showcaseMaxH = (viewportMaxHeight * 0.66f).coerceIn(185.dp, 310.dp)
              Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              ) {
                AuthSafeHarborRadarShowcase(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.weight(0.46f)
                      .heightIn(min = 180.dp, max = showcaseMaxH)
                      .fillMaxWidth()
                )
                AuthCommandBriefingColumn(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.weight(0.54f)
                      .then(if (isUltraCompactHeight) Modifier else Modifier.verticalScroll(scrollState)),
                  isOnline = isOnline,
                  isLoading = isLoading,
                  errorMessage = errorMessage,
                  onSignInGoogle = startGoogleSignIn,
                  onEnterDrifter = onPlayAsGuest,
                )
              }
            } else {
              val portraitShowcaseH = (viewportMaxHeight * 0.28f).coerceIn(160.dp, 225.dp)
              AuthSafeHarborRadarShowcase(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(portraitShowcaseH)
              )
              AuthCommandBriefingColumn(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                isOnline = isOnline,
                isLoading = isLoading,
                errorMessage = errorMessage,
                onSignInGoogle = startGoogleSignIn,
                onEnterDrifter = onPlayAsGuest,
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Left Column (`weight(0.46f)`): Live Gameplay-Honest Circular Safe-Harbor Radar Showcase.
 * Renders a round rippling cyan/gold digitized aperture framing the real `5x` `Rift Station`
 * sprite (`RiftSpriteBaker.safeZoneStationBitmap` + `drawSafeZoneStationHoloRing`) and
 * 3 real `128x128` ship sprites (`getShipSprite`) banking along orbital patrol arcs with thruster trails.
 */
@Composable
private fun AuthSafeHarborRadarShowcase(modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
  val headless = remember { isHeadlessGlEnvironment() }
  val visualRev = RiftVisualForgeState.visualRevision
  val customVer = RiftSpriteBaker.customShip9Version

  val orbitPhaseRad =
    if (headless) {
      0.85f
    } else {
      val transition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "auth_safe_harbor_showcase")
      val p by
        transition.animateFloat(
          initialValue = 0f,
          targetValue = (2.0 * PI).toFloat(),
          animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(9600, easing = LinearEasing), RepeatMode.Restart),
          label = "auth_orbit_rad",
        )
      p
    }

  val stationBmp = remember(visualRev) { RiftSpriteBaker.safeZoneStationBitmap }
  val patrolShip1 = remember(customVer, visualRev) { RiftSpriteBaker.getShipSprite(1, isAllied = true, isHitFlashing = false) }
  val patrolShip2 = remember(customVer, visualRev) { RiftSpriteBaker.getShipSprite(5, isAllied = true, isHitFlashing = false) }
  val patrolShip3 = remember(customVer, visualRev) { RiftSpriteBaker.getShipSprite(9, isAllied = false, isHitFlashing = false) }
  val shipMatrix = remember { Matrix() }
  val stationRect = remember { RectF() }

  Box(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
        .background(Color(0xFF040A16))
        .border(1.dp, Color(0x3838BDF8), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
        .padding(6.dp),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
    Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxHeight().aspectRatio(1f, matchHeightConstraintsFirst = true)) {
      val w = size.width
      val h = size.height
      if (w <= 8f || h <= 8f) return@Canvas
      val cx = w * 0.5f
      val cy = h * 0.5f
      val center = Offset(cx, cy)
      val apertureR = (min(w, h) * 0.41f).coerceAtLeast(36f)
      val timeSec = (orbitPhaseRad / (2f * PI.toFloat())) * 9.6f

      // 1. Deep Safe-Harbor abyssal space inside the circular Overwatch aperture
      drawCircle(
        brush =
          Brush.radialGradient(
            colors = listOf(Color(0xFF0A1D3B), Color(0xFF050E20), Color(0xFF020611)),
            center = center,
            radius = apertureR,
          ),
        radius = apertureR,
        center = center,
      )

      // Subtle tactical polar radar rings & crosshairs
      val gridColor = Color(0xFF38BDF8).copy(alpha = 0.14f)
      drawCircle(gridColor, radius = apertureR * 0.42f, center = center, style = Stroke(width = 1.dp.toPx()))
      drawCircle(gridColor, radius = apertureR * 0.72f, center = center, style = Stroke(width = 1.dp.toPx()))
      drawLine(gridColor, Offset(cx - apertureR * 0.92f, cy), Offset(cx + apertureR * 0.92f, cy), strokeWidth = 0.9.dp.toPx())
      drawLine(gridColor, Offset(cx, cy - apertureR * 0.92f), Offset(cx, cy + apertureR * 0.92f), strokeWidth = 0.9.dp.toPx())

      // 8 Radial Cyan/Gold Safe-Zone Stabilizer Beams bracing the Safe Harbor perimeter
      val safeShieldR = apertureR * 0.86f
      for (b in 0 until 8) {
        val bAng = (b * PI * 0.25).toFloat() + sin(orbitPhaseRad) * 0.02f
        val innerPt = Offset(cx + cos(bAng) * (apertureR * 0.22f), cy + sin(bAng) * (apertureR * 0.22f))
        val outerPt = Offset(cx + cos(bAng) * safeShieldR, cy + sin(bAng) * safeShieldR)
        drawLine(
          brush =
            Brush.linearGradient(
              listOf(Color(0x99FACC15), Color(0xAA00F5D4), Color(0x2238BDF8)),
              start = innerPt,
              end = outerPt,
            ),
          start = innerPt,
          end = outerPt,
          strokeWidth = 1.6.dp.toPx(),
          cap = StrokeCap.Round,
        )
      }
      drawCircle(
        color = Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.55f),
        radius = safeShieldR,
        center = center,
        style = Stroke(width = 1.6.dp.toPx()),
      )

      // 2. Real 5x Rift Station Sprite + Revolving Ops Holo-Ring + 3 Real 128x128 Patrol Ships
      val stationR = apertureR * 0.34f
      val patrolSpecs =
        arrayOf(
          Triple(patrolShip1, apertureR * 0.58f, orbitPhaseRad),
          Triple(patrolShip2, apertureR * 0.73f, -orbitPhaseRad * 1.0f + 2.15f),
          Triple(patrolShip3, apertureR * 0.66f, orbitPhaseRad * 1.0f + 4.20f),
        )

      // Draw curved cyan/gold thruster wakes first (under hulls)
      patrolSpecs.forEachIndexed { idx, (_, orbitR, angRad) ->
        val dirSign = if (idx == 1) -1f else 1f
        val trailColor = if (idx == 2) Color(0xFFFACC15) else Color(0xFF00F5D4)
        val segments = 8
        for (s in 0 until segments) {
          val a0 = angRad - dirSign * (s * 0.065f)
          val a1 = angRad - dirSign * ((s + 1) * 0.065f)
          val frac = 1f - (s / segments.toFloat())
          drawLine(
            color = trailColor.copy(alpha = 0.58f * frac),
            start = Offset(cx + cos(a0) * orbitR, cy + sin(a0) * orbitR),
            end = Offset(cx + cos(a1) * orbitR, cy + sin(a1) * orbitR),
            strokeWidth = (3.4f * frac).dp.toPx(),
            cap = StrokeCap.Round,
          )
        }
      }

      drawIntoCanvas { composeCanvas ->
        val nc = composeCanvas.nativeCanvas
        // Center 5x Rift Station
        nc.save()
        nc.translate(cx, cy)
        nc.rotate((orbitPhaseRad * 180f / PI.toFloat()) * 0.25f)
        stationRect.set(-stationR, -stationR, stationR, stationR)
        nc.drawBitmap(stationBmp, null, stationRect, null)
        nc.restore()

        // Shrunk 3D-tilted revolving cyan/gold Ops Holo-Ring
        RiftSpriteBaker.drawSafeZoneStationHoloRing(
          c = nc,
          cx = cx,
          cy = cy,
          stationRadius = stationR,
          timeSec = timeSec,
          isLockedOut = false,
          alphaScale = 1f,
        )

        // 3 Real 128x128 Ship Sprites banking along orbital patrol arcs
        val shipRenderSize = (apertureR * 0.22f).coerceAtLeast(18f)
        patrolSpecs.forEachIndexed { idx, (bmp, orbitR, angRad) ->
          val dirSign = if (idx == 1) -1f else 1f
          val sx = cx + cos(angRad) * orbitR
          val sy = cy + sin(angRad) * orbitR
          // Tangent heading (+ slight inward bank toward station)
          val headingRad = angRad + dirSign * (PI.toFloat() * 0.5f) - dirSign * 0.12f
          val halfBmp = bmp.width * 0.5f
          val drawScale = shipRenderSize / bmp.width.toFloat()
          shipMatrix.reset()
          shipMatrix.postTranslate(-halfBmp, -halfBmp)
          shipMatrix.postScale(drawScale, drawScale)
          shipMatrix.postRotate(headingRad * 180f / PI.toFloat())
          shipMatrix.postTranslate(sx, sy)
          nc.drawBitmap(bmp, shipMatrix, null)
        }
      }

      // 3. Mask #060D1A tablet glass outside aperture & draw Round Rippling Polar Digitization Rings
      val outerMask =
        Path().apply {
          fillType = PathFillType.EvenOdd
          addRect(Rect(0f, 0f, w, h))
          addOval(Rect(cx - apertureR, cy - apertureR, cx + apertureR, cy + apertureR))
        }
      drawPath(outerMask, color = Color(0xFF060D1A))

      val numBands = 6
      val numSegs = 40
      val segSweepDeg = 360f / numSegs.toFloat()
      val segGapDeg = 1.5f
      val borderSw = 0.9.dp.toPx()

      for (band in 0 until numBands) {
        val outerFrac = 1.20f - band * 0.038f
        val innerFrac = outerFrac - 0.032f
        val rMid = apertureR * ((outerFrac + innerFrac) * 0.5f)
        val bandThickness = (apertureR * (outerFrac - innerFrac)).coerceAtLeast(1.4f)
        val arcRect = Rect(cx - rMid, cy - rMid, cx + rMid, cy + rMid)
        val keepThreshold = 1.0f - band * 0.16f

        for (seg in 0 until numSegs) {
          val hash = ((band * 73856093) xor (seg * 19349663)) and 0xFF
          val normHash = hash / 255f
          val segAng = ((seg + 0.5f) / numSegs.toFloat()) * (2f * PI.toFloat())
          val inwardWave = 0.5f + 0.5f * sin(band * 0.95f - orbitPhaseRad * 3.0f + sin(segAng * 3f) * 0.5f)
          if (normHash > keepThreshold + inwardWave * 0.12f) continue

          val startDeg = seg * segSweepDeg + segGapDeg * 0.5f
          val sweepDeg = (segSweepDeg - segGapDeg).coerceAtLeast(1.2f)
          val cyanLit = (0.5f + 0.5f * cos(segAng - orbitPhaseRad)).pow(2.0f)
          val goldLit = (0.5f + 0.5f * cos(segAng + orbitPhaseRad * 0.7f - 1.8f)).pow(2.4f)
          val litAlpha = ((0.18f + 0.52f * cyanLit + 0.38f * goldLit) * inwardWave).coerceIn(0.08f, 0.82f)
          val cellColor = if (goldLit > cyanLit * 1.06f) Color(0xFFFACC15) else Color(0xFF00F5D4)

          drawArc(
            color = cellColor.copy(alpha = litAlpha * (1f - band * 0.10f).coerceAtLeast(0.25f)),
            startAngle = startDeg,
            sweepAngle = sweepDeg,
            useCenter = false,
            topLeft = arcRect.topLeft,
            size = arcRect.size,
            style = Stroke(width = if (band >= 4) borderSw * 1.2f else borderSw, cap = StrokeCap.Butt),
          )
        }
      }

      rotate(degrees = (orbitPhaseRad * 180f / PI.toFloat())) {
        drawCircle(
          brush =
            Brush.sweepGradient(
              0.00f to Color(0xFF00F5D4),
              0.25f to Color(0xFF38BDF8).copy(alpha = 0.48f),
              0.50f to Color(0xFFFACC15),
              0.75f to Color(0xFF1E293B).copy(alpha = 0.50f),
              1.00f to Color(0xFF00F5D4),
              center = center,
            ),
          radius = apertureR,
          center = center,
          style = Stroke(width = 1.7.dp.toPx()),
        )
      }
    }

    // Compact live telemetry label pinned at bottom of showcase
    Box(
      modifier =
        Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
          .padding(bottom = 4.dp)
          .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
          .background(Color(0xE6060D1A))
          .border(0.9.dp, Color(0x8800F5D4), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
          .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 2.5.dp)
    ) {
      Text(
        text = "RIFT STATION • LIVE SAFE HARBOR",
        color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
        fontSize = 8.8.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        maxLines = 1,
      )
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Right Column (`weight(0.54f)`): Plain-English Briefing, Tagline #2 & Auth Actions.
 */
@Composable
private fun AuthCommandBriefingColumn(
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
  isOnline: Boolean = true,
  isLoading: Boolean,
  errorMessage: String?,
  onSignInGoogle: () -> Unit,
  onEnterDrifter: () -> Unit,
) {
  Column(
    modifier = modifier,
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(7.dp),
  ) {
    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)) {
      Text(
        text = "Fast-Paced Competitive 2.5D Space Dogfighter",
        color = Color.White,
        fontSize = 14.0.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
      )
      Text(
        text = "Solo • Syndicate • Squadron — 6 Competitive Modes + Custom Arenas",
        color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
        fontSize = 10.2.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
      )
      Text(
        text = stringResource(R.string.auth_tagline_two),
        color = Color(0xFFFACC15),
        fontSize = 10.6.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
      )
    }

    if (!isOnline) {
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .background(Color(0x26F59E0B))
            .border(1.dp, Color(0xFFF59E0B), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 5.dp)
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "OFFLINE MODE READY — Practice Rift, Custom Arenas & Bot Matches work offline.",
          color = Color(0xFFFDE68A),
          fontSize = 9.8.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
      }
    }

    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
          .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .background(Color(0xD9091528))
          .border(1.dp, Color(0x4738BDF8), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
    ) {
      AuthTelemetryRow(
        iconSlot = { NexusMergedBrandEmblem(modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)) },
        text = stringResource(R.string.auth_feature_physics),
      )
      AuthTelemetryRow(
        iconSlot = { ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = 16.dp) },
        text = stringResource(R.string.auth_feature_ships),
      )
      AuthTelemetryRow(
        iconSlot = { RiftShardGemIcon(sizeDp = 16.dp) },
        text = stringResource(R.string.auth_feature_cloud),
      )
    }

    if (errorMessage != null) {
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .background(Color(0x33FF3B4E))
            .border(1.dp, Color(0xFFFF3B4E), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
      ) {
        Text(
          text = errorMessage,
          color = Color(0xFFFF6B7A),
          fontSize = 10.5.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag("auth_error_text"),
        )
      }
    }

    Button(
      onClick = onSignInGoogle,
      enabled = !isLoading,
      colors =
        ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
          containerColor = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
          contentColor = Color(0xFF030A14),
        ),
      shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
          .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
          .height(48.dp)
          .testTag("google_sign_in_button"),
    ) {
      if (isLoading) {
        CircularProgressIndicator(
          modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp),
          color = Color(0xFF030A14),
          strokeWidth = 2.5.dp,
        )
        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(10.dp))
        Text(
          text = stringResource(R.string.signing_in),
          fontSize = 12.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
      } else {
        Text(
          text = stringResource(R.string.sign_in_with_google),
          fontSize = 12.2.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          maxLines = 1,
          overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        )
      }
    }

    Button(
      onClick = onEnterDrifter,
      enabled = !isLoading,
      colors =
        ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
          containerColor = Color(0xFF0D1D34),
          contentColor = Color(0xFFFACC15),
        ),
      border = BorderStroke(1.4.dp, Color(0xFFFACC15)),
      shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
          .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()

          .testTag("skip_sign_in_guest_button"),
    ) {

@Composable

### FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/ui/MatchmakingQueueViewModel.kt
```
package com.example.ui

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.data.LivePilotState
import com.example.engine.RankedGameMode
import com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState
import com.example.engine.RiftGameEngine
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

enum class MatchmakingQueueStatus {
  IDLE,
  SEARCHING_BALANCED,
  EXPANDING_BRACKET,
  MATCH_FOUND,
  CANCELLED,
  TIMED_OUT,
}

data class LobbyPilotEntry(
  val uid: String,
  val callsign: String,
  val syndicateTag: String,
  val armadaName: String,
  val shipId: Int,
  val resonance: Int,
  val isLocalPilot: Boolean,
  val isWingmate: Boolean,
  val isEligibleOpponent: Boolean,
)

data class MatchmakingQueueUiState(
  val status: MatchmakingQueueStatus = MatchmakingQueueStatus.IDLE,
  val modeTitle: String = "",
  val riftLabel: String = "",
  val targetSectorKey: String = "",
  val rankedMode: RankedGameMode = RankedGameMode.SECTOR_CONVERGENCE,
  val requiresOpponentTeam: Boolean = false,
  val teamAvgResonance: Int = 0,
  val elapsedSec: Float = 0f,
  val maxDurationSec: Float = MAX_QUEUE_DURATION_SEC,
  val lobbyPilots: List<LobbyPilotEntry> = emptyList(),
  val eligibleOpponentCount: Int = 0,
  val balancedOpponentCount: Int = 0,
  val noticeMessage: String? = null,
) {
  val isQueueActive: Boolean
    get() =
      status == MatchmakingQueueStatus.SEARCHING_BALANCED ||
        status == MatchmakingQueueStatus.EXPANDING_BRACKET

  val remainingSec: Float
    get() = (maxDurationSec - elapsedSec).coerceIn(0f, maxDurationSec)

  val progressFraction: Float
    get() = (elapsedSec / maxDurationSec.coerceAtLeast(0.1f)).coerceIn(0f, 1f)

  val statusTransitionLabel: String
    get() =
      when (status) {
        MatchmakingQueueStatus.SEARCHING_BALANCED -> "BALANCED WINDOW (+/- 250 RESONANCE)"
        MatchmakingQueueStatus.EXPANDING_BRACKET -> "OPEN BRACKET (ACCEPTING ANY AVAILABLE TEAM)"
        MatchmakingQueueStatus.MATCH_FOUND -> "MATCH LOCKED // RIFTING IN"
        MatchmakingQueueStatus.CANCELLED -> "QUEUE CANCELLED"
        MatchmakingQueueStatus.TIMED_OUT -> "NO OTHER AVAILABLE TEAMS"
        MatchmakingQueueStatus.IDLE -> "STANDBY"
      }

  companion object {
    const val MAX_QUEUE_DURATION_SEC = 15.0f
    const val BRACKET_EXPANSION_SEC = 7.5f
    const val BALANCED_RESONANCE_WINDOW = 250
  }
}

/**
 * Lifecycle-aware ViewModel managing Ranked Resonance matchmaking queue state,
 * live lobby pilot tracking, Resonance bracket expansion (0-7.5s +/-250 RES -> 7.5-15.0s Open),
 * and clean status transitions (IDLE -> SEARCHING_BALANCED -> EXPANDING_BRACKET -> MATCH_FOUND / CANCELLED / TIMED_OUT).
 */
class MatchmakingQueueViewModel : ViewModel() {

  private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(MatchmakingQueueUiState())
  val uiState: StateFlow<MatchmakingQueueUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

  private var queueTimerJob: Job? = null
  private var pendingLaunchAction: (() -> Unit)? = null
  private var pendingTimeoutNoticeCallback: ((String) -> Unit)? = null

  private var latestUserId: String = ""
  private var latestCallsign: String = "COMMANDER"
  private var latestSyndicateTag: String = ""
  private var latestArmadaName: String = ""
  private var latestShipId: Int = 1
  private var latestLocalResonance: Int = 0
  private var latestIsDeviceOnline: Boolean = true
  private var latestMergedPilots: List<LivePilotState> = emptyList()

  /**
   * Streams live local & remote pilot presence into the matchmaking state machine so lobby
   * rosters, Strike Wing Resonance averages, and opponent match checks react in real time.
   */
  fun updateLobbySnapshot(
    currentUserId: String,
    localCallsign: String,
    localSyndicateTag: String,
    localArmadaName: String,
    localShipId: Int,
    localLiveResonance: Int,
    isDeviceOnline: Boolean,
    mergedLivePilots: List<LivePilotState>,
  ) {
    latestUserId = currentUserId
    latestCallsign = localCallsign.ifBlank { "PILOT" }
    latestSyndicateTag = RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(localSyndicateTag)
    latestArmadaName = localArmadaName.trim()
    latestShipId = localShipId.coerceIn(1, 10)
    latestLocalResonance = localLiveResonance.coerceAtLeast(0)
    latestIsDeviceOnline = isDeviceOnline
    latestMergedPilots = mergedLivePilots

    val cur = _uiState.value
    if (!cur.isQueueActive) return

    val computed =
      evaluateLobbyForTarget(
        targetSectorKey = cur.targetSectorKey,
        rankedMode = cur.rankedMode,
      )

    _uiState.value =
      cur.copy(
        teamAvgResonance = computed.teamAvgResonance,
        lobbyPilots = computed.lobbyPilots,
        eligibleOpponentCount = computed.eligibleOpponentCount,
        balancedOpponentCount = computed.balancedOpponentCount,
      )

    val readyToMatchNow =
      when (cur.status) {
        MatchmakingQueueStatus.SEARCHING_BALANCED -> computed.balancedOpponentCount > 0
        MatchmakingQueueStatus.EXPANDING_BRACKET -> computed.eligibleOpponentCount > 0
        else -> false
      }
    if (readyToMatchNow) {
      completeMatchFoundAndLaunch()
    }
  }

  /**
   * Enqueues or immediately dispatches Resonance-based matchmaking depending on mode rules,
   * device connectivity, and live lobby opponent availability.
   */
  fun enqueueOrExecute(
    modeTitle: String,
    riftLabel: String,
    targetSectorKey: String,
    rankedMode: RankedGameMode,
    isCustomInstance: Boolean,
    onNoTeamsNotice: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onExecuteLaunch: () -> Unit,
  ) {
    queueTimerJob?.cancel()
    queueTimerJob = null

    val isTeamRankedMode =
      !isCustomInstance &&
        rankedMode in
          setOf(
            RankedGameMode.SYNDICATE_WARS,
            RankedGameMode.RIFT_SKIRMISH,
            RankedGameMode.RIFT_CONTROL,
            RankedGameMode.FLUX_CORE,
            RankedGameMode.STASIS_BREACH,
          )
    val requiresOpponentTeam =
      !isCustomInstance &&
        (rankedMode == RankedGameMode.SYNDICATE_WARS ||
          (!RiftCalibrationState.botsEnabled && isTeamRankedMode))

    if (!isTeamRankedMode || (!latestIsDeviceOnline && !requiresOpponentTeam)) {
      pendingLaunchAction = null
      pendingTimeoutNoticeCallback = null
      _uiState.value =
        MatchmakingQueueUiState(
          status = MatchmakingQueueStatus.MATCH_FOUND,
          modeTitle = modeTitle,
          riftLabel = riftLabel,
          targetSectorKey = targetSectorKey,
          rankedMode = rankedMode,
        )
      _uiState.value = MatchmakingQueueUiState(status = MatchmakingQueueStatus.IDLE)
      onExecuteLaunch()
      return
    }

    val computed =
      evaluateLobbyForTarget(
        targetSectorKey = targetSectorKey,
        rankedMode = rankedMode,
      )

    if (computed.balancedOpponentCount > 0) {
      pendingLaunchAction = null
      pendingTimeoutNoticeCallback = null
      _uiState.value =
        MatchmakingQueueUiState(
          status = MatchmakingQueueStatus.MATCH_FOUND,
          modeTitle = modeTitle,
          riftLabel = riftLabel,
          targetSectorKey = targetSectorKey,
          rankedMode = rankedMode,
          requiresOpponentTeam = requiresOpponentTeam,
          teamAvgResonance = computed.teamAvgResonance,
          lobbyPilots = computed.lobbyPilots,
          eligibleOpponentCount = computed.eligibleOpponentCount,
          balancedOpponentCount = computed.balancedOpponentCount,
        )
      _uiState.value = MatchmakingQueueUiState(status = MatchmakingQueueStatus.IDLE)
      onExecuteLaunch()
      return
    }

    if (!latestIsDeviceOnline && requiresOpponentTeam) {
      pendingLaunchAction = null
      pendingTimeoutNoticeCallback = null
      val msg = "No other available teams"
      _uiState.value =
        MatchmakingQueueUiState(
          status = MatchmakingQueueStatus.TIMED_OUT,
          modeTitle = modeTitle,
          riftLabel = riftLabel,
          targetSectorKey = targetSectorKey,
          rankedMode = rankedMode,
          requiresOpponentTeam = requiresOpponentTeam,
          teamAvgResonance = computed.teamAvgResonance,
          lobbyPilots = computed.lobbyPilots,
          noticeMessage = msg,
        )
      onNoTeamsNotice(msg)
      return
    }

    pendingLaunchAction = onExecuteLaunch
    pendingTimeoutNoticeCallback = onNoTeamsNotice
    _uiState.value =
      MatchmakingQueueUiState(
        status = MatchmakingQueueStatus.SEARCHING_BALANCED,
        modeTitle = modeTitle,
        riftLabel = riftLabel,
        targetSectorKey = targetSectorKey,
        rankedMode = rankedMode,
        requiresOpponentTeam = requiresOpponentTeam,
        teamAvgResonance = computed.teamAvgResonance,
        elapsedSec = 0f,
        lobbyPilots = computed.lobbyPilots,
        eligibleOpponentCount = computed.eligibleOpponentCount,
        balancedOpponentCount = computed.balancedOpponentCount,
        noticeMessage = null,
      )

    queueTimerJob =
      viewModelScope.launch {
        var elapsed = 0f
        while (elapsed < MatchmakingQueueUiState.MAX_QUEUE_DURATION_SEC) {
          delay(100L)
          val activeState = _uiState.value
          if (!activeState.isQueueActive) return@launch

          elapsed =
            (elapsed + 0.1f).coerceAtMost(MatchmakingQueueUiState.MAX_QUEUE_DURATION_SEC)
          val nextStatus =
            if (elapsed < MatchmakingQueueUiState.BRACKET_EXPANSION_SEC) {
              MatchmakingQueueStatus.SEARCHING_BALANCED
            } else {
              MatchmakingQueueStatus.EXPANDING_BRACKET
            }
          val liveEval =
            evaluateLobbyForTarget(
              targetSectorKey = activeState.targetSectorKey,
              rankedMode = activeState.rankedMode,
            )

          _uiState.value =
            activeState.copy(
              status = nextStatus,
              elapsedSec = elapsed,
              teamAvgResonance = liveEval.teamAvgResonance,
              lobbyPilots = liveEval.lobbyPilots,
              eligibleOpponentCount = liveEval.eligibleOpponentCount,
              balancedOpponentCount = liveEval.balancedOpponentCount,
            )

          val foundMatch =
            if (nextStatus == MatchmakingQueueStatus.SEARCHING_BALANCED) {
              liveEval.balancedOpponentCount > 0
            } else {
              liveEval.eligibleOpponentCount > 0
            }
          if (foundMatch) {
            completeMatchFoundAndLaunch()
            return@launch
          }
        }

        val finalState = _uiState.value
        if (finalState.isQueueActive) {
          val finalEval =
            evaluateLobbyForTarget(
              targetSectorKey = finalState.targetSectorKey,
              rankedMode = finalState.rankedMode,
            )
          if (finalEval.eligibleOpponentCount > 0 || !finalState.requiresOpponentTeam) {
            completeMatchFoundAndLaunch()
          } else {
            val msg = "No other available teams"
            val notify = pendingTimeoutNoticeCallback
            pendingLaunchAction = null
            pendingTimeoutNoticeCallback = null
            _uiState.value =
              finalState.copy(
                status = MatchmakingQueueStatus.TIMED_OUT,
                elapsedSec = MatchmakingQueueUiState.MAX_QUEUE_DURATION_SEC,
                lobbyPilots = finalEval.lobbyPilots,
                eligibleOpponentCount = finalEval.eligibleOpponentCount,
                balancedOpponentCount = finalEval.balancedOpponentCount,
                noticeMessage = msg,
              )
            notify?.invoke(msg)
          }
        }
      }
  }

  /**
   * Immediately deploys into the match when bots / open-slot fill is allowed.
   */
  fun deployNow() {
    val cur = _uiState.value
    if (!cur.isQueueActive || cur.requiresOpponentTeam) return
    completeMatchFoundAndLaunch()
  }

  /**
   * Cancels the active matchmaking queue and returns status to CANCELLED -> IDLE.
   */
  fun cancelQueue() {
    queueTimerJob?.cancel()
    queueTimerJob = null
    pendingLaunchAction = null
    pendingTimeoutNoticeCallback = null
    _uiState.value =
      _uiState.value.copy(
        status = MatchmakingQueueStatus.CANCELLED,
        elapsedSec = 0f,
        noticeMessage = null,
      )
  }

  fun dismissNotice() {
    val cur = _uiState.value
    if (cur.noticeMessage != null || cur.status == MatchmakingQueueStatus.TIMED_OUT) {
      _uiState.value = MatchmakingQueueUiState(status = MatchmakingQueueStatus.IDLE)
    }
  }

  fun resetForAccountSwitch() {
    queueTimerJob?.cancel()
    queueTimerJob = null
    pendingLaunchAction = null
    pendingTimeoutNoticeCallback = null
    _uiState.value = MatchmakingQueueUiState(status = MatchmakingQueueStatus.IDLE)
  }

  private fun completeMatchFoundAndLaunch() {
    queueTimerJob?.cancel()
    queueTimerJob = null
    val launch = pendingLaunchAction
    pendingLaunchAction = null
    pendingTimeoutNoticeCallback = null
    _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(status = MatchmakingQueueStatus.MATCH_FOUND, noticeMessage = null)
    _uiState.value = MatchmakingQueueUiState(status = MatchmakingQueueStatus.IDLE)
    launch?.invoke()
  }

  private data class EvaluatedLobbySnapshot(
    val teamAvgResonance: Int,
    val lobbyPilots: List<LobbyPilotEntry>,
    val eligibleOpponentCount: Int,
    val balancedOpponentCount: Int,
  )

  private fun evaluateLobbyForTarget(
    targetSectorKey: String,
    rankedMode: RankedGameMode,
  ): EvaluatedLobbySnapshot {
    val wingResValues = mutableListOf(latestLocalResonance)
    if (latestIsDeviceOnline && latestArmadaName.isNotBlank()) {
      for (st in latestMergedPilots) {
        val rUid = st.userId.ifEmpty { st.id }
        if (
          rUid.isNotBlank() &&
            rUid != latestUserId &&
            st.armadaName.trim().equals(latestArmadaName, ignoreCase = true)
        ) {
          val pRes = (if (st.liveResonance > 0L) st.liveResonance else st.bounty).toInt().coerceAtLeast(0)
          wingResValues.add(pRes)
        }
      }
    }
    val teamAvgRes = (wingResValues.sum() / wingResValues.size.coerceAtLeast(1)).coerceAtLeast(0)

    val entries = mutableListOf<LobbyPilotEntry>()
    entries.add(
      LobbyPilotEntry(
        uid = latestUserId.ifBlank { "local" },
        callsign = latestCallsign.uppercase(Locale.US),
        syndicateTag = latestSyndicateTag,
        armadaName = latestArmadaName,
        shipId = latestShipId,
        resonance = latestLocalResonance,
        isLocalPilot = true,
        isWingmate = true,
        isEligibleOpponent = false,
      )
    )

    var eligibleOpponents = 0
    var balancedOpponents = 0

    if (latestIsDeviceOnline) {
      for (st in latestMergedPilots) {
        val rUid = st.userId.ifEmpty { st.id }
        if (rUid.isBlank() || rUid == latestUserId) continue
        val sameSector = st.sectorId.equals(targetSectorKey, ignoreCase = true)
        val sameWing =
          latestArmadaName.isNotBlank() &&
            st.armadaName.trim().equals(latestArmadaName, ignoreCase = true)
        if (!sameSector && !sameWing) continue

        val cleanRemoteSyn = RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(st.syndicateTag)
        val sameSyndicateInWar =
          rankedMode == RankedGameMode.SYNDICATE_WARS &&
            latestSyndicateTag.isNotBlank() &&
            cleanRemoteSyn == latestSyndicateTag
        val isOpponent = sameSector && !sameWing && !sameSyndicateInWar
        val pilotRes =
          (if (st.liveResonance > 0L) st.liveResonance else st.bounty).toInt().coerceAtLeast(0)

        if (isOpponent) {
          eligibleOpponents++
          if (abs(pilotRes - teamAvgRes) <= MatchmakingQueueUiState.BALANCED_RESONANCE_WINDOW) {
            balancedOpponents++
          }
        }

        entries.add(
          LobbyPilotEntry(
            uid = rUid,
            callsign = st.callsign.ifBlank { "PILOT" }.uppercase(Locale.US),
            syndicateTag = cleanRemoteSyn,
            armadaName = st.armadaName.trim(),
            shipId = st.shipId.toInt().coerceIn(1, 10),
            resonance = pilotRes,
            isLocalPilot = false,
            isWingmate = sameWing,
            isEligibleOpponent = isOpponent,
          )
        )
      }
    }

    return EvaluatedLobbySnapshot(
      teamAvgResonance = teamAvgRes,
      lobbyPilots = entries,
      eligibleOpponentCount = eligibleOpponents,
      balancedOpponentCount = balancedOpponents,
    )
  }
}

  HUB_MAIN,
  HANGAR_BAY,
  RIFT_FRAME_BAY,
  SQUADRON_BAY,
  SYNDICATE_BAY,
  GAME_MODES_BAY,
  CONDUIT_BAY,
  SHARD_STORE_BAY,
  DOSSIER_BAY,
  HELM_CODEX_BAY,
  OVERWATCH_INSPECT_BAY,
}

private fun parseSideBayModeKey(rawKey: String): RiftHubSideBayMode =
  when (rawKey.trim().uppercase(Locale.US)) {
    "HANGAR_BAY" -> RiftHubSideBayMode.HANGAR_BAY
    "RIFT_FRAME_BAY" -> RiftHubSideBayMode.RIFT_FRAME_BAY
    "SQUADRON_BAY" -> RiftHubSideBayMode.SQUADRON_BAY
    "SYNDICATE_BAY" -> RiftHubSideBayMode.SYNDICATE_BAY
    "GAME_MODES_BAY", "ACTIVE_RIFTS_BAY" -> RiftHubSideBayMode.GAME_MODES_BAY
    "CONDUIT_BAY" -> RiftHubSideBayMode.CONDUIT_BAY
    "SHARD_STORE_BAY" -> RiftHubSideBayMode.SHARD_STORE_BAY
    "DOSSIER_BAY" -> RiftHubSideBayMode.DOSSIER_BAY
    "HELM_CODEX_BAY" -> RiftHubSideBayMode.HELM_CODEX_BAY
    "OVERWATCH_INSPECT_BAY" -> RiftHubSideBayMode.OVERWATCH_INSPECT_BAY
    else -> RiftHubSideBayMode.HUB_MAIN
  }

internal fun formatOverwatchResonance(value: Int): String =
  String.format(Locale.US, "%,d", value.coerceAtLeast(0))

internal fun formatOverwatchTimerMmSs(totalSeconds: Int): String {
  val clamped = totalSeconds.coerceAtLeast(0)
  val mins = clamped / 60
  val secs = clamped % 60
  return String.format(Locale.US, "%02d:%02d", mins, secs)
}

internal fun generateSixCharRoomCode(seedSalt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): String {
  val alphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
  var v = abs(seedSalt xor 0x5DEECE66DL)
  val sb = StringBuilder(6)
  repeat(6) { idx ->
    val charIdx = ((v + idx * 17L) % alphabet.length).toInt()
    sb.append(alphabet[charIdx])
    v = (v * 1103515245L + 12345L) and 0x7FFFFFFFL
  }
  return sb.toString()
}

internal fun extractCustomRoomCode(instanceId: String): String {
  val parts = instanceId.split("_")
  val prefix = parts.firstOrNull()?.lowercase(Locale.US)
  if ((prefix == "priv" || prefix == "pub") && parts.size >= 2) {
    val candidate = parts[1].uppercase(Locale.US).replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9]"), "").take(8)
    if (candidate.length in 4..8) return candidate
  }
  return generateSixCharRoomCode(instanceId.hashCode().toLong())
}

internal fun extractCustomRoomCode(config: CustomGameConfig): String =
  config.roomCode
    .trim()
    .uppercase(Locale.US)
    .replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9]"), "")
    .take(8)
    .takeIf { it.length in 4..8 }
    ?: extractCustomRoomCode(config.instanceId)

internal fun isPrivateCustomGame(config: CustomGameConfig): Boolean =
  config.privateRoom || config.instanceId.startsWith("priv_", ignoreCase = true)

private fun riftHubCardTransitionOrder(node: NexusCoreNode): Int =
  when (node) {
    NexusCoreNode.ORBITAL_HUB -> -1
    NexusCoreNode.HANGAR_DECK -> 0
    NexusCoreNode.STAR_FORGE -> 1
    NexusCoreNode.SUBSPACE_COMMS -> 2
    NexusCoreNode.CONVERGENCE_GATE -> 3
    NexusCoreNode.RIFT_CONDUIT -> 4
    NexusCoreNode.SYNDICATE_CITADEL -> 5
    NexusCoreNode.ARCHIVE_CODEX -> 6
    NexusCoreNode.HELM_SYSTEMS -> 7
  }

private fun isLeftSideHubCard(node: NexusCoreNode): Boolean =
  node == NexusCoreNode.HANGAR_DECK ||
    node == NexusCoreNode.STAR_FORGE ||
    node == NexusCoreNode.SUBSPACE_COMMS
