                wingStackGap = wingStackGap,
                shardText = shardText,
                liveResonance = liveResonance,
                shipSpinDeg = shipSpinDeg,
                fluxOrbitRad = fluxOrbitRad,
                isCharged = chargedShipId == 10,
                localPrefs = localPrefs,
                currentUserId = currentUserId,
                indicatedShipId = hangarIndicatedShipId,
                onShareBuild = onShareActiveRiftFrameBuild,
                onInspectCosmetic = { item, isUnlocked, isEquipped ->
                  val isRankedReward = RiftProgressionCatalog.isRankedCosmeticCategory(item.category)
                  val previewSkin = if (item.category == "HULL_TRIM") item.id.coerceIn(0, 5) else null
                  val previewFinisher = if (item.category == "KILL_FINISHER") item.id.coerceIn(0, 4) else null
                  val previewWarp = if (item.category == "WARP_SIGNATURE") item.id.coerceIn(0, 3) else null
                  val previewHalo = if (item.category == "HVT_HALO") item.id.coerceIn(0, 3) else null
                  val rankedNote =
                    if (item.freeAtResonance <= 0) "Standard factory equipment"
                    else "Active at ${formatOverwatchResonance(item.freeAtResonance)}+ Live Resonance"
                  val hullSkinNote =
                    if (item.shardCost <= 0L) "Standard factory equipment"
                    else "Applies to all 10 ships"
                  onChangeOverwatchPrompt(
                    if (isRankedReward) {
                      OverwatchCircularPrompt.InfoStageInspect(
                        kicker = "RANKED LIVE RESONANCE REWARD",
                        title = item.name.uppercase(Locale.US),
                        badge =

                            isEquipped -> "EQUIPPED"

                            else -> "${formatOverwatchResonance(item.freeAtResonance)} LIVE"

                        shipId = hangarIndicatedShipId,
                        showResonanceCrest = true,
                        previewFinisherId = previewFinisher,

                        primaryActionLabel = if (!isEquipped && isUnlocked) "EQUIP" else "",

                            val res = handleUnlockOrEquipCosmetic(item)

                              onChangeOverwatchPrompt(
                                OverwatchCircularPrompt.InfoStageInspect(
                                  kicker = "RANKED LIVE RESONANCE REWARD",
                                  title = item.name.uppercase(Locale.US),
                                  badge = "EQUIPPED",
                                  summary = item.summary,
                                  tacticalNote = rankedNote,
                                  accentHex = 0xFF00F5D4L,
                                  shipId = hangarIndicatedShipId,
                                  showResonanceCrest = true,
                                  previewFinisherId = previewFinisher,
                                  previewWarpStyleId = previewWarp,
                                  previewHaloStyleId = previewHalo,
                                )
                              )
                            }
                          })
                          else null,
                      )
                    } else {
                      OverwatchCircularPrompt.InfoStageInspect(
                        kicker = "SHIP SKIN",
                        title = item.name.uppercase(Locale.US),
                        badge =
                          when {
                            isEquipped -> "EQUIPPED"
                            isUnlocked -> "OWNED"
                            else -> "${item.shardCost} SHARDS"
                          },
                        summary = item.summary,
                        tacticalNote = hullSkinNote,
                        accentHex = if (isUnlocked) 0xFF00F5D4L else 0xFFFFD700L,
                        shipId = hangarIndicatedShipId,
                        previewHullSkinId = previewSkin,
                        primaryActionLabel =
                          when {
                            isEquipped -> ""
                            isUnlocked -> "EQUIP"
                            else -> "BUY ${item.shardCost}"
                          },
                        onPrimaryAction =
                          if (isEquipped) null
                          else ({
                            val res = handleUnlockOrEquipCosmetic(item)
                            storePurchaseBanner = res.second
                            if (res.first) {
                              onChangeOverwatchPrompt(
                                OverwatchCircularPrompt.InfoStageInspect(
                                  kicker = "SHIP SKIN",
                                  title = item.name.uppercase(Locale.US),
                                  badge = "EQUIPPED",
                                  summary = item.summary,
                                  tacticalNote = hullSkinNote,
                                  accentHex = 0xFF00F5D4L,
                                  shipId = hangarIndicatedShipId,
                                  previewHullSkinId = previewSkin,
                                )
                              )
                            }
                          }),
                      )
                    }
                  )
                },
              )

            RiftHubSideBayMode.SQUADRON_BAY -> {

                      kicker = "SQUADRON FORMATION",
                      title = "REMOVE ${member.callsign.uppercase(Locale.US)}?",
                      subtitle =
                        "Removes this wingmate from Squadron [${activeArmadaName.ifBlank { "SQUADRON" }}].",
                      confirmLabel = "REMOVE",
                      accentHex = 0xFFFB7185L,
                      onConfirm = {
                        engine?.removeMemberFromArmada(member.uid.ifBlank { member.callsign })

            onChangeSideBayMode(RiftHubSideBayMode.HUB_MAIN)
          } else {
            onChangeSideBayMode(RiftHubSideBayMode.GAME_MODES_BAY)
          }
        },
        onBottomLeftBackOrCancel = {
          if (overwatchPrompt != OverwatchCircularPrompt.None) {
            onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
          } else if (sideBayMode != RiftHubSideBayMode.HUB_MAIN) {
            onChangeSideBayMode(RiftHubSideBayMode.HUB_MAIN)
          }
        },
        onBottomRightConfirmOrCharge = {
          when (val p = overwatchPrompt) {
            is OverwatchCircularPrompt.ShipInspect -> {
              if (!p.hideChargeButton) {
                onChargeShip(p.shipId)
                onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
                onChangeSideBayMode(RiftHubSideBayMode.HUB_MAIN)
              } else {
                onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
              }
            }
            is OverwatchCircularPrompt.PilotInspect -> {
              onInviteOnlinePilotToWing(p.pilot.rawLivePilot)
              onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
            }
            is OverwatchCircularPrompt.ActionConfirm -> {
              p.onConfirm()
              onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
            }
            is OverwatchCircularPrompt.CallsignRename -> {
              val clean = renameDraftState.trim().uppercase(Locale.US).replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_\\-]"), "").take(14)
              if (clean.length >= 2) {
                onRenamePilotCallsign(clean)
                onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
              }
            }
            is OverwatchCircularPrompt.SyndicateCrestBuilder -> {
              onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
            }
            is OverwatchCircularPrompt.InfoStageInspect -> {
              val hasCosmeticPreview =
                p.previewHullSkinId != null ||
                  p.previewFinisherId != null ||
                  p.previewWarpStyleId != null ||
                  p.previewHaloStyleId != null
              p.onPrimaryAction?.invoke()
              if (!hasCosmeticPreview) {
                onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
              }
            }
            OverwatchCircularPrompt.ResonanceLeaderboard -> {
              onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
            }
            OverwatchCircularPrompt.RiftFrameDrydock -> {
              onChargeShip(10)
              onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
              onChangeSideBayMode(RiftHubSideBayMode.HUB_MAIN)
            }
            is OverwatchCircularPrompt.FrameSlotRename -> {
              val clean = frameRenameDraft.trim().take(18)
              if (clean.isNotBlank()) {
                onSaveCustomSlot(
                  activeCustomSlot
                    .copy(slotId = activeCustomSlotId, customName = clean)
                    .clampToPointBudget(pointBudget.coerceAtLeast(100))
                )
              }
              onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
            }
            is OverwatchCircularPrompt.SquadronTagRename -> {
              applySquadronTagRename(squadronTagRenameDraft)
            }
            is OverwatchCircularPrompt.SliderWorkbench -> {
              onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
            }
            OverwatchCircularPrompt.None -> {
              if (sideBayMode == RiftHubSideBayMode.RIFT_FRAME_BAY) {
                onChargeShip(10)
                onChangeSideBayMode(RiftHubSideBayMode.HUB_MAIN)
              }
            }
          }
        },
      )

      if (hubTutorialStep in 1..6) {
        HubGuidedTutorialCoachmarkCard(
          modifier =
            Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
              .zIndex(4f)
              .padding(bottom = 8.dp, start = 12.dp, end = 12.dp)
              .widthIn(min = 276.dp, max = if (isTabletDeck) 468.dp else 404.dp),
          step = hubTutorialStep,
          isTabletDeck = isTabletDeck,
          pulseAlpha = tutorialPulseAlpha,
          onBack = {
            if (hubTutorialStep > 1) {
              hubTutorialStep--
            } else {
              hubTutorialStep = 0
              onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
              onChangeSideBayMode(RiftHubSideBayMode.HUB_MAIN)
            }
          },
          onSkipToFlight = {
            hubTutorialStep = 0
            onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
            onChangeSideBayMode(RiftHubSideBayMode.HUB_MAIN)
            onEnterPracticeRift()
          },
          onNextOrStartFlight = {
            if (hubTutorialStep < 6) {
              hubTutorialStep++
            } else {
              hubTutorialStep = 0
              onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
              onChangeSideBayMode(RiftHubSideBayMode.HUB_MAIN)
              onEnterPracticeRift()
            }
          },
          onDismissTour = {
            hubTutorialStep = 0
            onChangeOverwatchPrompt(OverwatchCircularPrompt.None)
            onChangeSideBayMode(RiftHubSideBayMode.HUB_MAIN)
          },
        )
      }

      val draggedItem = activeDraggedFrameItem
      if (draggedItem != null) {
        val ghostBmp =
          remember(draggedItem.isPrimary, draggedItem.itemId, RiftSpriteBaker.spriteVisualRevision) {
            if (draggedItem.isPrimary) {
              RiftSpriteBaker.getPrimaryWeaponIconBitmap(draggedItem.itemId).asImageBitmap()
            } else {
              RiftSpriteBaker.getSecondaryAbilityIconBitmap(draggedItem.itemId).asImageBitmap()
            }
          }
        val localX = dragPointerRootOffset.x - stageRootOrigin.x
        val localY = dragPointerRootOffset.y - stageRootOrigin.y
        Column(
          modifier =
            Modifier.zIndex(5f)
              .offset {
                IntOffset(
                  (localX - with(density) { 42.dp.toPx() }).roundToInt(),
                  (localY - with(density) { 48.dp.toPx() }).roundToInt(),
                )
              }
              .cockpitReticleSurface(
                accent = draggedItem.accentColor,
                isSelected = true,
                drawCornerTicks = true,
                featherAlpha = 0.72f,
              )
              .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 5.dp),
          horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
        ) {
          Image(
            bitmap = ghostBmp,
            contentDescription = draggedItem.label,
            contentScale = ContentScale.Fit,
            modifier = Modifier.size(34.dp),
          )
          Text(
            text = "${draggedItem.label.uppercase(Locale.US)} • ${draggedItem.pointCost}P",
            color = Color.White,
            fontSize = 7.6.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 1,
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun HubGuidedTutorialCoachmarkCard(
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
  step: Int,
  isTabletDeck: Boolean,
  pulseAlpha: Float,
  onBack: () -> Unit,
  onSkipToFlight: () -> Unit,
  onNextOrStartFlight: () -> Unit,
  onDismissTour: () -> Unit,
) {
  BackHandler(onBack = onDismissTour)
  val (title, summary) =
    when (step) {
      1 ->
        "OVERWATCH & LIVE SECTORS" to
          "Pinch 1.0x to 6.0x inside Overwatch to inspect live combat, tap the top-left chevrons to switch Rifts, tap the sensor strip to inspect human pilots, or tap RIFT IN > to launch."
      2 ->
        "RESONANCE & LEADERBOARDS" to
          "Live Resonance ranks top pilots across Global, Per-Ship, and Syndicate Leaderboards and unlocks Ranked rewards (Frame C-E, Finishers, Halos, and Warps) while held."
      3 ->
        "HANGAR DECK & 100-PT PARITY" to
          "All 10 starfighters share an identical 100-Point stat and weapon budget from 0 Resonance. Tap CHARGE on any ship to lock your hull with orbiting Flux icons across all modes."
      4 ->
        "RIFT FRAME DRAG & DROP DRYDOCK" to
          "Drag Primary Weapons from the left shelf and Secondary or Crate modules from the right shelf onto Ship 10's Overwatch sockets, then slide the 5 hull stat bars."
      5 ->
        "SYNDICATES, SQUADRON & RIFT AI" to
          "Form a 5-pilot Squadron with live team voice, charter a real-player Syndicate, or open Subspace Comms for sector channels and tactical Rift AI."
      else ->
        "ACTIVE RIFTS & FLIGHT TRAINING" to
          "Queue into 6 Competitive Modes or tune Custom Rift rules in Overwatch. Tap START FLIGHT TRAINING > below to launch Phase 2 live arena flight!"
    }
  val isFinalStep = step >= 6

  val textShadow =
    remember {
      Shadow(color = Color(0xE601040B), offset = Offset(0f, 1f), blurRadius = 6f)
    }

  Box(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .drawBehind {
          val w = size.width
          val h = size.height
          if (w <= 8f || h <= 8f) return@drawBehind
          val safePulse = pulseAlpha.coerceIn(0.45f, 1f)

          // (a) Edge-free elliptical radial legibility feather (zero opaque rectangular slab)
          val sx = if (w >= h) 1f else (w / h).coerceIn(0.35f, 1f)
          val sy = if (w >= h) (h / w).coerceIn(0.35f, 1f) else 1f
          val baseR = maxOf(w, h) * 0.58f
          scale(scaleX = sx, scaleY = sy, pivot = center) {
            drawCircle(
              brush =
                Brush.radialGradient(
                  colorStops =
                    arrayOf(
                      0.00f to Color(0xD8020714),
                      0.62f to Color(0x80040D1E),
                      1.00f to Color.Transparent,
                    ),
                  center = center,
                  radius = baseR,
                ),
              radius = baseR,
              center = center,
            )
          }

          // (b) Pulsing open 4-corner solar-gold and cyan targeting reticle brackets (8.dp L-ticks)
          val tick = minOf(8.dp.toPx(), w * 0.12f, h * 0.24f)
          val sw = 1.4.dp.toPx()
          val goldCol = Color(0xFFFFD700).copy(alpha = safePulse)
          val cyanCol = Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = safePulse)
          val pad = 1.5.dp.toPx()
          // Top-left (solar gold)
          drawLine(goldCol, Offset(pad, pad + tick), Offset(pad, pad), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
          drawLine(goldCol, Offset(pad, pad), Offset(pad + tick, pad), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
          // Top-right (cyan)
          drawLine(cyanCol, Offset(w - pad - tick, pad), Offset(w - pad, pad), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
          drawLine(cyanCol, Offset(w - pad, pad), Offset(w - pad, pad + tick), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
          // Bottom-left (cyan)
          drawLine(cyanCol, Offset(pad, h - pad - tick), Offset(pad, h - pad), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
          drawLine(cyanCol, Offset(pad, h - pad), Offset(pad + tick, h - pad), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
          // Bottom-right (solar gold)
          drawLine(goldCol, Offset(w - pad - tick, h - pad), Offset(w - pad, h - pad), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
          drawLine(goldCol, Offset(w - pad, h - pad - tick), Offset(w - pad, h - pad), sw, StrokeCap.Round)

          // (c) Tapered top and bottom horizontal laser filaments fading to transparent at both ends
          val laserStroke = 1.2.dp.toPx()
          drawLine(
            brush =
              Brush.horizontalGradient(
                colorStops =
                  arrayOf(
                    0.00f to Color.Transparent,
                    0.18f to Color(0xFFFFD700).copy(alpha = safePulse * 0.82f),
                    0.50f to Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.90f),
                    0.82f to Color(0xFFFFD700).copy(alpha = safePulse * 0.82f),
                    1.00f to Color.Transparent,
                  )
              ),
            start = Offset(w * 0.06f, pad),
            end = Offset(w * 0.94f, pad),
            strokeWidth = laserStroke,
            cap = StrokeCap.Round,
          )
          drawLine(
            brush =
              Brush.horizontalGradient(
                colorStops =
                  arrayOf(
                    0.00f to Color.Transparent,
                    0.18f to Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.80f),
                    0.50f to Color(0xFFFFD700).copy(alpha = safePulse * 0.86f),
                    0.82f to Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.80f),
                    1.00f to Color.Transparent,
                  )
              ),
            start = Offset(w * 0.06f, h - pad),
            end = Offset(w * 0.94f, h - pad),
            strokeWidth = laserStroke,
            cap = StrokeCap.Round,
          )
        }
        .testTag("hub_guided_tutorial_card"),
  ) {
    Column(
      modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 9.dp),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
    ) {
      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "HUB GUIDE • STEP $step OF 6",
          color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
          fontSize = if (isTabletDeck) 8.6.sp else 7.8.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          style = TextStyle(shadow = textShadow),
        )
        Row(
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
          for (i in 1..6) {
            val pipCol =
              when {
                i == step -> Color(0xFFFFD700)
                i < step -> Color(0xFF00F5D4)
                else -> Color(0xFF475569)
              }
            Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size(width = if (i == step) 14.dp else 6.dp, height = 5.dp)) {
              val cy = size.height * 0.5f
              drawLine(
                color = pipCol,
                start = Offset(1.dp.toPx(), cy),
                end = Offset((size.width - 1.dp.toPx()).coerceAtLeast(1.dp.toPx()), cy),
                strokeWidth = if (i == step) 3.dp.toPx() else 2.2.dp.toPx(),
                cap = StrokeCap.Round,
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }

      Text(
        text = title,
        color = Color.White,
        fontSize = if (isTabletDeck) 10.6.sp else 9.6.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        style = TextStyle(shadow = textShadow),
      )
      Text(
        text = summary,
        color = Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
        fontSize = if (isTabletDeck) 8.8.sp else 8.0.sp,
        lineHeight = if (isTabletDeck) 11.8.sp else 10.8.sp,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
        style = TextStyle(shadow = textShadow),
      )

      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      ) {
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
              .heightIn(min = 48.dp)
              .cockpitReticleSurface(
                accent = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                isSelected = true,
                drawCornerTicks = false,
                featherAlpha = 0.34f,
              )
              .clickable { onBack() }
              .padding(horizontal = 10.dp)
              .testTag("hub_tutorial_btn_back"),
          contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
          Text(
            text = if (step == 1) "CLOSE" else "< BACK",
            color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
            fontSize = 8.0.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            style = TextStyle(shadow = textShadow),
          )
        }

        if (!isFinalStep) {
          Box(
            modifier =
              Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
                .heightIn(min = 48.dp)
                .cockpitReticleSurface(
                  accent = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
                  isSelected = true,
                  drawCornerTicks = false,
                  featherAlpha = 0.38f,
                )
                .clickable { onSkipToFlight() }
                .padding(horizontal = 10.dp)
                .testTag("hub_tutorial_btn_skip_to_flight"),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
          ) {
            Text(
              text = "SKIP TO FLIGHT >",
              color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
              fontSize = 8.0.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              style = TextStyle(shadow = textShadow),
            )
          }
        }

        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
              .heightIn(min = 48.dp)
              .cockpitReticleSurface(
                accent = if (isFinalStep) Color(0xFF00F5D4) else Color(0xFFFFD700),
                isSelected = true,
                drawCornerTicks = true,
                featherAlpha = 0.48f,
              )
              .clickable { onNextOrStartFlight() }
              .padding(horizontal = 12.dp)
              .testTag("hub_tutorial_btn_next"),
          contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
          Text(
            text = if (isFinalStep) "START FLIGHT TRAINING >" else "NEXT >",
            color = if (isFinalStep) Color(0xFF00F5D4) else Color(0xFFFEF08A),
            fontSize = 8.2.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            style = TextStyle(shadow = textShadow),
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun HubDigitizingScanlineBox(
  modifier: Modifier,
  scanProgress: Float,
  isRightSide: Boolean,
  isDragging: Boolean = false,
  content: @Composable BoxScope.() -> Unit,
) {
  val targetTiltDeg =
    when {
      isDragging -> 0f
      isRightSide -> -9.5f
      else -> 9.5f
    }
  val animatedTiltDeg by
    animateFloatAsState(
      targetValue = targetTiltDeg,
      animationSpec = tween(durationMillis = 220, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
      label = "cockpit_wing_tilt",
    )
  Box(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .graphicsLayer {
          rotationY = animatedTiltDeg
          cameraDistance = 16f * density
          clip = false
        }
        .drawWithContent {
          drawContent()
          if (scanProgress < 0.99f) {
            val sweepY = size.height * scanProgress
            val alpha = (1f - scanProgress).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
            drawLine(
              brush =
                Brush.horizontalGradient(
                  colors =
                    listOf(
                      Color.Transparent,
                      Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.85f * alpha),
                      Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.90f * alpha),
                      Color(0xFF38BDF8).copy(alpha = 0.72f * alpha),
                      Color.Transparent,
                    ),
                ),
              start = Offset(0f, sweepY),
              end = Offset(size.width, sweepY),
              strokeWidth = 1.8.dp.toPx(),
              cap = StrokeCap.Round,
            )
          }
        },
    content = content,
  )
}

@Composable
private fun DedicatedCompactSplitBay(
  modifier: Modifier,
  title: String,
  primaryStat: String,
  badgeText: String,
  detailCue: String,
  accent: Color,
  secondaryAccent: Color,
  isTabletDeck: Boolean,
  testTag: String,
  onClick: () -> Unit,
) {
  BoxWithConstraints(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
        .heightIn(min = 52.dp)
        .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
          isRightSide = true,
          primaryBorder = accent,
          secondaryBorder = secondaryAccent,
        )
        .clickable { onClick() }
        .padding(horizontal = if (isTabletDeck) 9.dp else 7.dp, vertical = 5.dp)
        .testTag(testTag),
  ) {
    val showDetail = maxHeight >= 76.dp
    Column(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,
    ) {
      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      ) {
        Text(
          text = title,
          color = Color.White,
          fontSize = if (isTabletDeck) 10.6.sp else 9.0.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          maxLines = 1,
          overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          style = TextStyle(platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
          modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false).padding(end = 3.dp),
        )
        Text(
          text = badgeText,
          color = secondaryAccent,
          fontSize = if (isTabletDeck) 8.0.sp else 7.2.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          maxLines = 1,
          style = TextStyle(platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
        )
      }
      Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
      Text(
        text = primaryStat,
        color = accent,
        fontSize = if (isTabletDeck) 9.4.sp else 8.2.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        style = TextStyle(platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
      )
      if (showDetail) {
        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
        Text(
          text = detailCue,
          color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
          fontSize = if (isTabletDeck) 7.8.sp else 7.0.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          maxLines = 1,
          overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          style = TextStyle(platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

internal fun Modifier.chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
  isRightSide: Boolean,
  primaryBorder: Color,
  secondaryBorder: Color,
): Modifier =
  this.drawBehind {
    val w = size.width
    val h = size.height
    if (w <= 8f || h <= 8f) return@drawBehind
    val cx = if (!isRightSide) w * 0.46f else w * 0.54f
    val cy = h * 0.5f
    val featherR = maxOf(w * 0.62f, h * 0.78f)
    // Edge-free radial contrast feather behind floating cockpit HUD telemetry (zero dark slab / zero closed box)
    drawCircle(
      brush =
        Brush.radialGradient(
          colorStops =
            arrayOf(
              0.00f to Color(0x8A020714),
              0.52f to Color(0x42040D1E),
              1.00f to Color.Transparent,
            ),
          center = Offset(cx, cy),
          radius = featherR,
        ),
      radius = featherR,
      center = Offset(cx, cy),
    )
    // Tapered bottom accent laser filament (fades cleanly to transparent at both ends; zero vertical equator rails)
    val yLine = (h - 1.dp.toPx()).coerceAtLeast(1f)
    drawLine(
      brush =
        Brush.horizontalGradient(
          colorStops =
            if (!isRightSide) {
              arrayOf(
                0.00f to Color.Transparent,
                0.20f to primaryBorder.copy(alpha = 0.62f),
                0.68f to secondaryBorder.copy(alpha = 0.34f),
                1.00f to Color.Transparent,
              )
            } else {
              arrayOf(
                0.00f to Color.Transparent,
                0.32f to secondaryBorder.copy(alpha = 0.34f),
                0.80f to primaryBorder.copy(alpha = 0.62f),
                1.00f to Color.Transparent,
              )
            },
        ),
      start = Offset(0f, yLine),
      end = Offset(w, yLine),
      strokeWidth = 1.0.dp.toPx(),
      cap = StrokeCap.Round,
    )
  }

internal fun Modifier.cockpitReticleSurface(
  accent: Color,
  isSelected: Boolean = true,
  drawCornerTicks: Boolean = isSelected,
  featherAlpha: Float = if (isSelected) 0.52f else 0.24f,
): Modifier =
  this.drawBehind {
    val w = size.width
    val h = size.height
    if (w <= 6f || h <= 6f) return@drawBehind
    val centerPt = Offset(w * 0.5f, h * 0.5f)
    val featherR = maxOf(w * 0.58f, h * 0.72f)
    if (featherAlpha > 0.01f) {
      drawCircle(
        brush =
          Brush.radialGradient(
            colorStops =
              arrayOf(
                0.00f to Color(0xFF020714).copy(alpha = featherAlpha),
                0.60f to Color(0xFF040D1E).copy(alpha = featherAlpha * 0.45f),
                1.00f to Color.Transparent,
              ),
            center = centerPt,
            radius = featherR,
          ),
        radius = featherR,
        center = centerPt,
      )
    }
    if (isSelected) {
      drawCircle(
        brush =
          Brush.radialGradient(
            colorStops =
              arrayOf(
                0.00f to accent.copy(alpha = 0.18f),
                0.62f to accent.copy(alpha = 0.05f),
                1.00f to Color.Transparent,
              ),
            center = centerPt,
            radius = featherR * 0.92f,
          ),
        radius = featherR * 0.92f,
        center = centerPt,
      )
      if (drawCornerTicks) {
        val tick = minOf(5.5.dp.toPx(), w * 0.16f, h * 0.30f)
        val sw = 1.15.dp.toPx()
        val c = accent.copy(alpha = 0.92f)
        // Top-left open bracket
        drawLine(c, Offset(1f, tick), Offset(1f, 1f), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
        drawLine(c, Offset(1f, 1f), Offset(tick, 1f), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
        // Top-right open bracket
        drawLine(c, Offset(w - tick, 1f), Offset(w - 1f, 1f), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
        drawLine(c, Offset(w - 1f, 1f), Offset(w - 1f, tick), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
        // Bottom-left open bracket
        drawLine(c, Offset(1f, h - tick), Offset(1f, h - 1f), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
        drawLine(c, Offset(1f, h - 1f), Offset(tick, h - 1f), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
        // Bottom-right open bracket
        drawLine(c, Offset(w - tick, h - 1f), Offset(w - 1f, h - 1f), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
        drawLine(c, Offset(w - 1f, h - tick), Offset(w - 1f, h - 1f), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
      }
      val lineY = (h - 1.dp.toPx()).coerceAtLeast(1f)
      drawLine(
        brush =
          Brush.horizontalGradient(
            colorStops =
              arrayOf(
                0.00f to Color.Transparent,
                0.22f to accent.copy(alpha = 0.82f),
                0.50f to Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.88f),
                0.78f to accent.copy(alpha = 0.82f),
                1.00f to Color.Transparent,
              ),
          ),
        start = Offset(w * 0.08f, lineY),
        end = Offset(w * 0.92f, lineY),
        strokeWidth = 1.4.dp.toPx(),
        cap = StrokeCap.Round,
      )
    }
  }

internal fun Modifier.cockpitLaserInputSurface(
  accent: Color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
): Modifier =
  this.drawBehind {
    val w = size.width
    val h = size.height
    if (w <= 6f || h <= 6f) return@drawBehind
    val centerPt = Offset(w * 0.5f, h * 0.5f)
    val featherR = maxOf(w * 0.58f, h * 0.85f)
    drawCircle(
      brush =
        Brush.radialGradient(
          colorStops =
            arrayOf(
              0.00f to Color(0x78020714),
              0.62f to Color(0x36040D1E),
              1.00f to Color.Transparent,
            ),
          center = centerPt,
          radius = featherR,
        ),
      radius = featherR,
      center = centerPt,
    )
    val tick = minOf(4.5.dp.toPx(), h * 0.28f)
    val sw = 1.15.dp.toPx()
    val yB = (h - 1.dp.toPx()).coerceAtLeast(1f)
    drawLine(accent.copy(alpha = 0.85f), Offset(1f, yB - tick), Offset(1f, yB), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
    drawLine(accent.copy(alpha = 0.85f), Offset(w - 1f, yB - tick), Offset(w - 1f, yB), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
    drawLine(
      brush =
        Brush.horizontalGradient(
          colorStops =
            arrayOf(
              0.00f to accent.copy(alpha = 0.72f),
              0.50f to Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.82f),
              1.00f to accent.copy(alpha = 0.72f),
            ),
        ),
      start = Offset(1f, yB),
      end = Offset(w - 1f, yB),
      strokeWidth = 1.25.dp.toPx(),
      cap = StrokeCap.Round,
    )
  }

@Composable
private fun PortTopPilotPod(
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
  heightDp: Dp,
  @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") isTabletDeck: Boolean,
  pilotIdentityLabel: String,
  conduitRankLabel: String = "",
  isGoogleAuthenticated: Boolean,
  isStreaming: Boolean,
  onClickCallsign: () -> Unit,
  onSwitchAccount: () -> Unit,
) {
  val callsignFontSize = if (pilotIdentityLabel.length > 15) 10.2.sp else 11.4.sp
  val subtitleText =
    if (conduitRankLabel.isNotBlank()) "DOSSIER • $conduitRankLabel"
    else "PILOT DOSSIER"
  val hudShadow = remember { Shadow(color = Color(0xE6020611), offset = Offset(0f, 1f), blurRadius = 6f) }
  Row(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .height(heightDp)
        .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
          isRightSide = false,
          primaryBorder = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
          secondaryBorder = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
        )
        .padding(start = 6.dp, end = 2.dp, top = 3.dp, bottom = 4.dp),
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
  ) {
    Row(
      modifier =
        Modifier.weight(1f)
          .fillMaxHeight()
          .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
          .clickable { onClickCallsign() }
          .padding(end = 4.dp)
          .testTag("nexus_top_callsign"),
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
    ) {
      SwirlingRiftVortexGlyph(
        modifier = Modifier.size(22.dp),
        isStreaming = isStreaming,
      )
      Column(
        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,
      ) {
        Row(
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
        ) {
          Box(
            modifier =
              Modifier.size(6.dp)
                .clip(CircleShape)
                .background(if (isGoogleAuthenticated) Color(0xFF00F5D4) else Color(0xFFFACC15))
          )
          Text(
            text = pilotIdentityLabel,
            color = Color(0xFFF8FAFC),
            fontSize = callsignFontSize,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
            style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
          )
        }
        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
        Text(
          text = subtitleText,
          color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
          fontSize = 8.8.sp,
          letterSpacing = (-0.1).sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          maxLines = 1,
          overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
        )
      }
    }

    Box(
      modifier =
        Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
          .size(48.dp)
          .clickable { onSwitchAccount() }
          .testTag("nexus_top_switch_account"),
      contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
      Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size(19.dp)) {
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        val accent = if (isGoogleAuthenticated) Color(0xFF00F5D4) else Color(0xFFFACC15)
        drawArc(
          color = accent,
          startAngle = -145f,
          sweepAngle = 125f,
          useCenter = false,
          topLeft = Offset(w * 0.10f, h * 0.12f),
          size = Size(w * 0.80f, h * 0.76f),
          style = Stroke(width = 1.9.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
        )
        drawArc(
          color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
          startAngle = 35f,
          sweepAngle = 125f,
          useCenter = false,
          topLeft = Offset(w * 0.10f, h * 0.12f),
          size = Size(w * 0.80f, h * 0.76f),
          style = Stroke(width = 1.9.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
        )
        drawCircle(
          color = Color.White,
          radius = 2.4.dp.toPx(),
          center = Offset(w * 0.5f, h * 0.5f),
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun StarboardBottomUplinkPod(
  heightDp: Dp,
  @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") isTabletDeck: Boolean,
  syndicateTag: String = "",
  syndicateDisplayName: String = "",
  syndicateOnlineCount: Int,
  strikeWingOnlineCount: Int,
  armadaCount: Int,
  activeArmadaName: String = "",
  onClickSyn: () -> Unit,
  onClickWing: () -> Unit,
) {
  val hudShadow = remember { Shadow(color = Color(0xE6020611), offset = Offset(0f, 1f), blurRadius = 6f) }
  Row(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
        .height(heightDp)
        .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
          isRightSide = true,
          primaryBorder = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
          secondaryBorder = Color(0xFFFACC15),
        )
        .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
  ) {
    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.weight(1f)
          .fillMaxHeight()
          .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
          .clickable { onClickSyn() }
          .padding(horizontal = 4.dp)
          .testTag("nexus_top_syn"),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,
      horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
    ) {
      val cleanPodSynTag = syndicateTag.trim().uppercase(Locale.US)
      val hasPodSyndicate =
        cleanPodSynTag.isNotEmpty() && cleanPodSynTag !in LocalPilotPrefs.NON_PLAYER_SYNDICATE_TAGS
      Row(
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
      ) {
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.size(6.5.dp)
              .clip(CircleShape)
              .background(
                if (hasPodSyndicate && syndicateOnlineCount > 0) Color(0xFFFFD700)
                else Color(0xFF64748B)
              )
        )
        Text(
          text =
            if (hasPodSyndicate) "[$cleanPodSynTag] • ${syndicateOnlineCount.coerceAtLeast(1)} ON"
            else "SYNDICATES",
          color = Color(0xFFFACC15),
          fontSize = 10.8.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          maxLines = 1,
          overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
        )
      }
      Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
      Text(
        text =
          if (hasPodSyndicate) syndicateDisplayName.ifBlank { "[$cleanPodSynTag]" }
          else "CHARTER / JOIN >",
        color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
        fontSize = 8.8.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
      )
    }

    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.weight(1f)
          .fillMaxHeight()
          .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
          .clickable { onClickWing() }
          .padding(horizontal = 4.dp)
          .testTag("nexus_top_wing"),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,
      horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
    ) {
      Row(
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
      ) {
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.size(6.5.dp)
              .clip(CircleShape)
              .background(if (strikeWingOnlineCount > 0) Color(0xFF00F5D4) else Color(0xFF38BDF8))
        )
        Text(
          text = "SQUADRON • ${maxOf(strikeWingOnlineCount, armadaCount)}/5",
          color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
          fontSize = 10.8.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          maxLines = 1,
          style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
        )
      }
      Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
      Text(
        text = activeArmadaName.ifBlank { "SQUAD UP >" },
        color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
        fontSize = 8.8.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
      )
    }
  }
}

@Composable
internal fun HubDigitizedReturnBar(
  heightDp: Dp,
  isRightSide: Boolean,
  @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") isTabletDeck: Boolean,
  sectionTitle: String,
  accent: Color,
  trailingLabel: String? = null,
  trailingTag: String? = null,
  onTrailingClick: (() -> Unit)? = null,
  onBackToHub: (() -> Unit)? = null,
) {
  val hudShadow = remember { Shadow(color = Color(0xE6020611), offset = Offset(0f, 1f), blurRadius = 6f) }
  Row(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
        .height(heightDp)
        .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
          isRightSide = isRightSide,
          primaryBorder = accent,
          secondaryBorder = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
        )
        .padding(horizontal = 4.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
  ) {
    val cleanSectionTitle =
      remember(sectionTitle, onBackToHub != null, trailingLabel != null) {
        when {
          onBackToHub != null && trailingLabel != null && sectionTitle.startsWith("RIFT FRAME •") ->
            "RIFT FRAME"
          sectionTitle == "HANGAR 1-5" -> "SHIPS 1-5"
          sectionTitle == "HANGAR 6-10" -> "SHIPS 6-10"
          else -> sectionTitle
        }
      }
    val titleFontSize =
      when {
        cleanSectionTitle.length > 15 -> 9.6.sp
        cleanSectionTitle.length > 11 -> 10.4.sp
        else -> 11.0.sp
      }

    if (onBackToHub != null) {
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
            .fillMaxHeight()
            .cockpitReticleSurface(
              accent = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
              isSelected = true,
              drawCornerTicks = false,
              featherAlpha = 0.25f,
            )
            .clickable { onBackToHub() }
            .padding(horizontal = 6.dp)
            .testTag("nexus_btn_back_to_hub"),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "< HUB",
          color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
          fontSize = 10.0.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          maxLines = 1,
          softWrap = false,
          style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
        )
      }
    }

    Text(
      text = cleanSectionTitle,
      color = Color.White,
      fontSize = titleFontSize,
      fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
      fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
      maxLines = 1,
      softWrap = false,
      style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).padding(horizontal = 6.dp),
    )

    if (trailingLabel != null && onTrailingClick != null) {
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
            .fillMaxHeight()
            .cockpitReticleSurface(
              accent = Color(0xFFFACC15),
              isSelected = true,
              drawCornerTicks = false,
              featherAlpha = 0.25f,
            )
            .clickable { onTrailingClick() }
            .padding(horizontal = 6.dp)
            .let { mod -> if (trailingTag != null) mod.testTag(trailingTag) else mod },
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
      ) {
        Text(
          text = trailingLabel,
          color = Color(0xFFFACC15),
          fontSize = 9.6.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          maxLines = 1,
          softWrap = false,
          style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Renders the open-space corner regions outside the curved Circular Overwatch aperture:
 * 1. Top-Left (between Port Wing & Overwatch): Borderless 2-line sensor readout + Up/Down sector chevrons.
 * 2. Top-Right: Blazing luminous cockpit reticle `RIFT IN >>` trigger + floating active ship telemetry.
 */
@Composable
private fun BoxScope.OverwatchOpenSpaceCornerOverlays(
  openCornerAnchorDp: Dp,
  openCornerMaxWidthDp: Dp,
  topLeftCornerMaxWidthDp: Dp = openCornerMaxWidthDp,
  @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") isTabletDeck: Boolean,
  isFocused: Boolean,
  overwatchInstances: List<OverwatchRiftInstance>,
  activeInstance: OverwatchRiftInstance,
  @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") favoriteOverwatchKey: String = "",
  overwatchZoom: Float,
  liveRemainingSec: Int,
  liveAvgResonance: Int,
  activeShipTitle: String,
  activeShipState: String,
  sideBayMode: RiftHubSideBayMode,
  overwatchPrompt: OverwatchCircularPrompt,
  @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") chargedShipId: Int,
  @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") renameDraft: String,
  @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") density: androidx.compose.ui.unit.Density,
  onSelectOverwatchKey: (String) -> Unit,
  @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") onToggleFavoriteOverwatchKey: (String) -> Unit = {},
  onResetOverwatchCamera: () -> Unit,
  onQuickZoneIntoOverwatch: (OverwatchRiftInstance) -> Unit,
  onToggleOverwatchInspectBay: () -> Unit = {},
  @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") onToggleAllModesBay: () -> Unit,
  @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") onBottomLeftBackOrCancel: () -> Unit,
  @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") onBottomRightConfirmOrCharge: () -> Unit,
) {
  val showTopLeftSectorSwitcher =
    overwatchPrompt == OverwatchCircularPrompt.None &&
      sideBayMode != RiftHubSideBayMode.RIFT_FRAME_BAY
  val hudShadow = remember { Shadow(color = Color(0xF0020611), offset = Offset(0f, 1f), blurRadius = 7f) }

  // 1. TOP-LEFT OPEN SPACE: Edge-free radial-feathered 2-line sensor readout + Prev/Next Chevrons
  if (showTopLeftSectorSwitcher) {
    val totalInstances = overwatchInstances.size.coerceAtLeast(1)
    val currentIdx =
      remember(overwatchInstances, activeInstance.key) {
        overwatchInstances.indexOfFirst { it.key == activeInstance.key }.let { if (it < 0) 0 else it }
      }
    val countdownText = remember(liveRemainingSec) { formatOverwatchTimerMmSs(liveRemainingSec) }
    val humanCount = activeInstance.pilotCount.coerceAtLeast(0)
    val modeHeaderLine = activeInstance.modeTitle.uppercase(Locale.US)
    val isInspectBayOpen = sideBayMode == RiftHubSideBayMode.OVERWATCH_INSPECT_BAY

    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.align(Alignment.TopStart)
          .zIndex(3f)
          .padding(start = openCornerAnchorDp, top = 6.dp)
          .widthIn(max = topLeftCornerMaxWidthDp),
      horizontalAlignment = Alignment.Start,
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
    ) {
      Column(
        modifier =
          Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
            .cockpitReticleSurface(
              accent = if (isInspectBayOpen) Color(0xFF00F5D4) else Color(0xFF38BDF8),
              isSelected = isInspectBayOpen,
              drawCornerTicks = isInspectBayOpen,
              featherAlpha = if (isInspectBayOpen) 0.72f else 0.58f,
            )
            .clickable { onToggleOverwatchInspectBay() }
            .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
            .testTag("nexus_overwatch_terminal_readout"),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
      ) {
        Row(
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = modeHeaderLine,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false),
            color = if (isInspectBayOpen) Color(0xFF00F5D4) else Color.White,
            fontSize = 10.2.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 1,
            softWrap = false,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
            style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
          )
          Text(
            text = if (isInspectBayOpen) "[<]" else "[>]",
            color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
            fontSize = 9.2.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 1,
            softWrap = false,
            style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
          )
        }

        Row(
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "$countdownText •",
            color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
            fontSize = 9.4.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 1,
            softWrap = false,
            style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
          )
          ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = 11.dp)
          Text(
            text = "${formatOverwatchResonance(liveAvgResonance)} •",
            color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
            fontSize = 9.4.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 1,
            softWrap = false,
            style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
          )
          Text(
            text = if (humanCount == 1) "1 PILOT" else "$humanCount PILOTS",
            color = if (humanCount > 0) Color(0xFF38BDF8) else Color(0xFF94A3B8),
            fontSize = 9.4.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 1,
            softWrap = false,
            style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
          )
          if (overwatchZoom > 1.03f) {
            Box(
              modifier =
                Modifier.clickable { onResetOverwatchCamera() }
                  .padding(horizontal = 3.dp, vertical = 1.dp)
                  .testTag("nexus_overwatch_zoom_reset"),
            ) {
              Text(
                text = "1x",
                color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
                fontSize = 9.2.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                maxLines = 1,
                softWrap = false,
                style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }

      Row(
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
      ) {
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
              .size(width = 48.dp, height = 48.dp)
              .clickable {
                val prevIdx = if (currentIdx <= 0) totalInstances - 1 else currentIdx - 1
                onSelectOverwatchKey(overwatchInstances[prevIdx].key)
              }
              .testTag("nexus_overwatch_prev"),
          contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
          Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size(width = 14.dp, height = 8.dp)) {
            val p =
              Path().apply {
                moveTo(0f, size.height)
                lineTo(size.width * 0.5f, 0f)
                lineTo(size.width, size.height)
              }
            drawPath(p, color = Color(0xFF00F5D4), style = Stroke(width = 2.0.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round))
          }
        }

        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
              .size(width = 48.dp, height = 48.dp)
              .clickable {
                val nextIdx = (currentIdx + 1) % totalInstances
                onSelectOverwatchKey(overwatchInstances[nextIdx].key)
              }
              .testTag("nexus_overwatch_next"),
          contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
          Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size(width = 14.dp, height = 8.dp)) {
            val p =
              Path().apply {
                moveTo(0f, 0f)
                lineTo(size.width * 0.5f, size.height)
                lineTo(size.width, 0f)
              }
            drawPath(p, color = Color(0xFF00F5D4), style = Stroke(width = 2.0.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round))
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 2. TOP-RIGHT OPEN SPACE: Blazing Luminous Cockpit Reticle RIFT IN >> + Borderless Floating Ship Telemetry
  val riftInGlow =
    remember(isFocused) {
      Shadow(
        color = if (isFocused) Color(0xFFFFD700) else Color(0xFF00F5D4),
        offset = Offset.Zero,
        blurRadius = 12f,
      )
    }
  Column(
    modifier =
      Modifier.align(Alignment.TopEnd)
        .zIndex(3f)
        .padding(end = openCornerAnchorDp, top = 6.dp)
        .widthIn(max = openCornerMaxWidthDp),
    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End,
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
  ) {
    Box(
      modifier =
        Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
          .height(48.dp)
          .drawBehind {
            val w = size.width
            val h = size.height
            if (w <= 8f || h <= 8f) return@drawBehind
            val centerPt = Offset(w * 0.5f, h * 0.5f)
            val glowR = maxOf(w * 0.64f, h * 0.85f)
            // Radial dark contrast + cyan/gold plasma core glow (zero closed box or chamfered dark slab)
            drawCircle(
              brush =
                Brush.radialGradient(
                  colorStops =
                    arrayOf(
                      0.00f to Color(0xA8020B1A),
                      0.55f to Color(0x4C041428),
                      1.00f to Color.Transparent,
                    ),
                  center = centerPt,
                  radius = glowR,
                ),
              radius = glowR,
              center = centerPt,
            )
            drawCircle(
              brush =
                Brush.radialGradient(
                  colorStops =
                    arrayOf(
                      0.00f to Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = if (isFocused) 0.34f else 0.24f),
                      0.50f to Color(0xFFFFD700).copy(alpha = if (isFocused) 0.16f else 0.10f),
                      1.00f to Color.Transparent,
                    ),
                  center = centerPt,
                  radius = glowR * 0.92f,
                ),
              radius = glowR * 0.92f,
              center = centerPt,
            )
            // Open 4-corner targeting reticle ticks
            val tick = 7.dp.toPx()
            val sw = (if (isFocused) 1.7.dp else 1.4.dp).toPx()
            val cyanTick = Color(0xFF00F5D4)
            val goldTick = Color(0xFFFFD700)
            drawLine(cyanTick, Offset(2f, tick), Offset(2f, 2f), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
            drawLine(cyanTick, Offset(2f, 2f), Offset(tick, 2f), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
            drawLine(goldTick, Offset(w - tick, 2f), Offset(w - 2f, 2f), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
            drawLine(goldTick, Offset(w - 2f, 2f), Offset(w - 2f, tick), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
            drawLine(goldTick, Offset(2f, h - tick), Offset(2f, h - 2f), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
            drawLine(goldTick, Offset(2f, h - 2f), Offset(tick, h - 2f), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
            drawLine(cyanTick, Offset(w - tick, h - 2f), Offset(w - 2f, h - 2f), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
            drawLine(cyanTick, Offset(w - 2f, h - tick), Offset(w - 2f, h - 2f), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
            // Tapered luminous bottom launch filament
            drawLine(
              brush =
                Brush.horizontalGradient(
                  colorStops =
                    arrayOf(
                      0.00f to Color.Transparent,
                      0.18f to Color(0xFF00F5D4),
                      0.50f to Color(0xFFFFD700),
                      0.82f to Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                      1.00f to Color.Transparent,
                    ),
                ),
              start = Offset(w * 0.06f, h - 2.dp.toPx()),
              end = Offset(w * 0.94f, h - 2.dp.toPx()),
              strokeWidth = 1.6.dp.toPx(),
              cap = StrokeCap.Round,
            )
          }
          .clickable { onQuickZoneIntoOverwatch(activeInstance) }
          .padding(horizontal = 14.dp)
          .testTag("nexus_overwatch_rift_in"),
      contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
      Text(
        text = "RIFT IN >>",
        color = Color.White,
        fontSize = 12.2.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        letterSpacing = 0.9.sp,
        maxLines = 1,
        style = TextStyle(shadow = riftInGlow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
      )
    }

    Box(
      modifier =
        Modifier.cockpitReticleSurface(
          accent = if (activeShipState == "CHARGED") Color(0xFF00F5D4) else Color(0xFFFACC15),
          isSelected = false,
          drawCornerTicks = false,
          featherAlpha = 0.44f,
        )
        .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
    ) {
      Text(
        text = "$activeShipTitle • $activeShipState",
        color = if (activeShipState == "CHARGED") Color(0xFF00F5D4) else Color(0xFFFACC15),
        fontSize = 9.0.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        style = TextStyle(shadow = hudShadow, platformStyle = PlatformTextStyle(includeFontPadding = false)),
      )
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Signature Rift Hub Centerpiece — Circular Overwatch Viewport:
 */
@Composable
private fun RoundRipplingOverwatchAperture(
  modifier: Modifier,
  isFocused: Boolean,
  isTabletDeck: Boolean = false,
  drawHeadlessSafeZoneFallback: Boolean,
  activeInstance: OverwatchRiftInstance,
  overwatchPrompt: OverwatchCircularPrompt = OverwatchCircularPrompt.None,
  chargedShipId: Int = 0,
  bestShipId: Int = 0,
  activeShipId: Int = 1,
  activeCustomSlot: CustomShipLoadoutSlot = CustomShipLoadoutSlot(),
  activeCustomSlotId: String = "Frame A",
  activeCustomSlotName: String = "",
  pointBudget: Int = 100,
  activeDraggedFrameItem: DraggedRiftFrameItem? = null,
  dragPointerRootOffset: Offset = Offset.Zero,
  frameRenameDraft: String = "",
  onFrameRenameDraftChange: (String) -> Unit = {},
  squadronTagRenameDraft: String = "",
  onSquadronTagRenameDraftChange: (String) -> Unit = {},
  onSaveSquadronTagRename: (String) -> Unit = {},
  currentUserId: String = "",
  callsign: String = "",
  syndicateTag: String = "",
  liveResonance: Int = 0,
  cloudLeaderboardEntries: List<LeaderboardEntry> = emptyList(),
  onlineHumanPilots: List<LivePilotState> = emptyList(),
  syndicateDirectory: List<SyndicateInfo> = emptyList(),
  blockedPilotUids: Set<String> = emptySet(),
  shipSpinDeg: Float = 0f,
  fluxOrbitRad: Float = 0f,
  renameDraft: String = "",
  onRenameDraftChange: (String) -> Unit = {},
  resolveShipResonance: (Int) -> Int = { 0 },
  onChargeShip: (Int) -> Unit = {},
  onCustomizeRiftFrame: () -> Unit = {},
  onSaveCustomSlot: (CustomShipLoadoutSlot) -> Unit = {},
  onOpenFrameRenamePrompt: () -> Unit = {},
  onSaveFrameSlotRename: (String) -> Unit = {},
  onUpdatePrimarySocketBounds: (Rect) -> Unit = {},
  onUpdateSecondarySocketBounds: (Rect) -> Unit = {},
  onDismissPrompt: () -> Unit = {},
  onSquadUpPilot: (SquadronOnlinePilotItem) -> Unit = {},
  onAddFriendPilot: (SquadronOnlinePilotItem) -> Unit = {},
  onToggleBlockPilot: (String, String) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  onReportPilot: (String, String) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  onConfirmActionPrompt: (OverwatchCircularPrompt.ActionConfirm) -> Unit = {},
  onExecuteInfoStageAction: (OverwatchCircularPrompt.InfoStageInspect) -> Unit = {},
  onSaveCallsignRename: (String) -> Unit = {},
  onOverwatchTransformGesture:
    (centroidRootX: Float, centroidRootY: Float, panDxPx: Float, panDyPx: Float, zoomChange: Float) -> Unit,
  onResetOverwatchCamera: () -> Unit,
  onApertureRootBoundsChanged: (cx: Float, cy: Float, radiusPx: Float) -> Unit,
) {
  val headless = remember { isHeadlessGlEnvironment() }
  val density = LocalDensity.current
  val ripplePhase =
    if (headless) {
      0.45f
    } else {
      val transition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "round_rippling_aperture")
      val p by
        transition.animateFloat(
          initialValue = 0f,
          targetValue = (2.0 * PI).toFloat(),
          animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(5200, easing = LinearEasing), RepeatMode.Restart),
          label = "round_ripple_rad",
        )
      p
    }

  val energyNorm = (activeInstance.combinedResonance / 1600f).coerceIn(0.24f, 1.0f)

  var lensBoxSize by remember { mutableStateOf(IntSize.Zero) }
  var gestureSurfaceRootOrigin by remember { mutableStateOf(Offset.Zero) }
  val lensRadiusFraction = 0.476f
  val gestureCircleDiameterDp =
    with(density) {
      val minDim = min(lensBoxSize.width, lensBoxSize.height).toFloat()
      val rPx = if (minDim > 8f) (minDim * lensRadiusFraction).coerceAtLeast(48f) else 132.dp.toPx()
      (rPx * 2f).toDp()
    }

  Box(
    modifier =
      modifier.onGloballyPositioned { coords ->
        lensBoxSize = coords.size
        val rootPos = coords.positionInRoot()
        val w = coords.size.width.toFloat()
        val h = coords.size.height.toFloat()
        if (w > 8f && h > 8f) {
          val cx = rootPos.x + w * 0.5f
          val cy = rootPos.y + h * 0.5f
          val radius = (min(w, h) * lensRadiusFraction).coerceAtLeast(48f)
          onApertureRootBoundsChanged(cx, cy, radius)
        }
      },
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
      Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        if (w <= 8f || h <= 8f) return@Canvas
        val cx = w * 0.5f
        val cy = h * 0.5f
        val center = Offset(cx, cy)
        val apertureR = (min(w, h) * lensRadiusFraction).coerceAtLeast(48f)

        // Headless JVM / Robolectric Orbital Overwatch Schematic Fallback
        if (drawHeadlessSafeZoneFallback) {
          drawCircle(color = Color(0xFF030711), radius = apertureR, center = center)
          val stormR = apertureR * 0.90f
          drawCircle(
            color = Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.52f),
            radius = stormR,
            center = center,
            style = Stroke(width = 2.dp.toPx()),
          )
          val safeR = stormR * 0.16f
          for (b in 0 until 8) {
            val ang = (b * PI * 0.25).toFloat()
            val innerPt = Offset(cx + cos(ang) * (safeR * 0.32f), cy + sin(ang) * (safeR * 0.32f))
            val outerPt = Offset(cx + cos(ang) * safeR, cy + sin(ang) * safeR)
            drawLine(
              brush =
                Brush.linearGradient(
                  listOf(Color(0xFFFFD700), Color(0xFF00F5D4)),
                  start = innerPt,
                  end = outerPt,
                ),
              start = innerPt,
              end = outerPt,
              strokeWidth = 1.6.dp.toPx(),
            )
          }
          drawCircle(color = Color(0xFF091528), radius = safeR * 0.42f, center = center)
          drawCircle(
            color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
            radius = safeR * 0.20f,
            center = center,
            style = Stroke(width = 1.3.dp.toPx()),
          )
        }

        // 0. Subtle Perimeter Radial Reticle Lines & Range Ring Inside the Overwatch Aperture (0.84r .. 0.985r)
        drawCircle(
          color = Color(0x1E00F5D4),
          radius = apertureR * 0.91f,
          center = center,
          style = Stroke(width = 0.75.dp.toPx()),
        )
        for (ret in 0 until 12) {
          val rad = ret * (PI.toFloat() / 6f)
          val isMajorReticle = ret % 3 == 0
          val rIn = if (isMajorReticle) apertureR * 0.845f else apertureR * 0.905f
          val rOut = apertureR * 0.982f
          drawLine(
            color = if (isMajorReticle) Color(0x3000F5D4) else Color(0x1E38BDF8),
            start = Offset(cx + cos(rad) * rIn, cy + sin(rad) * rIn),
            end = Offset(cx + cos(rad) * rOut, cy + sin(rad) * rOut),
            strokeWidth = if (isMajorReticle) 0.95.dp.toPx() else 0.7.dp.toPx(),
            cap = StrokeCap.Round,
          )
        }

        // 1. Translucent Optical HUD Visor Lens Collar (#38050D1C glass meniscus + calibrated 72-tick vernier ring)
        val outerCollarMidR = apertureR * 1.022f
        val outerCollarWidth = (apertureR * 0.036f).coerceAtLeast(3.8.dp.toPx())
        drawCircle(
          brush =
            Brush.verticalGradient(
              colors =
                listOf(
                  Color(0x46071428),
                  Color(0x38050D1C),
                  Color(0x2E040A16),
                  Color(0x38050D1C),
                  Color(0x46071428),
                ),
              startY = cy - apertureR * 1.044f,
              endY = cy + apertureR * 1.044f,
            ),
          radius = outerCollarMidR,
          center = center,
          style = Stroke(width = outerCollarWidth),
        )
        // Thin specular glass meniscus outer & inner lens rims
        drawCircle(
          brush =
            Brush.verticalGradient(
              listOf(
                Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.56f),
                Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.62f),
                Color(0xFF38BDF8).copy(alpha = 0.42f),
                Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.52f),
              ),
              startY = cy - apertureR * 1.042f,
              endY = cy + apertureR * 1.042f,
            ),
          radius = apertureR * 1.042f,
          center = center,
          style = Stroke(width = 1.15.dp.toPx()),
        )
        drawCircle(
          color = Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.36f),
          radius = apertureR * 1.003f,
          center = center,
          style = Stroke(width = 0.85.dp.toPx()),
        )

        // Calibrated 72-tick optical vernier ring around the glass collar
        for (tick in 0 until 72) {
          val rad = tick * (2f * PI.toFloat() / 72f)
          val isCardinal = tick % 18 == 0
          val isMajor = tick % 6 == 0
          val rIn = apertureR * (if (isCardinal) 1.004f else if (isMajor) 1.009f else 1.016f)
          val rOut = apertureR * (if (isCardinal) 1.042f else if (isMajor) 1.038f else 1.030f)
          val tickColor =
            when {
              isCardinal -> Color(0xFFFFD700).copy(alpha = 0.86f)
              isMajor -> Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.66f)
              else -> Color(0xFF38BDF8).copy(alpha = 0.34f)
            }
          drawLine(
            color = tickColor,
            start = Offset(cx + cos(rad) * rIn, cy + sin(rad) * rIn),
            end = Offset(cx + cos(rad) * rOut, cy + sin(rad) * rOut),
            strokeWidth = (if (isCardinal) 1.35.dp else if (isMajor) 0.95.dp else 0.65.dp).toPx(),
            cap = StrokeCap.Round,
          )
        }

        // 2. Four Translucent Diagonal Optical Lock Arcs (45, 135, 225, 315 deg) + Luminous Port/Starboard Optical Nodes
        val outerClampLipR = apertureR * 1.044f
        for (diag in intArrayOf(45, 135, 225, 315)) {
          drawArc(
            color = if (diag == 135 || diag == 315) Color(0xFFFFD700).copy(alpha = 0.86f) else Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.72f),
            startAngle = diag - 7.5f,
            sweepAngle = 15f,
            useCenter = false,
            topLeft = Offset(cx - outerClampLipR, cy - outerClampLipR),
            size = Size(outerClampLipR * 2f, outerClampLipR * 2f),
            style = Stroke(width = 1.35.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
          )
        }
        for (wingSide in intArrayOf(-1, 1)) {
          val nodeX = cx + wingSide * (apertureR * 1.034f)
          drawCircle(color = Color(0x4400F5D4), radius = 4.6.dp.toPx(), center = Offset(nodeX, cy))
          drawCircle(
            color = Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.90f),
            radius = 3.2.dp.toPx(),
            center = Offset(nodeX, cy),
            style = Stroke(width = 1.05.dp.toPx()),
          )
          drawCircle(color = Color.White, radius = 1.3.dp.toPx(), center = Offset(nodeX, cy))
        }

        // 3. Harmonic Polar Resonance Matrix (1.006r .. 1.030r) Reacting to Combined Sector Resonance
        val numBands = 2
        val numSegs = 44
        val segSweepDeg = 360f / numSegs.toFloat()
        val segGapDeg = 1.7f
        val lightDirRad = ripplePhase * 0.75f
        val secondaryLightRad = -ripplePhase * 0.5f + 2.1f
        for (band in 0 until numBands) {
          val rMid = apertureR * (1.028f - band * 0.015f)
          val bandW = (apertureR * 0.011f).coerceAtLeast(1.1f)
          val arcRect = Rect(cx - rMid, cy - rMid, cx + rMid, cy + rMid)
          for (seg in 0 until numSegs) {
            val segAngleRad = ((seg + 0.5f) / numSegs.toFloat()) * (2f * PI.toFloat())
            val inwardWave =
              0.5f + 0.5f * sin(band * 1.1f - ripplePhase * 3.0f + sin(segAngleRad * 3f) * 0.5f)
            val primaryLit = (0.5f + 0.5f * cos(segAngleRad - lightDirRad)).pow(2.0f)
            val goldLit = (0.5f + 0.5f * cos(segAngleRad - secondaryLightRad)).pow(2.4f)
            val alpha =
              ((0.15f + 0.50f * primaryLit + 0.34f * goldLit) * inwardWave * (0.58f + 0.42f * energyNorm))
                .coerceIn(0.06f, 0.86f)
            val col =
              when {
                goldLit > primaryLit * 1.06f -> Color(0xFFFFD700)
                band == 1 -> Color(0xFF00F5D4)
                else -> Color(0xFF38BDF8)
              }
            drawArc(
              color = col.copy(alpha = alpha),
              startAngle = seg * segSweepDeg + segGapDeg * 0.5f,
              sweepAngle = (segSweepDeg - segGapDeg).coerceAtLeast(1.3f),
              useCenter = false,
              topLeft = arcRect.topLeft,
              size = arcRect.size,
              style = Stroke(width = bandW, cap = StrokeCap.Butt),
            )
          }
        }

        // 4. Calibrated 72-Tick Radar Azimuth Dial (4 Solar-Gold Cardinals, 8 Electric-Cyan Bearings, 60 Vernier Ticks)
        for (t in 0 until 72) {
          val ang = (t * PI / 36.0).toFloat()
          val isCardinal = t % 18 == 0
          val isSubCardinal = t % 6 == 0
          val r0 =
            when {
              isCardinal -> apertureR * 0.956f
              isSubCardinal -> apertureR * 0.972f
              else -> apertureR * 0.985f
            }
          val r1 =
            when {
              isCardinal -> apertureR * 1.022f
              isSubCardinal -> apertureR * 1.012f
              else -> apertureR * 1.003f
            }
          val col =
            when {
              isCardinal -> Color(0xFFFFD700).copy(alpha = 0.95f)
              isSubCardinal -> Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = 0.76f)
              else -> Color(0xFF38BDF8).copy(alpha = 0.36f)
            }
          val sw =
            when {
              isCardinal -> 1.65.dp.toPx()
              isSubCardinal -> 1.15.dp.toPx()
              else -> 0.65.dp.toPx()
            }
          drawLine(
            color = col,
            start = Offset(cx + cos(ang) * r0, cy + sin(ang) * r0),
            end = Offset(cx + cos(ang) * r1, cy + sin(ang) * r1),
            strokeWidth = sw,
            cap = StrokeCap.Round,
          )
        }

        // 5. Rotating Anodized Inner Aperture Lip + Top-Left Optical Specular Meniscus Highlights
        rotate(degrees = (lightDirRad * 180f / PI.toFloat())) {
          drawCircle(
            brush =
              Brush.sweepGradient(
                0.00f to Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = if (isFocused) 0.98f else 0.88f),
                0.24f to Color(0xFF38BDF8).copy(alpha = 0.54f),
                0.50f to Color(0xFFFFD700).copy(alpha = 0.92f),
                0.76f to Color(0xFF091528).copy(alpha = 0.64f),
                1.00f to Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = if (isFocused) 0.98f else 0.88f),
                center = center,
              ),
            radius = apertureR,
            center = center,
            style = Stroke(width = if (isFocused) 2.25.dp.toPx() else 1.8.dp.toPx()),
          )
        }

        val meniscusShiftDeg = if (headless) 0f else sin(ripplePhase) * 5f
        val meniscusLightDeg = -134f + meniscusShiftDeg
        val dispersionR = apertureR * 0.975f
        drawArc(
          color = Color(0xFF00F5D4).copy(alpha = if (isFocused) 0.42f else 0.32f),
          startAngle = meniscusLightDeg - 50f,
          sweepAngle = 100f,
          useCenter = false,
          topLeft = Offset(cx - dispersionR, cy - dispersionR),
          size = Size(dispersionR * 2f, dispersionR * 2f),
          style = Stroke(width = 2.4.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
        )
        val specularR = apertureR * 0.989f
        drawArc(
          color = Color(0xFFF8FAFC).copy(alpha = if (isFocused) 0.92f else 0.80f),
          startAngle = meniscusLightDeg - 36f,
          sweepAngle = 72f,
          useCenter = false,
          topLeft = Offset(cx - specularR, cy - specularR),
          size = Size(specularR * 2f, specularR * 2f),
          style = Stroke(width = 1.4.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
        )
        drawArc(
          color = Color.White.copy(alpha = if (isFocused) 0.98f else 0.90f),
          startAngle = meniscusLightDeg - 10f,
          sweepAngle = 20f,
          useCenter = false,
          topLeft = Offset(cx - specularR, cy - specularR),
          size = Size(specularR * 2f, specularR * 2f),
          style = Stroke(width = 2.1.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
        )
        val causticOuterR = apertureR * 0.950f
        drawArc(
          color = Color(0xFFFFD700).copy(alpha = 0.28f + 0.16f * energyNorm),
          startAngle = meniscusLightDeg + 150f,
          sweepAngle = 60f,
          useCenter = false,
          topLeft = Offset(cx - causticOuterR, cy - causticOuterR),
          size = Size(causticOuterR * 2f, causticOuterR * 2f),
          style = Stroke(width = 1.25.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
        )
      }

      // Interactive Circular Overwatch Touch Surface + Confined Circular Glass Prompts
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.size(gestureCircleDiameterDp)
            .clip(CircleShape)
            .onGloballyPositioned { coords ->
              gestureSurfaceRootOrigin = coords.positionInRoot()
            }
            .pointerInput(activeInstance.key, overwatchPrompt) {
              if (overwatchPrompt == OverwatchCircularPrompt.None) {
                detectTapGestures(
                  onDoubleTap = { onResetOverwatchCamera() },
                )
              }
            }
            .pointerInput(activeInstance.key, overwatchPrompt) {
              if (overwatchPrompt == OverwatchCircularPrompt.None) {
                detectTransformGestures { centroid, pan, zoom, _ ->
                  onOverwatchTransformGesture(
                    gestureSurfaceRootOrigin.x + centroid.x,
                    gestureSurfaceRootOrigin.y + centroid.y,
                    pan.x,
                    pan.y,
                    zoom,
                  )
                }
              }
            }
            .testTag("nexus_overwatch_gesture_surface"),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
      ) {
        if (overwatchPrompt != OverwatchCircularPrompt.None) {
          OverwatchCircularGlassPromptOverlay(
            prompt = overwatchPrompt,
            isTabletDeck = isTabletDeck,
            chargedShipId = chargedShipId,
            bestShipId = bestShipId,
            activeShipId = activeShipId,
            activeCustomSlot = activeCustomSlot,
            activeCustomSlotId = activeCustomSlotId,
            activeCustomSlotName = activeCustomSlotName,
            pointBudget = pointBudget,
            activeDraggedFrameItem = activeDraggedFrameItem,
            dragPointerRootOffset = dragPointerRootOffset,
            frameRenameDraft = frameRenameDraft,
            onFrameRenameDraftChange = onFrameRenameDraftChange,
            squadronTagRenameDraft = squadronTagRenameDraft,
            onSquadronTagRenameDraftChange = onSquadronTagRenameDraftChange,
            onSaveSquadronTagRename = onSaveSquadronTagRename,
            currentUserId = currentUserId,
            callsign = callsign,
            syndicateTag = syndicateTag,
            liveResonance = liveResonance,
            cloudLeaderboardEntries = cloudLeaderboardEntries,
            onlineHumanPilots = onlineHumanPilots,
            syndicateDirectory = syndicateDirectory,
            blockedPilotUids = blockedPilotUids,
            shipSpinDeg = shipSpinDeg,
            fluxOrbitRad = fluxOrbitRad,
            renameDraft = renameDraft,
            onRenameDraftChange = onRenameDraftChange,
