      color = Color(0xFFFFD700), fontSize = (8.0f * textScale).sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, style = WingTelemetryTextStyle, maxLines = 1,
     )
    }
    Row(
     verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy((3.0f * textScale).dp),
     modifier = Modifier.clickable(enabled = !uiUnlocked) { onOpenProgression() }.testTag("hud_console_progression_link"),
    ) {
     Image(
      bitmap = resonanceIcon,
      contentDescription = "Resonance",
      filterQuality = FilterQuality.High,
      modifier = Modifier.size((10.5f * textScale).dp),
     )
     Text("${engine.liveResonance}", color = Color(0xFFFFD700), fontSize = (7.6f * textScale).sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, style = WingTelemetryTextStyle, maxLines = 1)
     Text("•", color = Color(0xFF64748B), fontSize = (7.0f * textScale).sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, style = WingTelemetryTextStyle, maxLines = 1)
     Image(
      bitmap = riftShardIcon,
      contentDescription = "Rift Shards",
      filterQuality = FilterQuality.High,
      modifier = Modifier.size((10.5f * textScale).dp),
     )
     Text(shardDisplay, color = Color(0xFFF0ABFC), fontSize = (7.4f * textScale).sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, style = WingTelemetryTextStyle, maxLines = 1)
     Box(modifier = Modifier.width((24f * textScale).dp).height((2.6f * textScale).dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(1.3.dp)).background(Color(0xFF142844))) {
      Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(conduitProgressFraction.coerceIn(0.08f, 1f)).height((2.6f * textScale).dp).background(Color(0xFF00F5D4), RoundedCornerShape(1.3.dp)))
     }
    }
   }
   val nexusBtnRec = remember(visualRev) { RiftVisualForgeState.getRecipe(ForgeElementTarget.HUD_NEXUS_BUTTON) }
   Box(
    modifier = Modifier
     .offset { IntOffset(RiftCalibrationState.nexusBtnOffset.x.roundToInt(), RiftCalibrationState.nexusBtnOffset.y.roundToInt()) }
     .graphicsLayer {
      val ns = nexusBtnRec.pixelScale.coerceIn(0.65f, 1.65f)
      scaleX = ns; scaleY = ns
     }
     .testTag("hud_btn_nexus"),
   ) {
    SwirlingRiftHudOrb(isStreaming = isNexusStreaming, onClick = onOpenNexus)
   }
  }
 }

 SubcomposeLayout(modifier = modifier) { constraints ->
  val unbounded = Constraints()
  val probeLeft = subcompose("probe_left") { LeftWingInner(false) }.first().measure(unbounded)
  val probeRight = subcompose("probe_right") { RightWingInner(false) }.first().measure(unbounded)
  val sharedWingW = max(probeLeft.width, probeRight.width)
  val sharedWingH = max(probeLeft.height, probeRight.height)
  val wingFixedConstraints = Constraints.fixed(sharedWingW, sharedWingH)

  val leftPlaceable = subcompose("left_wing") { LeftWingInner(true) }.first().measure(wingFixedConstraints)
  val radarPlaceable = subcompose("radar") {
   CircularRadarMinimap(engine, frameTick, rootScreenSize, isRadarExpanded, radarExpandScale, onToggleRadarExpand, uiUnlocked)
  }.first().measure(unbounded)
  val rightPlaceable = subcompose("right_wing") { RightWingInner(true) }.first().measure(wingFixedConstraints)

  val gapPx = consoleGap.roundToPx()
  val totalW = (leftPlaceable.width + gapPx + radarPlaceable.width + gapPx + rightPlaceable.width).coerceAtMost(constraints.maxWidth)
  val totalH = max(radarPlaceable.height, sharedWingH)

  layout(totalW, totalH) {
   val wingY = (totalH - sharedWingH) / 2
   val radarY = (totalH - radarPlaceable.height) / 2
   leftPlaceable.placeRelative(0, wingY, zIndex = 1f)
   val radarX = leftPlaceable.width + gapPx
   val rightX = radarX + radarPlaceable.width + gapPx
   rightPlaceable.placeRelative(rightX, wingY, zIndex = 1f)
   radarPlaceable.placeRelative(radarX, radarY, zIndex = if (isRadarExpanded) 30f else 2f)
  }
 }
}

@Composable
private fun CircularRadarMinimap(
 engine: RiftGameEngine,
 frameTick: Int,
 rootScreenSize: IntSize,
 isExpanded: Boolean,
 expandScale: Float,
 onToggleExpand: () -> Unit,
 uiUnlocked: Boolean = false,
) {
 var panOffsetX by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }
 var panOffsetY by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }
 LaunchedEffect(isExpanded) {
  if (!isExpanded) {
   panOffsetX = 0f
   panOffsetY = 0f
  }
 }
 val trianglePath = remember { Path() }
 var radarCenterOnScreen by remember { mutableStateOf(Offset(960f, 980f)) }

 val normX = if (rootScreenSize.width > 0) (radarCenterOnScreen.x / rootScreenSize.width.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f) else 0.5f
 val normY = if (rootScreenSize.height > 0) (radarCenterOnScreen.y / rootScreenSize.height.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f) else 1.0f
 val intelligentPivotX = when { normX < 0.28f -> 0.0f; normX > 0.72f -> 1.0f; else -> normX }
 val intelligentPivotY = when { normY > 0.65f -> 1.0f; normY < 0.35f -> 0.0f; else -> normY }

 var continuousFrameNanos by remember { mutableLongStateOf(0L) }
 LaunchedEffect(Unit) { while (true) { withFrameNanos { continuousFrameNanos = it } } }
 val innerClipPath = remember { Path() }
 val fluxAgslShader = remember {
  if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) {
   runCatching { RuntimeShader(MINIMAP_FLUX_PLASMA_AGSL) }.getOrNull()
  } else null
 }

 val highlightSharedFluxRing =
  engine.currentPracticeTutorialStep() == PracticeTutorialStep.FIRING_AND_SHARED_FLUX && !uiUnlocked
 val fluxHighlightPhaseRad = ((System.currentTimeMillis() % 6283L) / 1000f)

 Box(
  modifier = Modifier.zIndex(if (isExpanded || expandScale > 1.02f) 35f else 2f).size(132.dp)
   .onGloballyPositioned { coords ->
    val pos = coords.positionInRoot()
    radarCenterOnScreen = Offset(pos.x + coords.size.width * 0.5f, pos.y + coords.size.height * 0.5f)
   }
   .graphicsLayer {
    scaleX = expandScale; scaleY = expandScale
    transformOrigin = TransformOrigin(intelligentPivotX, intelligentPivotY)
   }
   .goldenRiftTutorialHighlight(
    active = highlightSharedFluxRing,
    phaseRad = fluxHighlightPhaseRad,
    isCircle = true,
   )
   .wysiwygUnlockOutline(enabled = uiUnlocked, isCircle = true)
   .then(
    if (!uiUnlocked) {
     Modifier.pointerInput(Unit) { detectTapGestures(onTap = { onToggleExpand() }) }
      .pointerInput(Unit) {
       detectDragGestures(
        onDragEnd = { panOffsetX = 0f; panOffsetY = 0f },
        onDragCancel = { panOffsetX = 0f; panOffsetY = 0f },
        onDrag = { change, dragAmount ->
         change.consume()
         panOffsetX = (panOffsetX + dragAmount.x).coerceIn(-24f, 24f)
         panOffsetY = (panOffsetY + dragAmount.y).coerceIn(-24f, 24f)
        },
       )
      }
    } else Modifier
   )
   .testTag("hud_circular_radar"),
 ) {
  Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
   val tickKeepAlive = frameTick.toLong() + continuousFrameNanos
   if (tickKeepAlive == Long.MIN_VALUE) return@Canvas
   val w = size.width; val h = size.height; val center = Offset(w * 0.5f, h * 0.5f)
   val outerBezelRadius = (min(w, h) * 0.5f - 1.5.dp.toPx()).coerceAtLeast(24f)
   val fluxRingRadius = (outerBezelRadius - 5.2.dp.toPx()).coerceAtLeast(20f)
   val playfieldRadius = (fluxRingRadius - 6.8.dp.toPx()).coerceAtLeast(14f)
   val maxBlipRadius = (playfieldRadius - 2.6.dp.toPx()).coerceAtLeast(8f)
   val radarScale = playfieldRadius / engine.arenaRadius.coerceAtLeast(1000f)

   fun clampToRadar(rawX: Float, rawY: Float): Offset {
    val dx = rawX - center.x; val dy = rawY - center.y; val dist = hypot(dx, dy)
    return if (dist <= maxBlipRadius || dist < 0.001f) Offset(rawX, rawY)
    else Offset(center.x + dx * (maxBlipRadius / dist), center.y + dy * (maxBlipRadius / dist))
   }
   fun worldToRadar(wx: Float, wy: Float): Offset = clampToRadar(
    center.x + panOffsetX + (wx - engine.arenaCenterX) * radarScale,
    center.y + panOffsetY + (wy - engine.arenaCenterY) * radarScale,
   )

   // Outer obsidian-glass bezel (eliminates bezel/tip clipping)
   drawCircle(Color(0xE8030812), outerBezelRadius, center)
   drawCircle(Color(0x4438BDF8), outerBezelRadius, center, style = Stroke(width = 1.0.dp.toPx()))

   // Inner 1:1 circular playfield scope
   drawCircle(if (isExpanded) Color(0xF5040B16) else Color(0xCC040B16), playfieldRadius, center)
   innerClipPath.reset()
   innerClipPath.addOval(Rect(center.x - playfieldRadius, center.y - playfieldRadius, center.x + playfieldRadius, center.y + playfieldRadius))

   val nowMs = System.currentTimeMillis()
   val pulsePhase = ((nowMs % 1200L) / 1200f)
   val goldPulse = 0.5f + 0.5f * sin(((nowMs % 640L) / 640f) * 6.28318f)
   val p = engine.localPlayer

   clipPath(innerClipPath) {
    val arenaCenterOnRadar = Offset(center.x + panOffsetX, center.y + panOffsetY)
    drawCircle(Color(0x2238BDF8), playfieldRadius * 0.55f, arenaCenterOnRadar, style = Stroke(width = 1.0f))
    drawLine(Color(0x1838BDF8), Offset(arenaCenterOnRadar.x - playfieldRadius, arenaCenterOnRadar.y), Offset(arenaCenterOnRadar.x + playfieldRadius, arenaCenterOnRadar.y), 1f)
    drawLine(Color(0x1838BDF8), Offset(arenaCenterOnRadar.x, arenaCenterOnRadar.y - playfieldRadius), Offset(arenaCenterOnRadar.x, arenaCenterOnRadar.y + playfieldRadius), 1f)

    if (engine.hasActiveSafeZone()) {
     val szCenter = Offset(
      center.x + panOffsetX + (4000f - engine.arenaCenterX) * radarScale,
      center.y + panOffsetY + (4000f - engine.arenaCenterY) * radarScale,
     )
     val szRadius = ((engine.safeZone.width() * 0.5f) * RiftCalibrationState.safeZoneScale * radarScale).coerceAtLeast(3.2f)
     drawCircle(Color(0x2600F5D4), szRadius, szCenter)
     drawCircle(Color(0xAA00F5D4), szRadius, szCenter, style = Stroke(width = 1.2f))
    }

    for (wall in engine.walls) {
     val wx = wall.x + wall.w * 0.5f
     val wy = wall.y + wall.h * 0.5f
     val wPt = Offset(
      center.x + panOffsetX + (wx - engine.arenaCenterX) * radarScale,
      center.y + panOffsetY + (wy - engine.arenaCenterY) * radarScale,
     )
     val halfSpan = max(wall.w, wall.h) * 0.5f * radarScale
     drawCircle(Color(0x66475569), halfSpan.coerceIn(1.2f, 4.5f), wPt)
    }

    for (g in engine.greens) drawCircle(Color(0xFF10B981).copy(alpha = 0.55f), 1.1f, worldToRadar(g.x, g.y))

    if (engine.isStasisBreachRulesActive()) {
     drawCircle(Color(0xFF38BDF8), 4.2f, worldToRadar(engine.westBrigReactorX, engine.westBrigReactorY), style = Stroke(1.3f))
     drawCircle(Color(0xFFF43F5E), 4.2f, worldToRadar(engine.eastBrigReactorX, engine.eastBrigReactorY), style = Stroke(1.3f))
    } else if (engine.isRiftControlRulesActive()) {
     val aCol = when (engine.riftAlphaLockedBy) { 0 -> Color(0xFF00F5D4); 1 -> Color(0xFFF43F5E); else -> Color(0xFF38BDF8) }
     val oCol = when (engine.riftOmegaLockedBy) { 0 -> Color(0xFF00F5D4); 1 -> Color(0xFFF43F5E); else -> Color(0xFF38BDF8) }
     drawCircle(aCol, 4.6f, worldToRadar(engine.riftAlphaX, engine.riftAlphaY), style = Stroke(1.5f))
     drawCircle(oCol, 4.6f, worldToRadar(engine.riftOmegaX, engine.riftOmegaY), style = Stroke(1.5f))
    }

    for (anom in engine.anomalies) {
     val aColor = when (anom.type) {
      AnomalyType.PLASMA_RIFT -> Color(0xFFEF4444)
      AnomalyType.REPULSOR_RIFT -> Color(0xFF7DD3FC)
      AnomalyType.GRAVITY_RIFT -> Color(0xFFA855F7)
      AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_A -> Color(0xFF2DD4BF)
      AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_B -> Color(0xFF38BDF8)
     }
     drawCircle(aColor.copy(alpha = 0.82f), 2.6f, worldToRadar(anom.x, anom.y))
    }

    for (bw in engine.brickWalls) {
     val aPt = worldToRadar(if (bw.w >= bw.h) bw.x else bw.x + bw.w * 0.5f, if (bw.w >= bw.h) bw.y + bw.h * 0.5f else bw.y)
     val bPt = worldToRadar(if (bw.w >= bw.h) bw.x + bw.w else bw.x + bw.w * 0.5f, if (bw.w >= bw.h) bw.y + bw.h * 0.5f else bw.y + bw.h)
     drawLine(Color(0xFF00F5D4), aPt, bPt, strokeWidth = 2.2f)
    }

    for (dc in engine.decoys) {
     val isFriendlyDecoy = dc.ownerId == p.id || (p.armadaName.isNotEmpty() && dc.armadaName == p.armadaName) || (p.syndicateTag != "GUEST" && dc.syndicateTag == p.syndicateTag)
     drawCircle(if (isFriendlyDecoy) Color(0xFF38BDF8) else Color(0xFFEF4444), 2.2f, worldToRadar(dc.x, dc.y))
    }

    if (engine.isFluxCoreRulesActive() && engine.fluxCoreCarrierEntityId.isEmpty()) {
     val orbPt = worldToRadar(engine.fluxCoreOrb.x, engine.fluxCoreOrb.y)
     val orbHaloR = 4.4f + 4.8f * goldPulse
     drawCircle(Color(0xFFFACC15).copy(alpha = (0.85f - 0.50f * goldPulse).coerceIn(0.25f, 0.90f)), orbHaloR, orbPt, style = Stroke(1.5f))
     drawCircle(Color(0xFFFFD700), 4.4f, orbPt)
     drawCircle(Color.White, 4.4f, orbPt, style = Stroke(1.1f))
    }

    val radarShips = if (engine.hasJoinedMatch) engine.ships else listOf(p)
    for (s in radarShips) {
     if (s.respawnTimer > 0f) continue
     val isFriendly = engine.areAllied(p, s)
     val isBallCarrier = engine.hasJoinedMatch && engine.isFluxCoreRulesActive() &&
      (s.id == engine.fluxCoreCarrierEntityId || (engine.fluxCoreOrb.carrierShipId != -1 && s.shipId == engine.fluxCoreOrb.carrierShipId))
     if (s.isCloaked && !isFriendly && !s.isLocalPlayer && !isBallCarrier) continue

     val pt = worldToRadar(s.x, s.y)
     val sx = pt.x; val sy = pt.y
     if (isBallCarrier) {
      // 2x pulsing Gold Flux Core carrier beacon
      val carrierHaloR = 6.2f + 5.8f * goldPulse
      drawCircle(Color(0xFFFACC15).copy(alpha = (0.92f - 0.52f * goldPulse).coerceIn(0.30f, 0.95f)), carrierHaloR, pt, style = Stroke(1.8f))
      drawCircle(lerp(Color(0xFFFFD700), Color(0xFFFACC15), goldPulse), 6.2f, pt)
      drawCircle(Color.White, 6.2f, pt, style = Stroke(1.25f))
      continue
     }

     if (!engine.isFluxCoreRulesActive() && s.bounty >= RiftGameEngine.HVT_BOUNTY_THRESHOLD) {
      val pingR = 3.2f + pulsePhase * 6.5f
      drawCircle(Color(0xFFFFD700).copy(alpha = (1f - pulsePhase).coerceIn(0.20f, 0.90f)), pingR, pt, style = Stroke(1.3f))
     }

     if (s.isLocalPlayer) {
      val r = 4.2f; val a = s.angle
      trianglePath.reset()
      trianglePath.moveTo(sx + cos(a) * r, sy + sin(a) * r)
      trianglePath.lineTo(sx + cos(a + 2.4f) * r * 0.85f, sy + sin(a + 2.4f) * r * 0.85f)
      trianglePath.lineTo(sx + cos(a - 2.4f) * r * 0.85f, sy + sin(a - 2.4f) * r * 0.85f)
      trianglePath.close()
      drawPath(trianglePath, if (s.isCloaked) Color(0xFFD8B4FE) else Color.White)
     } else {
      val isSpectatedTarget = engine.isActivelySpectatingTeammates() && s.id == engine.spectatingTargetShipId
      val dotFill = when { isSpectatedTarget -> Color(0xFF00F5D4); isFriendly -> Color(0xFF3B82F6); else -> Color(0xFFEF4444) }
      val dotRadius = when { isSpectatedTarget -> 4.0f; s.isHuman -> 3.0f; else -> 2.2f }
      drawCircle(dotFill, dotRadius, pt)
      if (s.isHuman || isSpectatedTarget) drawCircle(Color.White, dotRadius, pt, style = Stroke(if (isSpectatedTarget) 1.3f else 1.0f))
     }
    }
   }

   drawCircle(Color(0x6638BDF8), playfieldRadius, center, style = Stroke(width = 1.1.dp.toPx()))

   // 3D AGSL Swirling Plasma Flux Ring wrapping the Circular Minimap
   val fluxPct = (p.flux / p.maxFlux.coerceAtLeast(1f)).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
   val critFlash = if (fluxPct < 0.20f || p.isIdleDraining) 0.38f + 0.62f * (0.5f + 0.5f * sin((nowMs % 320L) / 320f * 6.28318f)) else 1.0f
   val ringPrimary = when {
    p.isIdleDraining || fluxPct < 0.20f -> Color(0xFFEF4444).copy(alpha = critFlash)
    fluxPct >= 0.70f -> Color(0xFF00F5D4)
    fluxPct >= 0.35f -> Color(0xFF38BDF8)
    else -> Color(0xFFF59E0B)
   }
   val ringSecondary = when {
    p.isIdleDraining || fluxPct < 0.20f -> Color(0xFFF97316).copy(alpha = critFlash)
    fluxPct >= 0.70f -> Color(0xFF38BDF8)
    fluxPct >= 0.35f -> Color(0xFF10B981)
    else -> Color(0xFFEF4444)
   }

   val trackStrokeW = 5.0.dp.toPx()
   val arcStrokeW = 4.6.dp.toPx()
   val arcTopLeft = Offset(center.x - fluxRingRadius, center.y - fluxRingRadius)
   val arcSize = Size(fluxRingRadius * 2f, fluxRingRadius * 2f)
   drawCircle(Color(0xBF071120), fluxRingRadius, center, style = Stroke(width = trackStrokeW))
   for (tick in 0 until 12) {
    val tickRad = Math.toRadians(-90.0 + tick * 30.0)
    val rIn = fluxRingRadius - trackStrokeW * 0.48f; val rOut = fluxRingRadius + trackStrokeW * 0.48f
    drawLine(Color(0x5538BDF8), Offset(center.x + rIn * cos(tickRad).toFloat(), center.y + rIn * sin(tickRad).toFloat()), Offset(center.x + rOut * cos(tickRad).toFloat(), center.y + rOut * sin(tickRad).toFloat()), 0.9.dp.toPx())
   }

   if (fluxPct > 0.005f) {
    val sweepDeg = 360f * fluxPct
    drawArc(ringPrimary.copy(alpha = 0.24f), -90f, sweepDeg, false, arcTopLeft, arcSize, style = Stroke(width = arcStrokeW * 1.75f, cap = StrokeCap.Round))
    var drewAgslRing = false
    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33 && fluxAgslShader != null) {
     val timeSec = ((nowMs % 60000L) / 1000f)
     drewAgslRing = runCatching {
      fluxAgslShader.setFloatUniform("uRes", w, h)
      fluxAgslShader.setFloatUniform("uTime", timeSec)
      fluxAgslShader.setFloatUniform("uSweepFrac", fluxPct.coerceIn(0f, 1f))
      fluxAgslShader.setFloatUniform("uRIn", fluxRingRadius - arcStrokeW * 0.56f)
      fluxAgslShader.setFloatUniform("uROut", fluxRingRadius + arcStrokeW * 0.56f)
      fluxAgslShader.setFloatUniform("uColA", ringSecondary.red, ringSecondary.green, ringSecondary.blue)
      fluxAgslShader.setFloatUniform("uColB", ringPrimary.red, ringPrimary.green, ringPrimary.blue)
      drawRect(brush = ShaderBrush(fluxAgslShader), topLeft = Offset.Zero, size = Size(w, h), alpha = critFlash)
      true
     }.getOrDefault(false)
    }
    if (!drewAgslRing) {
     drawArc(ringSecondary, -90f, sweepDeg, false, arcTopLeft, arcSize, style = Stroke(width = arcStrokeW, cap = StrokeCap.Round))
     drawArc(ringPrimary, -90f, sweepDeg, false, arcTopLeft, arcSize, style = Stroke(width = arcStrokeW * 0.58f, cap = StrokeCap.Round))
    }

    val tipRad = Math.toRadians(-90.0 + sweepDeg.toDouble())
    val tipCenter = Offset(center.x + fluxRingRadius * cos(tipRad).toFloat(), center.y + fluxRingRadius * sin(tipRad).toFloat())
    val tipSpinDeg = ((nowMs % 1800L) / 1800f) * 360f
    val tipPulse = 0.90f + 0.14f * sin((nowMs % 900L) / 900f * 6.283185f)
    val symR = 4.8.dp.toPx() * tipPulse
    drawCircle(ringPrimary.copy(alpha = 0.34f), symR * 1.32f, tipCenter)
    drawCircle(Color(0xF0050E1D), symR * 0.96f, tipCenter)
    drawCircle(ringSecondary.copy(alpha = 0.72f), symR * 0.94f, tipCenter, style = Stroke(0.85.dp.toPx()))
    val outerArcR = symR * 0.82f
    val innerArcR = symR * 0.56f
    for (i in 0 until 3) {
     val baseDeg = tipSpinDeg + i * 120f
     drawArc(
      color = ringSecondary,
      startAngle = baseDeg,
      sweepAngle = 82f,
      useCenter = false,
      topLeft = Offset(tipCenter.x - outerArcR, tipCenter.y - outerArcR),
      size = Size(outerArcR * 2f, outerArcR * 2f),
      style = Stroke(width = 1.25.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
     )
     drawArc(
      color = ringPrimary,
      startAngle = baseDeg + 8f,
      sweepAngle = 68f,
      useCenter = false,
      topLeft = Offset(tipCenter.x - outerArcR, tipCenter.y - outerArcR),
      size = Size(outerArcR * 2f, outerArcR * 2f),
      style = Stroke(width = 0.85.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
     )
     drawArc(
      color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.88f),
      startAngle = -tipSpinDeg * 0.85f + i * 120f + 22f,
      sweepAngle = 54f,
      useCenter = false,
      topLeft = Offset(tipCenter.x - innerArcR, tipCenter.y - innerArcR),
      size = Size(innerArcR * 2f, innerArcR * 2f),
      style = Stroke(width = 0.75.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
     )
    }
    drawCircle(ringPrimary, 1.85.dp.toPx(), tipCenter)
    drawCircle(Color.White, 1.15.dp.toPx(), tipCenter)
   }
  }

  val playerFluxPct = (engine.localPlayer.flux / engine.localPlayer.maxFlux.coerceAtLeast(1f)).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
  val badgeColor = when {
   engine.localPlayer.isIdleDraining || playerFluxPct < 0.20f -> Color(0xFFEF4444)
   playerFluxPct >= 0.70f -> Color(0xFF00F5D4)
   playerFluxPct >= 0.35f -> Color(0xFF38BDF8)
   else -> Color(0xFFF59E0B)
  }
  Box(
   modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomCenter).padding(bottom = 1.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
    .background(Color(0xF2040B16)).border(1.dp, badgeColor.copy(alpha = 0.88f), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
    .padding(horizontal = 5.dp, vertical = 1.dp),
   contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
   Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.5.dp)) {
    FluxEmblem(sizeDp = 9.5.dp)
    Text("${engine.localPlayer.flux.roundToInt()}", color = badgeColor, fontSize = 7.0.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, style = CompactCircleTextStyle, maxLines = 1)
   }
  }
 }
}

@Composable
private fun UnifiedThreeRingCockpitButton(
 title: String,
 sub: String,
 strokeColor: Color,
 fillColor: Color,
 subColor: Color,
 borderWeight: Float = 1.0f,
 sizeDp: Dp = 50.dp,
 modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
 Box(modifier = modifier.size(sizeDp), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
  Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
   val cx = size.width * 0.5f; val cy = size.height * 0.5f; val r = size.minDimension * 0.47f
   drawCircle(Color(0xEB070F1E), r * 1.05f, Offset(cx, cy))
   drawCircle(strokeColor, r, Offset(cx, cy), style = Stroke(width = (2.0f * borderWeight).dp.toPx()))
   for (tick in 0 until 4) {
    val a = tick * (Math.PI.toFloat() * 0.5f)
    drawLine(strokeColor, Offset(cx + cos(a) * (r * 0.88f), cy + sin(a) * (r * 0.88f)), Offset(cx + cos(a) * (r * 1.03f), cy + sin(a) * (r * 1.03f)), 1.3.dp.toPx(), StrokeCap.Round)
   }
   drawCircle(fillColor, r * 0.86f, Offset(cx, cy))
   drawCircle(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.55f), r * 0.82f, Offset(cx, cy), style = Stroke(width = 1.0.dp.toPx()))
   val specR = r * 0.74f
   drawArc(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.45f), 205f, 130f, false, Offset(cx - specR, cy - specR), Size(specR * 2f, specR * 2f), style = Stroke(width = 1.4.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round))
  }
  Text(title, color = Color.White, fontSize = 8.0.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, style = CompactCircleTextStyle, maxLines = 1, modifier = Modifier.offset(y = (-6).dp))
  Box(
   modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomCenter).offset(y = (-2).dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(5.dp))
    .background(Color(0xF0040A16)).border(1.dp, strokeColor, RoundedCornerShape(5.dp)).padding(horizontal = 5.dp, vertical = 1.dp),
   contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) { Text(sub, color = subColor, fontSize = 6.8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, style = CompactCircleTextStyle, maxLines = 1) }
 }
}

@Composable
private fun KillFeedRow(entry: KillFeedEntry, alpha: Float) {
 val cleanKillerTag = entry.killerTag.trim().uppercase(Locale.US).takeIf {
  it.isNotEmpty() && it !in RiftGameEngine.LEGACY_FOUNDRY_TAGS && it !in setOf("GUEST", "FREE", "UNAFFILIATED", "NONE", "SOLO")
 } ?: ""
 val cleanVictimTag = entry.victimTag.trim().uppercase(Locale.US).takeIf {
  it.isNotEmpty() && it !in RiftGameEngine.LEGACY_FOUNDRY_TAGS && it !in setOf("GUEST", "FREE", "UNAFFILIATED", "NONE", "SOLO")
 } ?: ""
 val killerDisplay = if (cleanKillerTag.isNotEmpty()) "[$cleanKillerTag] ${entry.killerName}" else entry.killerName
 val victimDisplay = if (cleanVictimTag.isNotEmpty()) "[$cleanVictimTag] ${entry.victimName}" else entry.victimName
 val isHighBountyShutdown = entry.victimBounty > 1000
 val rowDropShadow = if (isHighBountyShutdown) Shadow(Color(0xFFF59E0B).copy(alpha = alpha), Offset(0f, 1f), 8f) else Shadow(Color(0xF2000000).copy(alpha = alpha), Offset(0f, 1.5f), 3.5f)
 val rowTextStyle = TextStyle(lineHeight = 11.5.sp, shadow = rowDropShadow)
 val killerColor = (when { isHighBountyShutdown -> Color(0xFFFEF08A); entry.killerIsLocal -> Color(0xFF38BDF8); entry.killerIsAllied -> Color(0xFF60A5FA); else -> Color(0xFFF87171) }).copy(alpha = alpha)
 val victimColor = (when { isHighBountyShutdown -> Color(0xFFF59E0B); entry.victimIsLocal -> Color(0xFF38BDF8); entry.victimIsAllied -> Color(0xFF60A5FA); else -> Color(0xFFF87171) }).copy(alpha = alpha)
 val bountyColor = (when { isHighBountyShutdown -> Color(0xFFF59E0B); entry.wasHvt -> Color(0xFFFFD700); else -> Color(0xFFFACC15) }).copy(alpha = alpha)

 Row(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = 1.dp, bottom = 4.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)) {
  Text(killerDisplay, color = killerColor, fontSize = 7.2.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, style = rowTextStyle, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false))
  Text(">>", color = (if (isHighBountyShutdown) Color(0xFFF59E0B) else Color(0xFFCBD5E1)).copy(alpha = 0.85f * alpha), fontSize = 6.8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, style = rowTextStyle)
  Text(victimDisplay, color = victimColor, fontSize = 7.6.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, style = rowTextStyle, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false))
  val feedResonanceBmp = remember(RiftVisualForgeState.visualRevision) { RiftSpriteBaker.resonanceIconBitmap.asImageBitmap() }
  Image(
   bitmap = feedResonanceBmp,
   contentDescription = "Resonance",
   filterQuality = FilterQuality.High,
   modifier = Modifier.size(9.5.dp).graphicsLayer { this.alpha = alpha },
  )
  Text("${entry.victimBounty}", color = bountyColor, fontSize = 7.6.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, style = rowTextStyle, maxLines = 1)
 }
}

data class PermanentUpgradeSlot(
 val iconType: Int,
 val label: String,
 val valueText: String,
 val isActive: Boolean,
 val accentColor: Color,
)

@Composable
private fun ActivePowerupsDock(
 player: ShipEntity,
 buffVersion: Int,
 frameTick: Int,
 textScale: Float,
 uiUnlocked: Boolean,
 buffRec: VisualElementRecipe = RiftVisualForgeState.getRecipe(ForgeElementTarget.HUD_BUFF_STRIP),
) {
 val unusedTick = frameTick + buffVersion
 val pctPerStack = RiftCalibrationState.overchargeSurgePctPerStack
 val spdPct = (player.speedOverchargeStacks * pctPerStack * 100f).roundToInt()
 val thrPct = (player.thrustOverchargeStacks * pctPerStack * 100f).roundToInt()
 val turnPct = player.turnOverchargeStacks * 12
 val maxFluxPct = player.maxFluxOverchargeStacks * 10
 val rchPct = (player.rechargeOverchargeStacks * pctPerStack * 100f).roundToInt()
 val dockBg = if (buffRec.isFactoryDefault) Color(0xD9080E18) else Color(buffRec.primaryColorInt).copy(alpha = buffRec.surfaceOpacity.coerceIn(0.25f, 0.98f))
 val dockBorder = if (buffRec.isFactoryDefault) Color(0x4D38BDF8) else Color(buffRec.trimColorInt)

 val activeSpecialReg =
  when {
   player.tractorBeamActive -> RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["TRACTOR_BEAM"]
   player.lanceBeamActive -> RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["LANCE_BEAM"]
   player.specialWeaponCharges > 0 && player.specialWeaponType != "NONE" -> RiftCodex.getBuffRegistryEntry(player.specialWeaponType)
   else -> null
  }
 val slots = buildList {
  if (activeSpecialReg != null) {
   val specVal =
    when {
     player.tractorBeamActive || player.lanceBeamActive -> "ON"
     player.specialWeaponStacks > 1 -> "x${player.specialWeaponStacks}"
     else -> "[${player.specialWeaponCharges}]"
    }
   add(
    PermanentUpgradeSlot(
     iconType = activeSpecialReg.buffTypeIndex.coerceAtLeast(0),
     label = activeSpecialReg.shortLabel.take(5),
     valueText = specVal,
     isActive = true,
     accentColor = Color(activeSpecialReg.strokeColorInt),
    )
   )
  }
  add(PermanentUpgradeSlot(9, "BNC", when { player.hasBouncingBulletsUpgrade -> "ON"; player.spec.primaryBounces > 0 -> "NAT"; else -> "OFF" }, player.hasBouncingBulletsUpgrade || player.spec.primaryBounces > 0, Color(0xFFA855F7)))
  add(PermanentUpgradeSlot(-10, "SPD", "+$spdPct%", player.speedOverchargeStacks > 0, Color(0xFF38BDF8)))
  add(PermanentUpgradeSlot(-11, "THR", "+$thrPct%", player.thrustOverchargeStacks > 0, Color(0xFFF59E0B)))
  add(PermanentUpgradeSlot(-13, "TURN", "+$turnPct%", player.turnOverchargeStacks > 0, Color(0xFFEC4899)))
  add(PermanentUpgradeSlot(-14, "MAX", "+$maxFluxPct%", player.maxFluxOverchargeStacks > 0, Color(0xFF00F5D4)))
  add(PermanentUpgradeSlot(-12, "RCH", "+$rchPct%", player.rechargeOverchargeStacks > 0, Color(0xFF10B981)))
 }

 Row(
  modifier = Modifier.wrapContentSize().clip(RoundedCornerShape(9.dp)).background(dockBg)
   .border((0.85f * buffRec.borderWeight).dp, dockBorder, RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
   .wysiwygUnlockOutline(enabled = uiUnlocked, cornerRadius = 9.dp)
   .padding(horizontal = (6.5f * textScale).dp, vertical = (2.8f * textScale).dp),
  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy((5.5f * textScale).dp),
 ) {
  slots.forEach { slot -> PermanentUpgradeBadge(slot = slot, textScale = textScale) }
 }
}

@Composable
private fun PermanentUpgradeBadge(slot: PermanentUpgradeSlot, textScale: Float) {
 val bmp = remember(slot.iconType) { RiftSpriteBaker.getBuffIconBitmap(slot.iconType).asImageBitmap() }
 val labelColor = if (slot.isActive) slot.accentColor else Color(0xFF64748B)
 Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy((2.5f * textScale).dp)) {
  Box(modifier = Modifier.size((14.0f * textScale).dp), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
   Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
    val strokeWidthPx = (if (slot.isActive) 1.1.dp else 0.7.dp).toPx()
    val radius = (size.minDimension - strokeWidthPx) / 2f
    if (slot.isActive) {
     drawCircle(slot.accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.25f), radius, style = Stroke(strokeWidthPx * 1.4f))
     drawCircle(slot.accentColor, radius, style = Stroke(strokeWidthPx))
    } else drawCircle(Color(0x3D475569), radius, style = Stroke(strokeWidthPx))
   }
   if (slot.iconType == -14) FluxEmblem(sizeDp = (9.5f * textScale).dp)
   else {
    Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size((10.0f * textScale).dp)) {
     drawImage(bmp, IntOffset.Zero, IntSize(size.width.toInt(), size.height.toInt()), alpha = if (slot.isActive) 1.0f else 0.28f)
    }
   }
  }
  Text("${slot.label} ${slot.valueText}", color = labelColor, fontSize = (6.8f * textScale).sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, style = WingTelemetryTextStyle, maxLines = 1)
 }
}

private fun cleanCodexShipName(rawName: String): String =
  rawName.replace(Regex("^#?[0-9]+[-\\s]*"), "").trim().uppercase(Locale.US)

private fun cleanDisplayShipTitle(shipId: Int, rawName: String): String =
  if (shipId == 10) "RIFT FRAME" else cleanCodexShipName(rawName)

internal fun copyTelemetryTextToClipboard(
  context: Context,
  formatLabel: String,
  payload: String,
): String {
  return runCatching {
      val cm = context.getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as? ClipboardManager
      cm?.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("Rift Telemetry $formatLabel", payload))
      "COPIED $formatLabel TELEMETRY TO CLIPBOARD"
    }
    .getOrDefault("READY // $formatLabel TELEMETRY GENERATED")
}

internal fun saveOrOpenTelemetryHtmlFile(
  context: Context,
  callsign: String,
  htmlPayload: String,
): String {
  val cleanCallsign =
    callsign
      .trim()
      .uppercase(Locale.US)
      .replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_\\-]"), "")
      .ifEmpty { "PILOT" }
  val fileName = "rift_telemetry_${cleanCallsign}.html"

  if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
    val resolver = context.contentResolver
    val values =
      ContentValues().apply {
        put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME, fileName)
        put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.MIME_TYPE, "text/html")
        put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH, Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS)
        put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.IS_PENDING, 1)
      }
    val insertedUri =
      runCatching { resolver.insert(MediaStore.Downloads.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, values) }.getOrNull()
    if (insertedUri != null) {
      val wroteOk =
        runCatching {
            resolver.openOutputStream(insertedUri)?.use { out ->
              out.write(htmlPayload.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
              out.flush()
            }
            val publishValues = ContentValues().apply { put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.IS_PENDING, 0) }
            resolver.update(insertedUri, publishValues, null, null)
            true
          }
          .getOrDefault(false)
      if (wroteOk) {
        val openedInViewer =
          runCatching {
              val viewIntent =
                Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW).apply {
                  setDataAndType(insertedUri, "text/html")
                  clipData = ClipData.newRawUri("Rift Telemetry HTML", insertedUri)
                  addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
                }
              context.startActivity(viewIntent)
              true
            }
            .getOrDefault(false)
        if (!openedInViewer) {
          runCatching {
            val sendFileIntent =
              Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply {
                type = "text/html"
                putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, insertedUri)
                clipData = ClipData.newRawUri("Rift Telemetry HTML", insertedUri)
                addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
              }
            val chooser =
              Intent.createChooser(sendFileIntent, "Open or Share $fileName")
                .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
            context.startActivity(chooser)
          }
        }
        return "SAVED $fileName TO DOWNLOADS"
      }
    }
  }

  return runCatching {
      val localFile = File(context.cacheDir, fileName)
      localFile.writeText(htmlPayload, Charsets.UTF_8)
      "SAVED $fileName // VIEWING LIVE BELOW"
    }
    .getOrDefault("VIEWING LIVE .HTML SHEET BELOW")
}

        ) {
          AndroidView(

              WebView(ctx).apply {
                setBackgroundColor(android.graphics.Color.parseColor("#02050B"))

                loadDataWithBaseURL(

  wingStackGap: Dp,
  callsign: String,
  syndicateTag: String,
  liveResonance: Int,
  peakResonance: Int,
  localPrefs: LocalPilotPrefs,
  currentUserId: String,
  dossierRefreshNonce: Int = 0,
  onBackToHub: () -> Unit,
  onOpenRenamePrompt: () -> Unit,
  onOpenResetPrompt: () -> Unit,
  onOpenSwitchAccountPrompt: () -> Unit,
  onOpenSurvivalSpreadsheet: () -> Unit,
) {
  val uidOrNull = currentUserId.ifBlank { null }
  val effectivePeakResonance = max(liveResonance, peakResonance)
  val conduitTier =
    remember(liveResonance) {
      RiftProgressionCatalog.getConduitTierForResonance(liveResonance)
    }
  val conduitProgress =
    remember(liveResonance) {
      RiftProgressionCatalog.getConduitProgressFraction(liveResonance)
    }
  val nextTier =
    remember(liveResonance) {
      RiftProgressionCatalog.getNextConduitTierThreshold(liveResonance)
    }
  val startingResonance =
    remember(liveResonance) {
      RiftProgressionCatalog.computeStartingBountyForResonance(liveResonance)
    }
  val tierAccent = Color(conduitTier.accentColorHex)
  val shipResonanceRows =
    remember(currentUserId, liveResonance, dossierRefreshNonce) {
      RiftCodex.getAllTenShips().map { ship ->
        Triple(
          ship.id,
          cleanDisplayShipTitle(ship.id, ship.name),
          localPrefs.getShipResonance(ship.id, uidOrNull),
        )
      }
    }
  val maxShipResonance =
    remember(shipResonanceRows) {
      (shipResonanceRows.maxOfOrNull { it.third } ?: 0).coerceAtLeast(100)
    }
  val callsignChangeCount =
    remember(currentUserId, liveResonance, dossierRefreshNonce, callsign) {
      localPrefs.getCallsignChangeCount(uidOrNull)
    }
  val isFirstRenameFree = callsignChangeCount == 0

  Column(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().testTag("dossier_left_identity_bay"),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(wingStackGap),
  ) {
    HubDigitizedReturnBar(
      heightDp = headerHeight,
      isRightSide = false,
      isTabletDeck = isTabletDeck,
      sectionTitle = "PILOT DOSSIER",
      accent = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
      onBackToHub = onBackToHub,
    )

    Column(
      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth().padding(end = 18.dp).verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(wingStackGap),
    ) {
      // Pilot Identity + Conduit Rank Tier & Live Resonance Header Pod
      Column(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
              isRightSide = false,
              primaryBorder = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
              secondaryBorder = Color(0xFFFFD700),
            )
            .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
      ) {
        Row(
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
          Text(
            text = if (syndicateTag.isNotBlank()) "[$syndicateTag] $callsign" else callsign,
            color = Color.White,
            fontSize = if (isTabletDeck) 10.6.sp else 9.4.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).padding(end = 6.dp),
          )
          Box(
            modifier =
              Modifier.cockpitReticleSurface(
                  accent = tierAccent,
                  isSelected = true,
                  drawCornerTicks = false,
                  featherAlpha = 0.28f,
                )
                .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                .testTag("dossier_conduit_tier_badge"),
          ) {
            Text(
              text = conduitTier.title,
              color = tierAccent,
              fontSize = 8.0.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              maxLines = 1,
            )
          }
        }

        // Conduit Rank Tier Laser Filament Progress Bar + Next-Tier Threshold Readout
        Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)) {
          Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(7.dp)) {
            val cy = size.height * 0.5f
            val fillFrac = conduitProgress.coerceIn(0.05f, 1f)
            val fillX = (size.width * fillFrac).coerceIn(4f, size.width)
            drawLine(
              color = tierAccent.copy(alpha = 0.20f),
              start = Offset(0f, cy),
              end = Offset(size.width, cy),
              strokeWidth = 1.6.dp.toPx(),
              cap = StrokeCap.Round,
            )
            drawLine(
              brush = Brush.horizontalGradient(listOf(tierAccent, Color(0xFFFFD700))),
              start = Offset(0f, cy),
              end = Offset(fillX, cy),
              strokeWidth = 2.8.dp.toPx(),
              cap = StrokeCap.Round,
            )
            drawCircle(
              color = Color.White,
              radius = 2.4.dp.toPx(),
              center = Offset(fillX, cy),
            )
          }
          Text(
            text =
              if (liveResonance >= 1500) {
                "APEX ARCHON • MAX TIER"
              } else {
                "${String.format(Locale.US, "%,d", liveResonance)} / ${String.format(Locale.US, "%,d", nextTier.first)} TO ${nextTier.second}"
              },
            color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
            fontSize = 7.2.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          )
        }

        Row(
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
        ) {
          ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = 12.dp)
          Text(
            text =
              "LIVE ${String.format(Locale.US, "%,d", liveResonance)} • PEAK ${String.format(Locale.US, "%,d", effectivePeakResonance)} • START $startingResonance",
            color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
            fontSize = 7.8.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          )
        }
      }

      // 10-Ship Resonance Breakdown across all 10 numberless hulls (including Rift Frame)
      Column(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
              isRightSide = false,
              primaryBorder = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
              secondaryBorder = Color(0xFF091528),
            )
            .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 7.dp)
            .testTag("dossier_ship_resonance_breakdown"),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
      ) {
        Row(
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
        ) {
          ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = 10.dp)
          Text(
            text = "10-SHIP RESONANCE BREAKDOWN",
            color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
            fontSize = 7.6.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          )
        }
        shipResonanceRows.forEach { (shipId, hullTitle, shipRes) ->
          val barCol =
            when {
              shipId == 10 -> Color(0xFFFFD700)
              shipRes > 0 -> Color(0xFF00F5D4)
              else -> Color(0xFF475569)
            }
          val frac =
            if (shipRes <= 0) 0.03f
            else (shipRes.toFloat() / maxShipResonance.toFloat()).coerceIn(0.05f, 1f)
          Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
            Row(
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            ) {
              Text(
                text = hullTitle,
                color = if (shipId == 10) Color(0xFFFFD700) else Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
                fontSize = 7.0.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
              )
              Text(
                text = String.format(Locale.US, "%,d", shipRes),
                color = if (shipRes > 0 || shipId == 10) barCol else Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                fontSize = 7.2.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }
            Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(4.dp)) {
              val cy = size.height * 0.5f
              val fillX = (size.width * frac).coerceIn(3f, size.width)
              drawLine(
                color = barCol.copy(alpha = 0.18f),
                start = Offset(0f, cy),
                end = Offset(size.width, cy),
                strokeWidth = 1.2.dp.toPx(),
                cap = StrokeCap.Round,
              )
              drawLine(
                color = barCol,
                start = Offset(0f, cy),
                end = Offset(fillX, cy),
                strokeWidth = 2.2.dp.toPx(),
                cap = StrokeCap.Round,
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Rename Callsign (1ST FREE vs 250 Shards with Crystal Icon)
      Row(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
            .heightIn(min = 48.dp)
            .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
              isRightSide = false,
              primaryBorder = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
              secondaryBorder = Color(0xFF091528),
            )
            .clickable { onOpenRenamePrompt() }
            .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
            .testTag("dossier_btn_rename_callsign"),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "RENAME CALLSIGN",
          color = Color.White,
          fontSize = if (isTabletDeck) 8.8.sp else 8.0.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
        if (isFirstRenameFree) {
          Text(
            text = "1ST FREE >",
            color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
            fontSize = 8.0.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          )
        } else {
          Row(
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
          ) {
            RiftShardGemIcon(sizeDp = 12.dp)
            Text(
              text = "250 >",
              color = Color(0xFFFACC15),
              fontSize = 8.0.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            )
          }
        }
      }

      // Survival Sheet + Overwatch-Guarded Switch Account & Reset Record
      Row(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
            .heightIn(min = 48.dp)
            .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
              isRightSide = false,
              primaryBorder = Color(0xFFFFD700),
              secondaryBorder = Color(0xFF091528),
            )
            .clickable { onOpenSurvivalSpreadsheet() }
            .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
            .testTag("dossier_btn_survival_sheet"),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "SURVIVAL SHEET",
          color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
          fontSize = 8.0.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
        Text(
          text = "OPEN TABLE >",
          color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
          fontSize = 7.6.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
      }

      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
      ) {
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.weight(1f)
              .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
              .heightIn(min = 48.dp)
              .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
                isRightSide = false,
                primaryBorder = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                secondaryBorder = Color(0xFF091528),
              )
              .clickable { onOpenSwitchAccountPrompt() }
              .padding(horizontal = 6.dp)
              .testTag("dossier_btn_switch_account"),
          contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "SWITCH ACCOUNT",
            color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
            fontSize = 7.4.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 1,
          )
        }
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.weight(1f)
              .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
              .heightIn(min = 48.dp)
              .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
                isRightSide = false,
                primaryBorder = Color(0xFFFB7185),
                secondaryBorder = Color(0xFF091528),
              )
              .clickable { onOpenResetPrompt() }
              .padding(horizontal = 6.dp)
              .testTag("dossier_btn_reset_record"),
          contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "RESET RECORD",
            color = Color(0xFFFB7185),
            fontSize = 7.4.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 1,
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
internal fun DossierRightCareerBay(
  isTabletDeck: Boolean,
  headerHeight: Dp,
  wingStackGap: Dp,
  bestShipId: Int,
  shipSpinDeg: Float,
  fluxOrbitRad: Float,
  shipResonanceFor: (Int) -> Int,
  localPrefs: LocalPilotPrefs,
  currentUserId: String,
  liveResonance: Int,
  dossierRefreshNonce: Int = 0,
  cloudLeaderboardEntries: List<LeaderboardEntry>,
  onInspectShip: (Int) -> Unit,
  onOpenSurvivalSpreadsheet: () -> Unit = {},
) {
  val context = LocalContext.current
  val uidOrNull = currentUserId.ifBlank { null }
  val career =
    remember(currentUserId, liveResonance, dossierRefreshNonce) {
      localPrefs.getPilotCareerStatsSummary(uidOrNull)
    }
  val survival =
    remember(currentUserId, liveResonance, dossierRefreshNonce) {
      localPrefs.getPilotSurvivalTelemetrySummary(uidOrNull)
    }
  val hubTapCount =
    remember(currentUserId, liveResonance, dossierRefreshNonce) {
      localPrefs.getHubTapTelemetryHistory().size
    }
  val allTimePeak =
    remember(currentUserId, liveResonance, dossierRefreshNonce) {
      localPrefs.getAllTimePeakBountySnapshot(uidOrNull)
    }
  val pvpPeak =
    remember(currentUserId, liveResonance, dossierRefreshNonce) {
      localPrefs.getPvpPeakBountySnapshot(uidOrNull)
    }
  val syndicateHistory =
    remember(currentUserId, liveResonance, dossierRefreshNonce) {
      localPrefs.getSyndicateServiceHistory(uidOrNull)
    }
  var peakTabIdx by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
  val allShips = remember(RiftSpriteBaker.customShip9Version) { RiftCodex.getAllTenShips() }
  val hallOfFame = remember(cloudLeaderboardEntries) { cloudLeaderboardEntries.take(5) }
  var exportBanner by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

  Column(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().testTag("dossier_right_career_bay"),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(wingStackGap),
  ) {
    HubDigitizedReturnBar(
      heightDp = headerHeight,
      isRightSide = true,
      isTabletDeck = isTabletDeck,
      sectionTitle = "CAREER & TELEMETRY",
      accent = Color(0xFFFFD700),
    )

    Column(
      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth().padding(start = 18.dp).verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(wingStackGap),
    ) {
      // Full Career Stats Grid (Matches, Wins, Losses, Win %, Elims, Deaths, Assists, Accuracy, Crates, Rifts)
      Column(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
              isRightSide = true,
              primaryBorder = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
              secondaryBorder = Color(0xFF091528),
            )
            .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 7.dp)
            .testTag("dossier_career_stats_grid"),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "MATCH RECORD",
          color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
          fontSize = 7.8.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
        val statRows =
          listOf(
            "MATCHES" to "${career.matchesPlayed}",
            "WINS / LOSSES" to "${career.wins} / ${career.losses}",
            "WIN RATE" to "${career.winPercent}%",
            "ELIMINATIONS" to "${career.eliminations}",
            "DEATHS / ASSISTS" to "${career.deaths} / ${career.assists}",
            "ACCURACY" to "${career.accuracyPercent}%",
            "CRATES / RIFTS" to "${career.cratePickups} / ${career.riftCaptures}",
          )
        statRows.forEach { (k, v) ->
          Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          ) {
            Text(
              text = k,
              color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
              fontSize = 7.2.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            )
            Text(
              text = v,
              color = Color.White,
              fontSize = 7.6.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            )
          }
        }
      }

      // Ship Survival Duration Readout
      Column(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
              isRightSide = true,
              primaryBorder = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
              secondaryBorder = Color(0xFF091528),
            )
            .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 7.dp)
            .testTag("dossier_survival_summary_card"),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp),
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "SHIP SURVIVAL DURATION (${survival.pilotCompletedLives} LIVES)",
          color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
          fontSize = 7.6.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
        Row(
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "AVG ${formatSurvivalDurationSec(survival.pilotAvgSurvivalSec)}",
            color = Color.White,
            fontSize = 7.6.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          )
          Text(
            text = "LAST ${formatSurvivalDurationSec(survival.pilotLastSurvivalSec)}",
            color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
            fontSize = 7.6.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          )
          Text(
            text = "MAX ${formatSurvivalDurationSec(survival.pilotMaxSurvivalSec)}",
            color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
            fontSize = 7.6.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          )
        }
      }

      // Peak Resonance Sortie & Executioner Telemetry (ALL-TIME / PVP)
      Column(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
              isRightSide = true,
              primaryBorder = Color(0xFFFFD700),
              secondaryBorder = Color(0xFF091528),
            )
            .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 7.dp)
            .testTag("dossier_peak_run_card"),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "PEAK RESONANCE SORTIE & EXECUTIONER",
          color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
          fontSize = 7.6.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
        Row(
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
        ) {
          listOf(0 to ("ALL-TIME" to "dossier_peak_tab_all"), 1 to ("PVP" to "dossier_peak_tab_pvp")).forEach { (idx, meta) ->
            val sel = peakTabIdx == idx
            Box(
              modifier =
                Modifier.weight(1f)
                  .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
                  .height(48.dp)
                  .clickable { peakTabIdx = idx }
                  .padding(vertical = 5.dp)
                  .testTag(meta.second),
              contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
            ) {
              Box(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                    .cockpitReticleSurface(
                      accent = if (idx == 0) Color(0xFFFFD700) else Color(0xFF00F5D4),
                      isSelected = sel,
                      drawCornerTicks = sel,
                      featherAlpha = if (sel) 0.42f else 0.14f,
                    ),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
              ) {
                Text(
                  text = meta.first,
                  color = if (sel) Color.White else Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                  fontSize = 7.8.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                )
              }
            }
          }
        }
        val activePeak = if (peakTabIdx == 0) allTimePeak else pvpPeak
        if (activePeak == null) {
          Text(
            text =
              if (peakTabIdx == 0) "No recorded Peak Resonance sorties yet — launch into a Rift to log your top run."
              else "No recorded PvP Peak Resonance sorties yet — defeat rival pilots in ranked Rifts to log this record.",
            color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
            fontSize = 7.4.sp,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
          )
        } else {
          val peakHullTitle =
            cleanDisplayShipTitle(
              activePeak.shipId.coerceIn(1, 10),
              activePeak.shipFlown.ifBlank { RiftCodex.getShipById(activePeak.shipId.coerceIn(1, 10)).name },
            )
          Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          ) {
            Text(
              text = "PEAK RESONANCE",
              color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
              fontSize = 7.2.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            )
            Row(
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp),
            ) {
              ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = 11.dp)
              Text(
                text = String.format(Locale.US, "%,d", activePeak.bountyReached.coerceAtLeast(0)),
                color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
                fontSize = 8.0.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }
          }
          val peakRows =
            listOf(
              "HULL FLOWN" to peakHullTitle,
              "TIME SURVIVED" to activePeak.formattedDuration(),
              "PVP / BOT ELIMS" to "${activePeak.pvpKills} / ${activePeak.botKills}",
              "ACCURACY" to "${activePeak.accuracyPercent()}%",
            )
          peakRows.forEach { (k, v) ->
            Row(
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            ) {
              Text(
                text = k,
                color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                fontSize = 7.2.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
              Text(
                text = v,
                color = Color.White,
                fontSize = 7.4.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }
          }
          val exec = activePeak.executioner
          val cleanKillerTag =
            exec.killerSyndicateTag
              .trim()
              .uppercase(Locale.US)
              .takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() && it !in LocalPilotPrefs.NON_PLAYER_SYNDICATE_TAGS }
              .orEmpty()
          val execPrefix = if (cleanKillerTag.isNotEmpty()) "[$cleanKillerTag] " else ""
          val (outcomeText, outcomeColor) =
            when {
              exec.survivedToConvergence -> "SURVIVED TO SECTOR CONVERGENCE" to Color(0xFF00F5D4)
              exec.killerCallsign.isBlank() -> "ACTIVE UNDEFEATED STREAK" to Color(0xFFFFD700)
              else -> {
                val killerHull = exec.killerShip.ifBlank { "UNKNOWN HULL" }.uppercase(Locale.US)
                val killerWeapon = exec.killingWeapon.ifBlank { "WEAPON FIRE" }.uppercase(Locale.US)
                "ELIMINATED BY $execPrefix${exec.killerCallsign.uppercase(Locale.US)} • $killerHull • $killerWeapon" to
                  Color(0xFFFB7185)
              }
            }
          Text(
            text = outcomeText,
            color = outcomeColor,
            fontSize = 7.2.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 2,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          )
        }
      }

      if (syndicateHistory.isNotEmpty()) {
        Column(
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
                isRightSide = true,
                primaryBorder = Color(0xFFC084FC),
                secondaryBorder = Color(0xFF091528),
              )
              .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 7.dp)
              .testTag("dossier_syndicate_history_card"),
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "SYNDICATE SERVICE RECORD",
            color = Color(0xFFC084FC),
            fontSize = 7.6.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          )
          syndicateHistory.take(5).forEach { entry ->
            Row(
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            ) {
              Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).padding(end = 6.dp)) {
                Text(
                  text = "[${entry.syndicateTag.uppercase(Locale.US)}] ${entry.syndicateName}",
                  color = Color.White,
                  fontSize = 7.4.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                  maxLines = 1,
                  overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                )
                Text(
                  text = "${entry.role.uppercase(Locale.US)} • ${entry.formatTenure()}",
                  color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                  fontSize = 6.8.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                  maxLines = 1,
                  overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                )
              }
              Text(
                text = "${entry.totalKills} ELIMS • ${entry.publicGameWins}W",
                color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
                fontSize = 7.0.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                maxLines = 1,
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Numberless Per-Ship Resonance Mastery Rows
      Column(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
              isRightSide = true,
              primaryBorder = Color(0xFFFFD700),
              secondaryBorder = Color(0xFF091528),
            )
            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 7.dp)
            .testTag("dossier_per_ship_mastery"),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "PER-SHIP RESONANCE (10 HULLS)",
          color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
          fontSize = 7.6.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
        allShips.forEach { ship ->
          val cleanShip = cleanDisplayShipTitle(ship.id, ship.name)
          val shipRes = shipResonanceFor(ship.id)
          val isBest = ship.id == bestShipId
          Row(
            modifier =
              Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
                .heightIn(min = 48.dp)
                .cockpitReticleSurface(
                  accent = if (isBest) Color(0xFFFFD700) else Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                  isSelected = isBest,
                  drawCornerTicks = isBest,
                  featherAlpha = if (isBest) 0.44f else 0.22f,
                )
                .clickable { onInspectShip(ship.id) }
                .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
                .testTag("dossier_ship_mastery_${ship.id}"),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          ) {
            Row(
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
              modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            ) {
              Spinning25dShipWithOrbitingFlux(
                shipId = ship.id,
                shipSpinDeg = shipSpinDeg,
                fluxOrbitRad = fluxOrbitRad,
                isCharged = false,
                isBestShip = isBest,
                sizeDp = 28.dp,
              )
              Text(
                text = cleanShip,
                color = if (isBest) Color(0xFFFFD700) else Color.White,
                fontSize = 7.8.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
              )
            }
            Row(
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp),
            ) {
              ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = 11.dp)
              Text(
                text = String.format(Locale.US, "%,d", shipRes),
                color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
                fontSize = 7.8.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Hall of Fame Top Pilots
      if (hallOfFame.isNotEmpty()) {
        Column(
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
                isRightSide = true,
                primaryBorder = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                secondaryBorder = Color(0xFF091528),
              )
              .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 7.dp),
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "SECTOR HALL OF FAME",
            color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
            fontSize = 7.6.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          )
          hallOfFame.forEachIndexed { idx, entry ->
            Row(
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            ) {
              Text(
                text = "${idx + 1}. ${entry.callsign}",
                color = if (idx == 0) Color(0xFFFFD700) else Color.White,
                fontSize = 7.4.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).padding(end = 6.dp),
              )
              Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp),
              ) {
                ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = 10.dp)
                Text(
                  text = String.format(Locale.US, "%,d", entry.allTimeBounty.coerceAtLeast(0L)),
                  color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
                  fontSize = 7.4.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                )
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Filterable Export Row (HTML Table, CSV, JSON incl. Hub Tap Telemetry)
      Column(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
              isRightSide = true,
              primaryBorder = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
              secondaryBorder = Color(0xFF091528),
            )
            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "TELEMETRY EXPORT ($hubTapCount HUB TAPS LOGGED)",
          color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
          fontSize = 7.2.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
        Row(
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
        ) {
          HubTelemetryMiniExportBtn(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            label = "HTML TABLE",
            accent = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
            testTag = "dossier_export_html",
            onClick = onOpenSurvivalSpreadsheet,
          )
          HubTelemetryMiniExportBtn(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            label = "CSV",
            accent = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
            testTag = "dossier_export_csv",
            onClick = {
              val payload =
                localPrefs.exportSurvivalTelemetryCsv(
                  localPrefs.getCallsign(uidOrNull),
                  localPrefs.getLiveResonance(uidOrNull),
                  uidOrNull,
                )
              exportBanner = copyTelemetryTextToClipboard(context, "CSV", payload)
            },
          )
          HubTelemetryMiniExportBtn(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            label = "JSON",
            accent = Color(0xFFFFD700),
            testTag = "dossier_export_json",
            onClick = {
              val payload =
                localPrefs.exportSurvivalTelemetryJson(
                  localPrefs.getCallsign(uidOrNull),
                  localPrefs.getLiveResonance(uidOrNull),
                  uidOrNull,
                )
              exportBanner = copyTelemetryTextToClipboard(context, "JSON", payload)
            },
          )
        }
        if (!exportBanner.isNullOrBlank()) {
          Text(
            text = exportBanner!!,
            color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
            fontSize = 7.0.sp,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
internal fun HubTelemetryMiniExportBtn(
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
  label: String,
  accent: Color,
  testTag: String,
  onClick: () -> Unit,
) {
  Box(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
        .height(48.dp)
        .clickable { onClick() }
        .padding(vertical = 4.dp)
        .testTag(testTag),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
    Box(
      modifier =
        Modifier.height(38.dp)
          .cockpitReticleSurface(
            accent = accent,
            isSelected = true,
            drawCornerTicks = true,
            featherAlpha = 0.36f,
          )
          .padding(horizontal = 8.dp),
      contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
      Text(
        text = label,
        color = Color.White,
        fontSize = 8.0.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        maxLines = 1,
      )
    }
  }
}

@Composable
internal fun SyndicateLeftDirectoryBay(
  isTabletDeck: Boolean,
  headerHeight: Dp,
  wingStackGap: Dp,
  currentTag: String,
  syndicateDirectory: List<SyndicateInfo>,
  syndicateWarRecord: SyndicateWarRecord,
  statusMessage: String?,
  callsign: String = "",
  lobbyMessages: List<SyndicateChatMessage> = emptyList(),
  onAcceptSyndicateInvite: (tag: String, name: String) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  onBackToHub: () -> Unit,
  onInspectSyndicate: (SyndicateInfo) -> Unit,
) {
  var searchQuery by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
  var dismissedInviteIds by remember { mutableStateOf(emptySet<String>()) }
  val cleanCurrentTagNorm = currentTag.trim().uppercase(Locale.US)
  val pendingSyndicateInvites =
    remember(lobbyMessages, callsign, cleanCurrentTagNorm, dismissedInviteIds) {
      val cleanCall = callsign.trim()
      if (cleanCall.isBlank()) {
        emptyList()
      } else {
        val seenTags = HashSet<String>()
        lobbyMessages
          .sortedByDescending { it.createdAtMs }
          .mapNotNull { msg ->
            if (msg.id in dismissedInviteIds) return@mapNotNull null
            val obj = msg.armadaObjective.trim()
            if (!obj.startsWith("SYNINVITE|", ignoreCase = true)) return@mapNotNull null
            val parts = obj.split("|")
            if (parts.size < 3) return@mapNotNull null
            val invTag = parts[1].trim().uppercase(Locale.US)
            val targetCall = parts[2].trim()
            val invName = parts.getOrNull(3)?.trim().orEmpty().ifBlank { "[$invTag] Syndicate" }
            if (invTag.isBlank() || invTag in LocalPilotPrefs.NON_PLAYER_SYNDICATE_TAGS) return@mapNotNull null
            if (!targetCall.equals(cleanCall, ignoreCase = true)) return@mapNotNull null
            if (invTag.equals(cleanCurrentTagNorm, ignoreCase = true)) return@mapNotNull null
            if (!seenTags.add(invTag)) return@mapNotNull null
            Triple(msg, invTag, invName)
          }
      }
    }
  val realSyndicates =
    remember(syndicateDirectory, searchQuery) {
      val q = searchQuery.trim().uppercase(Locale.US)
      syndicateDirectory
        .filter { it.isRealPlayerFoundedSyndicate() }
        .filter { syn ->
          q.isEmpty() ||
            syn.tag.uppercase(Locale.US).contains(q) ||
            syn.name.uppercase(Locale.US).contains(q) ||
            syn.motto.uppercase(Locale.US).contains(q)
        }
    }

  Column(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().testTag("syndicate_left_directory_bay"),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(wingStackGap),
  ) {
    HubDigitizedReturnBar(
      heightDp = headerHeight,
      isRightSide = false,
      isTabletDeck = isTabletDeck,
      sectionTitle = "SYNDICATES",
      accent = Color(0xFFFFD700),
      onBackToHub = onBackToHub,
    )

    Column(
      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth().padding(end = 18.dp).verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(wingStackGap),
    ) {
      // War Standings Readout Pod
      Row(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
              isRightSide = false,
              primaryBorder = Color(0xFFFFD700),
              secondaryBorder = Color(0xFF091528),
            )
            .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
            .testTag("syndicate_war_standings_pod"),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "WAR STANDINGS",
          color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
          fontSize = 7.6.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
        Text(
          text = "${syndicateWarRecord.warTrophies} TROPHIES • ${syndicateWarRecord.warWins}-${syndicateWarRecord.warLosses}",
          color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
          fontSize = 7.6.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
      }

      // Pending Syndicate Invites addressed to this pilot
      pendingSyndicateInvites.forEach { (inviteMsg, invTag, invName) ->
        Column(
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .chamferedSciFiPodSurface(
                isRightSide = false,
                primaryBorder = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
                secondaryBorder = Color(0xFFFFD700),
              )
              .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 7.dp)
              .testTag("syndicate_pending_invite_$invTag"),
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "SYNDICATE INVITATION // [$invTag]",
            color = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
            fontSize = 7.6.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          )
          Text(
            text = "$invName • Invited by ${inviteMsg.senderCallsign.uppercase(Locale.US)}",
            color = Color.White,
            fontSize = 7.4.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            maxLines = 2,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          )
          Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
          ) {
            Box(
              modifier =
                Modifier.weight(1f)
                  .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
                  .height(48.dp)
                  .clickable {
                    dismissedInviteIds = dismissedInviteIds + inviteMsg.id
                    onAcceptSyndicateInvite(invTag, invName)
                  }
                  .padding(vertical = 5.dp)
                  .testTag("syndicate_invite_accept_$invTag"),
              contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
            ) {
              Box(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                    .cockpitReticleSurface(
                      accent = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
                      isSelected = true,
                      drawCornerTicks = true,
                      featherAlpha = 0.44f,
                    ),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
              ) {
                Text(
                  text = "ACCEPT",
                  color = Color.White,
                  fontSize = 7.8.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                )
              }
            }
            Box(
              modifier =
                Modifier.weight(1f)
                  .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
                  .height(48.dp)
                  .clickable {
                    dismissedInviteIds = dismissedInviteIds + inviteMsg.id
                  }
                  .padding(vertical = 5.dp)
                  .testTag("syndicate_invite_decline_$invTag"),
              contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
            ) {
              Box(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                    .cockpitReticleSurface(
                      accent = Color(0xFFFB7185),
                      isSelected = false,
                      drawCornerTicks = false,
                      featherAlpha = 0.28f,
                    ),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
              ) {
                Text(
                  text = "DECLINE",
                  color = Color(0xFFFB7185),
                  fontSize = 7.8.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                )
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Live Search Bar
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
            .heightIn(min = 48.dp)
            .cockpitLaserInputSurface(Color(0xFF38BDF8))
            .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.CenterStart,
      ) {
        if (searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
          Text(
            text = "Search chartered Syndicates by tag or name...",
            color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
            fontSize = 8.0.sp,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          )
        }
        BasicTextField(
          value = searchQuery,
          onValueChange = { searchQuery = it.take(24) },
          singleLine = true,
          cursorBrush = SolidColor(Color(0xFF00F5D4)),
          textStyle =
            TextStyle(
              color = Color.White,
              fontSize = 8.4.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            ),
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag("syndicate_search_input"),
        )
      }

      if (!statusMessage.isNullOrBlank()) {
        Text(
          text = statusMessage,
