sealed interface UiState<out T> {
  data object Loading : UiState<Nothing>
  data class Success<T>(val data: T) : UiState<T>
  data class Error(val message: String) : UiState<Nothing>
}

private fun <T> Flow<T>.retryWithExponentialBackoff(tagLabel: String): Flow<T> =
  this.retryWhen { cause, attempt ->
    if (cause is CancellationException) {
      false
    } else {
      val backoffMs = minOf(8_000L, 900L * (1L shl attempt.coerceAtMost(3L).toInt()))
      Log.w("RiftViewModel", "Retrying $tagLabel stream in ${backoffMs}ms after transient error: ${cause.message}")
      delay(backoffMs)
      true
    }
  }

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
class RiftViewModel(
  private val repository: RiftRepository,
  val currentUserId: String,
  val initialCallsign: String,
  val isGoogleAuthenticated: Boolean = Firebase.auth.currentUser != null,
) : ViewModel() {

  private val _activeSectorId = MutableStateFlow("NEXUS_LOBBY")
  val activeSectorId: StateFlow<String> = _activeSectorId.asStateFlow()

  fun setActiveSector(sectorId: String) {
    val cleanSector = repository.sanitizeSectorMode(sectorId.ifBlank { "NEXUS_LOBBY" })
    if (_activeSectorId.value != cleanSector) {
      _activeSectorId.value = cleanSector
    }
  }

  val cloudSyncHealth: StateFlow<CloudSyncHealth> = repository.cloudSyncHealth

  private val cloudReadyFlow: StateFlow<Boolean> =
    callbackFlow {
        val auth = Firebase.auth
        fun checkReady(): Boolean {
          val uid = auth.currentUser?.uid?.trim()
          return isGoogleAuthenticated && !uid.isNullOrEmpty() && !uid.startsWith("dev_")
        }
        trySend(checkReady())
        val listener = FirebaseAuth.AuthStateListener { trySend(checkReady()) }
        auth.addAuthStateListener(listener)
        awaitClose { auth.removeAuthStateListener(listener) }
      }
      .distinctUntilChanged()
      .stateIn(
        scope = viewModelScope,
        started = SharingStarted.Eagerly,
        initialValue = isGoogleAuthenticated && Firebase.auth.currentUser != null,
      )

  private fun isCloudSessionReady(): Boolean {
    val uid = Firebase.auth.currentUser?.uid?.trim()
    return isGoogleAuthenticated && !uid.isNullOrEmpty() && !uid.startsWith("dev_")
  }

  val dossierState: StateFlow<UiState<PilotDossier?>> =
    cloudReadyFlow
      .flatMapLatest { ready ->
        if (!ready) {
          flowOf(UiState.Success(null))
        } else {
          val resolvedUid = Firebase.auth.currentUser?.uid?.trim()?.ifEmpty { currentUserId } ?: currentUserId
          repository
            .observePilotDossier(resolvedUid)
            .map<PilotDossier?, UiState<PilotDossier?>> { UiState.Success(it) }
            .retryWithExponentialBackoff("pilotDossier")
            .catch { error ->
              if (error is CancellationException) throw error
              emit(UiState.Error(error.message ?: "Failed to load pilot dossier"))
            }
        }
      }
      .stateIn(
        scope = viewModelScope,
        started = SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(STOP_TIMEOUT_MILLIS),
        initialValue = if (isCloudSessionReady()) UiState.Loading else UiState.Success(null),
      )

  val cloudProgressionState: StateFlow<String?> =
    cloudReadyFlow
      .flatMapLatest { ready ->
        if (!ready) {
          flowOf(null)
        } else {
          val resolvedUid = Firebase.auth.currentUser?.uid?.trim()?.ifEmpty { currentUserId } ?: currentUserId
          repository
            .observeCloudPilotProgression(resolvedUid)
            .distinctUntilChanged()
            .retryWithExponentialBackoff("pilotProgression")
            .catch { error ->
              if (error is CancellationException) throw error
              emit(null)
            }
        }
      }
      .stateIn(
        scope = viewModelScope,
        started = SharingStarted.Eagerly,
        initialValue = null,
      )

  val leaderboardState: StateFlow<UiState<List<LeaderboardEntry>>> =
    cloudReadyFlow
      .flatMapLatest { ready ->
        if (!ready) {
          flowOf(UiState.Success(emptyList()))
        } else {
          repository
            .observeLeaderboard()
            .map<List<LeaderboardEntry>, UiState<List<LeaderboardEntry>>> { UiState.Success(it) }
            .retryWithExponentialBackoff("leaderboard")
            .catch { error ->
              if (error is CancellationException) throw error
              emit(UiState.Error(error.message ?: "Failed to load leaderboard"))
            }
        }
      }
      .stateIn(
        scope = viewModelScope,
        started = SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(STOP_TIMEOUT_MILLIS),
        initialValue = if (isCloudSessionReady()) UiState.Loading else UiState.Success(emptyList()),
      )

  val sectorPilotsState: StateFlow<UiState<List<LivePilotState>>> =
    cloudReadyFlow
      .flatMapLatest { ready ->
        if (!ready) {
          flowOf(UiState.Success(emptyList()))
        } else {
          _activeSectorId
            .flatMapLatest { sectorId ->
              repository
                .observeSectorPilots(sectorId)
                .map<List<LivePilotState>, UiState<List<LivePilotState>>> { UiState.Success(it) }
                .retryWithExponentialBackoff("sectorPilots:$sectorId")
                .catch { error ->
                  if (error is CancellationException) throw error
                  emit(UiState.Error(error.message ?: "Failed to observe sector pilots"))
                }
            }
        }
      }
      .stateIn(
        scope = viewModelScope,
        started = SharingStarted.Eagerly,
        initialValue = if (isCloudSessionReady()) UiState.Loading else UiState.Success(emptyList()),
      )

  val allOnlineHumansState: StateFlow<List<LivePilotState>> =
    cloudReadyFlow
      .flatMapLatest { ready ->
        if (!ready) {
          flowOf(emptyList())
        } else {
          repository
            .observeAllOnlineHumanPilots()
            .retryWithExponentialBackoff("allOnlineHumanPilots")
            .catch { error ->
              if (error is CancellationException) throw error
              emit(emptyList())
            }
        }
      }
      .stateIn(
        scope = viewModelScope,
        started = SharingStarted.Eagerly,
        initialValue = emptyList(),
      )

  val sectorCombatEventsState: StateFlow<List<SectorCombatEvent>> =
    cloudReadyFlow
      .flatMapLatest { ready ->
        if (!ready) {
          flowOf(emptyList())
        } else {
          _activeSectorId.flatMapLatest { sectorId ->
            if (sectorId == "NEXUS_LOBBY") {
              flowOf(emptyList())
            } else {
              repository
                .observeSectorCombatEvents(sectorId)
                .retryWithExponentialBackoff("combatEvents:$sectorId")
                .catch { error ->
                  if (error is CancellationException) throw error
                  emit(emptyList())
                }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      .stateIn(
        scope = viewModelScope,
        started = SharingStarted.Eagerly,
        initialValue = emptyList(),
      )

  private val pendingLivePilotState = MutableStateFlow<LivePilotState?>(null)
  private val liveStateRevision = AtomicLong(0L)
  private val liveStateSignal = Channel<Unit>(Channel.CONFLATED)
  private val pendingCloudProgressionJson = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
  private val cloudProgressionSignal = Channel<Unit>(Channel.CONFLATED)

  init {
    viewModelScope.launch {
      cloudReadyFlow.collect { ready ->
        if (ready) {
          ensureInitialProfile()
          liveStateSignal.trySend(Unit)
          cloudProgressionSignal.trySend(Unit)
        }
      }
    }
    // Single-flight conflated cloud progression writer paced at >= 1,200ms:
    // Skips consecutive identical JSON payloads while guaranteeing the latest state flushes cleanly.
    viewModelScope.launch {
      var lastWrittenJson: String? = null
      while (true) {
        val nextJson = pendingCloudProgressionJson.value
        if (!isCloudSessionReady() || nextJson.isNullOrBlank() || nextJson == lastWrittenJson) {
          cloudProgressionSignal.receive()
          continue
        }
        val ok =
          try {
            repository.saveCloudPilotProgression(nextJson)
          } catch (e: CancellationException) {
            throw e
          } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Transient cloud progression sync error", e)
            false
          }
        if (ok) {
          lastWrittenJson = nextJson
        }
        delay(if (ok) 1_200L else 4_000L)
      }
    }
    // Single-flight conflated presence/telemetry writer:
    // Prevents concurrent Firestore .update() calls from piling up and stalling after initial spawn.
    viewModelScope.launch {
      var lastSentRevision = 0L
      var lastSentSector = ""
      var lastSentFiring = false
      var lastSentSecondarySeq = 0L
      var lastSentRespawning = false
      while (true) {
        val currentRev = liveStateRevision.get()
        val snapshot = pendingLivePilotState.value
        if (!isCloudSessionReady() || snapshot == null || currentRev <= lastSentRevision) {
          liveStateSignal.receive()
          continue
        }
        lastSentRevision = currentRev
        lastSentSector = snapshot.sectorId
        lastSentFiring = snapshot.isFiringPrimary
        lastSentSecondarySeq = snapshot.secondarySeq
        lastSentRespawning = snapshot.isRespawning
        try {
          repository.saveLivePilotState(snapshot)
        } catch (e: CancellationException) {
          throw e
        } catch (e: Exception) {
          Log.w(TAG, "Transient live state sync error", e)
        }
        // Pace steady position updates at ~115ms while waking immediately on urgent combat/sector changes
        withTimeoutOrNull(115L) {
          while (true) {
            liveStateSignal.receive()
            val next = pendingLivePilotState.value
            if (
              next != null &&
                (next.sectorId != lastSentSector ||
                  next.isFiringPrimary != lastSentFiring ||
                  next.secondarySeq != lastSentSecondarySeq ||
                  next.isRespawning != lastSentRespawning)
            ) {
              break
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private fun ensureInitialProfile() {
    if (!isCloudSessionReady()) return
    viewModelScope.launch {
      try {
        val resolvedUid = Firebase.auth.currentUser?.uid?.trim()?.ifEmpty { currentUserId } ?: currentUserId
        val existingResult = repository.getPilotDossier(resolvedUid)
        if (existingResult.isFailure) return@launch
        val existing = existingResult.getOrNull()
        if (existing == null) {
          val defaultDossier =
            PilotDossier(
              userId = resolvedUid,
              callsign = initialCallsign,
              syndicateTag = "",
              syndicateName = "Unaffiliated",
              preferredShipId = 1L,
              preferredFoundry = "Independent",
              preferredMode = "SECTOR_CONVERGENCE",
              pvpKills = 0L,
              pvpDeaths = 0L,
              pvpBountyPeak = 100L,
              allTimeKills = 0L,
              allTimeDeaths = 0L,
              allTimeBountyPeak = 100L,
              convergencesWon = 0L,
            )
          repository.savePilotDossier(defaultDossier)
          repository.saveLeaderboardEntry(
            LeaderboardEntry(
              userId = resolvedUid,
              callsign = initialCallsign,
              shipId = 1L,
              syndicateTag = "",
              armadaTag = "SOLO",
              armadaTierSize = 1,
              foundry = "Independent",
              pvpKills = 0L,
              pvpDeaths = 0L,
              pvpBounty = 100L,
              allTimeKills = 0L,
              allTimeDeaths = 0L,
              allTimeBounty = 100L,
              convergencesWon = 0L,
            )
          )
        }
      } catch (e: Exception) {
        Log.w(TAG, "Initial profile check skipped or offline", e)
      }
    }
  }

  fun syncCloudPilotProgression(payloadJson: String) {
    val cleanJson = payloadJson.trim()
    if (cleanJson.isEmpty() || !isCloudSessionReady()) return
    pendingCloudProgressionJson.value = cleanJson
    cloudProgressionSignal.trySend(Unit)
  }

  fun observeSyndicateMeta(tag: String): Flow<CloudSyndicateMeta?> {
    val cleanTag = tag.trim().uppercase(Locale.US)
    if (!isCloudSessionReady() || cleanTag.isEmpty() || cleanTag in LocalPilotPrefs.NON_PLAYER_SYNDICATE_TAGS) {
      return flowOf(null)
    }
    return repository
      .observeCloudSyndicateMeta(cleanTag)
      .retryWithExponentialBackoff("syndicateMeta:$cleanTag")
      .catch { error ->
        if (error is CancellationException) throw error
        Log.w(TAG, "Error observing syndicate meta for $cleanTag", error)
        emit(null)
      }
  }

  fun postStructuredChannelMessage(
    senderCallsign: String,
    senderSyndicateTag: String,
    channelKey: String,
    messageText: String,
    armadaName: String = "",
    armadaCurrentSize: Int = 1,
    armadaMaxSize: Int = 5,
    armadaObjective: String = "",
    isArmadaRecruitBanner: Boolean = false,
  ): SyndicateChatMessage {
    val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
    val safeChannelLabel = channelKey.trim().uppercase(Locale.US).take(24).ifEmpty { "#SECTOR-LOUNGE" }
    val safeMessage = UgcModeration.sanitizeUgcText(messageText).take(240)
    val safeObjective =
      (if (
        armadaObjective.startsWith("BUILD|", ignoreCase = true) ||
          armadaObjective.startsWith("ROOM|", ignoreCase = true) ||
          armadaObjective.startsWith("BUG|", ignoreCase = true)
      ) {
        armadaObjective.trim()
      } else {
        UgcModeration.sanitizeUgcText(armadaObjective)
      }).take(120)

    val msg =
      SyndicateChatMessage(
        id = "comm_${now}_${(100..999).random()}",
        senderUid = currentUserId,
        senderCallsign = senderCallsign,
        senderSyndicateTag = senderSyndicateTag,
        timestampLabel = safeChannelLabel,
        messageText = safeMessage,
        isArmadaRecruitBanner = isArmadaRecruitBanner,
        armadaName = armadaName.trim().uppercase(Locale.US).take(14),
        armadaCurrentSize = armadaCurrentSize.coerceIn(1, 5),
        armadaMaxSize = armadaMaxSize.coerceIn(1, 5),
        armadaObjective = safeObjective,
        requestSent = false,
        createdAtMs = now,
      )

    if (isCloudSessionReady()) {
      viewModelScope.launch {
        try {
          repository.postSectorCommMessage(msg)
        } catch (e: CancellationException) {
          throw e
        } catch (e: Exception) {
          Log.w(TAG, "Failed to post structured channel message", e)
        }
      }
    }
    return msg
  }

  fun lookupAndAddRealFriendByCallsign(
    rawCallsign: String,
    localPrefs: LocalPilotPrefs,
    onResult: (FriendPilotEntry?, String) -> Unit,
  ) {
    val cleanTarget =
      rawCallsign
        .trim()
        .uppercase(Locale.US)
        .replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_\\-]"), "")
        .take(14)
    if (cleanTarget.length < 2 || UgcModeration.containsProfanity(cleanTarget)) {
      onResult(null, "INVALID OR RESTRICTED CALLSIGN.")
      return
    }
    if (cleanTarget.equals(initialCallsign, ignoreCase = true)) {
      onResult(null, "CANNOT ADD YOUR OWN CALLSIGN TO STRIKE WING ROSTER.")
      return
    }
    val existingLocal = localPrefs.addFriendByCallsign(cleanTarget)
    if (existingLocal != null) {
      onResult(
        existingLocal,
        "VERIFIED PILOT [${existingLocal.syndicateTag.ifEmpty { "SOLO" }}] ${existingLocal.callsign} ALREADY IN ROSTER.",
      )
      return
    }
    if (!isCloudSessionReady()) {
      onResult(null, "LINK GOOGLE ACCOUNT IN HELM SYSTEMS TO SEARCH LIVE SWORN PILOTS.")
      return
    }
    viewModelScope.launch {
      val found =
        try {
          repository.findRealSwornPilotByCallsign(cleanTarget, excludeUid = currentUserId)
        } catch (e: CancellationException) {
          throw e
        } catch (e: Exception) {
          Log.w(TAG, "Failed to lookup sworn pilot by callsign", e)
          null
        }
      if (found != null) {
        localPrefs.saveVerifiedFriendPilot(found)
        val badge = found.syndicateTag.ifEmpty { "SOLO" }
        onResult(found, "VERIFIED SWORN PILOT [$badge] ${found.callsign} ADDED TO ROSTER.")
      } else {
        onResult(null, "NO VERIFIED SWORN PILOT FOUND FOR CALLSIGN $cleanTarget.")
      }
    }
  }

  fun lookupCustomGameByCode(
    rawCode: String,
    onResult: (CloudCustomGameRoom?, String) -> Unit,
  ) {
    val cleanCode = rawCode.trim().uppercase(Locale.US).replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9]"), "").take(8)
    if (cleanCode.length !in 4..8) {
      onResult(null, "ENTER A VALID 6-CHARACTER JOIN CODE.")
      return
    }
    if (!isCloudSessionReady()) {
      onResult(null, "SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE TO JOIN REMOTE CUSTOM GAMES BY CODE.")
      return
    }
    viewModelScope.launch {
      val result =
        try {
          repository.getCustomGameByJoinCode(cleanCode)
        } catch (e: CancellationException) {
          throw e
        } catch (e: Exception) {
          Result.failure(e)
        }
      val found = result.getOrNull()
      if (found != null) {
        onResult(found, "JOINING CUSTOM GAME [${found.roomCode}] // ${found.title}")
      } else if (result.isFailure) {
        onResult(null, "UNABLE TO REACH CLOUD DIRECTORY FOR CODE [$cleanCode].")
      } else {
        onResult(null, "NO ACTIVE CUSTOM GAME FOUND FOR CODE [$cleanCode].")
      }
    }
  }

  fun syncFromEngineJson(payloadJson: String) {
    if (!isCloudSessionReady()) return
    viewModelScope.launch {
      try {
        val obj = JSONObject(payloadJson)
        val callsign = obj.optString("callsign", initialCallsign)
        val shipId = obj.optLong("shipId", 1L)
        val foundry = obj.optString("foundry", "Independent")
        val mode = repository.sanitizeSectorMode(obj.optString("mode", "SECTOR_CONVERGENCE"))
        val pvpKills = obj.optLong("pvpKills", 0L)
        val pvpDeaths = obj.optLong("pvpDeaths", 0L)
        val pvpBountyPeak = obj.optLong("pvpBountyPeak", 100L)
        val allTimeKills = obj.optLong("allTimeKills", 0L)
        val allTimeDeaths = obj.optLong("allTimeDeaths", 0L)
        val allTimeBountyPeak = obj.optLong("allTimeBountyPeak", 100L)
        val convergencesWon = obj.optLong("convergencesWon", 0L)

        if (_activeSectorId.value != mode) {
          _activeSectorId.value = mode
        }

        repository.savePilotDossier(
          PilotDossier(
            userId = currentUserId,
            callsign = callsign,
            syndicateTag = "",
            syndicateName = "Unaffiliated",
            preferredShipId = shipId,
            preferredFoundry = foundry,
            preferredMode = mode,
            pvpKills = pvpKills,
            pvpDeaths = pvpDeaths,
            pvpBountyPeak = pvpBountyPeak,
            allTimeKills = allTimeKills,
            allTimeDeaths = allTimeDeaths,
            allTimeBountyPeak = allTimeBountyPeak,
            convergencesWon = convergencesWon,
          )
        )
        repository.saveLeaderboardEntry(
          LeaderboardEntry(
            userId = currentUserId,
            callsign = callsign,
            shipId = shipId,
            syndicateTag = "",
            foundry = foundry,
            pvpKills = pvpKills,
            pvpDeaths = pvpDeaths,
            pvpBounty = pvpBountyPeak,
            allTimeKills = allTimeKills,
            allTimeDeaths = allTimeDeaths,
            allTimeBounty = allTimeBountyPeak,
            convergencesWon = convergencesWon,
          )
        )
      } catch (e: Exception) {
        Log.w(TAG, "Failed to parse engine stats JSON", e)
      }
    }
  }

  fun syncTelemetryFromEngineJson(payloadJson: String) {
    if (!isCloudSessionReady()) return
    viewModelScope.launch {
      try {
        val obj = JSONObject(payloadJson)
        val sectorId = repository.sanitizeSectorMode(obj.optString("sectorId", "SECTOR_CONVERGENCE"))
        if (_activeSectorId.value != sectorId) {
          _activeSectorId.value = sectorId
        }
        val state =
          LivePilotState(
            userId = currentUserId,
            sectorId = sectorId,
            callsign = obj.optString("callsign", initialCallsign),
            shipId = obj.optLong("shipId", 1L),
            freq = obj.optLong("freq", 0L),
            x = obj.optDouble("x", 2000.0),
            y = obj.optDouble("y", 2000.0),
            vx = obj.optDouble("vx", 0.0),
            vy = obj.optDouble("vy", 0.0),
            angle = obj.optDouble("angle", 0.0),
            energy = obj.optLong("energy", 1200L),
            maxEnergy = obj.optLong("maxEnergy", 1200L),
            bounty = obj.optLong("bounty", 100L),
            lastPingType = obj.optString("lastPingType", "NONE"),
            lastPingX = obj.optDouble("lastPingX", 0.0),
            lastPingY = obj.optDouble("lastPingY", 0.0),
          )
        repository.saveLivePilotState(state)
      } catch (e: Exception) {
        Log.w(TAG, "Failed to parse telemetry JSON", e)
      }
    }
  }

  fun syncNativeLiveState(
    sectorId: String,
    callsign: String,
    syndicateTag: String = "",
    armadaName: String = "",
    shipId: Int,
    freq: Int,
    x: Float,
    y: Float,
    vx: Float,
    vy: Float,
    angle: Float,
    weaponAngle: Float = angle,
    isFiringPrimary: Boolean = false,
    isAfterburning: Boolean = false,
    isCloaked: Boolean = false,
    isRespawning: Boolean = false,
    isInStasisBrig: Boolean = false,
    secondarySeq: Long = 0L,
    secondaryType: String = "NONE",
    secondaryAim: Float = angle,
    flux: Float,
    maxFlux: Float,
    bounty: Int,
    liveResonance: Int = 0,
  ) {
    val cleanSector = repository.sanitizeSectorMode(sectorId.ifBlank { "NEXUS_LOBBY" })
    if (_activeSectorId.value != cleanSector) {
      _activeSectorId.value = cleanSector
    }
    if (!isCloudSessionReady()) return
    pendingLivePilotState.value =
      LivePilotState(
        userId = currentUserId,
        sectorId = cleanSector,
        callsign = callsign,
        syndicateTag = syndicateTag,
        armadaName = armadaName.take(14),
        shipId = shipId.toLong(),
        freq = freq.toLong(),
        x = x.toDouble(),
        y = y.toDouble(),
        vx = vx.toDouble(),
        vy = vy.toDouble(),
        angle = angle.toDouble(),
        weaponAngle = weaponAngle.toDouble(),
        isFiringPrimary = isFiringPrimary,
        isAfterburning = isAfterburning,
        isCloaked = isCloaked,
        isRespawning = isRespawning,
        isInStasisBrig = isInStasisBrig,
        secondarySeq = secondarySeq,
        secondaryType = secondaryType,
        secondaryAim = secondaryAim.toDouble(),
        energy = flux.toLong().coerceIn(0L, 10000L),
        maxEnergy = maxFlux.toLong().coerceIn(100L, 10000L),
        bounty = bounty.toLong(),
        liveResonance = liveResonance.toLong(),
        lastPingType = "NONE",
        lastPingX = 0.0,
        lastPingY = 0.0,
      )
    liveStateRevision.incrementAndGet()
    liveStateSignal.trySend(Unit)
  }

  fun buildCloudSnapshotJson(): String {
    val root = JSONObject()
    root.put("userId", currentUserId)
    root.put("defaultCallsign", initialCallsign)

    val dossier = (dossierState.value as? UiState.Success)?.data
    if (dossier != null) {
      val dObj =
        JSONObject().apply {
          put("callsign", dossier.callsign)
          put("preferredShipId", dossier.preferredShipId)
          put("preferredFoundry", dossier.preferredFoundry)
          put("preferredMode", dossier.preferredMode)
          put("pvpKills", dossier.pvpKills)
          put("pvpDeaths", dossier.pvpDeaths)
          put("pvpBountyPeak", dossier.pvpBountyPeak)
          put("allTimeKills", dossier.allTimeKills)
          put("allTimeDeaths", dossier.allTimeDeaths)
          put("allTimeBountyPeak", dossier.allTimeBountyPeak)
          put("convergencesWon", dossier.convergencesWon)
        }
      root.put("dossier", dObj)
    }

    val lbList = (leaderboardState.value as? UiState.Success)?.data ?: emptyList()
    val lbArray = JSONArray()
    lbList.forEach { entry ->
      lbArray.put(
        JSONObject().apply {
          put("userId", entry.userId.ifEmpty { entry.id })
          put("callsign", entry.callsign)
          put("shipId", entry.shipId)
          put("foundry", entry.foundry)
          put("pvpKills", entry.pvpKills)
          put("pvpDeaths", entry.pvpDeaths)
          put("pvpBounty", entry.pvpBounty)
          put("allTimeKills", entry.allTimeKills)
          put("allTimeDeaths", entry.allTimeDeaths)
          put("allTimeBounty", entry.allTimeBounty)
          put("convergencesWon", entry.convergencesWon)
          put("isHuman", true)
        }
      )
    }
    root.put("leaderboard", lbArray)

    val pilotsList = (sectorPilotsState.value as? UiState.Success)?.data ?: emptyList()
    val pilotsArray = JSONArray()
    pilotsList.forEach { p ->
      val pUid = p.userId.ifEmpty { p.id }.trim()
      if (pUid.isNotEmpty() && pUid != currentUserId) {
        pilotsArray.put(
          JSONObject().apply {
            put("userId", pUid)
            put("sectorId", p.sectorId)
            put("callsign", p.callsign)
            put("shipId", p.shipId)
            put("freq", p.freq)
            put("x", p.x)
            put("y", p.y)
            put("vx", p.vx)
            put("vy", p.vy)
            put("angle", p.angle)
            put("energy", p.energy)
            put("maxEnergy", p.maxEnergy)
            put("bounty", p.bounty)
            put("liveResonance", p.liveResonance)
            put("lastPingType", p.lastPingType)
            put("lastPingX", p.lastPingX)
            put("lastPingY", p.lastPingY)
          }
        )
      }
    }
    root.put("remotePilots", pilotsArray)

    return root.toString()
  }

  private companion object {
    const val TAG = "RiftViewModel"
    const val STOP_TIMEOUT_MILLIS = 5000L
  }
}

private fun DrawScope.drawSettingsBrackets(
  pad: Float,
  tick: Float,
  strokeW: Float,
  leftCol: Color,
  rightCol: Color = leftCol,
) {
  drawLine(leftCol, Offset(pad, pad), Offset(pad + tick, pad), strokeW)
  drawLine(leftCol, Offset(pad, pad), Offset(pad, pad + tick), strokeW)
  drawLine(leftCol, Offset(pad, size.height - pad), Offset(pad + tick, size.height - pad), strokeW)
  drawLine(leftCol, Offset(pad, size.height - pad - tick), Offset(pad, size.height - pad), strokeW)
  drawLine(rightCol, Offset(size.width - pad - tick, pad), Offset(size.width - pad, pad), strokeW)
  drawLine(rightCol, Offset(size.width - pad, pad), Offset(size.width - pad, pad + tick), strokeW)
  drawLine(
    rightCol,
    Offset(size.width - pad - tick, size.height - pad),
    Offset(size.width - pad, size.height - pad),
    strokeW,
  )
  drawLine(
    rightCol,
    Offset(size.width - pad, size.height - pad - tick),
    Offset(size.width - pad, size.height - pad),
    strokeW,
  )
}

@Composable
private fun VectorHelmWheelGlyph(accent: Color, sizeDp: Dp = 16.dp) {
  Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size(sizeDp)) {
    val cx = size.width * 0.5f
    val cy = size.height * 0.5f
    val r = size.minDimension * 0.42f
    drawCircle(accent, r, Offset(cx, cy), style = Stroke(width = 1.5.dp.toPx()))
    drawCircle(Color.White, r * 0.24f, Offset(cx, cy))
    for (i in 0 until 6) {
      val a = Math.toRadians(i * 60.0)
      drawLine(
        accent,
        Offset(cx + cos(a).toFloat() * (r * 0.28f), cy + sin(a).toFloat() * (r * 0.28f)),
        Offset(cx + cos(a).toFloat() * (r * 0.96f), cy + sin(a).toFloat() * (r * 0.96f)),
        strokeWidth = 1.2.dp.toPx(),
      )
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun SettingsBeveledButton(

  val pilotPrefs = remember(context) { LocalPilotPrefs(context) }
  val isSwornPilot = isGoogleAuthenticated && !pilotPrefs.isGuestBypassEnabled()

      if (!isSwornPilot) {
        "RFT"

            it.isNotEmpty() &&

                      .background(TabletShellBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .border(
                        1.dp,
                        if (isGoogleAuthenticated) Color(0xFF10B981) else TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.45f),
                        RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                      )
                      .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 8.dp)
                ) {
                  Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)) {
                    Row(
                      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                    ) {
                      Box(
                        modifier =
                          Modifier.size(7.dp)
                            .clip(CircleShape)
                            .background(
                              if (isGoogleAuthenticated) Color(0xFF10B981) else Color(0xFFFACC15)
                            )
                      )
                      Text(
                        text =
                          if (isSwornPilot) "SWORN PILOT LINKED"
                          else "[RFT] DRIFTER SESSION",
                        color =
                          if (isSwornPilot) Color(0xFF34D399) else Color(0xFFFACC15),
                        fontSize = 9.6.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                        fontFamily = Mono,
                      )
                    }
                    Text(
                      text =
                        if (activeSynTag.isNotEmpty()) "[$activeSynTag] $activeCallsign"
                        else activeCallsign,
                      color = Color.White,
                      fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 12.5.sp else 14.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                      fontFamily = Sans,
                      maxLines = 1,
                      overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    )
                  }
                }

                // Prominent Top-of-Card Switch Account Button (works for both Sworn Pilots & Drifters)
                SettingsBeveledButton(
                  label = "SWITCH ACCOUNT",
                  topColor = Color(0xFF0F2D3A),
                  bottomColor = TabletShellBg,
                  borderColor = Color(0xFFFACC15),
                  textColor = Color(0xFFFEF08A),
                  isCompactPhone = isCompactPhone,
                  modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                  heightOverride = if (isCompactPhone) 32.dp else 36.dp,
                  testTag = "settings_btn_switch_account",
                  onClick = { showSwitchAccountConfirmModal = true },
                )

                // Unified Custom Resonance Crest + Single Prismatic Rift Shard Gem
                Row(
                  modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                ) {
                  Row(
                    modifier =
                      Modifier.weight(0.92f)
                        .background(TabletShellBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                        .border(1.dp, Color(0xFFFACC15), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                        .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 7.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                  ) {
                    ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = 15.dp)
                    Text(
                      text = "$liveResonanceBalance",
                      color = Color(0xFFFEF08A),
                      fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 10.sp else 11.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                      fontFamily = Mono,
                      maxLines = 1,
                    )
                  }

                  Row(
                    modifier =
                      Modifier.weight(1.08f)
                        .background(TabletShellBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                        .border(1.dp, Color(0xFFC084FC), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                        .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 7.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                  ) {
                    RiftShardGemIcon(sizeDp = 15.dp)
                    Text(
                      text = shardReadoutText,
                      color = Color(0xFFF3E8FF),
                      fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 10.sp else 11.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                      fontFamily = Mono,
                      maxLines = 1,
                      overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    )
                  }
                }

                // Live Cloud Uplink Diagnostics Readout
                val diagColor =
                  when {
                    !isGoogleAuthenticated -> Color(0xFFFACC15)
                    cloudSyncHealth.isConnected -> Color(0xFF34D399)
                    !cloudSyncHealth.lastError.isNullOrBlank() -> Color(0xFFF87171)
                    else -> Color(0xFF38BDF8)
                  }
                Column(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                      .background(TabletShellBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .border(1.dp, diagColor.copy(alpha = 0.55f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = if (isCompactPhone) 4.dp else 5.5.dp)
                      .testTag("settings_cloud_diagnostics_card"),
                  verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
                ) {
                  Text(
                    text =
                      if (isGoogleAuthenticated) "UPLINK: ${cloudSyncHealth.statusLabel} • ${activeSectorTag.take(18)}"
                      else "UPLINK: LOCAL GUEST MODE (SIGN IN FOR LIVE PVP)",
                    color = diagColor,
                    fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.6.sp else 10.2.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    fontFamily = Mono,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                  )
                  val uidPreview = if (currentUserId.isNotBlank()) currentUserId.take(10) else "UNLINKED"
                  val diagDetail =
                    if (!cloudSyncHealth.lastError.isNullOrBlank()) {
                      "UID $uidPreview • ${cloudSyncHealth.lastError.take(34)}"
                    } else {
                      "UID $uidPreview • REAL-TIME TELEMETRY READY"
                    }
                  Text(
                    text = diagDetail,
                    color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                    fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.0.sp else 9.6.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontFamily = Mono,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                  )
                }
              }

              Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp)) {
                SettingsBeveledButton(
                  label =
                    if (hasUpdateAvailable) "[INSTALL / DOWNLOAD UPDATE]"
                    else "[CHECK FOR UPDATES • ${updateStatusLabel.take(20)}]",
                  topColor = if (hasUpdateAvailable) Color(0xFF0A362C) else Color(0xFF0C1E35),
                  bottomColor = TabletShellBg,
                  borderColor = if (hasUpdateAvailable) Color(0xFF34D399) else TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.70f),
                  textColor = if (hasUpdateAvailable) Color(0xFF6EE7B7) else TabletCyanBorder,
                  isCompactPhone = isCompactPhone,
                  modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                  heightOverride = if (isCompactPhone) 30.dp else 33.dp,
                  testTag = "settings_btn_check_update",
                  onClick = onCheckOrApplyUpdate,
                )
                SettingsBeveledButton(
                  label = "[TRACK A–C & SFX LAB]",
                  topColor = Color(0xFF1A1036),
                  bottomColor = TabletShellBg,
                  borderColor = Color(0xFFC084FC),
                  textColor = Color(0xFFF3E8FF),
                  isCompactPhone = isCompactPhone,
                  modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                  heightOverride = if (isCompactPhone) 30.dp else 34.dp,
                  testTag = "settings_btn_open_audio_forge",
                  onClick = onOpenAudioForge,
                )
                if (isGoogleAuthenticated) {
                  SettingsBeveledButton(
                    label = "SIGN OUT",
                    topColor = Color(0xFF102038),
                    bottomColor = TabletShellBg,
                    borderColor = TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.65f),
                    textColor = Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
                    isCompactPhone = isCompactPhone,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    heightOverride = if (isCompactPhone) 32.dp else 36.dp,
                    onClick = onRequestSignOut,
                  )
                } else {
                  SettingsBeveledButton(
                    label = "SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE",
                    topColor = Color(0xFF0A2E2B),
                    bottomColor = TabletShellBg,
                    borderColor = TabletTealBorder,
                    textColor = TabletTealBorder,
                    isCompactPhone = isCompactPhone,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    heightOverride = if (isCompactPhone) 32.dp else 36.dp,
                    onClick = onRequestGoogleSignIn,
                  )
                }
              }
            }

            // Right Column: Music/SFX Toggles, BPM Slider, Volume Sliders, 5 Genre Chips, 36.dp Forge Bar
            Column(
              modifier =
                Modifier.weight(0.64f)
                  .fillMaxHeight()
                  .background(TabletCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                  .border(1.dp, TabletTealBorder.copy(alpha = 0.55f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                  .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 12.dp),
              verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            ) {
              Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              ) {
                Row(
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(7.dp),
                  modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).padding(end = 6.dp),
                ) {
                  Text(
                    text = "SYNTH ENGINE",
                    color = TabletTealBorder,
                    fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 10.5.sp else 12.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    fontFamily = Mono,
                  )
                  Box(
                    modifier =
                      Modifier.background(TabletShellBg, RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                        .border(1.dp, TabletTealBorder.copy(alpha = 0.55f), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                        .padding(horizontal = 7.dp, vertical = 2.5.dp)
                  ) {
                    Text(
                      text = activeMusicSummary,
                      color = Color(0xFF7DD3FC),
                      fontSize = 9.6.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                      fontFamily = Mono,
                      maxLines = 1,
                      overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    )
                  }
                }
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                  SettingsBeveledButton(
                    label = if (musicEnabled) "MUSIC: ON" else "MUSIC: OFF",
                    topColor = if (musicEnabled) Color(0xFF0C2A42) else Color(0xFF2B111C),
                    bottomColor = TabletShellBg,
                    borderColor = if (musicEnabled) TabletTealBorder else Color(0xFFFF3B4E),
                    textColor = if (musicEnabled) TabletTealBorder else Color(0xFFFF6B7A),
                    isCompactPhone = isCompactPhone,
                    heightOverride = 28.dp,
                    testTag = "settings_music_toggle_button",
                    onClick = onToggleMusic,
                  )
                  SettingsBeveledButton(
                    label = if (sfxEnabled) "SFX: ON" else "SFX: OFF",
                    topColor = if (sfxEnabled) Color(0xFF0A2E24) else Color(0xFF2B111C),
                    bottomColor = TabletShellBg,
                    borderColor = if (sfxEnabled) Color(0xFF00E676) else Color(0xFFFF3B4E),
                    textColor = if (sfxEnabled) Color(0xFF00E676) else Color(0xFFFF6B7A),
                    isCompactPhone = isCompactPhone,
                    heightOverride = 28.dp,
                    testTag = "settings_sfx_toggle_button",
                    onClick = onToggleSfx,
                  )
                }
              }

              // Sliders Row: Tempo (Left) + Music/SFX Volume (Right)
              Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              ) {
                Column(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.weight(1f)
                      .background(TabletShellBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .border(1.dp, TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.42f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
                  verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
                ) {
                  Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  ) {
                    Text(
                      text = "TEMPO: $musicBpm BPM",
                      color = Color(0xFFFACC15),
                      fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                      fontFamily = Mono,
                    )
                    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
                      listOf(90, 118, 135, 155).forEach { bpmPreset ->
                        val isPresetActive = abs(musicBpm - bpmPreset) <= 1
                        Box(
                          modifier =
                            Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(5.dp))
                              .background(
                                if (isPresetActive) Color(0xFFFACC15) else Color(0xFF0D1D36)
                              )
                              .border(
                                1.dp,
                                if (isPresetActive) Color(0xFFFACC15) else Color(0x66FACC15),
                                RoundedCornerShape(5.dp),
                              )
                              .clickable { onChangeMusicBpm(bpmPreset) }
                              .padding(horizontal = 5.5.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                        ) {
                          Text(
                            text = "$bpmPreset",
                            color = if (isPresetActive) Color(0xFF040914) else Color.White,
                            fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                            fontFamily = Mono,
                          )
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }
                  Slider(
                    value = musicBpm.coerceIn(60, 180).toFloat(),
                    onValueChange = { onChangeMusicBpm(it.roundToInt().coerceIn(60, 180)) },
                    valueRange = 60f..180f,
                    colors =
                      SliderDefaults.colors(
                        thumbColor = Color(0xFFFACC15),
                        activeTrackColor = Color(0xFFFACC15),
                        inactiveTrackColor = Color(0xFF132642),
                      ),
                    modifier =
                      Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(22.dp).testTag("settings_music_bpm_slider"),
                  )
                  Text(
                    text = "60 BPM Ambient  --  180 BPM Overdrive",
                    color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                    fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                    fontFamily = Mono,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                  )
                }

                Column(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.weight(1f)
                      .background(TabletShellBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .border(1.dp, TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.42f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
                  verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
                ) {
                  Text(
                    text = "MUSIC VOL: ${(musicVolume * 100f).roundToInt()}%",
                    color = TabletTealBorder,
                    fontSize = 9.6.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    fontFamily = Mono,
                  )
                  Slider(
                    value = musicVolume.coerceIn(0f, 1f),
                    onValueChange = { onChangeMusicVolume(it.coerceIn(0f, 1f)) },
                    valueRange = 0f..1f,
                    colors =
                      SliderDefaults.colors(
                        thumbColor = TabletTealBorder,
                        activeTrackColor = TabletTealBorder,
                        inactiveTrackColor = Color(0xFF132642),
                      ),
                    modifier =
                      Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(20.dp).testTag("settings_music_volume_slider"),
                  )
                  Text(
                    text = "SFX VOL: ${(sfxVolume * 100f).roundToInt()}%",
                    color = TabletCyanBorder,
                    fontSize = 9.6.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    fontFamily = Mono,
                  )
                  Slider(
                    value = sfxVolume.coerceIn(0f, 1f),
                    onValueChange = { onChangeSfxVolume(it.coerceIn(0f, 1f)) },
                    valueRange = 0f..1f,
                    colors =
                      SliderDefaults.colors(
                        thumbColor = TabletCyanBorder,
                        activeTrackColor = TabletCyanBorder,
                        inactiveTrackColor = Color(0xFF132642),
                      ),
                    modifier =
                      Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(20.dp).testTag("settings_sfx_volume_slider"),
                  )
                }
              }

              // 5 Synth Genre Preset Chips + Unclipped 36.dp Prompt-to-Synth Track Forge Bar
              Column(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    .background(TabletShellBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .border(1.dp, TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.48f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
              ) {
                Row(
                  modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                ) {
                  Text(
                    text = "GENRES:",
                    color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
                    fontSize = 9.6.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    fontFamily = Mono,
                  )
                  MusicSynthArchetype.entries.forEach { archetype ->
                    val isSelected =
                      activeMusicArchetypeId.equals(archetype.id, ignoreCase = true) &&
                        forgePromptDraft.isBlank()
                    Box(
                      modifier =
                        Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                          .background(
                            Brush.verticalGradient(
                              if (isSelected) listOf(Color(0xFF0E4F5C), Color(0xFF062530))
                              else listOf(Color(0xFF0F2038), TabletShellBg)
                            )
                          )
                          .border(
                            1.dp,
                            if (isSelected) TabletTealBorder else TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.40f),
                            RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
                          )
                          .clickable {
                            forgePromptDraft = ""
                            onSelectMusicArchetype(archetype)
                          }
                          .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
                          .testTag("settings_music_archetype_${archetype.id}"),
                      contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                    ) {
                      Text(
                        text = "${archetype.label} (${archetype.defaultBpm})",
                        color = if (isSelected) TabletTealBorder else Color(0xFFF1F5F9),
                        fontSize = 9.6.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontFamily = Sans,
                        maxLines = 1,
                      )
                    }
                  }
                }

                Row(
                  modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                ) {
                  Box(
                    modifier =
                      Modifier.weight(1f)
                        .height(36.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                        .background(TabletInsetBg)
                        .border(1.dp, TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.55f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                        .padding(horizontal = 10.dp),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.CenterStart,
                  ) {
                    if (forgePromptDraft.isEmpty()) {
                      Text(
                        text =
                          "Prompt custom battle synth (e.g. dark acid bassline, cosmic pad, retro boss)...",
                        color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                        fontSize = 10.sp,
                        fontFamily = Sans,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                      )
                    }
                    BasicTextField(
                      value = forgePromptDraft,
                      onValueChange = { forgePromptDraft = it.take(120) },
                      singleLine = true,
                      cursorBrush = SolidColor(TabletTealBorder),
                      textStyle =
                        TextStyle(
                          color = Color.White,
                          fontSize = 11.sp,
                          fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
                          fontFamily = Sans,
                        ),
                      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag("settings_music_forge_input"),
                    )
                  }
                  Box(
                    modifier =
                      Modifier.height(36.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                        .background(
                          Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF4C1D95), Color(0xFF1E0B42)))
                        )
                        .border(1.dp, Color(0xFFC084FC), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                        .clickable { onForgeCustomMusicPrompt(forgePromptDraft) }
                        .padding(horizontal = 12.dp)
                        .testTag("settings_music_forge_btn"),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                  ) {
                    Text(
                      text = "FORGE TRACK",
                      color = Color(0xFFF3E8FF),
                      fontSize = 10.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                      fontFamily = Mono,
                      maxLines = 1,
                    )
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }

        // SUB-DECK 1: DISPLAY & DETAIL (2-Column Zero-Scroll Split)
        1 -> {
          Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 12.dp),
          ) {
            // Left Column: Camera Zoom / FOV + GRAPHICS DETAIL: LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH
            Column(
              modifier =
                Modifier.weight(1f)
                  .fillMaxHeight()
                  .background(TabletCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                  .border(1.dp, TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.58f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                  .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 12.dp),
              verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            ) {
              Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(7.dp)) {
                val zoomMode =
                  when {
                    cameraZoom <= 0.65f -> "TACTICAL OVERVIEW"
                    cameraZoom >= 1.25f -> "DOGFIGHT CLOSE-UP"
                    else -> "STANDARD ARENA"
                  }
                Text(
                  text =
                    "CAMERA ZOOM / ARENA FOV: ${String.format(Locale.US, "%.2fx", cameraZoom)} ($zoomMode)",
                  color = TabletTealBorder,
                  fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 11.sp else 12.5.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                  fontFamily = Mono,
                  maxLines = 1,
                  overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                )
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                  listOf(0.5f, 0.75f, 1.0f, 1.25f, 1.5f).forEach { preset ->
                    val isSelected = abs(cameraZoom - preset) <= 0.05f
                    Box(
                      modifier =
                        Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                          .background(if (isSelected) TabletTealBorder else TabletShellBg)
                          .border(
                            1.dp,
                            if (isSelected) TabletTealBorder else TabletTealBorder.copy(alpha = 0.45f),
                            RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
                          )
                          .clickable { onChangeCameraZoom(preset) }
                          .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
                    ) {
                      Text(
                        text = "${preset}x",
                        color = if (isSelected) Color(0xFF040914) else Color.White,
                        fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        fontFamily = Mono,
                      )
                    }
                  }
                }
                Slider(
                  value = cameraZoom.coerceIn(0.5f, 1.5f),
                  onValueChange = {
                    onChangeCameraZoom(((it * 20f).roundToInt() / 20f).coerceIn(0.5f, 1.5f))
                  },
                  valueRange = 0.5f..1.5f,
                  colors =
                    SliderDefaults.colors(
                      thumbColor = TabletTealBorder,
                      activeTrackColor = TabletTealBorder,
                      inactiveTrackColor = Color(0xFF132642),
                    ),
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(26.dp).testTag("settings_camera_zoom_slider"),
                )
              }

              Column(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    .background(TabletShellBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .border(1.dp, TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.50f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 7.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
              ) {
                Row(
                  modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                ) {
                  Text(
                    text = "FRAME RATE & QUALITY TIER",
                    color = TabletCyanBorder,
                    fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 10.sp else 11.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    fontFamily = Mono,
                  )
                  Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp)) {
                    listOf(false to "60HZ LOCK", true to "MAX HZ").forEach { (isMax, label) ->
                      val sel = preferMaxHz == isMax
                      Box(
                        modifier =
                          Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                            .background(if (sel) TabletTealBorder else TabletCardBg)
                            .border(
                              1.dp,
                              if (sel) TabletTealBorder else TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.40f),
                              RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
                            )
                            .clickable {
                              RiftCalibrationState.preferMaxRefreshRate = isMax
                              RiftCalibrationState.calibrationRevision++
                              RiftCalibrationState.savePersistedLayout(context)
                            }
                            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 3.5.dp)
                            .testTag(if (isMax) "settings_fps_max_hz" else "settings_fps_60hz"),
                      ) {
                        Text(
                          text = label,
                          color = if (sel) Color(0xFF040914) else Color.White,
                          fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                          fontFamily = Mono,
                        )
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
                Row(
                  modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                ) {
                  val presets =
                    listOf(
                      Triple(0, "PERFORMANCE", "LOW LIGHT"),
                      Triple(1, "BALANCED", "STANDARD"),
                      Triple(2, "ULTRA", "FULL VOLUMETRIC"),
                    )
                  presets.forEach { (tierIdx, tierLabel, subText) ->
                    val selected = activeGraphicsTier == tierIdx
                    val accent =
                      when (tierIdx) {
                        0 -> TabletCyanBorder
                        1 -> TabletTealBorder
                        else -> Color(0xFFC084FC)
                      }
                    Column(
                      modifier =
                        Modifier.weight(1f)
                          .clip(RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
                          .background(
                            if (selected) accent.copy(alpha = 0.22f) else TabletCardBg
                          )
                          .border(
                            1.2.dp,
                            if (selected) accent else TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.35f),
                            RoundedCornerShape(7.dp),
                          )
                          .clickable {
                            RiftCalibrationState.graphicsQualityTier = tierIdx
                            when (tierIdx) {
                              0 -> {
                                RiftVisualForgeState.pointLightEnabled = false
                                RiftVisualForgeState.dynamicLightIntensity = 0.0f
                              }
                              1 -> {
                                RiftVisualForgeState.pointLightEnabled = true
                                RiftVisualForgeState.dynamicLightIntensity = 0.85f
                                RiftVisualForgeState.projectileLightRadius = 0.9f
                              }
                              else -> {
                                RiftVisualForgeState.pointLightEnabled = true
                                RiftVisualForgeState.dynamicLightIntensity = 1.35f
                                RiftVisualForgeState.projectileLightRadius = 1.25f
                              }
                            }
                            RiftCalibrationState.calibrationRevision++
                            RiftVisualForgeState.visualRevision++
                            RiftCalibrationState.savePersistedLayout(context)
                          }
                          .padding(vertical = 5.dp, horizontal = 4.dp)
                          .testTag("settings_gfx_${tierLabel.lowercase(Locale.US)}"),
                      horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                    ) {
                      Text(
                        text = tierLabel,
                        color = if (selected) Color.White else Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
                        fontSize = 10.2.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                        fontFamily = Mono,
                        maxLines = 1,
                      )
                      Text(
                        text = subText,
                        color = if (selected) accent else Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                        fontSize = 9.0.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontFamily = Mono,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                      )
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }

            // Right Column: Playfield Text Scale (75% - 175%) + Presets + Live Dark-Space Preview
            Column(
              modifier =
                Modifier.weight(1f)
                  .fillMaxHeight()
                  .background(TabletCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                  .border(1.dp, TabletTealBorder.copy(alpha = 0.55f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                  .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 12.dp),
              verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            ) {
              Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                Text(
                  text = "PLAYFIELD TEXT SCALE: ${(playfieldTextScale * 100f).roundToInt()}%",
                  color = TabletTealBorder,
                  fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 11.sp else 12.5.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                  fontFamily = Mono,
                )
                Text(
                  text = "Scales world callsigns, Resonance readouts, Rift callouts, and Stasis timers.",
                  color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
                  fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.6.sp else 10.5.sp,
                  fontFamily = Sans,
                  maxLines = 1,
                  overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                )
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                  listOf(0.85f to "85%", 1.0f to "100%", 1.25f to "125%", 1.50f to "150%").forEach {
                    (preset, label) ->
                    val isSelected = abs(playfieldTextScale - preset) <= 0.04f
                    Box(
                      modifier =
                        Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                          .background(if (isSelected) TabletTealBorder else TabletShellBg)
                          .border(
                            1.dp,
                            if (isSelected) TabletTealBorder else TabletTealBorder.copy(alpha = 0.45f),
                            RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
                          )
                          .clickable { onChangePlayfieldTextScale(preset) }
                          .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
                    ) {
                      Text(
                        text = label,
                        color = if (isSelected) Color(0xFF040914) else Color.White,
                        fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        fontFamily = Mono,
                      )
                    }
                  }
                }
                Slider(
                  value = playfieldTextScale.coerceIn(0.75f, 1.75f),
                  onValueChange = {
                    onChangePlayfieldTextScale(((it * 20f).roundToInt() / 20f).coerceIn(0.75f, 1.75f))
                  },
                  valueRange = 0.75f..1.75f,
                  colors =
                    SliderDefaults.colors(
                      thumbColor = TabletTealBorder,
                      activeTrackColor = TabletTealBorder,
                      inactiveTrackColor = Color(0xFF132642),
                    ),
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(26.dp).testTag("settings_text_scale_slider"),
                )
              }

              Box(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(if (isCompactPhone) 68.dp else 88.dp)
                    .background(TabletInsetBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .border(1.dp, TabletTealBorder.copy(alpha = 0.48f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
              ) {
                Canvas(modifier = Modifier.matchParentSize()) {
                  drawSettingsBrackets(
                    4.dp.toPx(),
                    8.dp.toPx(),
                    1.4.dp.toPx(),
                    TabletTealBorder.copy(alpha = 0.65f),
                  )
                }
                Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                  Text(
                    text = "LIVE ARENA CALLSIGN PREVIEW",
                    color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                    fontSize = 10.2.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontFamily = Mono,
                  )
                  Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(3.dp))
                  val previewScale = playfieldTextScale.coerceIn(0.75f, 1.75f)
                  Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
                  ) {
                    Text(
                      text = "[SYN] VIPER_ACE •",
                      color = TabletCyanBorder,
                      fontSize = (12.5f * previewScale).sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                      fontFamily = Mono,
                      maxLines = 1,
                      overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    )
                    ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = (14f * previewScale).dp)
                    Text(
                      text = "350",
                      color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
                      fontSize = (12.5f * previewScale).sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                      fontFamily = Mono,
                      maxLines = 1,
                    )
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }

        // SUB-DECK 2: TWIN-STICK & HUD (Touch HUD Calibration Strip + Controller Schematic & 6 Action Binds)
        2 -> {
          Column(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 5.dp else 7.dp),
          ) {
            TouchHudCalibrationBar(
              context = context,
              isCompactPhone = isCompactPhone,
              onUnlockAndDragHud = {
                RiftCalibrationState.isUiUnlockedForDragging = true
                RiftCalibrationState.calibrationRevision++
                onCloseModal()
              },
            )
            ControllerDiagramAndMapperCard(
              context = context,
              modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
            )
          }
        }

        // SUB-DECK 3: CODEX (Embedded Tactical Ship, Buff & Rift Field Manual inside HELM SYSTEMS)
        else -> {
          Box(
            modifier =
              Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                .background(TabletCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF34D399).copy(alpha = 0.55f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp)),
          ) {
            CodexModal(
              isNexusStreaming = isNexusStreaming,
              onOpenNexus = onOpenNexusFromCodex,
              onCloseModal = onCloseModal,
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (showSwitchAccountConfirmModal) {
    Box(
      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxSize()
          .background(Color(0xD802050B))
          .clickable { showSwitchAccountConfirmModal = false }
          .testTag("settings_switch_account_confirm_modal"),
      contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
      Surface(
        modifier =
          Modifier.widthIn(min = 290.dp, max = 460.dp)
            .fillMaxWidth(0.78f)
            .clickable(enabled = false) {}
            .border(
              1.4.dp,
              Brush.linearGradient(listOf(Color(0xFFFACC15), TabletTealBorder, TabletCyanBorder)),
              RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
            ),
        color = TabletShellBg,
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
      ) {
        Column(
          modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 18.dp, vertical = 14.dp),
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "CONFIRM ACCOUNT SWITCH",
            color = Color(0xFFFEF08A),
            fontSize = 11.5.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = Mono,
            letterSpacing = 0.6.sp,
          )
          Text(
            text =
              "Switch to another Pilot account? Your current cloud progress is saved, and you will return to the Pilot sign-in screen.",
            color = Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
            fontSize = 10.5.sp,
            lineHeight = 14.5.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
            fontFamily = Sans,
          )
          Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp, Alignment.End),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          ) {
            Box(
              modifier =
                Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
                  .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                  .background(TabletCardBg)
                  .border(1.dp, TabletTealBorder, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                  .clickable { showSwitchAccountConfirmModal = false }
                  .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 7.dp)
                  .testTag("settings_switch_cancel_btn"),
              contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
            ) {
              Text(
                text = "[CANCEL]",
                color = TabletTealBorder,
                fontSize = 10.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                fontFamily = Mono,
              )
            }
            Box(
              modifier =
                Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
                  .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                  .background(Color(0xFF2B2208))
                  .border(1.2.dp, Color(0xFFFACC15), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                  .clickable {
                    showSwitchAccountConfirmModal = false
                    onSwitchAccount()
                  }
                  .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 7.dp)
                  .testTag("settings_switch_confirm_btn"),
              contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
            ) {
              Text(
                text = "[SWITCH ACCOUNT]",
                color = Color(0xFFFEF08A),
                fontSize = 10.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                fontFamily = Mono,
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  }
}

@Composable
fun ControllerDiagramAndMapperCard(context: Context, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
  val isCompactPhone = LocalConfiguration.current.screenHeightDp < 480
  val rev = RiftCalibrationState.calibrationRevision
  val isGamepadConnected = RiftCalibrationState.gamepadConnected
  var listeningSlot by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
  var feedbackBanner by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
  val mapperFocusRequester = remember { FocusRequester() }

  val pulseTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "controllerHighlightPulse")
  val pulseAlpha by
    pulseTransition.animateFloat(
      initialValue = 0.45f,
      targetValue = 1.0f,
      animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(520), RepeatMode.Reverse),
      label = "pulseAlpha",
    )

  LaunchedEffect(listeningSlot) {
    if (listeningSlot != null) runCatching { mapperFocusRequester.requestFocus() }
  }

  val activeListeningInfo =
    remember(listeningSlot) { REMAPPABLE_ACTION_SLOTS.find { it.slotId == listeningSlot } }
  val highlightedHardwareCode =
    remember(listeningSlot, rev) {
      listeningSlot?.let { RiftCalibrationState.getBindingForActionSlot(it) }
    }

  Row(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .fillMaxWidth()
        .background(TabletCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
        .border(1.dp, TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.58f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
        .focusRequester(mapperFocusRequester)
        .focusable()
        .onPreviewKeyEvent { keyEvent ->
          val slot = listeningSlot ?: return@onPreviewKeyEvent false
          val native = keyEvent.nativeKeyEvent
          if (native.action == KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN && native.repeatCount == 0) {
            val code =
              when (native.keyCode) {
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L2 -> RiftCalibrationState.BIND_LT
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R2 -> RiftCalibrationState.BIND_RT
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_A,
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_B,
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_X,
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_Y,
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L1,
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R1,
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_THUMBL,
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_THUMBR,
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP,
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN,
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_LEFT,
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_RIGHT -> native.keyCode
                else -> null
              }
            if (code != null) {
              RiftCalibrationState.gamepadConnected = true
              RiftCalibrationState.assignControllerBinding(slot, code, context)
              val slotTitle =
                REMAPPABLE_ACTION_SLOTS.find { it.slotId == slot }?.title ?: slot
              feedbackBanner =
                "BOUND [$slotTitle] TO [${RiftCalibrationState.getBindingLabel(code)}]"
              listeningSlot = null
              true
            } else false
          } else false
        }
        .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 10.dp)
        .testTag("controller_diagram_and_mapper_card"),
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 10.dp),
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
  ) {
    // Left (0.50f): Contoured Vector Twin-Stick Gamepad Schematic
    TwinStickControllerSchematicCanvas(
      modifier =
        Modifier.weight(0.50f)
          .fillMaxHeight()
          .background(TabletShellBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .border(1.dp, TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.45f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .testTag("controller_schematic_canvas"),
      revision = rev,
      highlightedCode = highlightedHardwareCode,
      pulseAlpha = pulseAlpha,
    )

    // Right (0.50f): Status Header + [RESET BINDS] + 2x3 Action Slot Grid + Hardware Bind Chips
    Column(
      modifier = Modifier.weight(0.50f).fillMaxHeight(),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
    ) {
      Row(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .background(TabletShellBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .border(1.dp, TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.45f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 5.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      ) {
        Row(
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
          modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
        ) {
          Box(
            modifier =
              Modifier.size(7.dp)
                .clip(CircleShape)
                .background(if (isGamepadConnected) Color(0xFF22C55E) else TabletCyanBorder)
          )
          Text(
            text =
              if (isGamepadConnected) "GAMEPAD LINKED" else "TOUCH HUD + GAMEPAD READY",
            color = if (isGamepadConnected) Color(0xFF4ADE80) else TabletTealBorder,
            fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.5.sp else 10.2.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = Mono,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          )
        }
        SettingsBeveledButton(
          label = "[RESET BINDS]",
          topColor = Color(0xFF1A243B),
          bottomColor = TabletShellBg,
          borderColor = Color(0xFFFACC15),
          textColor = Color(0xFFFEF08A),
          isCompactPhone = isCompactPhone,
          heightOverride = 26.dp,
          testTag = "btn_reset_default_controller_binds",
          onClick = {
            RiftCalibrationState.resetControllerBindingsToDefault(context)
            listeningSlot = null
            feedbackBanner =
              "RESTORED DEFAULT BINDS (RT=MAIN, R1=BUFF, LT=BRAKE, X=SEC, A=REPEL, Y=MULTI)"
          },
        )
      }

      if (activeListeningInfo != null) {
        Row(
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .background(TabletShellBg, RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
