              .border(1.2.dp, Color(0xFFFACC15), RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
              .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "PRESS KEY OR TAP CHIP FOR [${activeListeningInfo.title}]...",
            color = Color(0xFFFEF08A),
            fontSize = 9.5.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = Mono,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
          )
          Text(
            text = "[CANCEL]",
            color = Color(0xFFF87171),
            fontSize = 9.5.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = Mono,
            modifier = Modifier.padding(start = 6.dp).clickable { listeningSlot = null },
          )
        }
      } else if (feedbackBanner != null) {
        Row(
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .background(Color(0xFF062420), RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
              .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF10B981), RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
              .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
          Text(
            text = feedbackBanner ?: "",
            color = Color(0xFF6EE7B7),
            fontSize = 9.5.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = Mono,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
          )
          Text(
            text = "[X]",
            color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
            fontSize = 9.5.sp,
            fontFamily = Mono,
            modifier = Modifier.padding(start = 6.dp).clickable { feedbackBanner = null },
          )
        }
      }

      // 2x3 Remappable Action Slot Grid
      Column(
        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 4.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
      ) {
        REMAPPABLE_ACTION_SLOTS.chunked(2).forEach { pair ->
          Row(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
          ) {
            pair.forEach { slotInfo ->
              val isListening = listeningSlot == slotInfo.slotId
              val boundCode =
                remember(rev, slotInfo.slotId) {
                  RiftCalibrationState.getBindingForActionSlot(slotInfo.slotId)
                }
              val boundLabel = remember(boundCode) { RiftCalibrationState.getBindingLabel(boundCode) }
              val bracketColor =
                if (slotInfo.slotId == "PRIMARY_FIRE" || slotInfo.slotId == "MULTI_TOGGLE") {
                  Color(0xFFFACC15)
                } else {
                  TabletTealBorder
                }

              Box(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.weight(1f)
                    .fillMaxHeight()
                    .testTag("controller_bind_slot_${slotInfo.slotId}")
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .background(
                      Brush.verticalGradient(
                        if (isListening) listOf(Color(0xFF1A2842), TabletShellBg)
                        else listOf(Color(0xFF0A172D), TabletShellBg)
                      )
                    )
                    .border(
                      if (isListening) 1.5.dp else 1.dp,
                      if (isListening) Color(0xFFFACC15) else bracketColor.copy(alpha = 0.55f),
                      RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                    )
                    .clickable {
                      listeningSlot =
                        if (listeningSlot == slotInfo.slotId) null else slotInfo.slotId
                    }
              ) {
                Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                  val cCol = if (isListening) Color(0xFFFACC15) else bracketColor
                  drawSettingsBrackets(0f, 7.dp.toPx(), 1.6.dp.toPx(), cCol)
                  val gx = size.width * 0.18f
                  val gy = size.height * 0.28f
                  val gw = 22.dp.toPx()
                  val gh = 12.dp.toPx()
                  drawRoundRect(
                    TabletInsetBg,
                    Offset(gx - gw * 0.5f, gy - gh * 0.5f),
                    Size(gw, gh),
                    CornerRadius(4f, 4f),
                  )
                  drawRoundRect(
                    Color(0xFF475569),
                    Offset(gx - gw * 0.5f, gy - gh * 0.5f),
                    Size(gw, gh),
                    CornerRadius(4f, 4f),
                    style = Stroke(width = 1.2f),
                  )
                  val dotOffset =
                    when (boundCode) {
                      RiftCalibrationState.BIND_LT,
                      KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L1 -> Offset(gx - gw * 0.34f, gy - gh * 0.48f)
                      RiftCalibrationState.BIND_RT,
                      KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R1 -> Offset(gx + gw * 0.34f, gy - gh * 0.48f)
                      KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_Y -> Offset(gx + gw * 0.26f, gy - gh * 0.22f)
                      KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_X -> Offset(gx + gw * 0.14f, gy)
                      KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_B -> Offset(gx + gw * 0.38f, gy)
                      else -> Offset(gx + gw * 0.26f, gy + gh * 0.22f)
                    }
                  drawCircle(cCol, 2.8.dp.toPx(), dotOffset)
                }

                Column(
                  modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(horizontal = 7.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
                  verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                ) {
                  Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.End,
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  ) {
                    Box(
                      modifier =
                        Modifier.background(
                            if (isListening) Color(0xFFFACC15) else TabletInsetBg,
                            RoundedCornerShape(4.dp),
                          )
                          .border(
                            1.dp,
                            if (isListening) Color(0xFFFACC15) else bracketColor,
                            RoundedCornerShape(4.dp),
                          )
                          .padding(horizontal = 5.dp, vertical = 1.dp)
                    ) {
                      Text(
                        text = if (isListening) "PRESS..." else "[$boundLabel]",
                        color = if (isListening) Color(0xFF040914) else bracketColor,
                        fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                        fontFamily = Mono,
                      )
                    }
                  }
                  Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(1.dp)) {
                    Text(
                      text = slotInfo.title,
                      color = Color.White,
                      fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.5.sp else 10.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                      fontFamily = Mono,
                      maxLines = 1,
                      overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    )
                    Text(
                      text = slotInfo.subtitle,
                      color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                      fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 8.6.sp else 9.2.sp,
                      lineHeight = 10.5.sp,
                      maxLines = 1,
                      overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    )
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Hardware Bind Chips Strip
      Row(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .background(TabletShellBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .border(1.dp, TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.45f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
            .horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      ) {
        Text(
          text = if (listeningSlot != null) "BIND CHIP:" else "CHIPS:",
          color = if (listeningSlot != null) Color(0xFFFACC15) else Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
          fontSize = 9.5.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = Mono,
        )
        HARDWARE_BIND_CHIPS.forEach { (hwCode, hwLabel) ->
          val actionOnChip =
            remember(rev, hwCode) { RiftCalibrationState.getActionForBinding(hwCode) }
          val isHighlighted = highlightedHardwareCode == hwCode
          Box(
            modifier =
              Modifier.testTag("controller_hw_chip_$hwCode")
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                .background(
                  when {
                    isHighlighted -> Color(0xFF1A2842)
                    listeningSlot != null -> Color(0xFF0E223D)
                    else -> TabletCardBg
                  }
                )
                .border(
                  1.dp,
                  when {
                    isHighlighted -> Color(0xFFFACC15)
                    listeningSlot != null -> TabletCyanBorder
                    else -> TabletCyanBorder.copy(alpha = 0.38f)
                  },
                  RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
                )
                .clickable {
                  val activeSlot = listeningSlot ?: "PRIMARY_FIRE"
                  RiftCalibrationState.assignControllerBinding(activeSlot, hwCode, context)
                  val slotTitle =
                    REMAPPABLE_ACTION_SLOTS.find { it.slotId == activeSlot }?.title ?: activeSlot
                  feedbackBanner = "BOUND [$slotTitle] TO [$hwLabel]"
                  listeningSlot = null
                }
                .padding(horizontal = 7.dp, vertical = 3.5.dp),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
          ) {
            Text(
              text = if (actionOnChip != null) "$hwLabel ($actionOnChip)" else hwLabel,
              color = if (isHighlighted) Color(0xFFFEF08A) else Color.White,
              fontSize = 9.5.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = Mono,
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun TwinStickControllerSchematicCanvas(
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
  revision: Int,
  highlightedCode: Int?,
  pulseAlpha: Float,
) {
  val ltAction =
    remember(revision) {
      RiftCalibrationState.getActionForBinding(RiftCalibrationState.BIND_LT) ?: "UNBOUND"
    }
  val rtAction =
    remember(revision) {
      RiftCalibrationState.getActionForBinding(RiftCalibrationState.BIND_RT) ?: "UNBOUND"
    }
  val l1Action =
    remember(revision) {
      RiftCalibrationState.getActionForBinding(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L1) ?: "MENU TAB"
    }
  val r1Action =
    remember(revision) {
      RiftCalibrationState.getActionForBinding(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R1) ?: "UNBOUND"
    }
  val xAction =
    remember(revision) {
      RiftCalibrationState.getActionForBinding(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_X) ?: "UNBOUND"
    }
  val yAction =
    remember(revision) {
      RiftCalibrationState.getActionForBinding(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_Y) ?: "UNBOUND"
    }
  val aAction =
    remember(revision) {
      RiftCalibrationState.getActionForBinding(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_A) ?: "UNBOUND"
    }
  val bAction =
    remember(revision) {
      RiftCalibrationState.getActionForBinding(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_B) ?: "UNBOUND"
    }

  val labelPaint = remember {
    Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
      typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.MONOSPACE, Typeface.BOLD)
      textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
    }
  }

  Canvas(modifier = modifier) {
    val w = size.width
    val h = size.height
    val cx = w * 0.5f
    val cy = h * 0.54f
    drawSettingsBrackets(5.dp.toPx(), 10.dp.toPx(), 1.5f, TabletTealBorder.copy(alpha = 0.58f))

    fun strokeForCode(code: Int, defaultColor: Color): Color =
      if (highlightedCode == code) Color(0xFFFACC15).copy(alpha = pulseAlpha) else defaultColor

    val bodyW = w * 0.44f
    val bodyH = h * 0.48f
    val bodyLeft = cx - bodyW * 0.5f
    val bodyTop = cy - bodyH * 0.46f
    val bodyRight = cx + bodyW * 0.5f
    val bodyBottom = cy + bodyH * 0.54f
    val trigW = bodyW * 0.24f
    val trigH = h * 0.075f
    val ltCenter = Offset(bodyLeft + bodyW * 0.20f, bodyTop - trigH * 1.48f)
    val rtCenter = Offset(bodyRight - bodyW * 0.20f, bodyTop - trigH * 1.48f)
    val l1Center = Offset(bodyLeft + bodyW * 0.20f, bodyTop - trigH * 0.54f)
    val r1Center = Offset(bodyRight - bodyW * 0.20f, bodyTop - trigH * 0.54f)

    fun drawShoulder(
      code: Int,
      center: Offset,
      wScale: Float,
      hScale: Float,
      rad: Float,
      fillCol: Color,
      strokeCol: Color,
      baseStroke: Float,
    ) {
      val topLeft = Offset(center.x - trigW * wScale * 0.5f, center.y - trigH * hScale * 0.5f)
      val sz = Size(trigW * wScale, trigH * hScale)
      drawRoundRect(
        if (highlightedCode == code) Color(0xFF1A2842) else fillCol,
        topLeft,
        sz,
        CornerRadius(rad, rad),
      )
      drawRoundRect(
        strokeForCode(code, strokeCol),
        topLeft,
        sz,
        CornerRadius(rad, rad),
        style = Stroke(width = if (highlightedCode == code) 3.2f else baseStroke),
      )
    }
    drawShoulder(
      RiftCalibrationState.BIND_LT,
      ltCenter,
      0.96f,
      0.90f,
      7f,
      Color(0xFF0A1F38),
      TabletTealBorder,
      1.8f,
    )
    drawShoulder(
      RiftCalibrationState.BIND_RT,
      rtCenter,
      0.96f,
      0.90f,
      7f,
      Color(0xFF142038),
      Color(0xFFFACC15),
      1.8f,
    )
    drawShoulder(
      KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L1,
      l1Center,
      1.04f,
      0.80f,
      6f,
      Color(0xFF0E1B30),
      Color(0xFF94A3B8),
      1.6f,
    )
    drawShoulder(
      KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R1,
      r1Center,
      1.04f,
      0.80f,
      6f,
      Color(0xFF092624),
      TabletTealBorder,
      1.6f,
    )

    val gamepadPath =
      Path().apply {
        moveTo(bodyLeft + bodyW * 0.16f, bodyTop)
        lineTo(bodyRight - bodyW * 0.16f, bodyTop)
        cubicTo(
          bodyRight + bodyW * 0.08f,
          bodyTop,
          bodyRight + bodyW * 0.15f,
          cy - bodyH * 0.05f,
          bodyRight + bodyW * 0.13f,
          cy + bodyH * 0.22f,
        )
        cubicTo(
          bodyRight + bodyW * 0.15f,
          bodyBottom + bodyH * 0.36f,
          bodyRight - bodyW * 0.02f,
          bodyBottom + bodyH * 0.40f,
          bodyRight - bodyW * 0.10f,
          bodyBottom + bodyH * 0.34f,
        )
        cubicTo(
          bodyRight - bodyW * 0.19f,
          bodyBottom + bodyH * 0.26f,
          bodyRight - bodyW * 0.22f,
          bodyBottom + bodyH * 0.02f,
          bodyRight - bodyW * 0.26f,
          bodyBottom - bodyH * 0.06f,
        )
        lineTo(bodyLeft + bodyW * 0.26f, bodyBottom - bodyH * 0.06f)
        cubicTo(
          bodyLeft + bodyW * 0.22f,
          bodyBottom + bodyH * 0.02f,
          bodyLeft + bodyW * 0.19f,
          bodyBottom + bodyH * 0.26f,
          bodyLeft + bodyW * 0.10f,
          bodyBottom + bodyH * 0.34f,
        )
        cubicTo(
          bodyLeft + bodyW * 0.02f,
          bodyBottom + bodyH * 0.40f,
          bodyLeft - bodyW * 0.15f,
          bodyBottom + bodyH * 0.36f,
          bodyLeft - bodyW * 0.13f,
          cy + bodyH * 0.22f,
        )
        cubicTo(
          bodyLeft - bodyW * 0.15f,
          cy - bodyH * 0.05f,
          bodyLeft - bodyW * 0.08f,
          bodyTop,
          bodyLeft + bodyW * 0.16f,
          bodyTop,
        )
        close()
      }
    drawPath(
      gamepadPath,
      Brush.verticalGradient(
        listOf(Color(0xFF1A2840), Color(0xFF091326)),
        startY = bodyTop,
        endY = bodyBottom + bodyH * 0.38f,
      ),
    )
    drawPath(gamepadPath, TabletCyanBorder, style = Stroke(width = 2.2.dp.toPx()))

    val seamCol = Color(0xFFFACC15).copy(alpha = 0.72f)
    drawPath(
      Path().apply {
        moveTo(bodyLeft + bodyW * 0.05f, bodyTop + bodyH * 0.16f)
        quadraticTo(
          bodyLeft - bodyW * 0.05f,
          cy + bodyH * 0.16f,
          bodyLeft + bodyW * 0.06f,
          bodyBottom + bodyH * 0.24f,
        )
      },
      seamCol,
      style = Stroke(width = 1.4.dp.toPx()),
    )
    drawPath(
      Path().apply {
        moveTo(bodyRight - bodyW * 0.05f, bodyTop + bodyH * 0.16f)
        quadraticTo(
          bodyRight + bodyW * 0.05f,
          cy + bodyH * 0.16f,
          bodyRight - bodyW * 0.06f,
          bodyBottom + bodyH * 0.24f,
        )
      },
      seamCol,
      style = Stroke(width = 1.4.dp.toPx()),
    )

    val lStickCenter = Offset(cx - bodyW * 0.25f, cy - bodyH * 0.08f)
    val rStickCenter = Offset(cx + bodyW * 0.14f, cy + bodyH * 0.20f)
    val stickRadius = bodyH * 0.19f
    fun drawThumbStick(center: Offset, code: Int, mainCol: Color, innerRingCol: Color) {
      drawCircle(TabletInsetBg, stickRadius, center)
      drawCircle(strokeForCode(code, mainCol), stickRadius, center, style = Stroke(width = 2.2f))
      drawCircle(innerRingCol, stickRadius * 0.72f, center, style = Stroke(width = 1.4f))
      drawCircle(mainCol.copy(alpha = 0.42f), stickRadius * 0.42f, center)
      drawCircle(mainCol, stickRadius * 0.42f, center, style = Stroke(width = 1.4f))
    }
    drawThumbStick(
      lStickCenter,
      KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_THUMBL,
      TabletTealBorder,
      Color(0xFF1E293B),
    )
    drawThumbStick(
      rStickCenter,
      KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_THUMBR,
      Color(0xFFC084FC),
      Color(0xFFFACC15).copy(alpha = 0.65f),
    )

    val dpadCenter = Offset(cx - bodyW * 0.14f, cy + bodyH * 0.20f)
    val dArm = stickRadius * 0.76f
    val dThick = stickRadius * 0.46f
    drawRoundRect(
      TabletShellBg,
      Offset(dpadCenter.x - dArm, dpadCenter.y - dThick * 0.5f),
      Size(dArm * 2f, dThick),
      CornerRadius(3f, 3f),
    )
    drawRoundRect(
      TabletShellBg,
      Offset(dpadCenter.x - dThick * 0.5f, dpadCenter.y - dArm),
      Size(dThick, dArm * 2f),
      CornerRadius(3f, 3f),
    )
    drawRoundRect(
      Color(0xFF64748B),
      Offset(dpadCenter.x - dArm, dpadCenter.y - dThick * 0.5f),
      Size(dArm * 2f, dThick),
      CornerRadius(3f, 3f),
      style = Stroke(width = 1.3f),
    )
    drawRoundRect(
      Color(0xFF64748B),
      Offset(dpadCenter.x - dThick * 0.5f, dpadCenter.y - dArm),
      Size(dThick, dArm * 2f),
      CornerRadius(3f, 3f),
      style = Stroke(width = 1.3f),
    )
    val chevCol = TabletCyanBorder
    val chevOff = dArm * 0.62f
    listOf(Offset(0f, -chevOff), Offset(0f, chevOff), Offset(-chevOff, 0f), Offset(chevOff, 0f))
      .forEach { d -> drawCircle(chevCol, 2.0f, dpadCenter + d) }

    val faceClusterCenter = Offset(cx + bodyW * 0.26f, cy - bodyH * 0.08f)
    val faceOffset = stickRadius * 0.78f
    val btnR = stickRadius * 0.36f
    val yPos = Offset(faceClusterCenter.x, faceClusterCenter.y - faceOffset)
    val xPos = Offset(faceClusterCenter.x - faceOffset, faceClusterCenter.y)
    val bPos = Offset(faceClusterCenter.x + faceOffset, faceClusterCenter.y)
    val aPos = Offset(faceClusterCenter.x, faceClusterCenter.y + faceOffset)

    listOf(
        Triple(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_Y, yPos, Color(0xFFFACC15) to "Y"),
        Triple(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_X, xPos, TabletTealBorder to "X"),
        Triple(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_B, bPos, Color(0xFFEF4444) to "B"),
        Triple(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_A, aPos, TabletCyanBorder to "A"),
      )
      .forEach { (code, pos, colAndLetter) ->
        val (col, letter) = colAndLetter
        val isHi = highlightedCode == code
        val isBound = RiftCalibrationState.getActionForBinding(code) != null
        drawCircle(if (isHi) Color(0xFF1A2842) else TabletShellBg, btnR, pos)
        drawCircle(
          strokeForCode(code, if (isBound) col else col.copy(alpha = 0.65f)),
          btnR,
          pos,
          style = Stroke(width = if (isHi) 3.2f else if (isBound) 2.2f else 1.6f),
        )
        drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.apply {
          labelPaint.color = android.graphics.Color.WHITE
          labelPaint.textSize = btnR * 1.15f
          labelPaint.textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
          drawText(letter, pos.x, pos.y + btnR * 0.40f, labelPaint)
        }
      }

    fun drawCalloutLabel(
      anchor: Offset,
      elbowX: Float,
      calloutX: Float,
      yFrac: Float,
      text: String,
      hex: String,
      alignLeft: Boolean,
    ) {
      val argb = android.graphics.Color.parseColor(hex)
      val cCol = Color(argb)
      val elbowPos = Offset(w * elbowX, h * yFrac)
      val calloutPos = Offset(w * calloutX, h * yFrac)
      drawCircle(cCol, 2.6f, anchor)
      drawLine(cCol.copy(alpha = 0.80f), anchor, elbowPos, 1.5f)
      drawLine(cCol.copy(alpha = 0.80f), elbowPos, calloutPos, 1.5f)
      drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.apply {
        labelPaint.color = argb
        labelPaint.textSize = (h * 0.048f).coerceIn(13f, 20f)
        labelPaint.textAlign = if (alignLeft) Paint.Align.LEFT else Paint.Align.RIGHT
        drawText(text, if (alignLeft) calloutPos.x + 4f else calloutPos.x - 4f, calloutPos.y + 4f, labelPaint)
      }
    }

    drawCalloutLabel(ltCenter, 0.30f, 0.25f, 0.13f, "LT/L2: $ltAction", "#00F5D4", false)
    drawCalloutLabel(l1Center, 0.30f, 0.25f, 0.25f, "L1/LB: $l1Action", "#CBD5E1", false)
    drawCalloutLabel(lStickCenter, 0.30f, 0.25f, 0.50f, "L-STICK: FLIGHT", "#00F5D4", false)
    drawCalloutLabel(dpadCenter, 0.30f, 0.25f, 0.80f, "D-PAD: ZOOM/HANGAR", "#94A3B8", false)
    drawCalloutLabel(rtCenter, 0.70f, 0.75f, 0.12f, "RT/R2: $rtAction", "#FACC15", true)
    drawCalloutLabel(r1Center, 0.70f, 0.75f, 0.23f, "R1/RB: $r1Action", "#00F5D4", true)
    drawCalloutLabel(yPos, 0.71f, 0.75f, 0.35f, "Y: $yAction", "#FACC15", true)
    drawCalloutLabel(xPos, 0.71f, 0.75f, 0.46f, "X: $xAction", "#00F5D4", true)
    drawCalloutLabel(bPos, 0.71f, 0.75f, 0.57f, "B: $bAction", "#EF4444", true)
    drawCalloutLabel(aPos, 0.71f, 0.75f, 0.68f, "A: $aAction", "#38BDF8", true)
    drawCalloutLabel(rStickCenter, 0.70f, 0.75f, 0.82f, "R-STICK: 360 AIM", "#C084FC", true)
  }
}

@Composable
private fun TouchHudCalibrationBar(
  context: Context,
  isCompactPhone: Boolean,
  onUnlockAndDragHud: () -> Unit,
) {
  val rev = RiftCalibrationState.calibrationRevision
  val floating = remember(rev, RiftCalibrationState.touchFloatingJoystick) {
    RiftCalibrationState.touchFloatingJoystick
  }
  val swapped = remember(rev, RiftCalibrationState.swapLeftRightControls) {
    RiftCalibrationState.swapLeftRightControls
  }
  val deadzone = remember(rev, RiftCalibrationState.touchJoystickDeadzone) {
    RiftCalibrationState.touchJoystickDeadzone
  }
  val sensitivity = remember(rev, RiftCalibrationState.touchJoystickSensitivity) {
    RiftCalibrationState.touchJoystickSensitivity
  }

  Column(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
        .background(TabletCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
        .border(1.dp, Color(0xFFC084FC).copy(alpha = 0.60f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
        .padding(horizontal = if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 10.dp, vertical = if (isCompactPhone) 5.dp else 6.dp)
        .testTag("settings_touch_hud_calibration_bar"),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
  ) {
    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
      Text(
        text = "TOUCH TWIN-STICK:",
        color = TabletTealBorder,
        fontSize = 9.8.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
        fontFamily = Mono,
      )
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
            .background(if (floating) TabletTealBorder else TabletShellBg)
            .border(1.dp, TabletTealBorder, RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
            .clickable {
              RiftCalibrationState.touchFloatingJoystick = !floating
              RiftCalibrationState.calibrationRevision++
              RiftCalibrationState.savePersistedLayout(context)
            }
            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
            .testTag("settings_btn_toggle_floating_stick"),
      ) {
        Text(
          text = if (floating) "STICK: FLOATING" else "STICK: FIXED ANCHOR",
          color = if (floating) Color(0xFF040914) else Color.White,
          fontSize = 9.4.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = Mono,
        )
      }
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
            .background(if (swapped) Color(0xFFC084FC) else TabletShellBg)
            .border(1.dp, Color(0xFFC084FC), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
            .clickable {
              RiftCalibrationState.swapLeftRightControls = !swapped
              RiftCalibrationState.calibrationRevision++
              RiftCalibrationState.savePersistedLayout(context)
            }
            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
            .testTag("settings_btn_swap_left_right"),
      ) {
        Text(
          text = if (swapped) "HANDS: SWAPPED (R-MOVE / L-FIRE)" else "HANDS: STANDARD (L-MOVE / R-FIRE)",
          color = if (swapped) Color(0xFF040914) else Color.White,
          fontSize = 9.4.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = Mono,
        )
      }
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
            .background(Color(0xFF1F1606))
            .border(1.dp, Color(0xFFFACC15), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
            .clickable { onUnlockAndDragHud() }
            .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
            .testTag("settings_btn_unlock_drag_hud"),
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "[UNLOCK & DRAG HUD]",
          color = Color(0xFFFEF08A),
          fontSize = 9.4.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = Mono,
        )
      }
    }
    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "DEADZONE ${(deadzone * 100f).roundToInt()}%",
          color = TabletCyanBorder,
          fontSize = 9.2.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = Mono,
        )
        Slider(
          value = deadzone.coerceIn(0.02f, 0.30f),
          onValueChange = {
            RiftCalibrationState.touchJoystickDeadzone = it.coerceIn(0.02f, 0.30f)
            RiftCalibrationState.calibrationRevision++
            RiftCalibrationState.savePersistedLayout(context)
          },
          valueRange = 0.02f..0.30f,
          colors =
            SliderDefaults.colors(
              thumbColor = TabletCyanBorder,
              activeTrackColor = TabletCyanBorder,
              inactiveTrackColor = Color(0xFF132642),
            ),
          modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).height(18.dp).testTag("settings_touch_deadzone_slider"),
        )
      }
      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "SENS ${String.format(Locale.US, "%.2fx", sensitivity)}",
          color = Color(0xFFC084FC),
          fontSize = 9.2.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = Mono,
        )
        Slider(
          value = sensitivity.coerceIn(0.60f, 1.80f),
          onValueChange = {
            RiftCalibrationState.touchJoystickSensitivity = it.coerceIn(0.60f, 1.80f)
            RiftCalibrationState.calibrationRevision++
            RiftCalibrationState.savePersistedLayout(context)
          },
          valueRange = 0.60f..1.80f,
          colors =
            SliderDefaults.colors(
              thumbColor = Color(0xFFC084FC),
              activeTrackColor = Color(0xFFC084FC),
              inactiveTrackColor = Color(0xFF132642),
            ),
          modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).height(18.dp).testTag("settings_touch_sensitivity_slider"),
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

private val NON_SYNDICATE_TAGS =
  LocalPilotPrefs.NON_PLAYER_SYNDICATE_TAGS + RiftGameEngine.LEGACY_FOUNDRY_TAGS

@Composable
private fun SyndicateCrestBadge(
  tag: String,
  localPrefs: LocalPilotPrefs,
  currentPlayerTag: String,
  sizeDp: Dp = 36.dp,
) {
  val visualRev = RiftVisualForgeState.visualRevision
  val activePlayerCrest = RiftVisualForgeState.activeSyndicateCrestRecipe
  val normalizedTag = tag.trim().take(4).uppercase(Locale.US)
  val crestBitmap =
    remember(normalizedTag, currentPlayerTag, visualRev, activePlayerCrest) {
      val savedRaw =
        if (normalizedTag.isNotEmpty() && normalizedTag !in NON_SYNDICATE_TAGS) {
          localPrefs.getSyndicateCrestJson(normalizedTag)
        } else {
          null
        }
      val resolvedRecipe =
        when {
          !savedRaw.isNullOrBlank() ->
            runCatching { SyndicateCrestRecipe.fromJson(JSONObject(savedRaw)) }
              .getOrElse {
                SyndicateCrestRecipe.synthesizeFromPrompt(
                  "Syndicate $normalizedTag crest",
                  variationSalt = normalizedTag.hashCode(),
                )
              }
          normalizedTag.isNotEmpty() &&
            normalizedTag.equals(currentPlayerTag.trim(), ignoreCase = true) -> activePlayerCrest
          else ->
            SyndicateCrestRecipe.synthesizeFromPrompt(
              "Syndicate ${normalizedTag.ifEmpty { "RIFT" }} crest",
              variationSalt = normalizedTag.ifEmpty { "RIFT" }.hashCode(),
            )
        }
      RiftSpriteBaker.bakeSyndicateCrestBitmap(
          recipe = resolvedRecipe,
          tagText = normalizedTag,
          sizePx = 128,
        )
        .asImageBitmap()
    }

  Image(
    bitmap = crestBitmap,
    contentDescription = "Syndicate Crest $normalizedTag",
    filterQuality = FilterQuality.High,
    modifier = Modifier.size(sizeDp),
  )
}

@Composable
private fun VectorCitadelEmblem(accent: Color, sizeDp: Dp = 18.dp) {
  val shieldPath = remember { Path() }
  Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size(sizeDp)) {
    val cx = size.width * 0.5f
    val cy = size.height * 0.5f
    val r = size.minDimension * 0.44f
    shieldPath.reset()
    shieldPath.moveTo(cx, cy - r)
    shieldPath.lineTo(cx + r * 0.86f, cy - r * 0.42f)
    shieldPath.lineTo(cx + r * 0.68f, cy + r * 0.44f)
    shieldPath.lineTo(cx, cy + r)
    shieldPath.lineTo(cx - r * 0.68f, cy + r * 0.44f)
    shieldPath.lineTo(cx - r * 0.86f, cy - r * 0.42f)
    shieldPath.close()
    drawPath(shieldPath, accent.copy(alpha = 0.20f))
    drawPath(shieldPath, accent, style = Stroke(width = 1.5.dp.toPx()))
    drawCircle(Color.White, radius = r * 0.22f, center = Offset(cx, cy))
  }
}

@Composable
private fun VectorPadlockGlyph(color: Color, sizeDp: Dp = 12.dp) {
  Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size(sizeDp)) {
    val w = size.width
    val h = size.height
    val shackleW = w * 0.48f
    val shackleLeft = (w - shackleW) * 0.5f
    drawArc(
      color = color,
      startAngle = 180f,
      sweepAngle = 180f,
      useCenter = false,
      topLeft = Offset(shackleLeft, h * 0.10f),
      size = Size(shackleW, h * 0.46f),
      style = Stroke(width = 1.4.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
    )
    drawRoundRect(
      color = color,
      topLeft = Offset(w * 0.20f, h * 0.44f),
      size = Size(w * 0.60f, h * 0.46f),
      cornerRadius = CornerRadius(2.dp.toPx(), 2.dp.toPx()),
      style = Stroke(width = 1.4.dp.toPx()),
    )
  }
}

@Composable
private fun VectorStrikeWingGlyph(accent: Color, sizeDp: Dp = 18.dp) {
  val wingPath = remember { Path() }
  Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size(sizeDp)) {
    val w = size.width
    val h = size.height
    wingPath.reset()
    wingPath.moveTo(w * 0.50f, h * 0.10f)
    wingPath.lineTo(w * 0.92f, h * 0.78f)
    wingPath.lineTo(w * 0.50f, h * 0.60f)
    wingPath.lineTo(w * 0.08f, h * 0.78f)
    wingPath.close()
    drawPath(wingPath, accent.copy(alpha = 0.22f))
    drawPath(wingPath, accent, style = Stroke(width = 1.4.dp.toPx()))
  }
}

@Composable
private fun SyndicateInputBox(
  value: String,
  onValueChange: (String) -> Unit,
  placeholder: String,
  borderColor: Color,
  textColor: Color,
  height: Dp,
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
  enabled: Boolean = true,
  fontFamily: FontFamily = Mono,
  fontSizeSp: Float = 11.5f,
  testTag: String,
  onFocusChange: (Boolean) -> Unit,
  onDone: () -> Unit,
) {
  Box(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .height(height)
        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
        .background(Color(0xFF040914))
        .border(1.dp, borderColor, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
        .padding(horizontal = 10.dp),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.CenterStart,
  ) {
    if (value.isEmpty()) {
      Text(
        text = placeholder,
        fontSize = 10.2.sp,
        color = Color(0xFF64748B),
        fontFamily = fontFamily,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
      )
    }
    BasicTextField(
      value = value,
      onValueChange = onValueChange,
      enabled = enabled,
      readOnly = !enabled,
      singleLine = true,
      cursorBrush = SolidColor(borderColor),
      keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(imeAction = ImeAction.Done),
      keyboardActions = KeyboardActions(onDone = { onDone() }),
      textStyle =
        TextStyle(
          color = textColor,
          fontSize = fontSizeSp.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = fontFamily,
        ),
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().onFocusChanged { onFocusChange(it.isFocused) }.testTag(testTag),
    )
  }
}

  val id: String,

)

@Composable
fun SyndicatesModal(
  currentSyndicateTag: String,
  currentSyndicateName: String,
  remainingLockDays: Int,
  remainingLockFormatted: String,
  directoryList: List<SyndicateInfo>,
  rosterMembers: List<SyndicateMemberEntry>,
  activeShipsInSector: List<ShipEntity>,
  achievements: List<PilotAchievement>,
  statusBannerMessage: String?,
  onJoinSyndicate: (SyndicateInfo) -> Unit,
  onLeaveSyndicate: () -> Unit,
  onCreateCustomSyndicate: (tag: String, name: String, motto: String) -> Unit,
  pendingSyndicateInvites: List<PendingSyndicateInvite> = emptyList(),
  isInviteOnlySyndicate: Boolean = false,
  officerCallsigns: Set<String> = emptySet(),
  canManageSyndicateRoster: Boolean = false,
  isSyndicateFounder: Boolean = false,
  onAcceptSyndicateInvite: (PendingSyndicateInvite) -> Unit = {},
  onDeclineSyndicateInvite: (PendingSyndicateInvite) -> Unit = {},
  onInvitePilotToSyndicate: (String) -> Unit = {},
  onToggleInviteOnlySyndicate: (Boolean) -> Unit = {},
  onToggleSyndicateOfficer: (callsign: String, makeOfficer: Boolean) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  onKickSyndicateMember: (callsign: String) -> Unit = {},
  onCloseModal: () -> Unit = {},
) {
  val isCompactPhone = LocalConfiguration.current.screenHeightDp < 480
  val context = LocalContext.current
  val localPrefs = remember(context) { LocalPilotPrefs(context) }
  val isDrifter = remember(currentSyndicateTag) { localPrefs.isGuestBypassEnabled() }
  var activeTab by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }

  val isRealEnlistedSyndicate =
    !isDrifter && currentSyndicateTag.trim().uppercase(Locale.US) !in NON_SYNDICATE_TAGS

  Column(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        .imePadding()
        .background(CitadelTabletBg, RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
        .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 8.dp)
        .testTag("syndicates_modal")
  ) {
    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(if (isCompactPhone) 30.dp else 36.dp),
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
    ) {
      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
      ) {
        if (isRealEnlistedSyndicate) {
          SyndicateCrestBadge(
            tag = currentSyndicateTag,
            localPrefs = localPrefs,
            currentPlayerTag = currentSyndicateTag,
            sizeDp = if (isCompactPhone) 28.dp else 34.dp,
          )
        } else {
          VectorCitadelEmblem(
            accent = CitadelTeal,
            sizeDp = if (isCompactPhone) 20.dp else 24.dp,
          )
        }
        val headerLabel =
          if (isRealEnlistedSyndicate) {
            "SYNDICATE CITADEL // [$currentSyndicateTag] $currentSyndicateName"
          } else if (isDrifter) {
            "SYNDICATE CITADEL // [RFT] RIFT DRIFTER"
          } else {
            "SYNDICATE CITADEL // INDEPENDENT PILOT"
          }
        Text(
          text = headerLabel,
          color = Color.White,
          fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 12.5.sp else 14.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = Sans,
          letterSpacing = 0.6.sp,
          maxLines = 1,
          overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        )
        val isWarnBadge = remainingLockDays > 0 || !isRealEnlistedSyndicate
        Row(
          modifier =
            Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
              .background(CitadelCardBg)
              .border(
                1.dp,
                if (isWarnBadge) CitadelGold else CitadelCyan,
                RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
              )
              .padding(horizontal = 7.dp, vertical = 2.5.dp),
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
        ) {
          if (remainingLockDays > 0) {
            VectorPadlockGlyph(color = CitadelGold, sizeDp = 11.dp)
          } else {
            Box(
              modifier =
                Modifier.size(6.dp)
                  .clip(CircleShape)
                  .background(if (isRealEnlistedSyndicate) Color(0xFF10B981) else CitadelGold)
            )
          }
          Text(
            text =
              when {
                remainingLockDays > 0 -> "LOCK: $remainingLockFormatted"
                !isRealEnlistedSyndicate -> "UNAFFILIATED PILOT"
                else -> "ENLISTED (15d LOCK)"
              },
            color = if (isWarnBadge) CitadelGold else CitadelCyan,
            fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.5.sp else 10.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = Mono,
            maxLines = 1,
          )
        }
      }
    }

    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(if (isCompactPhone) 4.dp else 6.dp))

    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
    ) {
      SyndicateTabButton(
        label = "1. DIRECTORY & JOIN",
        selected = activeTab == 0,
        onClick = { activeTab = 0 },
        tag = "syndicate_tab_directory",
      )
      SyndicateTabButton(
        label = "2. SYNDICATE ROSTER",
        selected = activeTab == 1,
        onClick = { activeTab = 1 },
        tag = "syndicate_tab_roster",
      )
      SyndicateTabButton(
        label = if (isCompactPhone) "3. LEADERS & MEDALS" else "3. RESONANCE TARGETS & MEDALS",
        selected = activeTab == 2,
        onClick = { activeTab = 2 },
        tag = "syndicate_tab_bounties",
      )
      SyndicateTabButton(
        label = "4. CREATE SYNDICATE",
        selected = activeTab == 3,
        onClick = { activeTab = 3 },
        tag = "syndicate_tab_create",
      )
    }

    if (isDrifter) {
      Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(if (isCompactPhone) 3.dp else 5.dp))
      Row(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .background(CitadelCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .border(1.2.dp, CitadelGold, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = if (isCompactPhone) 4.dp else 5.dp)
            .testTag("syndicate_drifter_lock_banner"),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
      ) {
        VectorPadlockGlyph(color = CitadelGold, sizeDp = 12.dp)
        Text(
          text =
            "DRIFTERS WEAR THE [RFT] TAG. SIGN IN AS A SWORN PILOT IN HELM SYSTEMS TO JOIN OR CHARTER A SYNDICATE.",
          color = CitadelGold,
          fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.5.sp else 10.2.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
          fontFamily = Mono,
          maxLines = 1,
          overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        )
      }
    } else if (!isRealEnlistedSyndicate && !isCompactPhone) {
      Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .background(CitadelCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .border(1.dp, CitadelGold.copy(alpha = 0.65f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
      ) {
        Text(
          text =
            "INDEPENDENT PILOT STATUS: Join or charter a real-player Syndicate below to unlock Syndicate Wars & forged Syndicate Crests (15-day allegiance lock).",
          color = Color(0xFFFEF08A),
          fontSize = 10.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
          fontFamily = Sans,
          maxLines = 1,
          overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        )
      }
    }

    if (!statusBannerMessage.isNullOrBlank()) {
      Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(3.dp))
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .background(CitadelCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.60f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
      ) {
        Text(
          text = statusBannerMessage,
          color = CitadelCyan,
          fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.6.sp else 10.5.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = Sans,
          maxLines = 1,
          overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        )
      }
    }

    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(if (isCompactPhone) 4.dp else 6.dp))

    Box(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
      when (activeTab) {
        0 ->
          DirectoryAndJoinPane(
            currentSyndicateTag = currentSyndicateTag,
            isDrifter = isDrifter,
            localPrefs = localPrefs,
            remainingLockDays = remainingLockDays,
            remainingLockFormatted = remainingLockFormatted,
            directoryList = directoryList,
            pendingSyndicateInvites = pendingSyndicateInvites,
            onAcceptSyndicateInvite = onAcceptSyndicateInvite,
            onDeclineSyndicateInvite = onDeclineSyndicateInvite,
            onJoinSyndicate = onJoinSyndicate,
            onSelectCreateTab = { activeTab = 3 },
          )
        1 ->
          MySyndicateRosterPane(
            currentSyndicateTag = currentSyndicateTag,
            currentSyndicateName = currentSyndicateName,
            isDrifter = isDrifter,
            isRealEnlistedSyndicate = isRealEnlistedSyndicate,
            localPrefs = localPrefs,
            remainingLockDays = remainingLockDays,
            remainingLockFormatted = remainingLockFormatted,
            rosterMembers = rosterMembers,
            isInviteOnlySyndicate = isInviteOnlySyndicate,
            officerCallsigns = officerCallsigns,
            canManageSyndicateRoster = canManageSyndicateRoster,
            isSyndicateFounder = isSyndicateFounder,
            onLeaveSyndicate = onLeaveSyndicate,
            onInvitePilotToSyndicate = onInvitePilotToSyndicate,
            onToggleInviteOnlySyndicate = onToggleInviteOnlySyndicate,
            onToggleSyndicateOfficer = onToggleSyndicateOfficer,
            onKickSyndicateMember = onKickSyndicateMember,
            onOpenDirectoryTab = { activeTab = 0 },
            onOpenCharterTab = { activeTab = 3 },
          )
        2 ->
          ResonanceTargetsAndAchievementsPane(
            activeShipsInSector = activeShipsInSector,
            achievements = achievements,
          )
        else ->
          CreateSyndicatePane(
            currentPlayerTag = currentSyndicateTag,
            isDrifter = isDrifter,
            localPrefs = localPrefs,
            remainingLockDays = remainingLockDays,
            remainingLockFormatted = remainingLockFormatted,
            onCreateCustomSyndicate = onCreateCustomSyndicate,
          )
      }
    }
  }
}

private enum class SquadronSortMode {
  ACTIVITY,
  RESONANCE,
}

private fun squadronActivityPriority(isOnline: Boolean, statusLabel: String): Int {
  if (!isOnline) return 0
  val upper = statusLabel.uppercase(Locale.US)
  return if (
    upper.contains("COMBAT") ||
      (upper.contains("IN ") && !upper.contains("HUB") && !upper.contains("LOBBY"))
  ) {
    2
  } else {
    1
  }
}

@Composable
private fun SquadronSortTogglePill(
  label: String,
  selected: Boolean,
  accent: Color,
  tag: String,
  onClick: () -> Unit,
) {
  Box(
    modifier =
      Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
        .background(if (selected) accent.copy(alpha = 0.24f) else CitadelCardBg)
        .border(1.dp, if (selected) accent else Color(0xFF334155), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
        .clickable { onClick() }
        .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
        .testTag(tag),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
    Text(
      text = label,
      color = if (selected) Color.White else Color(0xFF94A3B8),
      fontSize = 8.8.sp,
      fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
      fontFamily = Mono,
      maxLines = 1,
    )
  }
}

@Composable
fun ArmadaFleetModal(
  currentSyndicateTag: String,
  activeArmadaName: String,
  armadaTierLabel: String,
  armadaSlots: List<ArmadaMemberSlot>,
  friendsList: List<FriendPilotEntry>,
  blockedPilotUids: Set<String> = emptySet(),
  statusBannerMessage: String?,
  onCreateOrRenameArmada: (String) -> Unit,
  onInviteFriendToArmada: (FriendPilotEntry) -> Unit,
  onRequestJoinFriendArmada: (FriendPilotEntry) -> Unit,
  onRemoveArmadaMember: (String) -> Unit,
  onSimulateRosterShift4To2: () -> Unit = {},
  onLeaveArmadaToSolo: () -> Unit,
  onAddFriendByCallsign: (String) -> Unit,
  onBlockPilot: (uid: String, callsign: String) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  onReportPilot: (uid: String, callsign: String) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  onCloseModal: () -> Unit = {},
) {
  val isCompactPhone = LocalConfiguration.current.screenHeightDp < 480
  var squadronSortMode by remember { mutableStateOf(SquadronSortMode.ACTIVITY) }
  val realArmadaSlots =
    remember(armadaSlots) {
      armadaSlots.filter {
        !it.callsign.contains("[BOT]", ignoreCase = true) &&
          !it.syndicateTag.equals("BOT", ignoreCase = true) &&
          !it.uid.startsWith("bot_", ignoreCase = true)
      }
    }
  val isDeployedInArmada = activeArmadaName.isNotEmpty() && realArmadaSlots.isNotEmpty()

  Column(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        .imePadding()
        .background(CitadelTabletBg, RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
        .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 8.dp)
        .testTag("armada_fleet_modal")
  ) {
    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(if (isCompactPhone) 32.dp else 36.dp),
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
    ) {
      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
      ) {
        VectorStrikeWingGlyph(
          accent = if (isDeployedInArmada) Color(0xFF10B981) else CitadelCyan,
          sizeDp = if (isCompactPhone) 18.dp else 22.dp,
        )
        Text(
          text =
            if (isCompactPhone) "SQUADRON COMMAND (1–5 PILOTS)"
            else "SQUADRON COMMAND // 1–5 SWORN PILOT FORMATION",
          color = Color.White,
          fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 12.sp else 13.5.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = Sans,
          letterSpacing = 0.6.sp,
          maxLines = 1,
          overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        )
        Row(
          modifier =
            Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
              .background(CitadelCardBg)
              .border(
                1.dp,
                if (isDeployedInArmada) Color(0xFF10B981) else CitadelCyan,
                RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
              )
              .padding(horizontal = 7.dp, vertical = 2.5.dp),
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
        ) {
          Box(
            modifier =
              Modifier.size(6.dp)
                .clip(CircleShape)
                .background(if (isDeployedInArmada) Color(0xFF10B981) else CitadelCyan)
          )
          Text(
            text =
              if (isDeployedInArmada) {
                "[$activeArmadaName] (${realArmadaSlots.size}/5 • $armadaTierLabel)"
              } else {
                "[SOLO] INDEPENDENT"
              },
            color = if (isDeployedInArmada) Color(0xFF34D399) else CitadelCyan,
            fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.2.sp else 9.8.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = Mono,
            maxLines = 1,
          )
        }
      }

      Row(
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "SORT:",
          color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
          fontSize = 8.6.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = Mono,
        )
        SquadronSortTogglePill(
          label = "ACTIVITY",
          selected = squadronSortMode == SquadronSortMode.ACTIVITY,
          accent = Color(0xFF00F5D4),
          tag = "squadron_sort_activity",
          onClick = { squadronSortMode = SquadronSortMode.ACTIVITY },
        )
        SquadronSortTogglePill(
          label = "RESONANCE",
          selected = squadronSortMode == SquadronSortMode.RESONANCE,
          accent = CitadelGold,
          tag = "squadron_sort_resonance",
          onClick = { squadronSortMode = SquadronSortMode.RESONANCE },
        )
      }
    }

    if (!statusBannerMessage.isNullOrBlank()) {
      Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .background(CitadelCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.60f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
      ) {
        Text(
          text = statusBannerMessage,
          color = CitadelCyan,
          fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.6.sp else 10.8.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = Sans,
          maxLines = 1,
          overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        )
      }
    }

    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(if (isCompactPhone) 4.dp else 8.dp))

    Box(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
      ArmadaAndFriendsTabPane(
        activeArmadaName = activeArmadaName,
        armadaTierLabel = armadaTierLabel,
        armadaSlots = realArmadaSlots,
        friendsList = friendsList,
        sortMode = squadronSortMode,
        blockedPilotUids = blockedPilotUids,
        onCreateOrRenameArmada = onCreateOrRenameArmada,
        onInviteFriendToArmada = onInviteFriendToArmada,
        onRequestJoinFriendArmada = onRequestJoinFriendArmada,
        onRemoveArmadaMember = onRemoveArmadaMember,
        onLeaveArmadaToSolo = onLeaveArmadaToSolo,
        onAddFriendByCallsign = onAddFriendByCallsign,
        onBlockPilot = onBlockPilot,
        onReportPilot = onReportPilot,
      )
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun DirectoryAndJoinPane(
  currentSyndicateTag: String,
  isDrifter: Boolean,
  localPrefs: LocalPilotPrefs,
  remainingLockDays: Int,
  remainingLockFormatted: String,
  directoryList: List<SyndicateInfo>,
  pendingSyndicateInvites: List<PendingSyndicateInvite> = emptyList(),
  onAcceptSyndicateInvite: (PendingSyndicateInvite) -> Unit = {},
  onDeclineSyndicateInvite: (PendingSyndicateInvite) -> Unit = {},
  onJoinSyndicate: (SyndicateInfo) -> Unit,
  onSelectCreateTab: () -> Unit = {},
) {
  val isCompactPhone = LocalConfiguration.current.screenHeightDp < 480
  var rankingMode by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }

  val mergedDirectory =
    remember(directoryList, currentSyndicateTag, rankingMode) {
      val byTag = linkedMapOf<String, SyndicateInfo>()
      for (item in directoryList) {
        val clean = localPrefs.sanitizeSyndicateTag(item.tag)
        val normalized = item.copy(tag = clean)
        if (clean.isNotEmpty() && localPrefs.isHumanFoundedSyndicateRecord(normalized)) {
          val existing = byTag[clean]
          if (
            existing == null ||
              normalized.memberCount > existing.memberCount ||
              normalized.combinedBounty > existing.combinedBounty
          ) {
            byTag[clean] = normalized
          }
        }
      }
      val mapped = byTag.values.map { syn -> syn to localPrefs.getSyndicateWarRecord(syn.tag) }
      if (rankingMode == 0) {
        mapped.sortedWith(
          compareByDescending<Pair<SyndicateInfo, SyndicateWarRecord>> { it.second.warTrophies }
            .thenByDescending { it.second.warWins }
            .thenByDescending { it.first.combinedBounty }
        )
      } else {
        mapped.sortedWith(
          compareByDescending<Pair<SyndicateInfo, SyndicateWarRecord>> { it.first.combinedBounty }
            .thenByDescending { it.first.memberCount }
            .thenByDescending { it.second.warTrophies }
        )
      }
    }

  Column(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        .background(CitadelCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
        .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.48f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
        .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 10.dp),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 8.dp),
  ) {
    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
      Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .background(if (rankingMode == 0) CitadelGold.copy(alpha = 0.22f) else CitadelTabletBg)
              .border(
                1.dp,
                if (rankingMode == 0) CitadelGold else CitadelGold.copy(alpha = 0.50f),
                RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
              )
              .clickable { rankingMode = 0 }
              .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 5.dp)
              .testTag("syndicate_rank_mode_war_trophies")
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "SYNDICATE WARS LADDER",
            color = if (rankingMode == 0) Color.White else CitadelGold,
            fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.8.sp else 10.8.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
            fontFamily = Mono,
          )
        }
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .background(if (rankingMode == 1) CitadelTeal.copy(alpha = 0.22f) else CitadelTabletBg)
              .border(
                1.dp,
                if (rankingMode == 1) CitadelTeal else CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.50f),
                RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
              )
              .clickable { rankingMode = 1 }
              .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 5.dp)
              .testTag("syndicate_rank_mode_collective_prestige")
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "COLLECTIVE MEMBER PRESTIGE",
            color = if (rankingMode == 1) Color.White else CitadelTeal,
            fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.8.sp else 10.8.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
            fontFamily = Mono,
          )
        }
      }
      if (!isCompactPhone) {
        Text(
          text =
            if (rankingMode == 0) "RANKED BY SYNDICATE WAR TROPHIES"
            else "RANKED BY COMBINED MEMBER RESONANCE & ROSTER SIZE",
          color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
          fontSize = 9.6.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = Mono,
        )
      }
    }

    if (pendingSyndicateInvites.isNotEmpty()) {
      Column(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .background(Color(0xFF0A1E36), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .border(1.dp, CitadelGold.copy(alpha = 0.72f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
            .testTag("syndicate_pending_invites_card"),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "INCOMING SYNDICATE INVITES (${pendingSyndicateInvites.size})",
          color = CitadelGold,
          fontSize = 10.2.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
          fontFamily = Mono,
        )
        for (inv in pendingSyndicateInvites.take(3)) {
          Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          ) {
            Text(
              text = "[${inv.syndicateTag}] ${inv.syndicateName} // INVITED BY ${inv.inviterCallsign}",
              color = Color.White,
              fontSize = 10.8.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = Sans,
              maxLines = 1,
              overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
              modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            )
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
              Button(
                onClick = { onAcceptSyndicateInvite(inv) },
                enabled = remainingLockDays <= 0 && !isDrifter,
                colors =
                  ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                    containerColor = CitadelTeal,
                    contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
                    disabledContainerColor = Color(0xFF132238),
                    disabledContentColor = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                  ),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(7.dp),
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                modifier =
                  Modifier.heightIn(min = 48.dp).testTag("accept_syndicate_invite_${inv.syndicateTag}"),
              ) {
                Text("ACCEPT", fontSize = 9.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, fontFamily = Mono)
              }
              Button(
                onClick = { onDeclineSyndicateInvite(inv) },
                colors =
                  ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                    containerColor = Color(0xFF280E1A),
                    contentColor = Color(0xFFFF3B4E),
                  ),
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color(0xFFFF3B4E)),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(7.dp),
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                modifier =
                  Modifier.heightIn(min = 48.dp).testTag("decline_syndicate_invite_${inv.syndicateTag}"),
              ) {
                Text("DECLINE", fontSize = 9.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = Mono)
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (mergedDirectory.isEmpty()) {
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.weight(1f)
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .background(CitadelTabletBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
            .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.45f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
            .padding(16.dp),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
      ) {
        Column(
          horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
        ) {
          VectorCitadelEmblem(accent = CitadelTeal, sizeDp = 30.dp)
          Text(
            text = "NO SWORN SYNDICATES CHARTERED IN THIS SECTOR YET",
            color = CitadelTeal,
            fontSize = 13.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
            fontFamily = Sans,
          )
          Text(
            text =
              "Every Syndicate in RIFT is 100% real-player-founded. Open Tab 4 to charter the first Syndicate!",
            color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
            fontSize = 11.sp,
            fontFamily = Sans,
            textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
          )
          Button(
            onClick = onSelectCreateTab,
            colors =
              ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                containerColor = CitadelGold,
                contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
              ),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
            modifier = Modifier.height(34.dp),
          ) {
            Text(
              text = "CHARTER FIRST SYNDICATE",
              fontSize = 10.5.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = Mono,
            )
          }
        }
      }
    } else {
      LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
      ) {
        items(mergedDirectory, key = { it.first.tag }) { (syn, warRecord) ->
          val isMember =
            !isDrifter && syn.tag.equals(currentSyndicateTag, ignoreCase = true)
          Row(
            modifier =
              Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .background(
                  if (isMember) Color(0xFF0E2542) else CitadelRowBg,
                  RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                )
                .border(
                  1.dp,
                  if (isMember) CitadelGold else CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.38f),
                  RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                )
                .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 10.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          ) {
            Row(
              modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
            ) {
              SyndicateCrestBadge(
                tag = syn.tag,
                localPrefs = localPrefs,
                currentPlayerTag = currentSyndicateTag,
                sizeDp = if (isCompactPhone) 36.dp else 44.dp,
              )
              Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Row(
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                ) {
                  Text(
                    text = "[${syn.tag}] ${syn.name}",
                    color = if (isMember) CitadelGold else CitadelTeal,
                    fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 12.5.sp else 14.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    fontFamily = Sans,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                  )
                  Text(
                    text =
                      "${warRecord.warTrophies} WAR TROPHIES • ${warRecord.warWins}W-${warRecord.warLosses}L • STREAK ${warRecord.warStreak}",
                    color = CitadelGold,
                    fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.8.sp else 10.8.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                    fontFamily = Mono,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                  )
                }
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
                Row(
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
                ) {
                  Text(
                    text = "${syn.memberCount} PILOTS • ${syn.combinedBounty} TOTAL RESONANCE",
                    color = CitadelCyan,
                    fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.8.sp else 10.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontFamily = Mono,
                  )
                  Text(
                    text = "// ${syn.motto.uppercase(Locale.US)}",
                    color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                    fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.6.sp else 10.2.sp,
                    fontFamily = Sans,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                  )
                }
              }
            }
            if (isMember) {
              Box(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.background(Color(0xFF062E22), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF10B981), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
              ) {
                Text(
                  text = "ENLISTED",
                  color = Color(0xFF00E676),
                  fontSize = 10.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                  fontFamily = Mono,
                )
              }
            } else {
              Button(
                onClick = { onJoinSyndicate(syn) },
                enabled = remainingLockDays <= 0 && !isDrifter,
                colors =
                  ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                    containerColor = CitadelTeal,
                    contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
                    disabledContainerColor = Color(0xFF132238),
                    disabledContentColor = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                  ),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                modifier =
                  Modifier.height(if (isCompactPhone) 32.dp else 36.dp)
                    .testTag("join_syndicate_${syn.tag}"),
              ) {
                Text(
                  text =
                    when {
                      isDrifter -> "SWORN PILOT ONLY"
                      remainingLockDays > 0 -> "LOCKED ($remainingLockFormatted)"
                      else -> "JOIN [${syn.tag}]"
                    },
                  fontSize = 10.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                  fontFamily = Mono,
                )
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun MySyndicateRosterPane(
  currentSyndicateTag: String,
  currentSyndicateName: String,
  isDrifter: Boolean,
  isRealEnlistedSyndicate: Boolean,
  localPrefs: LocalPilotPrefs,
  remainingLockDays: Int,
  remainingLockFormatted: String,
  rosterMembers: List<SyndicateMemberEntry>,
  isInviteOnlySyndicate: Boolean = false,
  officerCallsigns: Set<String> = emptySet(),
  canManageSyndicateRoster: Boolean = false,
  isSyndicateFounder: Boolean = false,
  onLeaveSyndicate: () -> Unit,
  onInvitePilotToSyndicate: (String) -> Unit = {},
  onToggleInviteOnlySyndicate: (Boolean) -> Unit = {},
  onToggleSyndicateOfficer: (callsign: String, makeOfficer: Boolean) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  onKickSyndicateMember: (callsign: String) -> Unit = {},
  onOpenDirectoryTab: () -> Unit,
  onOpenCharterTab: () -> Unit,
) {
  val isCompactPhone = LocalConfiguration.current.screenHeightDp < 480
  val focusManager = LocalFocusManager.current
  val keyboardController = LocalSoftwareKeyboardController.current
  var inviteCallsignInput by remember { mutableStateOf("") }

  if (!isRealEnlistedSyndicate) {
    Box(
      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxSize()
          .background(CitadelCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.48f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .padding(16.dp),
      contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
      Column(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth(0.84f)
            .background(CitadelTabletBg, RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
            .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.55f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 18.dp, vertical = if (isCompactPhone) 12.dp else 18.dp),
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 9.dp),
      ) {
        VectorCitadelEmblem(accent = CitadelTeal, sizeDp = 30.dp)
        Text(
          text = "NO ACTIVE SYNDICATE ALLEGIANCE",
          color = CitadelTeal,
          fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 13.sp else 14.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = Sans,
          letterSpacing = 0.6.sp,
        )
        Text(
          text =
            if (isDrifter) {
              "[RFT] Rift Drifters and Independent Pilots operate solo with zero Syndicate command obligations. Sign in as a Sworn Pilot in HELM SYSTEMS, then join an existing player Syndicate in Tab 1 or charter your own in Tab 4."
            } else {
              "Independent Pilots operate solo until pledging to a player-founded Syndicate. Browse active Syndicates in Tab 1 or charter your own 1–3 character Syndicate in Tab 4."
            },
          color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
          fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 10.sp else 11.sp,
          fontFamily = Sans,
          textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
          lineHeight = if (isCompactPhone) 13.5.sp else 15.sp,
        )
        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
          Button(
            onClick = onOpenDirectoryTab,
            colors =
              ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                containerColor = Color(0xFF0284C7),
                contentColor = Color.White,
              ),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
            modifier = Modifier.height(34.dp),
          ) {
            Text("BROWSE DIRECTORY", fontSize = 10.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = Mono)
          }
          Button(
            onClick = onOpenCharterTab,
            colors =
              ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                containerColor = CitadelGold,
                contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
              ),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
            modifier = Modifier.height(34.dp),
          ) {
            Text("CHARTER SYNDICATE", fontSize = 10.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = Mono)
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return
  }

  val humanRoster =
    remember(rosterMembers) {
      rosterMembers.filter {
        !it.callsign.contains("[BOT]", ignoreCase = true) &&
          !it.tag.equals("BOT", ignoreCase = true) &&
          !it.uid.startsWith("bot_", ignoreCase = true)
      }
    }

  Column(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        .background(CitadelCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
        .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.48f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
        .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 12.dp)
  ) {
    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
    ) {
      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
      ) {
        SyndicateCrestBadge(
          tag = currentSyndicateTag,
          localPrefs = localPrefs,
          currentPlayerTag = currentSyndicateTag,
          sizeDp = if (isCompactPhone) 36.dp else 44.dp,
        )
        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
          Text(
            text =
              "ACTIVE ROSTER // [$currentSyndicateTag] $currentSyndicateName (${humanRoster.size} MEMBERS)",
            color = Color.White,
            fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 12.5.sp else 14.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = Sans,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          )
          Text(
            text = "Customize your Syndicate Crest in STAR FORGE",
            color = CitadelTeal,
            fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.6.sp else 10.2.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = Mono,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          )
        }
      }

      Button(
        onClick = onLeaveSyndicate,
        enabled = remainingLockDays <= 0,
        colors =
          ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
            containerColor = Color(0xFF280E1A),
            contentColor = Color(0xFFFF3B4E),
            disabledContainerColor = Color(0xFF132238),
            disabledContentColor = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
          ),
        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (remainingLockDays <= 0) Color(0xFFFF3B4E) else Color(0xFF334155)),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
        modifier =
          Modifier.height(if (isCompactPhone) 32.dp else 34.dp).testTag("leave_syndicate_button"),
      ) {
        Text(
          text =
            if (remainingLockDays > 0) "LEAVE LOCKED ($remainingLockFormatted)"
            else "LEAVE SYNDICATE (15d 00h LOCK)",
          fontSize = 9.8.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = Mono,
        )
      }
    }

    if (canManageSyndicateRoster) {
      Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
      Row(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .background(CitadelTabletBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .border(1.dp, CitadelTeal.copy(alpha = 0.45f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
            .testTag("syndicate_command_invite_bar"),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
      ) {
        SyndicateInputBox(
          value = inviteCallsignInput,
          onValueChange = {
            inviteCallsignInput =
              it.uppercase(Locale.US).replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_-]"), "").take(14)
          },
          placeholder = "INVITE SWORN PILOT CALLSIGN",
          borderColor = CitadelTeal,
          textColor = Color.White,
          height = 48.dp,
          modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
          fontFamily = Mono,
          fontSizeSp = 10.5f,
          testTag = "syndicate_invite_callsign_input",
          onFocusChange = {},
          onDone = {
            keyboardController?.hide()
            focusManager.clearFocus(force = true)
          },
        )
        Button(
          onClick = {
            if (inviteCallsignInput.length >= 2) {
              onInvitePilotToSyndicate(inviteCallsignInput)
              inviteCallsignInput = ""
            }
            keyboardController?.hide()
            focusManager.clearFocus(force = true)
          },
          colors =
            ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
              containerColor = CitadelTeal,
              contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
            ),
          shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
          contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
          modifier =
            Modifier.heightIn(min = 48.dp)
              .testTag("syndicate_invite_pilot_btn"),
        ) {
          Text("INVITE PILOT", fontSize = 9.8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, fontFamily = Mono)
        }
        if (isSyndicateFounder) {
          Button(
            onClick = { onToggleInviteOnlySyndicate(!isInviteOnlySyndicate) },
            colors =
              ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                containerColor = if (isInviteOnlySyndicate) Color(0xFF422006) else Color(0xFF0D253B),
                contentColor = if (isInviteOnlySyndicate) CitadelGold else CitadelCyan,
              ),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (isInviteOnlySyndicate) CitadelGold else CitadelCyan),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
            modifier =
              Modifier.heightIn(min = 48.dp)
                .testTag("syndicate_invite_only_toggle"),
          ) {
            Text(
              text = if (isInviteOnlySyndicate) "INVITE ONLY" else "OPEN JOIN",
              fontSize = 9.5.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = Mono,
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }

    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

    LazyColumn(
      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
    ) {
      items(humanRoster, key = { it.uid }) { member ->
        val shipSpec = RiftCodex.getShipById(member.shipId)
        val upperCallsign = member.callsign.trim().uppercase(Locale.US)
        val isMemberFounder =
          member.role.contains("FOUNDER", ignoreCase = true) ||
            member.role.contains("LEADER", ignoreCase = true)
        val isMemberOfficer =
          !isMemberFounder &&
            (upperCallsign in officerCallsigns || member.role.contains("OFFICER", ignoreCase = true))
        val resolvedRoleLabel =
          when {
            isMemberFounder -> "FOUNDER"
            isMemberOfficer -> "OFFICER"
            else -> "MEMBER"
          }
        Row(
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .background(CitadelRowBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.30f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        ) {
          Row(
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
          ) {
            ShipSpritePreview(shipId = member.shipId, sizeDp = 30)
            Column {
              Text(
                text = "[$currentSyndicateTag] ${member.callsign} • $resolvedRoleLabel",
                color =
                  when {
                    isMemberFounder -> CitadelGold
                    isMemberOfficer -> CitadelTeal
                    else -> Color.White
                  },
                fontSize = 12.5.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = Sans,
              )
              Text(
                text =
                  "HULL: ${shipSpec.name.uppercase(Locale.US)} (${shipSpec.role.uppercase(Locale.US)})",
                color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                fontSize = 10.2.sp,
                fontFamily = Mono,
              )
            }
          }
          Row(
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
          ) {
            Text(
              text = "KILLS: ${member.kills}",
              color = CitadelTeal,
              fontSize = 11.2.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = Mono,
            )
