            Row(
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
            ) {
              ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = 12.dp)
              Text(
                text = "${member.bountyContribution}",
                color = CitadelGold,
                fontSize = 11.5.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = Mono,
              )
            }
            if (!member.isLocalPlayer && !isMemberFounder) {
              if (isSyndicateFounder) {
                Button(
                  onClick = { onToggleSyndicateOfficer(member.callsign, !isMemberOfficer) },
                  colors =
                    ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                      containerColor = Color(0xFF0E203D),
                      contentColor = if (isMemberOfficer) CitadelGold else CitadelCyan,
                    ),
                  border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (isMemberOfficer) CitadelGold else CitadelCyan),
                  shape = RoundedCornerShape(7.dp),
                  contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.heightIn(min = 48.dp).testTag("syndicate_role_toggle_${member.callsign}"),
                ) {
                  Text(
                    text = if (isMemberOfficer) "DEMOTE" else "OFFICER",
                    fontSize = 9.0.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontFamily = Mono,
                  )
                }
              }
              if (isSyndicateFounder || (canManageSyndicateRoster && !isMemberOfficer)) {
                Button(
                  onClick = { onKickSyndicateMember(member.callsign) },
                  colors =
                    ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                      containerColor = Color(0xFF280E1A),
                      contentColor = Color(0xFFFF3B4E),
                    ),
                  border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color(0xFFFF3B4E)),
                  shape = RoundedCornerShape(7.dp),
                  contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.heightIn(min = 48.dp).testTag("syndicate_kick_${member.callsign}"),
                ) {
                  Text("REMOVE", fontSize = 9.0.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = Mono)
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun ResonanceTargetsAndAchievementsPane(
  activeShipsInSector: List<ShipEntity>,
  achievements: List<PilotAchievement>,
) {
  val highResTargets =
    remember(activeShipsInSector) {
      activeShipsInSector
        .filter { it.bounty >= RiftGameEngine.HVT_BOUNTY_THRESHOLD }
        .sortedByDescending { it.bounty }
    }
  Row(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.weight(1f)
          .fillMaxSize()
          .background(CitadelCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .border(1.dp, CitadelGold.copy(alpha = 0.45f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .padding(10.dp)
    ) {
      Text(
        text = "RIFT LEADERS // HIGH-RESONANCE TARGETS (RESONANCE >= 250)",
        color = CitadelGold,
        fontSize = 12.5.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
        fontFamily = Sans,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
      )
      Text(
        text = "ELIMINATE HIGH-RESONANCE TARGETS FOR BONUS RESONANCE & GOLD RADAR PINGS.",
        color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
        fontSize = 10.sp,
        fontFamily = Sans,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
      )
      Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
      if (highResTargets.isEmpty()) {
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.weight(1f)
              .fillMaxWidth()
              .background(CitadelTabletBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.30f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .padding(12.dp),
          contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "NO SWORN PILOTS ABOVE 250 RESONANCE IN ACTIVE SECTOR.",
            color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
            fontSize = 10.2.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = Mono,
            textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
          )
        }
      } else {
        LazyColumn(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
          items(highResTargets, key = { it.id }) { targetShip ->
            Row(
              modifier =
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                  .background(CitadelRowBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                  .border(1.dp, CitadelGold.copy(alpha = 0.60f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                  .padding(8.dp),
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            ) {
              Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
              ) {
                ShipSpritePreview(shipId = targetShip.shipId, sizeDp = 28)
                Column {
                  val armTag =
                    if (targetShip.armadaName.isNotEmpty()) "[${targetShip.armadaName}]" else "[SOLO]"
                  val cleanTargetSyn =
                    targetShip.syndicateTag.trim().uppercase(Locale.US).let { raw ->
                      if (raw in NON_SYNDICATE_TAGS) ""
                      else raw.take(3).let { if (it in NON_SYNDICATE_TAGS) "" else it }
                    }
                  val synPrefix = if (cleanTargetSyn.isNotEmpty()) "[$cleanTargetSyn] " else ""
                  Text(
                    text = "RIFT LEADER // $armTag $synPrefix${targetShip.callsign}",
                    color = CitadelGold,
                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontFamily = Sans,
                  )
                  Text(
                    text =
                      "HULL: ${targetShip.spec.name.uppercase(Locale.US)} • SECTOR (${(targetShip.x / 500f).toInt()},${(targetShip.y / 500f).toInt()})",
                    color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                    fontSize = 10.sp,
                    fontFamily = Mono,
                  )
                }
              }
              Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
              ) {
                ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = 13.dp)
                Text(
                  text = "${targetShip.bounty}",
                  color = Color(0xFFFF3B4E),
                  fontSize = 13.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                  fontFamily = Mono,
                )
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.weight(1f)
          .fillMaxSize()
          .background(CitadelCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .border(1.dp, CitadelTeal.copy(alpha = 0.45f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .padding(10.dp)
    ) {
      Text(
        text = "PILOT COMBAT ACHIEVEMENTS",
        color = CitadelTeal,
        fontSize = 12.5.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
        fontFamily = Sans,
      )
      Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
      LazyColumn(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
        items(achievements, key = { it.id }) { ach ->
          Row(
            modifier =
              Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .background(
                  if (ach.unlocked) Color(0xFF08241E) else CitadelRowBg,
                  RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                )
                .border(
                  1.dp,
                  if (ach.unlocked) Color(0xFF10B981) else CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.35f),
                  RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                )
                .padding(8.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
              Text(
                text = if (ach.unlocked) "[UNLOCKED] ${ach.title}" else "[LOCKED] ${ach.title}",
                color = if (ach.unlocked) Color(0xFF00E676) else CitadelTeal,
                fontSize = 11.8.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = Sans,
              )
              Text(
                text = ach.description.uppercase(Locale.US),
                color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                fontSize = 9.8.sp,
                fontFamily = Sans,
              )
            }
            Text(
              text = ach.progressText,
              color = CitadelGold,
              fontSize = 11.5.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = Mono,
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun CreateSyndicatePane(
  currentPlayerTag: String,
  isDrifter: Boolean,
  localPrefs: LocalPilotPrefs,
  remainingLockDays: Int,
  remainingLockFormatted: String,
  onCreateCustomSyndicate: (tag: String, name: String, motto: String) -> Unit,
) {
  val isCompactPhone = LocalConfiguration.current.screenHeightDp < 480
  val isCooldownLocked = remainingLockDays > 0 || isDrifter

  var tagInput by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
  var nameInput by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
  var mottoInput by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
  var anyFieldFocused by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

  val focusManager = LocalFocusManager.current
  val keyboardController = LocalSoftwareKeyboardController.current
  val inputBoxHeight = 36.dp
  val dismissIme = {
    focusManager.clearFocus()
    keyboardController?.hide()
  }

  Row(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        .background(CitadelCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
        .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.48f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
        .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 12.dp),
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 10.dp else 14.dp),
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
  ) {
    // Left Column (0.32f): Live Forged Crest Preview Pedestal + 15d 00h Allegiance Lock Summary
    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.weight(0.32f)
          .fillMaxHeight()
          .background(CitadelTabletBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .border(1.dp, CitadelTeal.copy(alpha = 0.58f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 10.dp),
      horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceEvenly,
    ) {
      Text(
        text = "LIVE FORGED CREST",
        color = CitadelTeal,
        fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.5.sp else 10.2.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
        fontFamily = Mono,
      )
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.size(if (isCompactPhone) 68.dp else 78.dp)
            .background(Color(0xFF040914), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
            .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.65f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
      ) {
        SyndicateCrestBadge(
          tag = tagInput.ifBlank { "TAG" },
          localPrefs = localPrefs,
          currentPlayerTag = currentPlayerTag,
          sizeDp = if (isCompactPhone) 60.dp else 68.dp,
        )
      }
      Text(
        text = "[${tagInput.ifBlank { "TAG" }}] ${nameInput.ifBlank { "SYNDICATE" }.uppercase(Locale.US)}",
        color = CitadelGold,
        fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.8.sp else 10.8.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
        fontFamily = Mono,
        maxLines = 1,
        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
      )
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .background(CitadelCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
            .border(1.dp, CitadelGold.copy(alpha = 0.50f), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "15d 00h ALLEGIANCE LOCK\nFORGE CREST IN STAR FORGE",
          color = Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
          fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.sp else 9.5.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = Mono,
          textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
          lineHeight = 11.5.sp,
        )
      }
    }

    // Right Column (0.68f): Zero-Scroll Tag/Name Row + Motto Row + Charter Submit Button
    Column(
      modifier = Modifier.weight(0.68f).fillMaxHeight(),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
    ) {
      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
          Text(
            text = "CHARTER OFFICIAL PLAYER SYNDICATE",
            color = Color.White,
            fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 12.sp else 13.8.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
            fontFamily = Sans,
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          )
          if (!isDrifter && remainingLockDays > 0) {
            Text(
              text = "ALLEGIANCE COOLDOWN ACTIVE: $remainingLockFormatted REMAINING",
              color = CitadelGold,
              fontSize = 9.6.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = Mono,
              maxLines = 1,
              overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
            )
          } else {
            Text(
              text = "REGISTERS YOUR 1–3 CHAR [TAG] TO CLOUD DIRECTORY & SYNDICATE WARS",
              color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
              fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.2.sp else 9.8.sp,
              fontFamily = Mono,
              maxLines = 1,
              overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
            )
          }
        }
        if (anyFieldFocused && !isCooldownLocked) {
          Button(
            onClick = { dismissIme() },
            colors =
              ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                containerColor = Color(0xFF00E676),
                contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
              ),
            border = BorderStroke(1.2.dp, Color(0xFF00E676)),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
            modifier =
              Modifier.height(30.dp)
                .shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                .testTag("create_syndicate_done_button"),
          ) {
            Text("DONE", fontSize = 9.8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = Mono)
          }
        }
      }

      Column(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().alpha(if (isCooldownLocked) 0.45f else 1.0f),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 5.dp else 7.dp),
      ) {
        Row(
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
        ) {
          Column(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(0.36f),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
          ) {
            Text(
              text = "TAG (1–3 CHARS)",
              color = CitadelGold,
              fontSize = 9.6.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = Mono,
              maxLines = 1,
            )
            SyndicateInputBox(
              value = tagInput,
              onValueChange = { if (!isCooldownLocked) tagInput = localPrefs.sanitizeSyndicateTag(it) },
              placeholder = "e.g. VEX, A7",
              borderColor = CitadelGold,
              textColor = CitadelGold,
              height = inputBoxHeight,
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
              enabled = !isCooldownLocked,
              fontFamily = Mono,
              fontSizeSp = 12f,
              testTag = "create_syndicate_tag_input",
              onFocusChange = { anyFieldFocused = it },
              onDone = { dismissIme() },
            )
          }
          Column(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(0.64f),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
          ) {
            Text(
              text = "SYNDICATE NAME",
              color = CitadelTeal,
              fontSize = 9.6.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = Mono,
              maxLines = 1,
            )
            SyndicateInputBox(
              value = nameInput,
              onValueChange = { if (!isCooldownLocked) nameInput = it.take(24) },
              placeholder = "Enter Syndicate Name...",
              borderColor = CitadelTeal,
              textColor = Color.White,
              height = inputBoxHeight,
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
              enabled = !isCooldownLocked,
              fontFamily = Sans,
              fontSizeSp = 12f,
              testTag = "create_syndicate_name_input",
              onFocusChange = { anyFieldFocused = it },
              onDone = { dismissIme() },
            )
          }
        }

        Column(
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "SYNDICATE DOCTRINE / MOTTO",
            color = CitadelCyan,
            fontSize = 9.6.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = Mono,
            maxLines = 1,
          )
          SyndicateInputBox(
            value = mottoInput,
            onValueChange = { if (!isCooldownLocked) mottoInput = it.take(60) },
            placeholder = "Enter Syndicate Doctrine or Motto...",
            borderColor = CitadelCyan,
            textColor = Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
            height = inputBoxHeight,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            enabled = !isCooldownLocked,
            fontFamily = Sans,
            fontSizeSp = 11.5f,
            testTag = "create_syndicate_motto_input",
            onFocusChange = { anyFieldFocused = it },
            onDone = { dismissIme() },
          )
        }
      }

      val canSubmit =
        !isDrifter && remainingLockDays <= 0 && tagInput.isNotBlank() && nameInput.length >= 3
      val previewTag = tagInput.ifBlank { "TAG" }
      val previewName = nameInput.ifBlank { "SYNDICATE" }.uppercase(Locale.US)
      Button(
        onClick = {
          dismissIme()
          onCreateCustomSyndicate(tagInput, nameInput, mottoInput)
        },
        enabled = canSubmit,
        colors =
          ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
            containerColor = CitadelGold,
            contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
            disabledContainerColor = Color(0xFF132238),
            disabledContentColor = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
          ),
        border = BorderStroke(1.2.dp, if (canSubmit) CitadelGold else Color(0xFF334155)),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
        modifier =
          Modifier.height(if (isCompactPhone) 36.dp else 40.dp)
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .testTag("create_syndicate_submit_button"),
      ) {
        Text(
          text =
            "CHARTER [$previewTag] $previewName & LOCK FOR 15d 00h",
          fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 10.5.sp else 11.8.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = Mono,
          maxLines = 1,
          overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun ArmadaAndFriendsTabPane(
  activeArmadaName: String,
  armadaTierLabel: String,
  armadaSlots: List<ArmadaMemberSlot>,
  friendsList: List<FriendPilotEntry>,
  sortMode: SquadronSortMode = SquadronSortMode.ACTIVITY,
  blockedPilotUids: Set<String> = emptySet(),
  onCreateOrRenameArmada: (String) -> Unit,
  onInviteFriendToArmada: (FriendPilotEntry) -> Unit,
  onRequestJoinFriendArmada: (FriendPilotEntry) -> Unit,
  onRemoveArmadaMember: (String) -> Unit,
  onLeaveArmadaToSolo: () -> Unit,
  onAddFriendByCallsign: (String) -> Unit,
  onBlockPilot: (uid: String, callsign: String) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  onReportPilot: (uid: String, callsign: String) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
) {
  val isCompactPhone = LocalConfiguration.current.screenHeightDp < 480
  val sortedSquadronSlots =
    remember(armadaSlots, sortMode) {
      when (sortMode) {
        SquadronSortMode.RESONANCE ->
          armadaSlots.sortedWith(
            compareByDescending<ArmadaMemberSlot> { it.resonance }
              .thenByDescending { squadronActivityPriority(it.isOnline, it.activityLabel) }
              .thenByDescending { it.isLeader }
              .thenBy { it.callsign }
          )
        SquadronSortMode.ACTIVITY ->
          armadaSlots.sortedWith(
            compareByDescending<ArmadaMemberSlot> {
                squadronActivityPriority(it.isOnline, it.activityLabel)
              }
              .thenByDescending { it.isLeader }
              .thenByDescending { it.resonance }
              .thenBy { it.callsign }
          )
      }
    }
  val visibleFriends =
    remember(friendsList, blockedPilotUids, sortMode) {
      val filtered =
        friendsList.filter { friend ->
          friend.uid !in blockedPilotUids &&
            !friend.uid.startsWith("friend_custom_") &&
            !friend.uid.startsWith("bot_") &&
            !friend.callsign.contains("[BOT]", ignoreCase = true)
        }
      when (sortMode) {
        SquadronSortMode.RESONANCE ->
          filtered.sortedWith(
            compareByDescending<FriendPilotEntry> { it.bounty }
              .thenByDescending { squadronActivityPriority(it.isOnline, it.statusText) }
              .thenBy { it.callsign }
          )
        SquadronSortMode.ACTIVITY ->
          filtered.sortedWith(
            compareByDescending<FriendPilotEntry> {
                squadronActivityPriority(it.isOnline, it.statusText)
              }
              .thenByDescending { it.bounty }
              .thenBy { it.callsign }
          )
      }
    }
  var armadaNameInput by
    remember(activeArmadaName) { mutableStateOf(activeArmadaName.ifEmpty { "APEX_SQD" }) }
  var newFriendInput by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
  var inputFocused by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

  val buttonCooldownSec = remember { mutableStateMapOf<String, Int>() }
  LaunchedEffect(buttonCooldownSec.keys.toList()) {
    while (buttonCooldownSec.isNotEmpty()) {
      delay(1000L)
      for (k in buttonCooldownSec.keys.toList()) {
        val rem = (buttonCooldownSec[k] ?: 0) - 1
        if (rem <= 0) buttonCooldownSec.remove(k) else buttonCooldownSec[k] = rem
      }
    }
  }

  val focusManager = LocalFocusManager.current
  val keyboardController = LocalSoftwareKeyboardController.current
  val inputBoxHeight = if (isCompactPhone) 34.dp else 38.dp
  val dismissIme = {
    focusManager.clearFocus()
    keyboardController?.hide()
  }

  Row(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 12.dp),
  ) {
    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.width(if (isCompactPhone) 272.dp else 316.dp)
          .fillMaxHeight()
          .background(CitadelCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.48f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 12.dp)
          .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 8.dp),
    ) {
      Text(
        text =
          if (activeArmadaName.isEmpty()) "[STATUS: OPERATING INDEPENDENTLY]"
          else "[SQUADRON: $activeArmadaName] (${sortedSquadronSlots.size}/5 • $armadaTierLabel)",
        color = if (activeArmadaName.isEmpty()) CitadelCyan else Color(0xFF34D399),
        fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 10.5.sp else 11.8.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
        fontFamily = Sans,
      )
      Text(
        text = "SQUADRON TAG (UP TO 14 CHARS)",
        color = CitadelCyan,
        fontSize = 9.5.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = Mono,
      )

      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      ) {
        SyndicateInputBox(
          value = armadaNameInput,
          onValueChange = {
            armadaNameInput =
              it.uppercase(Locale.US).replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_-]"), "").take(14)
          },
          placeholder = "SQUADRON TAG",
          borderColor = CitadelCyan,
          textColor = Color.White,
          height = inputBoxHeight,
          modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
          fontFamily = Mono,
          fontSizeSp = 11f,
          testTag = "armada_name_input",
          onFocusChange = { inputFocused = it },
          onDone = { dismissIme() },
        )
        Button(
          onClick = {
            dismissIme()
            onCreateOrRenameArmada(armadaNameInput)
          },
          colors =
            ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
              containerColor = Color(0xFF10B981),
              contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
            ),
          border = BorderStroke(1.2.dp, Color(0xFF34D399)),
          shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
          contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
          modifier =
            Modifier.height(inputBoxHeight)
              .shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .testTag("form_armada_button"),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = if (activeArmadaName.isEmpty()) "FORM SQD" else "RENAME SQD",
            fontSize = 9.8.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
            fontFamily = Mono,
          )
        }
      }

      Text(
        text =
          if (sortMode == SquadronSortMode.RESONANCE) "ROSTER ORDER: HIGHEST RESONANCE"
          else "ROSTER ORDER: ACTIVITY STATUS",
        color = if (sortMode == SquadronSortMode.RESONANCE) CitadelGold else CitadelTeal,
        fontSize = 8.8.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = Mono,
      )

      Column(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = 60.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
      ) {
        if (sortedSquadronSlots.isEmpty()) {
          Box(
            modifier =
              Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .background(CitadelTabletBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.35f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                .padding(9.dp)
          ) {
            Text(
              text =
                "FLYING [SOLO] IN OPEN SECTOR.\nLINK SWORN PILOTS ON THE RIGHT TO FORM A 1–5 PILOT SQUADRON.",
              color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
              fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.6.sp else 10.2.sp,
              fontFamily = Sans,
            )
          }
        } else {
          sortedSquadronSlots.forEach { slot ->
            val actRank = squadronActivityPriority(slot.isOnline, slot.activityLabel)
            val statusDotCol =
              when (actRank) {
                2 -> Color(0xFF00E676)
                1 -> CitadelCyan
                else -> Color(0xFF64748B)
              }
            Row(
              modifier =
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                  .background(CitadelRowBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                  .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.32f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                  .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            ) {
              Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(7.dp),
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
              ) {
                Box(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.size(8.dp).clip(CircleShape).background(statusDotCol)
                )
                ShipSpritePreview(shipId = slot.shipId, sizeDp = 26)
                Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                  Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
                  ) {
                    Text(
                      text = "[${slot.syndicateTag}] ${slot.callsign}",
                      color = if (slot.isLeader) CitadelGold else Color.White,
                      fontSize = 11.2.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                      fontFamily = Sans,
                      maxLines = 1,
                      overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    )
                    Row(
                      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp),
                    ) {
                      ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = 11.dp)
                      Text(
                        text = "${slot.resonance}",
                        color = CitadelGold,
                        fontSize = 9.0.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        fontFamily = Mono,
                        maxLines = 1,
                      )
                    }
                  }
                  Text(
                    text =
                      "${if (slot.isLeader) "LEADER" else "MEMBER"} • ${slot.activityLabel.uppercase(Locale.US)}",
                    color = if (slot.isOnline) CitadelTeal else Color(0xFF64748B),
                    fontSize = 9.2.sp,
                    fontFamily = Mono,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                  )
                }
              }
              if (!slot.isLeader) {
                Button(
                  onClick = { onRemoveArmadaMember(slot.callsign) },
                  colors =
                    ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                      containerColor = Color(0xFF280E1A),
                      contentColor = Color(0xFFFF3B4E),
                    ),
                  border = BorderStroke(1.2.dp, Color(0xFFFF3B4E)),
                  shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                  contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                  modifier = Modifier.height(28.dp).shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)),
                ) {
                  Text("DROP", fontSize = 9.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = Mono)
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      if (activeArmadaName.isNotEmpty()) {
        Button(
          onClick = onLeaveArmadaToSolo,
          colors =
            ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
              containerColor = Color(0xFF280E1A),
              contentColor = Color(0xFFEF4444),
            ),
          border = BorderStroke(1.2.dp, Color(0xFFEF4444)),
          shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
          contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .height(if (isCompactPhone) 32.dp else 36.dp)
              .shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .testTag("leave_armada_solo_button"),
        ) {
          Text("LEAVE SQUADRON", fontSize = 9.8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = Mono)
        }
      }
    }

    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.weight(1f)
          .fillMaxHeight()
          .background(CitadelCardBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .border(1.dp, CitadelTeal.copy(alpha = 0.48f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .padding(if (isCompactPhone) 8.dp else 12.dp),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 8.dp),
    ) {
      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
      ) {
        Text(
          text =
            if (isCompactPhone) {
              "SWORN PILOTS (${visibleFriends.count { it.isOnline }} ONLINE)"
            } else {
              "VERIFIED SWORN PILOTS & SQUADRON LINK (${visibleFriends.count { it.isOnline }} ONLINE)"
            },
          color = Color.White,
          fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 11.5.sp else 13.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
          fontFamily = Sans,
          maxLines = 1,
          overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
          modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
        )
        Row(
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
        ) {
          SyndicateInputBox(
            value = newFriendInput,
            onValueChange = {
              newFriendInput =
                it.uppercase(Locale.US).replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_-]"), "").take(14)
            },
            placeholder = "SEARCH SWORN PILOT CALLSIGN",
            borderColor = CitadelTeal,
            textColor = Color.White,
            height = inputBoxHeight,
            modifier = Modifier.width(if (isCompactPhone) 158.dp else 192.dp),
            fontFamily = Mono,
            fontSizeSp = 10.5f,
            testTag = "friend_search_input",
            onFocusChange = { inputFocused = it },
            onDone = { dismissIme() },
          )
          Button(
            onClick = {
              if (newFriendInput.length >= 3) {
                onAddFriendByCallsign(newFriendInput)
                newFriendInput = ""
              }
              dismissIme()
            },
            colors =
              ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                containerColor = CitadelTeal,
                contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
              ),
            border = BorderStroke(1.2.dp, CitadelTeal),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
            modifier = Modifier.height(inputBoxHeight).shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)),
          ) {
            Text("LINK PILOT", fontSize = 9.8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = Mono)
          }
          if (inputFocused) {
            Button(
              onClick = { dismissIme() },
              colors =
                ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                  containerColor = Color(0xFF00E676),
                  contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
                ),
              border = BorderStroke(1.2.dp, Color(0xFF00E676)),
              shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
              contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
              modifier =
                Modifier.height(inputBoxHeight)
                  .shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                  .testTag("friend_input_done_button"),
            ) {
              Text("DONE", fontSize = 9.8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = Mono)
            }
          }
        }
      }

      if (visibleFriends.isEmpty()) {
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.weight(1f)
              .fillMaxWidth()
              .background(CitadelTabletBg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.35f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .padding(14.dp),
          contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
          Text(
            text =
              "NO LINKED SWORN PILOTS YET.\nENTER A VERIFIED CLOUD PILOT CALLSIGN ABOVE AND TAP [LINK PILOT] TO RECRUIT.",
            color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
            fontSize = 10.5.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = Mono,
            textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
            lineHeight = 14.5.sp,
          )
        }
      } else {
        LazyColumn(
          modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
        ) {
          items(visibleFriends, key = { it.uid }) { friend ->
            val reqKey = "req_${friend.uid}"
            val invKey = "inv_${friend.uid}"
            val reqRem = buttonCooldownSec[reqKey] ?: 0
            val invRem = buttonCooldownSec[invKey] ?: 0
            Row(
              modifier =
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                  .background(CitadelRowBg, RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
                  .border(1.dp, CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.30f), RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
                  .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = if (isCompactPhone) 6.dp else 8.dp),
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            ) {
              Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
              ) {
                Box(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.size(9.dp)
                      .clip(CircleShape)
                      .background(if (friend.isOnline) Color(0xFF00E676) else Color(0xFF64748B))
                )
                ShipSpritePreview(shipId = friend.shipId, sizeDp = 28)
                Column {
                  val badge =
                    if (friend.currentArmadaName.isNotEmpty()) "[${friend.currentArmadaName}]"
                    else "[SOLO]"
                  Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                  ) {
                    Text(
                      text = "$badge [${friend.syndicateTag}] ${friend.callsign}",
                      color = Color.White,
                      fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 11.8.sp else 13.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                      fontFamily = Sans,
                    )
                    Row(
                      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp),
                    ) {
                      ResonanceCrestIcon(sizeDp = 11.dp)
                      Text(
                        text = "${friend.bounty}",
                        color = CitadelGold,
                        fontSize = 9.6.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        fontFamily = Mono,
                      )
                    }
                  }
                  Text(
                    text = friend.statusText.uppercase(Locale.US),
                    color = if (friend.isOnline) Color(0xFF94A3B8) else Color(0xFF64748B),
                    fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 9.8.sp else 10.5.sp,
                    fontFamily = Mono,
                  )
                }
              }

              Row(
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              ) {
                if (friend.isOnline) {
                  if (friend.currentArmadaName.isNotEmpty() && friend.currentArmadaCount < 5) {
                    val reqLocked = reqRem > 0
                    Button(
                      onClick = {
                        buttonCooldownSec[reqKey] = 10
                        onRequestJoinFriendArmada(friend)
                      },
                      enabled = !reqLocked,
                      colors =
                        ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                          containerColor = if (reqLocked) CitadelTabletBg else Color(0xFF0E203D),
                          contentColor = if (reqLocked) CitadelGold else CitadelCyan,
                          disabledContainerColor = CitadelTabletBg,
                          disabledContentColor = CitadelGold,
                        ),
                      border =
                        BorderStroke(
                          1.2.dp,
                          if (reqLocked) CitadelGold else CitadelCyan,
                        ),
                      shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                      contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                      modifier =
                        Modifier.height(if (isCompactPhone) 30.dp else 34.dp)
                          .shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                          .testTag("request_join_friend_${friend.callsign}"),
                    ) {
                      Text(
                        text = if (reqLocked) "SENT (${reqRem}s)" else "JOIN SQD",
                        fontSize = 9.6.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontFamily = Mono,
                      )
                    }
                  }
                  val invLocked = invRem > 0
                  Button(
                    onClick = {
                      buttonCooldownSec[invKey] = 10
                      onInviteFriendToArmada(friend)
                    },
                    enabled = !invLocked,
                    colors =
                      ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                        containerColor = if (invLocked) CitadelTabletBg else Color(0xFF10B981),
                        contentColor = if (invLocked) CitadelGold else Color(0xFF05080E),
                        disabledContainerColor = CitadelTabletBg,
                        disabledContentColor = CitadelGold,
                      ),
                    border =
                      BorderStroke(
                        1.2.dp,
                        if (invLocked) CitadelGold else Color(0xFF34D399),
                      ),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                    contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                    modifier =
                      Modifier.height(if (isCompactPhone) 30.dp else 34.dp)
                        .shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                        .testTag("invite_friend_${friend.callsign}"),
                  ) {
                    Text(
                      text = if (invLocked) "SENT (${invRem}s)" else "+ INVITE",
                      fontSize = 9.6.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                      fontFamily = Mono,
                    )
                  }
                }
                Button(
                  onClick = { onReportPilot(friend.uid, friend.callsign) },
                  colors =
                    ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                      containerColor = CitadelTabletBg,
                      contentColor = CitadelGold,
                    ),
                  border = BorderStroke(1.2.dp, CitadelGold),
                  shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                  contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 8.dp),
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.height(if (isCompactPhone) 30.dp else 34.dp)
                      .shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .testTag("report_armada_friend_${friend.uid}"),
                ) {
                  Text("RPT", fontSize = 9.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = Mono)
                }
                Button(
                  onClick = { onBlockPilot(friend.uid, friend.callsign) },
                  colors =
                    ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                      containerColor = Color(0xFF280E1A),
                      contentColor = Color(0xFFEF4444),
                    ),
                  border = BorderStroke(1.2.dp, Color(0xFFEF4444)),
                  shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                  contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 8.dp),
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.height(if (isCompactPhone) 30.dp else 34.dp)
                      .shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .testTag("block_armada_friend_${friend.uid}"),
                ) {
                  Text("BLK", fontSize = 9.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = Mono)
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun SyndicateTabButton(
  label: String,
  selected: Boolean,
  onClick: () -> Unit,
  tag: String,
) {
  val isCompactPhone = LocalConfiguration.current.screenHeightDp < 480
  Box(
    modifier =
      Modifier.shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
        .background(if (selected) CitadelTeal.copy(alpha = 0.24f) else CitadelCardBg)
        .border(
          1.2.dp,
          if (selected) CitadelTeal else CitadelCyan.copy(alpha = 0.48f),
          RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
        )
        .clickable { onClick() }
        .padding(
          horizontal = if (isCompactPhone) 9.dp else 12.dp,
          vertical = if (isCompactPhone) 4.5.dp else 6.dp,
        )
        .testTag(tag)
  ) {
    Text(
      text = label,
      color = if (selected) Color.White else Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
      fontSize = if (isCompactPhone) 10.sp else 11.2.sp,
      fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
      fontFamily = Mono,
      maxLines = 1,
    )
  }
}

package com.example.ui.theme

import android.os.Build
import androidx.compose.foundation.isSystemInDarkTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.darkColorScheme
import androidx.compose.material3.dynamicDarkColorScheme
import androidx.compose.material3.dynamicLightColorScheme
import androidx.compose.material3.lightColorScheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext

private val DarkColorScheme =
  darkColorScheme(primary = Purple80, secondary = PurpleGrey80, tertiary = Pink80)

private val LightColorScheme =
  lightColorScheme(
    primary = Purple40,
    secondary = PurpleGrey40,
    tertiary = Pink40,

    /* Other default colors to override
    background = Color(0xFFFFFBFE),
    surface = Color(0xFFFFFBFE),
    onPrimary = Color.White,
    onSecondary = Color.White,
    onTertiary = Color.White,
    onBackground = Color(0xFF1C1B1F),
    onSurface = Color(0xFF1C1B1F),
    */
  )

@Composable
fun MyApplicationTheme(
  darkTheme: Boolean = isSystemInDarkTheme(),
  // Dynamic color is available on Android 12+
  dynamicColor: Boolean = true,
  content: @Composable () -> Unit,
) {
  val colorScheme =
    when {
      dynamicColor && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S -> {
        val context = LocalContext.current
        if (darkTheme) dynamicDarkColorScheme(context) else dynamicLightColorScheme(context)
      }

      darkTheme -> DarkColorScheme
      else -> LightColorScheme
    }

  MaterialTheme(colorScheme = colorScheme, typography = Typography, content = content)
}

package com.example

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import com.example.engine.RiftSpriteBaker
import com.example.engine.RiftVisualForgeState
import com.example.engine.SpaceObstacleStyle
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(sdk = [36])
class ExampleRobolectricTest {

  @Test
  fun `read string from context`() {
    val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
    val appName = context.getString(R.string.app_name)
    assertEquals("RIFT", appName)
  }

  @Test
  fun `build103 custom 5pct scale adjusters survival spreadsheet and gaussian splat state work`() {
    val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
    val prefs = com.example.data.LocalPilotPrefs(context)
    prefs.recordCompletedShipLife(
      record =
        com.example.data.CompletedShipLifeRecord(
          shipId = 1,
          shipName = "VIPER",
          aliveDurationSec = 42.5f,
          isLocalPilot = true,
          isHuman = true,
          modeId = "CUSTOM_RIFT",
          isCustomGame = true,
          damageTakenScalePct = 65,
          weaponFluxCostScalePct = 40,
          endReason = "ELIMINATED",
        ),
      uid = "test_u103",
    )
    val summary = prefs.getPilotSurvivalTelemetrySummary("test_u103")
    assertTrue(summary.perShip.first { it.shipId == 1 }.completedLives >= 1)
    val html = prefs.exportSurvivalTelemetryHtmlSpreadsheet("PILOT103", 120, "test_u103")
    assertTrue(html.contains("VIPER") && html.contains("applyFilters"))

    val customCfg =
      com.example.engine.CustomGameConfig(
        instanceId = "pub_test103",
        title = "TEST CUSTOM RIFT",
        hostCallsign = "PILOT103",
        baseMode = com.example.engine.RankedGameMode.SECTOR_CONVERGENCE,
        damageTakenScalePct = 65,
        weaponFluxCostScalePct = 40,
      )
    assertEquals(65, customCfg.damageTakenScalePct)
    assertEquals(40, customCfg.weaponFluxCostScalePct)

    val splatRecipe =
      com.example.engine.VisualElementRecipe.defaultFor(com.example.engine.ForgeElementTarget.RIFT_PLASMA)
        .copy(splatSoftness = 1.35f, splatRadiusMult = 1.25f)
    assertEquals(1.35f, splatRecipe.splatSoftness, 0.01f)
    RiftVisualForgeState.resetAllVisualTargetsToDefault()
  }

  @Test
  fun `riftSpriteBaker and AuthSafeHarborRadarShowcase assets initialize and render without ExceptionInInitializerError`() {
    assertTrue(RiftVisualForgeState.visualRevision >= 0)
    assertTrue(RiftSpriteBaker.customShip9Version >= 1)
    assertNotNull(RiftSpriteBaker.safeZoneStationBitmap)
    assertNotNull(RiftSpriteBaker.supplyPodFrameBitmap)
    assertNotNull(RiftSpriteBaker.fluxIconBitmap)
    assertNotNull(RiftSpriteBaker.resonanceIconBitmap)
    assertNotNull(RiftSpriteBaker.riftShardIconBitmap)
    assertNotNull(RiftSpriteBaker.getRiftAnomalyIconBitmap("plasma_rift"))
    assertNotNull(RiftSpriteBaker.getRiftAnomalyIconBitmap("repulsor_rift"))
    assertNotNull(RiftSpriteBaker.getRiftAnomalyIconBitmap("gravity_rift"))
    assertNotNull(RiftSpriteBaker.getRiftAnomalyIconBitmap("phase_rift"))
    assertNotNull(RiftSpriteBaker.getRiftAnomalyIconBitmap("unstable_rift"))

    for (shipId in 1..10) {
      assertNotNull(RiftSpriteBaker.getShipSprite(shipId, isAllied = true, isHitFlashing = false))
      assertNotNull(RiftSpriteBaker.getShipSprite(shipId, isAllied = false, isHitFlashing = false))
    }

    assertNotNull(RiftSpriteBaker.getSpaceObstacleBitmap(SpaceObstacleStyle.ORBITAL_STATION, 0))
    assertNotNull(RiftSpriteBaker.getNexusHubModuleEmblemBitmap("HANGAR_DECK", activeShipId = 1))

    // Exercise the exact Safe-Harbor Holo-Ring & Playfield Rift Canvas calls used by AuthScreen & Arena
    val testBmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(128, 128, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
    val testCanvas = Canvas(testBmp)
    RiftSpriteBaker.drawSafeZoneStationHoloRing(
      c = testCanvas,
      cx = 64f,
      cy = 64f,
      stationRadius = 48f,
      timeSec = 1.25f,
      isLockedOut = false,
      alphaScale = 1f,
    )
    RiftSpriteBaker.drawUnstableMergedRiftOnCanvas(
      canvas = testCanvas,
      cx = 64f,
      cy = 64f,
      r = 36f,
      spinAngle = 0.5f,
      pulsePhase = 0.4f,
    )
  }
}

### FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/RiftAuditConsistencyTest.kt
```
package com.example

import android.content.Context
import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import com.example.data.LocalPilotPrefs
import com.example.data.UgcModeration
import com.example.engine.AnomalyType
import com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState
import com.example.engine.RiftCodex
import com.example.engine.RiftGameEngine
import com.example.engine.RiftSoundSynthesizer
import com.example.engine.SpatialAnomalyEntity
import com.example.engine.WallRect
import kotlin.math.hypot
import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(sdk = [36])
class RiftAuditConsistencyTest {

  private lateinit var context: Context
  private lateinit var engine: RiftGameEngine

  @Before
  fun setUp() {
    context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext()
    RiftCalibrationState.resetAll(context = null, engine = null)
    engine = RiftGameEngine(sfx = RiftSoundSynthesizer())
    engine.rebuildRosterForMode("FFA")
    engine.anomalies.clear()
    engine.walls.clear()
  }

  @After
  fun tearDown() {
    RiftCalibrationState.resetAll(context = null, engine = null)
  }

  @Test
  fun `zero friction coasting persists when left stick is released and only brakes via manual button`() {
    engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(1, forceFromHangar = true)
    val player = engine.localPlayer
    player.x = 2000f
    player.y = 2000f
    player.vx = 420f
    player.vy = -160f

    // Ensure no stick drag and no manual brake: velocity must NOT decay over multiple updates
    engine.leftStickActive = false
    engine.leftStickMag = 0f
    repeat(10) { engine.stepSimulation(0.016f) }
    assertFalse(engine.autoBraking)
    assertEquals(420f, player.vx, 1.0f)
    assertEquals(-160f, player.vy, 1.0f)

    // Engaging manual [BRAKE] slows velocity down cleanly
    engine.engageManualBrake()
    assertTrue(engine.autoBraking)
    repeat(15) { engine.stepSimulation(0.016f) }
    assertTrue(hypot(player.vx, player.vy) < hypot(420f, -160f) * 0.7f)
  }

  @Test
  fun `viper phase dash cancels brake raises speed cap and primes overcharge`() {
    engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(1, forceFromHangar = true)
    val player = engine.localPlayer
    player.x = 2200f
    player.y = 2200f
    player.vx = 250f
    player.vy = 0f
    player.angle = 0f
    player.bombTimer = 0f
    player.flux = player.maxFlux
    engine.engageManualBrake()
    assertTrue(engine.autoBraking)

    engine.fireSecondaryBomb(player, 0f)

    assertFalse(engine.autoBraking)
    assertTrue(player.phaseDashTimer > 0.30f)
    assertTrue(player.phaseShieldTimer > 0.50f)
    assertTrue(player.sniperOverchargeReady)
    val speedAfter = hypot(player.vx, player.vy)
    assertTrue("Phase Dash speed should exceed normal topSpeed", speedAfter > player.spec.topSpeed)

    // Advance physics a few frames while Phase Dash window is active: burst speed must not be clamped to topSpeed
    repeat(5) { engine.stepSimulation(0.016f) }
    assertTrue(hypot(player.vx, player.vy) > player.spec.topSpeed)
  }

  @Test
  fun `disruptor cloak and zero-flux decloak emp work on button tap and primary fire pull`() {
    engine.anomalies.clear()
    engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(6, forceFromHangar = true)
    val player = engine.localPlayer
    player.x = 2000f
    player.y = 2000f
    player.flux = 400f
    assertFalse(player.isCloaked)

    // Enemy within 220px radius
    val enemy = engine.ships.first { !it.isLocalPlayer }
    engine.ships.retainAll { it === player || it === enemy }
    enemy.respawnTimer = 0f
    enemy.x = 2120f
    enemy.y = 2000f
    enemy.flux = enemy.maxFlux
    val enemyStartFlux = enemy.flux

    // Tap to cloak
    engine.fireSecondaryBomb(player, 0f)
    assertTrue(player.isCloaked)

    // Drop Flux below 350 (above 150 floor) and pull Primary Fire trigger -> must still detonate EMP at 0 Flux cost
    player.flux = 240f
    player.gunTimer = 0f
    val shockwavesBefore = engine.shockwaves.size
    engine.firePrimaryGun(player)

    assertFalse(player.isCloaked)
    // Only primary gun cost is deducted; EMP Pulse itself costs 0 Flux
    assertEquals(240f - player.spec.primaryCost, player.flux, 0.5f)
    assertTrue(engine.shockwaves.size > shockwavesBefore)
    assertTrue("Enemy Flux should drop by 25% Max Flux", enemy.flux < enemyStartFlux)
    assertTrue("Enemy should receive 2.0s EMP recharge lock", enemy.empTimer >= 1.9f)
  }

  @Test
  fun `disruptor 150 flux safety floor breaks cloak without firing emp`() {
    engine.anomalies.clear()
    engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(6, forceFromHangar = true)
    val player = engine.localPlayer
    player.x = 2000f
    player.y = 2000f
    player.isCloaked = true
    player.flux = 152f

    // Isolate target enemy from unrelated AI combat and set Flux below max to verify recharge stays intact
    val enemy = engine.ships.first { !it.isLocalPlayer }
    engine.ships.retainAll { it === player || it === enemy }
    enemy.respawnTimer = 0f
    enemy.x = 2100f
    enemy.y = 2000f
    enemy.empTimer = 0f
    enemy.gunTimer = 5f
    enemy.bombTimer = 5f
    enemy.flux = enemy.maxFlux * 0.5f
    val enemyStartFlux = enemy.flux

    // Tick enough 36 Flux/s cloak drain (3.6 Flux over 0.10s) to cross <= 150 Flux threshold
    engine.stepSimulation(0.10f)
    assertFalse(player.isCloaked)
    assertTrue("Forced uncloak must not drain enemy Flux with EMP", enemy.flux >= enemyStartFlux)
    assertTrue("Forced uncloak must not apply EMP recharge lock", enemy.empTimer <= 0.01f)
  }

  @Test
  fun `dynamic buff cap scales by mode override`() {
    RiftCalibrationState.buffTargetCountOverride = null
    RiftCalibrationState.buffModeOverride = "3V3"
    assertEquals(12, engine.getEffectiveBuffCap())
    RiftCalibrationState.buffModeOverride = "5V5"
    assertEquals(10, engine.getEffectiveBuffCap())
    RiftCalibrationState.buffModeOverride = "10V10"
    assertEquals(20, engine.getEffectiveBuffCap())
    RiftCalibrationState.buffModeOverride = "FFA"
    assertEquals(40, engine.getEffectiveBuffCap())
  }

  @Test
  fun `phase rift pair warps aim bounce raycast trajectories between Node A and Node B`() {
    engine.walls.clear()
    engine.walls.add(WallRect(0f, 0f, 8000f, 16f))
    engine.anomalies.clear()
    val nodeA =
      SpatialAnomalyEntity(
        id = "anom_test_a",
        type = AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_A,
        x = 2250f,
        y = 2000f,
        physicalRadius = 180f,
        partnerId = "anom_test_b",
      )
    val nodeB =
      SpatialAnomalyEntity(
        id = "anom_test_b",
        type = AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_B,
        x = 6000f,
        y = 5500f,
        physicalRadius = 180f,
        partnerId = "anom_test_a",
      )
    engine.anomalies.add(nodeA)
    engine.anomalies.add(nodeB)

    val player = engine.localPlayer
    player.x = 2000f
    player.y = 2000f
    val pts = engine.computeBounceTrajectory(player, angle = 0f, maxBounces = 2, segmentMaxLen = 540f)

    assertTrue(pts.any { it.isWarp && !it.isBounce })
    assertTrue(pts.any { it.isWarp && it.isBounce && it.x == 6000f && it.y == 5500f })
    assertTrue(pts.last().x > 6100f)
  }

  @Test
  fun `ship names codex and ugc moderation adhere to clean rift rules`() {
    val allShips = RiftCodex.getAllTenShips()
    assertEquals(10, allShips.size)
    val legacyPrefix = Regex("^[0-9]+-")
    val forbiddenWords = listOf("Energy", "NRG", "Thor", "Wormhole", "Shotgun", "Missile", "Rocket", "Decoy", "Brick")

    for (s in allShips) {
      assertFalse("Ship ${s.name} must not have numeric prefix", legacyPrefix.containsMatchIn(s.name))
      for (bad in forbiddenWords) {
        assertFalse("Ship title contains $bad", s.primaryTitle.contains(bad, ignoreCase = true))
        assertFalse("Ship secondary contains $bad", s.secondaryTitle.contains(bad, ignoreCase = true))
      }
    }

    assertTrue(UgcModeration.containsProfanity("badshitname"))
    assertFalse(UgcModeration.containsProfanity("APEX_ACE"))
    val masked = UgcModeration.sanitizeUgcText("Good luck fuck that")
    assertFalse(masked.contains("fuck", ignoreCase = true))

    val prefs = LocalPilotPrefs(context)
    prefs.blockPilot("toxic_1")
    assertTrue("toxic_1" in prefs.getBlockedPilotUids())
    assertEquals(1, prefs.reportPilot("toxic_1", "TOXIC_PILOT", "Abusive Comms"))
  }

  @Test
  fun `eclipse ship 9 has 100 point parity and deploys two-way containment bubble`() {
    val eclipse = RiftCodex.getShipById(9)
    assertEquals("Eclipse", eclipse.name)
    assertEquals("INTERDICTOR_DOME", eclipse.bombType)
    assertEquals(320f, eclipse.bombCost, 0.1f)
    assertEquals(8.5f, eclipse.bombCooldown, 0.1f)
    assertEquals(6.0f, RiftCalibrationState.interdictorBubbleDuration, 0.1f)
    assertEquals(275f, RiftCalibrationState.interdictorBubbleRadius, 0.1f)
    assertEquals(
      100,
      eclipse.speedPts +
        eclipse.thrustPts +
        eclipse.turnPts +
        eclipse.maxFluxPts +
        eclipse.rechargePts +
        eclipse.primaryPts +
        eclipse.secondaryPts,
    )
    assertEquals(100, eclipse.totalAllocatedPoints)

    val riftFrame = RiftCodex.getShipById(10)
    assertEquals(10, riftFrame.id)

    engine.walls.clear()
    engine.anomalies.clear()
    engine.interdictorBubbles.clear()
    engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(9, forceFromHangar = true)
    val player = engine.localPlayer
    val enemy = engine.ships.first { !it.isLocalPlayer }
    engine.ships.retainAll { it === player || it === enemy }

    player.x = 2000f
    player.y = 2000f
    player.vx = 0f
    player.vy = 0f
    player.flux = player.maxFlux
    player.bombTimer = 0f

    // Deploy Eclipse Stasis Bubble at (2000, 2000)
    engine.fireSecondaryBomb(player, 0f)
    assertEquals(1, engine.interdictorBubbles.size)
    val bubble = engine.interdictorBubbles.first()
    assertEquals(275f, bubble.radius, 0.1f)
    assertEquals(6.0f, bubble.life, 0.1f)

    // 1. Inside ship attempting to cross outward beyond (radius - 36f = 239f) is clamped inside and reflected
    player.x = 2235f
    player.y = 2000f
    player.vx = 400f
    player.vy = 0f
    engine.stepSimulation(0.05f)
    val distInsideAfter = hypot(player.x - bubble.x, player.y - bubble.y)
    assertTrue("Ship inside dome must not escape perimeter", distInsideAfter <= bubble.radius - 35.5f)
    assertTrue("Ship velocity must reflect inward", player.vx < 0f)

    // 2. Outside ship attempting to enter inward within (radius + 36f = 311f) is clamped outside and reflected
    enemy.respawnTimer = 0f
    enemy.x = 2315f
    enemy.y = 2000f
    enemy.vx = -400f
    enemy.vy = 0f
    engine.stepSimulation(0.05f)
    val distOutsideAfter = hypot(enemy.x - bubble.x, enemy.y - bubble.y)
    assertTrue("Ship outside dome must not breach perimeter", distOutsideAfter >= bubble.radius + 35.5f)
    assertTrue("Outside ship velocity must reflect outward", enemy.vx > 0f)
  }

  @Test
  fun `flux core mode overcharges carrier and ejects at 1650 px per sec`() {
    engine.deployToRankedMode(com.example.engine.RankedGameMode.FLUX_CORE)
    val player = engine.localPlayer
    engine.ships.retainAll { it === player }

    // Position player outside the Safe Zone right on top of the Flux Core Orb
    player.respawnTimer = 0f
    player.x = engine.fluxCoreOrb.x
    player.y = engine.fluxCoreOrb.y
    player.vx = 0f
    player.vy = 0f
    engine.fluxCoreOrb.pickupImmunitySec = 0f

    // Step simulation so player picks up the Flux Core Orb
    engine.stepSimulation(0.05f)
    assertEquals(player.id, engine.fluxCoreCarrierEntityId)
    assertEquals(1, engine.fluxCoreOrb.overchargeTier)

    // Advance holdDurationSec to 25.0s -> Tier 5 (up to Tier 10 at 50s)
    engine.fluxCoreOrb.holdDurationSec = 25.0f
    engine.stepSimulation(0.05f)
    assertEquals(5, engine.fluxCoreOrb.overchargeTier)

    engine.fluxCoreOrb.holdDurationSec = 52.0f
    engine.stepSimulation(0.05f)
    assertEquals(10, engine.fluxCoreOrb.overchargeTier)

    // Entering the Safe Zone ejects the Flux Core at 1650 px/s with a 30.0s deceleration timer
    player.x = engine.safeZone.centerX()
    player.y = engine.safeZone.centerY()
    engine.stepSimulation(0.01f)

    assertEquals("", engine.fluxCoreCarrierEntityId)
    assertEquals(-1, engine.fluxCoreOrb.carrierShipId)
    assertTrue("Eject deceleration timer must be ~30.0s", engine.fluxCoreOrb.ejectDecelTimerSec >= 29.9f)
    val ejectSpeed = hypot(engine.fluxCoreOrb.vx, engine.fluxCoreOrb.vy)
    assertEquals(1650f, ejectSpeed, 25f)
  }

  @Test
  fun `stasis breach captures eliminated ships and prisoner core breakout releases all prisoners`() {
    engine.deployToRankedMode(com.example.engine.RankedGameMode.STASIS_BREACH, teamSizeBracket = 10)
    assertEquals(8000f, engine.westBrigGeneratorHp, 0.1f)
    assertEquals(8000f, engine.eastBrigGeneratorHp, 0.1f)

    val player = engine.localPlayer // freq = 0 (West Horizon)
    val eastVictim = engine.ships.first { it.freq == 1 }

    // Eliminate eastVictim outside the Safe Zone using a bullet from player
    eastVictim.respawnTimer = 0f
    eastVictim.phaseShieldTimer = 0f
    eastVictim.isInStasisBrig = false
    eastVictim.x = 2000f
    eastVictim.y = 2000f
    eastVictim.flux = 10f

    engine.bullets.clear()
    engine.bullets.add(
      com.example.engine.BulletEntity(
        ownerId = player.id,
        ownerCallsign = player.callsign,
        ownerSyndicateTag = player.syndicateTag,

  @Test
  fun `stage5 overlapping rifts merge into 10s unstable rift and detonate for 75 percent max flux plus shatter asteroids`() {
    engine.deployToRankedMode(com.example.engine.RankedGameMode.SECTOR_CONVERGENCE)
    val player = engine.localPlayer
    val victim = engine.ships.first { !it.isLocalPlayer }
    engine.ships.retainAll { it === player || it === victim }
    player.x = 900f
    player.y = 900f

    engine.walls.clear()
    engine.pendingAsteroidRespawns.clear()
    engine.walls.add(
      WallRect(
        x = 2480f,
        y = 2480f,
        w = 164f,
        h = 164f,
        style = com.example.engine.SpaceObstacleStyle.CRYSTAL_ASTEROID,
        hp = 2400f,
        maxHp = 2400f,
      )
    )

    engine.anomalies.clear()
    engine.anomalies.add(
      SpatialAnomalyEntity(
        id = "rift_merge_1",
        type = AnomalyType.PLASMA_RIFT,
        x = 2500f,
        y = 2500f,
        physicalRadius = 210f,
        life = 40f,
        maxLife = 60f,
      )
    )
    engine.anomalies.add(
      SpatialAnomalyEntity(
        id = "rift_merge_2",
        type = AnomalyType.REPULSOR_RIFT,
        x = 2620f,
        y = 2500f,
        physicalRadius = 210f,
        life = 40f,
        maxLife = 60f,
      )
    )

    // Step once -> overlapping non-partnered Rifts fuse into a single 10.0s Unstable Rift
    engine.stepSimulation(0.05f)
    val merged = engine.anomalies.firstOrNull { it.isUnstableMergedRift }
    assertTrue("Overlapping Rifts must merge into an Unstable Rift", merged != null)
    val unstable = merged!!
    assertEquals(10.0f, unstable.maxLife, 0.1f)
    assertTrue(unstable.life in 9.5f..10.0f)

    // Place victim inside blast radius at full Flux and trigger 0.0s Doomsday detonation
    victim.respawnTimer = 0f
    victim.phaseShieldTimer = 0f
    victim.x = unstable.x + 120f
    victim.y = unstable.y
    victim.flux = victim.maxFlux
    val fullFlux = victim.maxFlux

    unstable.life = 0.02f
    engine.stepSimulation(0.05f)

    assertEquals("Doomsday blast must deal 75% of ship Max Flux", fullFlux * 0.25f, victim.flux, fullFlux * 0.04f)
    assertTrue(
      "Doomsday blast must shatter nearby Crystal Asteroids and queue 20s respawn",
      engine.walls.none { it.style == com.example.engine.SpaceObstacleStyle.CRYSTAL_ASTEROID } &&
        engine.pendingAsteroidRespawns.isNotEmpty(),
    )
  }

  @Test
  fun `stage5 max gravity rift pulls obstacles and repulsor inner core triggers supersonic slingshot`() {
    engine.deployToRankedMode(com.example.engine.RankedGameMode.SECTOR_CONVERGENCE)
    val p = engine.localPlayer
    engine.ships.retainAll { it === p }
    engine.walls.clear()
    engine.anomalies.clear()

    val rock =
      WallRect(
        x = 2650f,
        y = 2118f,
        w = 164f,
        h = 164f,
        style = com.example.engine.SpaceObstacleStyle.CRYSTAL_ASTEROID,
      )
    engine.walls.add(rock)
    val startRockCenterX = rock.x + rock.w * 0.5f

    engine.anomalies.add(
      SpatialAnomalyEntity(
        id = "max_grav",
        type = AnomalyType.GRAVITY_RIFT,
        x = 2200f,
        y = 2200f,
        physicalRadius = 420f,
        life = 30f,
        maxLife = 60f,
      )
    )
    p.x = 6200f
    p.y = 6200f
    repeat(10) { engine.stepSimulation(0.05f) }
    val pulledRockCenterX = rock.x + rock.w * 0.5f
    assertTrue("Max-size 420px Gravity Rift must pull nearby obstacle inward", pulledRockCenterX < startRockCenterX - 3f)

    // Test Repulsor inner-core supersonic slingshot (> afterburnerSpeed)
    engine.anomalies.clear()
    engine.anomalies.add(
      SpatialAnomalyEntity(
        id = "rep_sling",
        type = AnomalyType.REPULSOR_RIFT,
        x = 6200f,
        y = 6200f,
        physicalRadius = 220f,
        life = 30f,
        maxLife = 60f,
      )
    )
    p.x = 6230f
    p.y = 6200f
    p.vx = 40f
    p.vy = 0f
    engine.stepSimulation(0.05f)
    val slingSpeed = hypot(p.vx, p.vy)
    assertTrue(
      "Repulsor inner core must launch ship faster than afterburnerSpeed (${p.spec.afterburnerSpeed}), got $slingSpeed",
      slingSpeed > p.spec.afterburnerSpeed * 1.15f,
    )
  }

  @Test
  fun `stage5 destructible crystal asteroids drop crate 10-hit station fires 16-bolt nova and stasis barriers stack`() {
    engine.deployToRankedMode(com.example.engine.RankedGameMode.RIFT_SKIRMISH, teamSizeBracket = 2)
    val p = engine.localPlayer
    engine.ships.retainAll { it === p }
    engine.walls.clear()
    engine.greens.clear()
    engine.bullets.clear()
    engine.brickWalls.clear()
    engine.pendingAsteroidRespawns.clear()

    // 1. Stack two Stasis Barriers at the same coordinates -> single BrickWallEntity with stackCount == 2
    p.x = 1500f
    p.y = 1500f
    p.angle = 0f
    p.specialWeaponType = "STASIS_BARRIER"
    p.specialWeaponCharges = 1
    engine.activateUtility("SPECIAL")
    p.specialWeaponType = "STASIS_BARRIER"
    p.specialWeaponCharges = 1
    engine.activateUtility("SPECIAL")
    assertEquals(1, engine.brickWalls.size)
    assertEquals(2, engine.brickWalls.first().stackCount)

    // 2. Destructible 2,400 HP Crystal Asteroid shatters, drops guaranteed GreenCrate, and queues 20.0s respawn
    engine.walls.add(
      WallRect(
        x = 2200f,
        y = 2200f,
        w = 164f,
        h = 164f,
        style = com.example.engine.SpaceObstacleStyle.CRYSTAL_ASTEROID,
        hp = 200f,
        maxHp = 2400f,
      )
    )
    engine.bullets.add(
      com.example.engine.BulletEntity(
        ownerId = p.id,
        ownerCallsign = p.callsign,
        ownerSyndicateTag = p.syndicateTag,
        ownerArmadaName = "",
        ownerIsHuman = true,
        freq = p.freq,
        x = 2180f,
        y = 2282f,
        vx = 1200f,
        vy = 0f,
        damage = 260f,
        bouncesLeft = 0,
        life = 1.0f,
        color = 0xFF00F5D4.toInt(),
      )
    )
    engine.stepSimulation(0.05f)
    assertTrue("Crystal Asteroid reduced to <= 0 HP must shatter", engine.walls.isEmpty())
    assertTrue(
      "Shattered Crystal Asteroid must drop a guaranteed Supply Crate at its center",
      engine.greens.any { hypot(it.x - 2282f, it.y - 2282f) < 12f },
    )
    assertEquals("Shattered Crystal Asteroid must queue a 20.0s respawn", 1, engine.pendingAsteroidRespawns.size)
    assertTrue(engine.pendingAsteroidRespawns.first().timerSec >= 19.8f)

    // 3. Orbital Station fires a 16-bolt 360-degree Station Defense Nova on the 10th impact
    val station =
      WallRect(
        x = 3200f,
        y = 3200f,
        w = 168f,
        h = 168f,
        style = com.example.engine.SpaceObstacleStyle.ORBITAL_STATION,
      )
    engine.walls.add(station)
    engine.bullets.clear()
    repeat(10) {
      engine.bullets.add(
        com.example.engine.BulletEntity(
          ownerId = p.id,
          ownerCallsign = p.callsign,
          ownerSyndicateTag = p.syndicateTag,
          ownerArmadaName = "",
          ownerIsHuman = true,
          freq = p.freq,
          x = 3180f,
          y = 3284f,
          vx = 1400f,
          vy = 0f,
          damage = 120f,
          bouncesLeft = 0,
          life = 0.5f,
          color = 0xFF00F5D4.toInt(),
        )
      )
      engine.stepSimulation(0.03f)
    }
    val novaBolts = engine.bullets.filter { it.ownerId == "station_defense" }
    assertEquals("10th impact on Orbital Station must unleash 16 radial Defense Nova bolts", 16, novaBolts.size)
    assertEquals(-999, novaBolts.first().freq)
  }
}

### FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/base/FirestoreEmulatorTestBase.kt
```
package com.example.base

import android.content.Context
import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import com.google.firebase.FirebaseApp
import com.google.firebase.FirebaseOptions
import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuth
import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuthInvalidUserException
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestore
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestoreException
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestoreSettings
import com.google.firebase.firestore.MemoryCacheSettings
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.tasks.await
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeout
import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config
import org.robolectric.annotation.LooperMode

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(sdk = [36])
@LooperMode(LooperMode.Mode.INSTRUMENTATION_TEST)
abstract class FirestoreEmulatorTestBase {

  protected lateinit var firestore: FirebaseFirestore
  protected lateinit var auth: FirebaseAuth
  protected lateinit var databaseId: String

  @Before
  open fun setUpFirebase() {
    val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
    val resId =
      context.resources.getIdentifier("firestore_database_id", "string", context.packageName)
    databaseId = if (resId != 0) context.getString(resId) else "demo-database"

    val app =
      if (FirebaseApp.getApps(context).isEmpty()) {
        val newApp =
          FirebaseApp.initializeApp(
            context,
            FirebaseOptions.Builder()
              .setApplicationId("com.game.rift")
              .setProjectId(PROJECT_ID)
              .setApiKey("fake-api-key-for-emulator")
              .build(),
          )
        val newFirestore = FirebaseFirestore.getInstance(newApp, databaseId)
        newFirestore.useEmulator(EMULATOR_HOST, FIRESTORE_PORT)
        newFirestore.firestoreSettings =
          FirebaseFirestoreSettings.Builder()
            .setLocalCacheSettings(MemoryCacheSettings.newBuilder().build())
            .build()

        val newAuth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance(newApp)
        newAuth.useEmulator(EMULATOR_HOST, AUTH_PORT)
        newApp
      } else {
        FirebaseApp.getInstance()
      }

    val emulatorAvailable = try {
      java.net.Socket().use { socket ->
        socket.connect(java.net.InetSocketAddress(EMULATOR_HOST, FIRESTORE_PORT), 500)
        true
      }
    } catch (_: Exception) {
      false
    }
    org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue(
      "Firestore emulator is not running on $EMULATOR_HOST:$FIRESTORE_PORT",
      emulatorAvailable,
    )

    firestore = FirebaseFirestore.getInstance(app, databaseId)
    auth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance(app)
  }

  @After
  open fun tearDownFirebase() {
    if (::auth.isInitialized) {
      auth.signOut()
    }
  }

  protected suspend fun signInTestUser(email: String): String =
    withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
      withTimeout(AUTH_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        val result =
          try {
            auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email, DEFAULT_PASSWORD).await()
          } catch (unused: Exception) {
            auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(email, DEFAULT_PASSWORD).await()
          }
        checkNotNull(result.user?.uid) { "User auth failed" }
      }
    }

  protected fun Throwable.unwrapFirestoreException(): FirebaseFirestoreException? {
    var current: Throwable? = this
    while (current != null) {
      if (current is FirebaseFirestoreException) return current
      current = current.cause
    }
    return null
  }

  private companion object {
    const val EMULATOR_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
    const val FIRESTORE_PORT = 8085
    const val AUTH_PORT = 9099
    const val PROJECT_ID = "demo-no-project"
    const val DEFAULT_PASSWORD = "password123"
    const val AUTH_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000L
  }
}

package com.example.data

  @Test
  fun saveAndObservePilotDossier_authenticatedOwner_succeeds() = runBlocking {
    val uid = signInTestUser(ALICE_EMAIL)
    val repo = RiftRepository(firestore)

    val saveResult =
      withTimeout(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        repo.savePilotDossier(
          PilotDossier(
            userId = uid,
            callsign = "VIPER_ACE",
            preferredShipId = 2L,
            preferredFoundry = "Independent",
            preferredMode = "FFA",
            pvpKills = 8L,
            pvpDeaths = 2L,
            pvpBountyPeak = 640L,
            allTimeKills = 25L,
            allTimeDeaths = 5L,
            allTimeBountyPeak = 1100L,
            convergencesWon = 2L,
          )
        )
      }
    assertTrue("Expected dossier save to succeed: ${saveResult.exceptionOrNull()}", saveResult.isSuccess)

    val emitted =
      withTimeout(FLOW_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        repo.observePilotDossier(uid).first { it != null && it.callsign == "VIPER_ACE" }
      }
    assertNotNull(emitted)
    assertEquals(8L, emitted?.pvpKills)
  }

    withTimeout(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS) {
      aliceRepo.savePilotDossier(PilotDossier(userId = aliceUid, callsign = "ALICE_ACE")).getOrThrow()
    }

    signInTestUser(BOB_EMAIL)
    val bobRepo = RiftRepository(firestore)
    val result = withTimeout(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS) { bobRepo.getPilotDossier(aliceUid) }
    assertTrue("Expected cross-user read to fail", result.isFailure)
    val ex = result.exceptionOrNull()?.unwrapFirestoreException()
    assertNotNull("Expected FirebaseFirestoreException", ex)
    assertEquals(FirebaseFirestoreException.Code.PERMISSION_DENIED, ex?.code)
  }

  fun saveAndObserveLeaderboard_authenticatedUsers_succeeds() = runBlocking {
    val aliceUid = signInTestUser(ALICE_EMAIL)

      withTimeout(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS) {

    assertTrue("Expected leaderboard save to succeed: ${saveResult.exceptionOrNull()}", saveResult.isSuccess)

    val entries =
      withTimeout(FLOW_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        repo.observeLeaderboard().first { list -> list.any { it.id == aliceUid } }
      }
    assertTrue(entries.any { it.callsign == "ALICE_TOP" && it.pvpKills == 12L })
  }

  @Test
  fun observeLeaderboard_unauthenticatedUser_failsWithPermissionDenied() = runBlocking {
    auth.signOut()
    val repo = RiftRepository(firestore)

    try {
      withTimeout(FLOW_TIMEOUT_MS) { repo.observeLeaderboard().first() }
      fail("Expected unauthenticated leaderboard query to fail")
    } catch (e: Exception) {
      val firestoreEx = e.unwrapFirestoreException()
      assertNotNull("Expected nested FirebaseFirestoreException, got $e", firestoreEx)
      assertEquals(FirebaseFirestoreException.Code.PERMISSION_DENIED, firestoreEx?.code)
    }
  }

  @Test
  fun saveAndObserveLivePilotState_authenticatedOwner_succeeds() = runBlocking {
    val aliceUid = signInTestUser(ALICE_EMAIL)
    val repo = RiftRepository(firestore)

    val saveResult =
      withTimeout(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        repo.saveLivePilotState(
          LivePilotState(
            userId = aliceUid,
            sectorId = "SECTOR_CONVERGENCE",
            callsign = "ALICE_ACE",
            syndicateTag = "AEX",
            armadaName = "SOLO",
            shipId = 9L,
            freq = 0L,
            x = 2400.0,
            y = 2100.0,
            vx = 180.0,
            vy = -60.0,
            angle = 1.2,
            weaponAngle = 1.2,
            isFiringPrimary = true,
            isAfterburning = false,
            isCloaked = false,
            energy = 2400L,
            maxEnergy = 2400L,
            bounty = 350L,
          )
        )
      }
    assertTrue("Expected live pilot state save to succeed: ${saveResult.exceptionOrNull()}", saveResult.isSuccess)

    val pilots =
      withTimeout(FLOW_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        repo.observeSectorPilots("SECTOR_CONVERGENCE").first { list -> list.any { it.id == aliceUid } }
      }
    assertTrue(pilots.any { it.callsign == "ALICE_ACE" && it.shipId == 9L })
  }

  private companion object {
    const val ALICE_EMAIL = "alice_rift@test.com"
    const val BOB_EMAIL = "bob_rift@test.com"
    const val DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000L
    const val FLOW_TIMEOUT_MS = 10000L
  }
}
